fields.desc_en: The ideas under soma design: the body-mind as one living whole, felt from within, and the philosophy of cultivating it.
fields.desc_zh: 身体设计背后的思想：身与心是一个从内部被感受的整体，以及修养这个整体的哲学。

subs.desc_en: Shusterman's discipline of the body as the site of sensory appreciation and self-cultivation.
subs.desc_zh: Shusterman 提出的身体美学：身体是感官鉴赏与自我修养的所在。

subs.desc_en: Leib, flesh, felt sense, the absent body: Husserl, Merleau-Ponty, Sheets-Johnstone, Gendlin, Leder.
subs.desc_zh: 活的身体、肉身、体会、缺席的身体：Husserl、Merleau-Ponty、Sheets-Johnstone、Gendlin、Leder。

subs.desc_en: Mind as lived, embodied action: Varela, Thompson, Rosch, Johnson, Lakoff, Noë, Damasio.
subs.desc_zh: 心智是活出来的具身行动：Varela、Thompson、Rosch、Johnson、Lakoff、Noë、Damasio。

subs.en: Body-Mind Oneness in East Asian Thought
subs.zh: 东亚思想中的身心一如
subs.desc_en: Shinjin ichinyo, qi and self-cultivation: Yuasa Yasuo, Ichikawa Hiroshi, Zen, Daoist and Confucian body thought.
subs.desc_zh: 身心一如、气与修身：汤浅泰雄、市川浩、禅宗、道家与儒家的身体思想。

subs.desc_en: How HCI turned to the body: Dourish, Klemmer, Hornecker, Loke & Robertson, Höök's somaesthetic interaction design.
subs.desc_zh: 人机交互如何转向身体：Dourish、Klemmer、Hornecker、Loke & Robertson、Höök 的身体美学交互设计。

fields.desc_en: The practices soma designers train in and borrow from: movement education, meditation, breath, martial and dance traditions that treat body and mind as one.
fields.desc_zh: 身体设计师修习并借鉴的实践：动作教育、冥想、呼吸，以及把身心视为一体的武术与舞蹈传统。

subs.desc_en: Feldenkrais, Alexander Technique, Body-Mind Centering, Laban/Bartenieff, Hanna Somatics.
subs.desc_zh: Feldenkrais、亚历山大技巧、身心平衡技法（BMC）、Laban/Bartenieff、Hanna 身心学。

subs.desc_en: Practices of body-mind unity from Asia: qigong, tai chi, yoga, zazen, aikido, butoh roots.
subs.desc_zh: 来自亚洲的身心合一修习：气功、太极、瑜伽、坐禅、合气道等。

subs.desc_en: Mindfulness, body scan, breathwork and contemplative practice.
subs.desc_zh: 正念、身体扫描、呼吸练习与沉思修习。

subs.desc_en: Contact Improvisation, Authentic Movement, Continuum, Halprin, Butoh, Deborah Hay.
subs.desc_zh: 接触即兴、真实动作、Continuum、Halprin、舞踏、Deborah Hay。

subs.desc_en: Focusing, Somatic Experiencing, Hakomi and body-based approaches to trauma and pain.
subs.desc_zh: Focusing（体会聚焦）、身体经验疗法（SE）、Hakomi，以及以身体为本的创伤与疼痛疗法。

fields.desc_en: How to design from the body: first-person inquiry, estrangement, somatic training of the designer, bodystorming, material exploration, articulating felt experience.
fields.desc_zh: 如何从身体出发做设计：第一人称探究、陌生化、设计师的身体训练、身体风暴、材料探索、说出被感受到的经验。

subs.zh: 第一人称与自传式方法
subs.desc_en: The designer's own felt experience as data: first-person research, autoethnography, autobiographical design.
subs.desc_zh: 把设计师自身的感受当作数据：第一人称研究、自我民族志、自传式设计。

subs.desc_en: Disrupting habitual movement and perception to notice the body anew.
subs.desc_zh: 打破惯常的动作与感知，重新注意到身体。

subs.desc_en: Feldenkrais lessons, body scans and movement practice to sharpen the designer's sensitivity (somaesthetic appreciation).
subs.desc_zh: 用 Feldenkrais 课、身体扫描和动作练习，磨练设计师的感受力（身体美学鉴赏）。

subs.desc_en: Ideating with and through moving bodies, props and play.
subs.desc_zh: 借由运动的身体、道具与游戏来构思。

subs.desc_en: Feeling materials, actuators and biosignals on the body: Soma Bits, somaesthetic toolkits, somadata.
subs.desc_zh: 在身体上感受材料、执行器与生物信号：Soma Bits、身体美学工具包、somadata。

subs.zh: 说出并评估被感受到的经验
subs.desc_en: Micro-phenomenology, body maps, soma trajectories, the Sensual Evaluation Instrument, somatic connoisseurship.
subs.desc_zh: 微观现象学、身体地图、身体轨迹、感官评估工具、身体鉴赏力。

subs.zh: 强概念、设计品质与伦理
subs.desc_en: Intermediate-level design knowledge from soma design: strong concepts, design qualities, felt ethics.
subs.desc_zh: 从身体设计中提炼的中间层设计知识：强概念、设计品质、被感受的伦理。

fields.desc_en: Interactive systems that help us feel our own body-mind more richly: soma mats, breathing lights, heat, shape-change, sound and garments.
fields.desc_zh: 帮助我们更丰富地感受自身身心的交互系统：身体垫、呼吸灯、热、形变、声音与衣物。

subs.desc_en: Systems that slow us down and direct attention inward: Soma Mat, Breathing Light, guided body scans.
subs.desc_zh: 让我们慢下来、把注意力转向身体内部的系统：Soma Mat、Breathing Light、引导式身体扫描。

subs.desc_en: Breath as input, output and shared rhythm.
subs.desc_zh: 把呼吸当作输入、输出与共享的节律。

subs.desc_en: Technology that acts on the skin and body: heat, vibration, inflatables, shape-changing surfaces.
subs.desc_zh: 作用于皮肤与身体的技术：热、振动、充气结构、形变表面。

subs.desc_en: Hearing the body: movement sonification, singing, the voice as felt.
subs.desc_zh: 听见身体：动作声音化、歌唱、被感受到的嗓音。

subs.zh: 衣物、织物与柔性可穿戴
subs.desc_en: Clothing and soft materials that sense and touch: corsets, shirts, e-textiles.
subs.desc_zh: 能感知与触碰的衣物和柔软材料：胸衣、衬衫、电子织物。

fields.desc_en: Technology that extends the felt body: extra limbs, new senses, muscles moved by computers, cyborg art, and the transhuman and posthuman ideas behind them, read from the soma rather than from the machine.
fields.desc_zh: 延展被感受的身体的技术：多出来的肢体、新的感官、由计算机驱动的肌肉、赛博格艺术，以及其背后的超人类与后人类思想——从身体出发，而不是从机器出发来理解。

subs.zh: 多出来的肢体、尾巴与假体
subs.desc_en: Supernumerary fingers, arms and tails, and prostheses that the body learns to feel as its own.
subs.desc_zh: 多出来的手指、手臂和尾巴，以及身体学会视为己有的假体。

subs.desc_en: Feeling north, sound, infrared, echolocation or other species' senses through the skin and body.
subs.desc_zh: 借由皮肤与身体感受方向、声音、红外、回声定位或其他物种的感官。

subs.desc_en: Computers that move muscles, balance and reflexes (EMS, GVS): who is acting when the body is shared with a machine.
subs.desc_zh: 驱动肌肉、平衡与反射的计算机（肌肉电刺激、前庭电刺激）：当身体与机器共享时，是谁在行动。

subs.zh: 超人体育、增强游戏与表演
subs.desc_en: Play, sport, performance and rituals with augmented, AI-read or shared bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 以增强的、被 AI 读取的或共享的身体进行游戏、体育、表演与仪式。

subs.desc_en: Artists who rebuild their own bodies with technology: Stelarc, Harbisson, Ribas, Orlan, Donnarumma.
subs.desc_zh: 用技术重建自己身体的艺术家：Stelarc、Harbisson、Ribas、Orlan、Donnarumma。

subs.desc_en: From natural-born cyborgs and the cyborg manifesto to transhumanism and its critics: what augmentation means for body-mind unity.
subs.desc_zh: 从“天生的赛博格”与赛博格宣言，到超人类主义及其批评：增强对身心一体意味着什么。

fields.desc_en: Emotion as a bodily, felt process: affective loops, biosignals as design material, interoception, and the ambiguity of body data.
fields.desc_zh: 情绪是身体的、被感受的过程：情感回路、作为设计材料的生物信号、内感受，以及身体数据的模糊性。

subs.desc_en: Systems where emotion is co-produced through gesture and response: eMoto, Affective Diary, SenToy.
subs.desc_zh: 情绪在手势与回应中被共同产生的系统：eMoto、Affective Diary、SenToy。

subs.zh: 作为设计材料的生物信号
subs.desc_en: EDA, heart rate, EMG, EEG turned into felt experience: from biodata to somadata.
subs.desc_zh: 把皮肤电、心率、肌电、脑电转化为可感受的体验：从生物数据到身体数据。

subs.desc_en: Heartbeat, gut, breath and inner sensations made perceptible or altered.
subs.desc_zh: 让心跳、肠胃、呼吸等内在感觉变得可感知或被改变。

subs.zh: 身体数据、反思与模糊性
subs.desc_en: Self-tracking reconsidered: open interpretation, ambiguity, reflection rather than measurement.
subs.desc_zh: 重新思考自我追踪：开放诠释、模糊性，重在反思而非测量。

fields.desc_en: The moving body in dance, performance, sport, play and art, and the computing built around it.
fields.desc_zh: 舞蹈、表演、运动、游戏与艺术中运动的身体，以及围绕它构建的计算。

subs.desc_en: Choreography, sensing and projection with and for dancers.
subs.desc_zh: 与舞者一起、为舞者而做的编舞、传感与投影。

subs.desc_en: Modelling movement quality: Laban effort, MOCO, interactive machine learning for movement.
subs.desc_zh: 对动作质感建模：Laban 力效、MOCO、面向动作的交互式机器学习。

subs.desc_en: Exertion games, body-centric play, physical training and sport.
subs.desc_zh: 运动型游戏、以身体为中心的玩、体能训练与体育。

subs.desc_en: Somatic performance, the singing body, opera with machines.
subs.desc_zh: 身体性表演、歌唱的身体、与机器同台的歌剧。

subs.desc_en: Art that works directly on the visitor's senses and body: Lygia Clark, Rebecca Horn, Char Davies.
subs.desc_zh: 直接作用于观众感官与身体的艺术：Lygia Clark、Rebecca Horn、Char Davies。

fields.zh: 亲密、女性主义与酷儿身体
fields.desc_en: Designing for bodies that design has ignored or made taboo: menstruation, pleasure, fertility, menopause, queer and trans bodies.
fields.desc_zh: 为设计长期忽视或视为禁忌的身体而设计：月经、愉悦、生育、更年期、酷儿与跨性别身体。

subs.desc_en: Touching and being in touch with the menstruating body.
subs.desc_zh: 触碰并贴近来月经的身体。

subs.desc_en: Pleasure, intimacy and sexual wellbeing as design topics.
subs.desc_zh: 把愉悦、亲密与性健康作为设计主题。

subs.zh: 女性主义人机交互与女性健康
subs.desc_en: Pelvic floor, fertility, pregnancy and the politics of tracking women's bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 盆底、生育、怀孕，以及追踪女性身体的政治。

subs.zh: 更年期、衰老与生命转折
subs.desc_en: Bodies changing over a life: menopause, ageing, illness.
subs.desc_zh: 一生中变化的身体：更年期、衰老、疾病。

subs.desc_en: Soma design with and for queer, trans and non-normative bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 与酷儿、跨性别及非规范身体一起、为他们而做的身体设计。

fields.desc_en: Somatic approaches to pain, rehabilitation, stress and mental health, where feeling better starts from feeling more.
fields.desc_zh: 面向疼痛、康复、压力与心理健康的身体取向：感觉更好，始于感觉更多。

subs.desc_en: Movement confidence, pain and physical rehabilitation.
subs.desc_zh: 动作信心、疼痛与身体康复。

subs.desc_en: Biofeedback, breath and body awareness for stress and mental health.
subs.desc_zh: 借助生物反馈、呼吸与身体觉察应对压力、改善心理健康。

subs.zh: 神经多样性与运动障碍
subs.desc_en: Parkinson's, stroke, autism, sensory differences.
subs.desc_zh: 帕金森、中风、自闭症与感官差异。

subs.desc_en: Bodies in care: older adults, caregivers, touch in care.
subs.desc_zh: 处在照护关系中的身体：老年人、照护者、照护中的触碰。

fields.desc_en: Intercorporeality: feeling each other's bodies through mediated touch, shared breath and heartbeat, and collective movement.
fields.desc_zh: 身体间性：通过中介的触碰、共享的呼吸与心跳，以及集体动作，感受彼此的身体。

subs.desc_en: Touch at a distance, hugs, holding hands through technology.
subs.desc_zh: 远距离的触碰、拥抱，以技术牵手。

subs.zh: 共享的呼吸、心跳与同步
subs.desc_en: Sharing biosignals and falling into rhythm with others.
subs.desc_zh: 分享生物信号，与他人进入同一节律。

subs.zh: 集体与参与式的身体经验
subs.desc_en: Groups moving, breathing and sensing together.
subs.desc_zh: 一群人一起运动、呼吸与感受。

fields.zh: 身体与机器、AI 与扩展现实
fields.desc_en: Soma design meets drones, robots, machine learning, virtual bodies and more-than-human others.
fields.desc_zh: 身体设计遇上无人机、机器人、机器学习、虚拟身体与超越人类的他者。

subs.zh: 身体美学的机器人与无人机
subs.desc_en: Drone Chi, soft and inflatable robots, robots felt through the body.
subs.desc_zh: Drone Chi、软体与充气机器人、用身体去感受的机器人。

subs.en: Soma Design with AI & Machine Learning
subs.zh: 与 AI 和机器学习的身体设计
subs.desc_en: Machine learning as a somatic material; AI that listens to the body.
subs.desc_zh: 把机器学习当作身体材料；聆听身体的 AI。

subs.desc_en: Body ownership, embodiment swaps, breath- and biosignal-driven VR/AR.
subs.desc_zh: 身体拥有感、身体互换、由呼吸与生物信号驱动的 VR/AR。

subs.desc_en: Feeling with plants, animals, weather and ecosystems.
subs.desc_zh: 与植物、动物、天气和生态系统一同感受。

modalities: 电刺激（肌肉电刺激、前庭电刺激）
多出来的肢体与身体延伸

collections.desc_zh: Kristina Höök 奠定身体设计的专著中讨论的作品与方法。

collections.zh: ACM TEI 有形、嵌入与具身交互会议

collections.desc_zh: 发表于 TEI 有形、嵌入与具身交互会议的论文与作品。

collections.desc_zh: 发表于国际运动与计算会议（MOCO）的论文与作品。

collections.desc_en: Works at New Interfaces for Musical Expression.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 NIME 新音乐表达界面会议的作品。

身体是一个活的整体：非二元的设计，用被感受的身体思考。

身体纳为己有的工具、肢体与感官，以及其中不变的那个身体。
The designer's and user's own felt experience as knowledge.
设计者与使用者的亲身感受即是知识。

慢下来、向内转、培养身体的感受力。
Making the habitual body strange so it can be felt again.
让习以为常的身体变得陌生，从而再次被感受到。
Emotion as embodied, felt and co-produced between body and system.
情绪是具身的、被感受的，在身体与系统之间被共同产生。
Actuation onto the body: heat, pressure, vibration, shape.

身体感受他人的身体，并与之共振。
Movement quality, gesture and choreography as meaning.
动作质感、手势与编舞承载意义。
Biosignals and tracking, read as open and ambiguous rather than as truth.
把生物信号和追踪数据读作开放、模糊的，而不是真相。

安适、康复与对身体的照护。
快乐、感官享受、玩性与身体的发力。

谁的身体、什么规范：女性主义、酷儿、残障与文化视角。
Soma extended to machines, other species and environments.
把身体延伸到机器、其他物种与环境。

creators.name: Noura Howell
creators.role: Assistant Professor, School of Literature, Media, and Communication, Georgia Tech
creators.bio: HCI researcher and designer who builds emotional biosensing garments and installations; PhD from UC Berkeley's School of Information, now directs the Future Feelings Lab at Georgia Tech.
creators.why: Howell's work treats biosignals as ambiguous social cues and life-affirming presence rather than as readings of what a person 'really' feels.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院文学、媒体与传播学院助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者与设计师，制作情绪生物传感服装与装置；博士毕业于加州大学伯克利分校信息学院，现主持佐治亚理工的 Future Feelings Lab。
creators.why_zh: Howell 把生物信号当作模糊的社交线索和对生命在场的肯定，而不是对人“真实”情绪的读数。

creators.name: Fannie Liu
creators.role: HCI researcher; research scientist at Snap Research during Significant Otter
creators.bio: HCI researcher who studied expressive biosignals in a PhD at Carnegie Mellon's HCI Institute and built heart-rate sharing apps for close relationships.
creators.why: Liu showed how shared heart rate can become an expressive, felt social cue between people, and where it threatens agency over one's own feelings.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；Significant Otter 期间任 Snap Research 研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，在卡内基梅隆大学人机交互研究所的博士研究聚焦“可表达的生物信号”，为亲密关系设计了心率分享应用。
creators.why_zh: Liu 展示了共享心率如何成为人与人之间可表达、可感受的社交线索，也指出它在哪些地方威胁到人对自身感受的主导权。

creators.name: George Poonkhin Khut
creators.role: Artist; Senior Lecturer, UNSW Art & Design
creators.bio: Australian artist and interaction designer who has made heart-rate, breath and brainwave biofeedback artworks since the early 2000s, for galleries and for children's hospitals.
creators.why: Khut's biofeedback art turns heart and breath into a slow, first-person practice of attending to the body-mind, citing somatic bodywork and Shusterman's somaesthetics.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；新南威尔士大学艺术与设计学院高级讲师
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家、交互设计师，自 2000 年代初起创作心率、呼吸与脑电生物反馈艺术，作品既进美术馆也进儿童医院。
creators.why_zh: Khut 的生物反馈艺术把心跳与呼吸变成一种慢下来、以第一人称关照身心的练习，并明确援引身体工作法与 Shusterman 的身体美学。

creators.name: Ana Tajadura-Jiménez
creators.role: Associate Professor, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid; lead of the i_mBODY Lab
creators.bio: Researcher in multisensory body perception who uses sound to change how people feel their own body; led the ERC project BODYinTRANSIT.
creators.why: Tajadura-Jiménez shows that the felt body is plastic: altering the sounds of one's own steps can make the body feel lighter and change mood and gait together.
creators.role_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学副教授，i_mBODY 实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 研究多感官身体知觉，用声音改变人对自身身体的感受；主持欧洲研究理事会项目 BODYinTRANSIT。
creators.why_zh: Tajadura-Jiménez 揭示了被感受的身体是可塑的：改变自己脚步的声音，就能让身体变轻，同时改变情绪与步态。

creators.name: Manos Tsakiris
creators.role: Professor of Psychology, Royal Holloway, University of London
creators.bio: Psychologist and neuroscientist of the bodily self, interoception and body ownership; leads the Lab of Action & Body.
creators.why: Tsakiris's experiments tie how well we feel our own heartbeat to how firmly we feel we own our body, grounding the self in interoception.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学皇家霍洛威学院心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究身体自我、内感受与身体拥有感的心理学家与神经科学家，主持 Lab of Action & Body。
creators.why_zh: Tsakiris 的实验把人感受自己心跳的能力与身体拥有感的稳固程度联系起来，让“自我”扎根于内感受。

creators.name: doppel
creators.role: Wearable technology company
creators.bio: London start-up founded in 2015 by four Royal College of Art / Imperial College graduates that makes a wristband emitting a heartbeat-like pulse.
creators.why: Instead of measuring the body, doppel acts on it through felt rhythm, using interoceptive entrainment to change arousal.
creators.role_zh: 可穿戴技术公司
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦初创公司，由四位皇家艺术学院 / 帝国理工学院毕业生于 2015 年创立，产品是一只发出类似心跳脉动的腕带。
creators.why_zh: doppel 不去测量身体，而是通过可感受的节律作用于身体，借内感受的同步来改变唤醒水平。

creators.name: Jean Costa
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, Cornell University)
creators.bio: HCI researcher who designed wearables that regulate emotion through false and ambient bodily feedback, working with Tanzeem Choudhury and Malte Jung at Cornell.
creators.why: Costa's work shows that what we believe about our own body signals changes what we feel, opening a design space of interoceptive suggestion.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（康奈尔大学博士）
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，在康奈尔大学与 Tanzeem Choudhury、Malte Jung 合作，设计通过虚假或环境化的身体反馈来调节情绪的可穿戴设备。
creators.why_zh: Costa 的研究表明，我们对自身身体信号的相信会改变我们的感受，由此打开“内感受暗示”的设计空间。

creators.name: Kirsten Boehner
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, Cornell University)
creators.bio: Researcher in information science and critical HCI who, with Dourish and Sengers, formulated the interactional approach to emotion in design.
creators.why: Boehner's work reframed emotion in HCI from information to be detected into experience that people make and interpret together.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（康奈尔大学博士）
creators.bio_zh: 信息科学与批判性人机交互研究者，与 Dourish、Sengers 一起提出了设计中理解情绪的“互动观”。
creators.why_zh: Boehner 的工作把人机交互中的情绪从“有待检测的信息”重新定义为人们共同创造、共同诠释的经验。

creators.name: Phoebe Sengers
creators.role: Professor of Information Science and Science & Technology Studies, Cornell University
creators.bio: Cultural theorist and technologist whose work on reflective design, affect and ambiguity shaped critical and experiential HCI.
creators.why: Sengers argued that systems should leave room for multiple interpretations of experience, a basis for designing with ambiguous body data.
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学信息科学与科学技术研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 文化理论家与技术研究者，其关于反思性设计、情感与模糊性的工作塑造了批判性与体验导向的人机交互。
creators.why_zh: Sengers 主张系统应为经验保留多重诠释的空间，这是用模糊的身体数据做设计的基础。

creators.name: Rosalind Picard
creators.role: Professor, MIT Media Lab; founder of the Affective Computing group
creators.bio: Electrical engineer who founded the field of affective computing and co-founded Affectiva and Empatica.
creators.why: Picard's programme of sensing and modelling emotion is the reference point that soma design both builds on and argues with.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室教授，情感计算研究组创始人
creators.bio_zh: 电气工程师，开创了情感计算领域，并参与创办 Affectiva 与 Empatica。
creators.why_zh: Picard 感知并建模情绪的研究纲领，是身体设计既借鉴又与之争论的参照点。

creators.name: Lisa Feldman Barrett
creators.role: University Distinguished Professor of Psychology, Northeastern University
creators.bio: Psychologist and neuroscientist who developed the theory of constructed emotion, in which the brain builds emotions from interoceptive predictions.
creators.why: Barrett's theory places interoception and the body's energy budget at the root of every feeling, undoing the split between emotion and body.
creators.role_zh: 美国东北大学心理学校级杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家与神经科学家，提出情绪建构理论：大脑依据对身体内部状态的预测来建构情绪。
creators.why_zh: Barrett 的理论把内感受与身体的“能量预算”放在一切感受的根部，拆解了情绪与身体的二分。

creators.name: A. D. (Bud) Craig
creators.role: Neuroanatomist; formerly Barrow Neurological Institute
creators.bio: Neuroanatomist who mapped the interoceptive pathway from the body to the insular cortex and wrote How Do You Feel? (2015).
creators.why: Craig redefined interoception as the sense of the physiological condition of the whole body, the ground of felt emotion.
creators.role_zh: 神经解剖学家；曾任职巴罗神经研究所
creators.bio_zh: 神经解剖学家，描绘了从身体通往脑岛皮层的内感受通路，著有 How Do You Feel?（2015）。
creators.why_zh: Craig 把内感受重新定义为对全身生理状态的感觉，这是被感受的情绪的根基。

creators.name: Sarah Garfinkel
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Neuroscience, Institute of Cognitive Neuroscience, UCL
creators.bio: Neuroscientist who studies how signals from the heart shape emotion, cognition and mental health.
creators.why: Garfinkel's model separates how accurately we sense our body from how we believe we sense it, a key distinction for any interoceptive design.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院认知神经科学研究所认知神经科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学家，研究来自心脏的信号如何塑造情绪、认知与心理健康。
creators.why_zh: Garfinkel 的模型区分了“我们感受身体有多准确”与“我们自认为感受得如何”，这是任何内感受设计都要面对的区分。

creators.name: Jérémy Frey
creators.role: Co-founder, Ullo; HCI and physiological computing researcher
creators.bio: Researcher in physiological computing and tangible interfaces (Inria, IDC Herzliya) who co-founded Ullo to make biofeedback objects.
creators.why: Frey designs objects that externalise breath, heart and brain activity so people can feel and share inner states.
creators.role_zh: Ullo 联合创始人；人机交互与生理计算研究者
creators.bio_zh: 生理计算与实体界面研究者（曾在 Inria、赫兹利亚跨学科中心），联合创办 Ullo，制作生物反馈物件。
creators.why_zh: Frey 设计把呼吸、心跳与脑活动外化的物件，让人感受并分享内在状态。

creators.name: Petr Slovák
creators.role: Reader in Human-Computer Interaction, King's College London
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on social-emotional learning, mental health and technologies that support felt, embodied skills.
creators.why: Slovák's early heart-rate sharing study named the 'physiosocial' space in which a shared body signal becomes intimate.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦国王学院人机交互高级讲师（Reader）
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，关注社会情感学习、心理健康，以及支持具身感受技能的技术。
creators.why_zh: Slovák 早期的心率分享研究提出了“生理-社会”空间：共享的身体信号在其中变得亲密。

creators.name: Joris H. Janssen
creators.role: Researcher in affective computing (formerly Philips Research / TU Eindhoven)
creators.bio: Researcher who studied heartbeats as social signals and physiological empathy at Philips Research and Eindhoven University of Technology.
creators.why: Janssen showed that a heard heartbeat is felt as intimate and can shift how close people feel to one another.
creators.role_zh: 情感计算研究者（曾任职飞利浦研究院 / 埃因霍温理工大学）
creators.bio_zh: 在飞利浦研究院与埃因霍温理工大学研究作为社交信号的心跳与生理共情。
creators.why_zh: Janssen 展示了被听见的心跳会被体验为亲密，并能改变人与人之间感到的距离。

creators.name: Mariam Hassib
creators.role: HCI researcher (LMU Munich at the time of HeartChat)
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on physiological sensing for communication and on affective and brain-computer interfaces.
creators.why: Hassib's HeartChat brings heart rate into everyday messaging as a cue for empathy.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（HeartChat 期间在慕尼黑大学）
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究用于沟通的生理传感，以及情感与脑机界面。
creators.why_zh: Hassib 的 HeartChat 把心率带进日常聊天，作为共情的线索。

creators.name: R. Michael Winters
creators.role: Researcher in sonification and auditory display (PhD, Georgia Tech)
creators.bio: Researcher in sonification and music technology who studied heartbeat sounds as expressive biosignals at Georgia Tech's Sonification Lab.
creators.why: Winters shows that hearing another person's heartbeat can be an embodied route to empathy.
creators.role_zh: 声音化与听觉显示研究者（佐治亚理工学院博士）
creators.bio_zh: 声音化与音乐科技研究者，在佐治亚理工学院声音化实验室研究作为可表达生物信号的心跳声。
creators.why_zh: Winters 的研究表明，听见他人的心跳可以是一条通向共情的具身路径。

creators.name: Marianna Obrist
creators.role: Professor of Multisensory Interfaces, University College London
creators.bio: HCI researcher who leads the SCHI Lab and studies touch, taste and smell as channels of experience and emotion.
creators.why: Obrist's work maps how felt qualities of touch and other senses carry emotion, bringing the non-visual body into interaction design.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院多感官界面教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，领导 SCHI Lab，研究触觉、味觉与嗅觉如何承载体验与情绪。
creators.why_zh: Obrist 的工作描绘了触觉等感官的质感如何承载情绪，把非视觉的身体带入交互设计。

creators.name: Jane Aspell
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Neuroscience, Anglia Ruskin University
creators.bio: Cognitive neuroscientist of bodily self-consciousness who worked with Olaf Blanke at EPFL on full-body and cardio-visual illusions.
creators.why: Aspell's cardio-visual illusion shows that inner signals like the heartbeat help decide where we feel our self to be.
creators.role_zh: 安格利亚鲁斯金大学认知神经科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究身体自我意识的认知神经科学家，曾在洛桑联邦理工学院与 Olaf Blanke 合作研究全身错觉与心-视错觉。
creators.why_zh: Aspell 的心-视错觉表明，心跳这样的内部信号参与决定我们感到“自我”在哪里。

creators.name: Chris Elsden
creators.role: Research Fellow in Design Informatics, University of Edinburgh
creators.bio: HCI researcher who studies personal data, memory and speculative design of data-driven futures.
creators.why: Elsden reframes self-tracking data as material for remembering and reflection instead of a record of performance.
creators.role_zh: 爱丁堡大学设计信息学研究员
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究个人数据、记忆，以及关于数据驱动未来的思辨设计。
creators.why_zh: Elsden 把自我追踪数据重新定义为回忆与反思的材料，而不是表现记录。

creators.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Mexican-Canadian media artist whose large-scale participatory installations use biometric signals such as heartbeat, breath and fingerprints.
creators.why: Lozano-Hemmer's pulse works turn the private rhythm of one's heart into light and sound shared in public space.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 墨西哥裔加拿大媒体艺术家，其大型参与式装置使用心跳、呼吸、指纹等生物特征信号。
creators.why_zh: Lozano-Hemmer 的“脉搏”系列把私人的心跳节律变成在公共空间中共享的光与声。

creators.name: Christian Nold
creators.role: Artist, designer and researcher
creators.bio: Artist and researcher who invented the Bio Mapping device and has run participatory emotion-mapping projects in more than 25 cities.
creators.why: Bio Mapping made skin conductance a prompt for collective storytelling about how places feel, not a verdict on feeling.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家与研究者，发明了 Bio Mapping 装置，在二十五个以上城市主持参与式情绪地图项目。
creators.why_zh: Bio Mapping 让皮肤电成为人们集体讲述“地方给人什么感受”的引子，而不是对感受的裁决。

creators.name: Christian Boltanski
creators.bio: French artist whose installations about memory, absence and death used photographs, clothing, light bulbs and sound.
creators.why: Boltanski's heartbeat archive treats the sound of a beating heart as the most intimate trace of a living person.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以照片、衣物、灯泡和声音制作关于记忆、缺席与死亡的装置。
creators.why_zh: Boltanski 的心跳档案把心跳声视为一个活着的人最私密的痕迹。

creators.name: TERMINALBEACH
creators.role: Artist duo (Peter Votava and Erich Berger)
creators.bio: Austrian artist duo of Peter Votava and Erich Berger working with audiovisual performance, biofeedback and generative systems.
creators.why: Their Heart Chamber Orchestra lets the musicians' own heartbeats write the score they play.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组（Peter Votava 与 Erich Berger）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Peter Votava 与 Erich Berger 组成的奥地利艺术二人组，创作视听表演、生物反馈与生成系统作品。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 Heart Chamber Orchestra 让乐手自己的心跳谱写他们所演奏的乐谱。

creators.name: Erin Gee
creators.role: Artist and composer
creators.bio: Canadian artist and composer who builds biosensors and robotic instruments to make emotional and bodily states audible.
creators.why: Gee's work turns the physiology of emotion into music, asking what of feeling can and cannot travel through data.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家与作曲家，自制生物传感器与机器人乐器，让情绪与身体状态可被听见。
creators.why_zh: Gee 把情绪的生理变成音乐，追问感受中哪些能、哪些不能经由数据传递。

creators.name: ORLAN
creators.role: Artist working with performance, surgery, biotechnology and robotics
creators.bio: French artist known for her surgery-performances of the 1990s and later work with cell culture, avatars and robots.
creators.why: She made cosmetic surgery a public, conscious performance, asking who owns and authors the flesh.
creators.role_zh: 以表演、外科手术、生物技术和机器人创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以 1990 年代的外科手术表演闻名，后来转向细胞培养、虚拟化身与机器人创作。
creators.why_zh: 她把整形手术变成公开而清醒的表演，追问谁拥有、谁书写这具血肉。

creators.name: Neil Harbisson
creators.role: Cyborg artist; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation and Cyborg Arts
creators.bio: Artist born with achromatopsia who hears colour through an antenna implanted in his skull.
creators.why: His antenna is a long first-person case of a new sense becoming part of perception and identity.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家；Cyborg Foundation 与 Cyborg Arts 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 天生全色盲的艺术家，通过植入颅骨的天线“听见”颜色。
creators.why_zh: 他的天线是一个长期的第一人称案例：一种新感官如何成为知觉与身份的一部分。

creators.name: Moon Ribas
creators.role: Cyborg artist and choreographer; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation
creators.bio: Catalan dancer who for years felt earthquakes worldwide as vibrations from sensors implanted in her body.
creators.why: She treats a new sense as a practice of attention and dance, not as data display.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家、编舞家；Cyborg Foundation 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加泰罗尼亚舞者，多年来通过植入体内的传感器，以振动感受全球地震。
creators.why_zh: 她把新感官当作一种注意力与舞蹈的修习，而不是数据显示。

creators.name: Kevin Warwick
creators.role: Cybernetics researcher; Emeritus Professor, Coventry and Reading Universities
creators.bio: British engineer who had an RFID chip (1998) and then a neural electrode array (2002) implanted to connect his nervous system to computers.
creators.why: His self-experiments are the engineering baseline of the cyborg body, with little attention to how it feels.
creators.role_zh: 控制论研究者；考文垂大学与雷丁大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国工程师，先后植入 RFID 芯片（1998）和神经电极阵列（2002），把自己的神经系统接入计算机。
creators.why_zh: 他的自体实验是赛博格身体的工程基线，但很少关注它被感受的方式。

creators.name: Viktoria Modesta
creators.role: Bionic pop artist and performer
creators.bio: Latvian-born British singer and performer who chose a below-knee amputation in 2007 and performs with designed prosthetic legs.
creators.why: She presents the prosthetic body as chosen, expressive and desirable rather than as a deficit.
creators.role_zh: 仿生流行艺术家与表演者
creators.bio_zh: 生于拉脱维亚的英国歌手与表演者，2007 年主动选择膝下截肢，以设计过的义肢登台表演。
creators.why_zh: 她把义体身体呈现为主动选择的、有表现力的、可被欲望的身体，而非缺陷。

creators.name: Aimee Mullins
creators.role: Athlete, actor and model
creators.bio: American Paralympic sprinter, actor and model, born without fibula bones, who owns many pairs of prosthetic legs.
creators.why: She speaks from inside the prosthetic body about choosing height, gait and identity with each pair of legs.
creators.role_zh: 运动员、演员与模特
creators.bio_zh: 美国残奥会短跑运动员、演员与模特，天生没有腓骨，拥有多副义肢腿。
creators.why_zh: 她从义体身体内部讲述：每换一双腿，就在选择身高、步态与身份。

creators.name: Lucy McRae
creators.role: Artist and body architect
creators.bio: Australian artist who calls herself a body architect and builds speculative devices, films and rituals for future bodies.
creators.why: Her works turn speculative body technology into felt, often tender experiences of pressure, scent and skin.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、身体建筑师
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家，自称“身体建筑师”，为未来的身体制作思辨性的装置、影片与仪式。
creators.why_zh: 她把思辨的身体技术变成可感受的、常常温柔的压力、气味与皮肤体验。

creators.name: Wafaa Bilal
creators.role: Artist; Professor, NYU Tisch School of the Arts
creators.bio: Iraqi-American artist whose performances expose the body to remote, networked violence and surveillance.
creators.why: He uses his own body, even surgically, to make networked distance felt as pain and exposure.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；纽约大学 Tisch 艺术学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 伊拉克裔美国艺术家，他的表演让身体暴露于远程、网络化的暴力与监视之下。
creators.why_zh: 他用自己的身体（甚至通过手术）让网络化的距离被感受为疼痛与暴露。

creators.name: Eduardo Kac
creators.role: Artist; pioneer of telepresence and bio art
creators.bio: Brazilian-American artist who made telerobotic works from the late 1980s before turning to transgenic art.
creators.why: His 1997 implant performance is an early artwork about the body entering a database.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；远程在场艺术与生物艺术先驱
creators.bio_zh: 巴西裔美国艺术家，1980 年代末起创作远程机器人作品，后来转向转基因艺术。
creators.why_zh: 他 1997 年的植入表演是关于身体进入数据库的早期艺术作品。

creators.name: Lee Bul
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Korean artist working across performance, sculpture and installation; her work addresses technology, gender, utopia and the body.
creators.why: Her Cyborg sculptures show the technological body as gendered, fragmented and vulnerable.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术家，横跨表演、雕塑与装置，关注技术、性别、乌托邦与身体。
creators.why_zh: 她的赛博格雕塑把技术化的身体呈现为被性别化的、破碎的、脆弱的。

creators.name: Mariko Mori
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Japanese artist whose photographs, videos and installations join technology with Buddhist and Shinto ideas of oneness.
creators.why: Wave UFO uses brainwaves to stage shared, meditative attention rather than control.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，她的摄影、影像与装置把技术与佛教、神道的“合一”观念结合。
creators.why_zh: 《Wave UFO》用脑电波营造共享的、冥想式的注意，而不是控制。

creators.name: Shu Lea Cheang
creators.role: Artist and filmmaker
creators.bio: Taiwanese-American net-art pioneer whose films and installations deal with surveillance, sexuality and data.
creators.why: I.K.U. imagines orgasm as data harvested from bodies, a queer, sex-positive take on the cyborg.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 台裔美国网络艺术先驱，其电影与装置关注监控、性与数据。
creators.why_zh: 《I.K.U.》把高潮想象成从身体采集的数据，是对赛博格的酷儿、性积极的诠释。

creators.name: Marcel·lí Antúnez Roca
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of La Fura dels Baus
creators.bio: Catalan artist who left La Fura dels Baus to build 'mechatronic performances' in which exoskeletons, robots and audiences control a body.
creators.why: Epizoo gives the audience his face and body to move, making involuntary movement a shared, uneasy experience.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；La Fura dels Baus 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加泰罗尼亚艺术家，离开 La Fura dels Baus 后创作“机电表演”，让外骨骼、机器人与观众共同操控身体。
creators.why_zh: 《Epizoo》把他的脸和身体交给观众去移动，让不由自主的动作成为共同的、令人不安的体验。

creators.name: Margherita Pevere
creators.role: Artist and researcher in biological art
creators.bio: Italian artist who works with living matter, bacteria and the leaking, ageing body.
creators.why: Her biomaterial practice adds decay and bodily fluids to Donnarumma's machine bodies.
creators.role_zh: 生物艺术艺术家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，以活体物质、细菌以及会渗漏、会衰老的身体进行创作。
creators.why_zh: 她的生物材料实践为 Donnarumma 的机器身体加入了腐坏与体液。

creators.name: Natasha Vita-More
creators.role: Designer and transhumanist theorist; former chair of Humanity+
creators.bio: American designer and writer who has proposed designed future bodies since the 1980s and co-edited The Transhumanist Reader.
creators.why: Her body-design proposals show the transhumanist view of the body as an upgradable platform.
creators.role_zh: 设计师与超人类主义理论家；Humanity+ 前主席
creators.bio_zh: 美国设计师与作者，自 1980 年代起提出被设计的未来身体，合编《The Transhumanist Reader》。
creators.why_zh: 她的身体设计方案展示了超人类主义把身体视为可升级平台的观点。

creators.name: Max More
creators.role: Philosopher; co-founder of the Extropy Institute
creators.bio: British-born philosopher who shaped modern transhumanism through the Extropian principles (1990s) and led the Alcor Life Extension Foundation.
creators.why: He states the transhumanist case for technological self-transformation that soma design must answer.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；Extropy Institute 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 生于英国的哲学家，通过 1990 年代的“外熵原则”塑造了当代超人类主义，曾领导 Alcor 生命延续基金会。
creators.why_zh: 他阐明了以技术自我改造的超人类主义立场，身体设计需要回应这一立场。

creators.name: Manfred Clynes
creators.role: Scientist, inventor and musician (1925–2020)
creators.bio: Austrian-born scientist at Rockland State Hospital who studied the dynamics of emotion (sentics) and co-coined 'cyborg' in 1960.
creators.why: He framed the cyborg as unconscious self-regulation that would free a person to feel and create.
creators.role_zh: 科学家、发明家、音乐家（1925–2020）
creators.bio_zh: 生于奥地利的科学家，任职于罗克兰州立医院，研究情绪的动力学（sentics），1960 年与人合创“赛博格”一词。
creators.why_zh: 他把赛博格设想为无意识的自我调节，从而让人得以自由地感受与创造。

creators.name: Nathan S. Kline
creators.role: Psychiatrist (1916–1983)
creators.bio: American psychiatrist and psychopharmacology pioneer who directed research at Rockland State Hospital.
creators.why: Co-author of the 1960 paper that named the cyborg.
creators.bio_zh: 美国精神科医生、精神药理学先驱，曾主持罗克兰州立医院的研究。
creators.why_zh: 1960 年命名“赛博格”那篇论文的合著者。

creators.name: Julian Huxley
creators.role: Evolutionary biologist; first Director-General of UNESCO (1887–1975)
creators.bio: British biologist and humanist who popularised the word 'transhumanism' in 1957.
creators.why: His short essay is the origin point of the transhumanist idea of self-directed human evolution.
creators.role_zh: 进化生物学家；联合国教科文组织首任总干事（1887–1975）
creators.bio_zh: 英国生物学家与人文主义者，1957 年推广了“超人类主义”一词。
creators.why_zh: 他的短文是“人类自主引导进化”这一超人类主义观念的起点。

creators.name: Donna Haraway
creators.role: Distinguished Professor Emerita, History of Consciousness Department, UC Santa Cruz
creators.bio: Feminist scholar of science and technology, author of A Cyborg Manifesto, When Species Meet and Staying with the Trouble.
creators.why: Her cyborg is a situated, fleshy and political body, not a mind freed from matter.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校意识史系杰出荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 女性主义科学技术学者，著有《赛博格宣言》《当物种相遇》和《与麻烦共存》。
creators.why_zh: 她的赛博格是一个处境化的、有血肉的、政治性的身体，而不是摆脱了物质的心灵。

creators.name: Andy Clark
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Philosophy, University of Sussex
creators.bio: British philosopher of embodied and extended cognition, author of Natural-Born Cyborgs (2003) and The Experience Machine (2023).
creators.why: He argues that tools and bodies form one cognitive system, the philosophical basis of the extended body.
creators.role_zh: 萨塞克斯大学认知哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国哲学家，研究具身认知与延展认知，著有《天生的赛博格》（2003）和《The Experience Machine》（2023）。
creators.why_zh: 他主张工具与身体构成一个认知系统，这是“延展的身体”的哲学基础。

creators.name: David Chalmers
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy and Neural Science, New York University
creators.bio: Australian philosopher who named the 'hard problem' of consciousness and writes on virtual worlds and machine consciousness.
creators.why: Co-author of The Extended Mind.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学哲学与神经科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚哲学家，提出意识的“困难问题”，也研究虚拟世界与机器意识。
creators.why_zh: 《延展心灵》的合著者。

creators.name: N. Katherine Hayles
creators.role: Distinguished Research Professor, UCLA; James B. Duke Professor Emerita, Duke University
creators.bio: American literary and media theorist of cybernetics, posthumanism and nonconscious cognition.
creators.why: She showed how cybernetics erased the body by treating information as disembodied, and argued for embodied posthumanism.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校杰出研究教授，杜克大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国文学与媒介理论家，研究控制论、后人类主义与非意识认知。
creators.why_zh: 她揭示了控制论如何把信息当作无身体之物从而抹去身体，并主张一种具身的后人类主义。

creators.name: Rosi Braidotti
creators.role: Distinguished University Professor Emerita, Utrecht University
creators.bio: Italian-Australian feminist philosopher of nomadic subjectivity and critical posthumanism.
creators.why: She grounds posthumanism in embodied, embedded and relational subjects, against both humanist and transhumanist ideals.
creators.role_zh: 乌得勒支大学荣休杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利裔澳大利亚女性主义哲学家，提出游牧主体与批判的后人类主义。
creators.why_zh: 她把后人类主义扎根于具身的、嵌入的、关系性的主体，既反对人文主义理想，也反对超人类主义理想。

creators.name: Don Ihde
creators.role: Philosopher of technology; Distinguished Professor Emeritus, Stony Brook University
creators.bio: American philosopher who founded postphenomenology, the study of how technologies shape perception and action.
creators.why: His 'embodiment relations' describe how a tool withdraws into the felt body, the core of soma-design thinking on technology.
creators.role_zh: 技术哲学家，纽约州立大学石溪分校荣休杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，后现象学的创立者，研究技术如何塑造人的感知与行动。
creators.why_zh: 他的“具身关系”描述工具如何隐退进被感受的身体，这是身体设计思考技术的核心。

creators.name: Nick Bostrom
creators.role: Philosopher; founding director of the Future of Humanity Institute, Oxford (2005–2024)
creators.bio: Swedish philosopher of existential risk and human enhancement, co-founder of the World Transhumanist Association.
creators.why: He gives the most cited philosophical defence of human enhancement.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；牛津大学人类未来研究所创所所长（2005–2024）
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典哲学家，研究生存风险与人类增强，世界超人类主义协会联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: 他为人类增强提供了被引用最多的哲学辩护。

creators.name: Francis Fukuyama
creators.role: Political scientist; Senior Fellow, Stanford University
creators.bio: American political scientist known for The End of History and for his critique of biotechnological enhancement.
creators.why: He is the best-known critic of transhumanism, defending a shared human nature.
creators.role_zh: 政治学家；斯坦福大学高级研究员
creators.bio_zh: 美国政治学家，以《历史的终结》及对生物技术增强的批评闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他是最知名的超人类主义批评者，捍卫共同的人性。

creators.name: Michael Sandel
creators.role: Professor of Government, Harvard University
creators.bio: American political philosopher who teaches the course Justice and served on the US President's Council on Bioethics.
creators.why: His ethic of 'giftedness' asks designers to value what the body is given, not only what it can be made to do.
creators.role_zh: 哈佛大学政府学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国政治哲学家，讲授“公正”课程，曾任美国总统生命伦理委员会成员。
creators.why_zh: 他的“天赋”伦理请设计者珍视身体被给予的东西，而不只是它能被改造成什么。

creators.name: Bernard Stiegler
creators.role: Philosopher (1952–2020); founder of the Institut de recherche et d'innovation, Centre Pompidou
creators.bio: French philosopher of technics, memory and attention, author of the Technics and Time series.
creators.why: He argues the human has always been technical: there is no pure, unaugmented body to return to.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家（1952–2020）；蓬皮杜中心研究与创新研究所创始人
creators.bio_zh: 法国技术、记忆与注意力哲学家，著有《技术与时间》系列。
creators.why_zh: 他主张人从来就是技术性的：不存在一个可以回归的、纯粹未经增强的身体。

creators.name: Hans Moravec
creators.role: Roboticist; former Research Professor, Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
creators.bio: Austrian-born roboticist known for Moravec's paradox and for predicting that human minds could be transferred into robots.
creators.why: His mind-uploading scenario is the clearest dualist position that soma design argues against.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；卡内基梅隆大学机器人研究所前研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 生于奥地利的机器人学家，以“莫拉维克悖论”及预言人类心灵可转移到机器人中闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他的“心灵上传”设想是身体设计所反对的最清晰的二元论立场。

creators.name: Vivian Sobchack
creators.role: Professor Emerita of Film, Television and Digital Media, UCLA
creators.bio: American film and media theorist who brought existential phenomenology to film and wrote about living with her own prosthetic leg.
creators.why: She writes about prosthesis from inside a body that uses one, correcting abstract cyborg talk.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校电影、电视与数字媒体荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国电影与媒介理论家，把存在主义现象学引入电影研究，并写下自己与义肢共同生活的经验。
creators.why_zh: 她从一个使用义肢的身体内部来书写义体，纠正抽象的赛博格话语。

creators.name: Laura Forlano
creators.role: Professor of Art + Design and Communication Studies, Northeastern University
creators.bio: American design researcher and writer on disability, feminist technoscience and living with an automated insulin system.
creators.why: She writes the disabled cyborg body in the first person, as care, labour and exhaustion.
creators.role_zh: 美国东北大学艺术与设计、传播学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国设计研究者与作者，研究残障、女性主义技术科学，以及与自动胰岛素系统共同生活。
creators.why_zh: 她以第一人称书写残障的赛博格身体：它是照护、劳动与疲惫。

creators.name: Allucquére Rosanne Stone
creators.role: Media theorist and artist; Professor Emerita, University of Texas at Austin
creators.bio: American media theorist, performance artist and a founder of transgender studies (also known as Sandy Stone).
creators.why: She insisted that the body does not disappear in virtual space and that virtual worlds rest on physical bodies.
creators.role_zh: 媒介理论家与艺术家；得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国媒介理论家、行为艺术家，跨性别研究的奠基者之一（又名 Sandy Stone）。
creators.why_zh: 她坚持身体不会在虚拟空间中消失，虚拟世界始终建立在物理身体之上。

creators.name: Francesca Ferrando
creators.role: Philosopher; Clinical Associate Professor, New York University
creators.bio: Italian philosopher who distinguishes philosophical posthumanism from transhumanism and teaches the posthuman.
creators.why: She gives a clear map of posthuman positions, separating embodied posthumanism from enhancement programmes.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；纽约大学临床副教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利哲学家，区分哲学后人类主义与超人类主义，讲授“后人类”课程。
creators.why_zh: 她清晰地梳理了后人类的各种立场，把具身的后人类主义与增强计划区分开。

creators.name: Dani Clode
creators.role: Augmentation designer working with the Plasticity Lab, MRC Cognition and Brain Sciences Unit, University of Cambridge
creators.role_zh: 增强设计师，与剑桥大学 MRC 认知与脑科学研究所 Plasticity Lab 合作
creators.bio: Designer who made the Third Thumb as a Royal College of Art graduate project and then developed it with neuroscientists into a research device.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师，在皇家艺术学院的毕业项目中做出 Third Thumb，之后与神经科学家合作把它发展为研究设备。
creators.why: She treats prosthetics as extensions rather than replacements, and her device became the standard probe for how the brain takes in an extra body part.
creators.why_zh: 她把假体看作延伸而不是替代；她的设备成了研究大脑如何接纳一个额外身体部位的常用工具。

creators.name: Paulina Kieliba
creators.role: Cognitive neuroscientist; formerly Institute of Cognitive Neuroscience, University College London
creators.role_zh: 认知神经科学家；曾任职于伦敦大学学院认知神经科学研究所
creators.bio: Neuroscientist who led the first study of how days of wearing a robotic extra thumb change the brain's map of the hand.
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学家，主导了第一项关于连续数天佩戴机器人额外拇指如何改变大脑手部表征的研究。
creators.why: Her study shows that augmentation is felt in the biological body too, not only in the device.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究表明，增强不仅发生在设备上，也会被原本的身体感受到。

creators.name: Tamar Makin
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Neuroscience, MRC Cognition and Brain Sciences Unit, University of Cambridge; leads the Plasticity Lab
creators.role_zh: 剑桥大学 MRC 认知与脑科学研究所认知神经科学教授，Plasticity Lab 负责人
creators.bio: Neuroscientist who studies body representation in amputees, prosthesis users and people wearing augmentation devices.
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学家，研究截肢者、假体使用者与增强设备佩戴者的身体表征。
creators.why: She asks whether technology can ever be felt as part of the body, and what the brain gives up to make room for it.
creators.why_zh: 她追问技术能否真正被感受为身体的一部分，以及大脑为容纳它要付出什么。

creators.name: Junichi Nabeshima
creators.role: Researcher, Embodied Media Project, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）Embodied Media 项目研究者
creators.bio: Designer-researcher who built Arque, a wearable robotic tail, with Yamen Saraiji and Kouta Minamizawa.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，与 Yamen Saraiji、南泽孝太一起制作了可穿戴机器人尾巴 Arque。
creators.why: Arque gives a human a body part that humans lost in evolution and asks how balance feels with it.
creators.why_zh: Arque 让人重新拥有进化中失去的身体部位，并追问有了它之后平衡是什么感觉。

creators.name: MHD Yamen Saraiji
creators.role: Researcher in telepresence and body augmentation; formerly Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (Embodied Media Project)
creators.role_zh: 远程临场与身体增强研究者；曾任职于庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科 Embodied Media 项目
creators.bio: Syrian-born researcher who built telepresence robots and extra limbs at Keio KMD, including Fusion, MetaArms and Arque.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于叙利亚的研究者，在庆应 KMD 制作了远程临场机器人与额外肢体，包括 Fusion、MetaArms 和 Arque。
creators.why: His systems let two people share one body, or one person carry more limbs, and so make body ownership a design material.
creators.why_zh: 他的系统让两个人共享一个身体，或让一个人拥有更多肢体，从而把身体归属感变成设计材料。

creators.name: Masahiko Inami
creators.role: Professor, Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology (RCAST), University of Tokyo; director of the JST ERATO Inami JIZAI Body Project
creators.role_zh: 东京大学先端科学技术研究中心（RCAST）教授；JST ERATO 稻见自在身体项目负责人
creators.bio: Augmented-human researcher known for optical camouflage, co-founder of the Superhuman Sports Society, and author of the JIZAI Body concept.
creators.bio_zh: 增强人类研究者，以光学迷彩闻名，超人体育协会的共同发起人，提出了“自在身体”（JIZAI Body）的概念。
creators.why: He frames augmentation around jizai (freedom and ease), a body that can move and extend as one wishes, which brings an East Asian ideal of freedom into cyborg design.
creators.why_zh: 他以“自在”来理解增强：一个能随心移动与延伸的身体，把东亚的自由理想带入赛博格设计。

creators.name: Nahoko Yamamura
creators.role: Designer-researcher, University of Tokyo; JIZAI ARMS team of the JIZAI Body Project
creators.role_zh: 东京大学设计研究者；自在身体项目 JIZAI ARMS 团队成员
creators.bio: Researcher who led the collaborative design of JIZAI ARMS, a wearable base with detachable robot arms that wearers can exchange.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，主导了 JIZAI ARMS 的协作设计：一个可穿戴底座，配有可拆卸、可在佩戴者之间交换的机械臂。
creators.why: Her work treats extra limbs as social objects that can be shared, not just personal tools.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究把额外肢体看作可以分享的社会性物件，而不只是个人工具。

creators.name: Domenico Prattichizzo
creators.role: Professor of Robotics, University of Siena; head of SIRSLab
creators.role_zh: 锡耶纳大学机器人学教授，SIRSLab 负责人
creators.bio: Roboticist who developed the Robotic Sixth Finger, a wearable extra finger used to restore grasp after stroke.
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学家，开发了“机器人第六指”，一种用于中风后恢复抓握的可穿戴额外手指。
creators.why: His extra finger works with a body that has lost function, so augmentation and rehabilitation meet.
creators.why_zh: 他的额外手指服务于失去功能的身体，让增强与康复相遇。

creators.name: Arvid Guterstam
creators.role: Neuroscientist and physician; formerly Brain, Body and Self Laboratory, Karolinska Institutet
creators.role_zh: 神经科学家与医生；曾任职于卡罗林斯卡学院“脑、身体与自我实验室”
creators.bio: Researcher in Henrik Ehrsson's lab who produced the illusion of owning a third arm and other body-ownership illusions.
creators.bio_zh: Henrik Ehrsson 实验室的研究者，创造了“拥有第三只手臂”等身体归属错觉。
creators.why: His experiments show that the felt body can hold more limbs than it has.
creators.why_zh: 他的实验表明，被感受的身体可以容纳比实际更多的肢体。

creators.name: Andrea Stevenson Won
creators.role: Associate Professor of Communication, Cornell University; director of the Virtual Embodiment Lab
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学传播学副教授，Virtual Embodiment Lab 负责人
creators.bio: VR researcher who, with Jeremy Bailenson and Jaron Lanier, tested how people learn to move avatars with extra or rearranged limbs.
creators.bio_zh: 虚拟现实研究者，与 Jeremy Bailenson、Jaron Lanier 一起测试人如何学会操控多出肢体或肢体被重新排列的化身。
creators.why: Her 'homuncular flexibility' studies show how fast the body schema reorganises around a new body plan.
creators.why_zh: 她的“小人灵活性”研究表明，身体图式会很快围绕一个新的身体结构重新组织。

creators.name: Hugh Herr
creators.role: Professor of Media Arts and Sciences, MIT Media Lab; head of the Biomechatronics group
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室媒体艺术与科学教授，Biomechatronics 组负责人
creators.bio: Climber and bilateral amputee who builds bionic legs; his group developed the agonist-antagonist myoneural interface (AMI), a surgery that lets prosthesis users feel their artificial joint.
creators.bio_zh: 攀岩者与双腿截肢者，研发仿生腿；他的团队发展了“主动肌-拮抗肌肌神经接口”（AMI），一种让假体使用者能感受到人工关节的手术方法。
creators.why: He argues that a prosthesis becomes part of the self only when it can be felt from within, through proprioception.
creators.why_zh: 他认为，只有当假体能通过本体感被从内部感受到时，它才会成为自我的一部分。

creators.name: Aryan Saini
creators.role: HCI researcher, Exertion Games Lab, Monash University
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学 Exertion Games Lab 人机交互研究者
creators.bio: Researcher who designs pneumatic bodily extensions that gently move the wearer's ear, hand or arm in everyday situations.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，设计能在日常情境中轻轻移动佩戴者耳朵、手或手臂的气动身体延伸装置。
creators.why: His soft extensions ask how being moved a little changes bodily awareness.
creators.why_zh: 他的柔性延伸装置追问：被轻轻带动一下，会怎样改变人对身体的觉察。

creators.name: Paul Bach-y-Rita
creators.role: Neuroscientist and rehabilitation physician (1934–2006); University of Wisconsin–Madison
creators.role_zh: 神经科学家与康复医生（1934–2006）；威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
creators.bio: Pioneer of sensory substitution who, from 1969, let blind people perceive images through touch on the back and later the tongue.
creators.bio_zh: 感官替代的先驱，自 1969 年起让盲人通过背部、后来通过舌头上的触觉感知图像。
creators.why: He showed that 'we see with the brain, not the eyes': perception is learned through the body's active exploration.
creators.why_zh: 他提出“我们用大脑而不是眼睛看”：知觉是通过身体的主动探索习得的。

creators.name: Peter B. L. Meijer
creators.role: Dutch engineer; creator of The vOICe sensory substitution system
creators.role_zh: 荷兰工程师，感官替代系统 The vOICe 的创造者
creators.bio: Engineer at Philips Research who in 1992 published The vOICe, which turns camera images into soundscapes for blind users.
creators.bio_zh: 飞利浦研究院工程师，1992 年发表 The vOICe，把摄像头画面转换成声音景观供盲人使用。
creators.why: Long-term users report visual-like experiences from sound, which makes The vOICe a test case for how senses are learned.
creators.why_zh: 长期使用者报告从声音中获得类似视觉的体验，这让 The vOICe 成为研究感官如何习得的案例。

creators.name: Saskia K. Nagel
creators.role: Professor of Applied Ethics, RWTH Aachen University; formerly Institute of Cognitive Science, University of Osnabrück
creators.role_zh: 亚琛工业大学应用伦理学教授；曾任职于奥斯纳布吕克大学认知科学研究所
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist and ethicist who, with Peter König's group in Osnabrück, first tested the feelSpace belt that lets wearers feel magnetic north.
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学家与伦理学者，与奥斯纳布吕克 Peter König 团队一起首次测试了让佩戴者感受磁北的 feelSpace 腰带。
creators.why: The feelSpace studies show that a new sense changes how space itself feels, not only what one knows.
creators.why_zh: feelSpace 研究表明，一种新感官改变的是空间本身的感受，而不只是人所知道的信息。

creators.name: David Eagleman
creators.role: Neuroscientist, Stanford University; co-founder of Neosensory
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学神经科学家，Neosensory 联合创始人
creators.bio: Neuroscientist and author who built the VEST, a vest that turns sound into vibration on the torso, and the wristband product Neosensory Buzz.
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学家与作家，制作了把声音转换为躯干振动的 VEST 背心，以及腕带产品 Neosensory Buzz。
creators.why: He popularised the idea that the brain will learn to make sense of any data fed through the skin.
creators.why_zh: 他普及了这样一个想法：通过皮肤输入的任何数据，大脑都能学会理解。

creators.name: Cyborg Nest
creators.role: Company that made the North Sense wearable (founded 2016 by Liviu Babitz and Scott Cohen)
creators.role_zh: 制作 North Sense 可穿戴设备的公司（2016 年由 Liviu Babitz 与 Scott Cohen 创立）
creators.bio: Start-up that sold the North Sense, a small device pierced onto the chest that vibrates when the wearer faces north.
creators.bio_zh: 一家初创公司，销售 North Sense：一个穿刺固定在胸前、当佩戴者面向北方时振动的小装置。
creators.why: It offered a new sense as a consumer product and collected its users' first-person accounts of living with it.
creators.why_zh: 它把新感官做成消费产品，并记录了使用者关于长期佩戴的第一人称叙述。

creators.name: Alvaro Cassinelli
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Creative Media, City University of Hong Kong; formerly Ishikawa Lab, University of Tokyo
creators.role_zh: 香港城市大学创意媒体学院副教授；曾任职于东京大学石川实验室
creators.bio: Uruguayan-born researcher and artist who made the Haptic Radar, a headband that lets wearers feel nearby objects on the skin of the head.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于乌拉圭的研究者与艺术家，制作了 Haptic Radar：一个让佩戴者在头皮上感受到附近物体的头带。
creators.why: His 'extended skin' makes the space around the body a felt part of it.
creators.why_zh: 他的“延展皮肤”让身体周围的空间成为身体被感受的一部分。

creators.name: Hiromi Nakamura
creators.role: Researcher in electric taste, University of Tokyo; formerly Miyashita Lab, Meiji University
creators.role_zh: 电味觉研究者，东京大学；曾就读于明治大学宫下实验室
creators.bio: Researcher who has spent more than a decade making taste changeable with weak electric currents, from Augmented Gustation (2011) to the Kirin Electric Salt Spoon.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，十余年来用微弱电流改变味觉，从 2011 年的“增强味觉”到麒麟的电盐勺。
creators.why: Her work treats taste, an intimate inner sense, as something technology can tune.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究把味觉这种私密的内在感觉视为可以被技术调节的东西。

creators.name: Homei Miyashita
creators.role: Professor, School of Science and Technology, Meiji University
creators.role_zh: 明治大学理工学部教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher known for playful work on taste, smell and eating, including electric taste and the licking screen Taste the TV.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，以关于味觉、嗅觉与饮食的趣味研究闻名，包括电味觉与可舔的屏幕 Taste the TV。
creators.why: He turns the chemical senses, usually ignored by interfaces, into a place for design.
creators.why_zh: 他把通常被界面忽视的化学感官变成设计的场所。

creators.name: Jas Brooks
creators.role: HCI researcher, Human Computer Integration Lab, University of Chicago
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，芝加哥大学人机融合实验室
creators.bio: Researcher who builds interfaces for smell and temperature by stimulating the trigeminal nerve in the nose.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，通过刺激鼻腔内的三叉神经来制作嗅觉与温度界面。
creators.why: Their work treats smell as an embodied, directional sense that devices can address through the body's own nerves.
creators.why_zh: 其研究把嗅觉看作具身的、有方向的感官，设备可以借由身体自己的神经去作用于它。

creators.name: Jasmine Lu
creators.role: HCI researcher, Human Computer Integration Lab, University of Chicago
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，芝加哥大学人机融合实验室
creators.bio: Researcher who works on haptics made from chemicals on the skin and on devices that live with the body.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，研究以皮肤上的化学物质产生的触觉，以及与身体共存的设备。
creators.why: Chemical haptics shows how the skin's own chemistry can be a display.
creators.why_zh: 化学触觉展示了皮肤自身的化学反应如何成为一种显示。

creators.name: Yudai Tanaka
creators.role: HCI researcher, Human Computer Integration Lab, University of Chicago
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，芝加哥大学人机融合实验室
creators.bio: Researcher who produces touch and force sensations by stimulating nerves and the brain rather than the skin.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，通过刺激神经与大脑而不是皮肤来产生触感与力感。
creators.why: His work asks where a touch is felt when it starts in the brain.
creators.why_zh: 他的研究追问：当触感从大脑开始时，它在身体何处被感受到。

creators.name: Daisuke Tajima
creators.role: Researcher in the sense of agency and human augmentation (University of Tokyo and Sony Computer Science Laboratories)
creators.role_zh: 研究能动感与人类增强的研究者（东京大学、索尼计算机科学研究所）
creators.bio: Researcher who, with Jun Nishida, Pedro Lopes and Shunichi Kasahara, studied how people feel about touches their muscles are made to perform.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，与西田惇、Pedro Lopes、笠原俊一一起研究人们如何感受被电刺激“代为完成”的触碰。
creators.why: His study maps when an assisted movement still feels like one's own.
creators.why_zh: 他的研究描绘了一个被辅助的动作在何时仍然让人觉得是自己的。

creators.name: Emi Tamaki
creators.role: Founder and CEO of H2L, Inc.; formerly Rekimoto Lab, University of Tokyo
creators.role_zh: H2L 公司创始人兼 CEO；曾就读于东京大学暦本实验室
creators.bio: Researcher and entrepreneur who made PossessedHand, which moves the fingers with electrical muscle stimulation, and founded the body-sharing company H2L.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者与创业者，制作了用肌肉电刺激驱动手指的 PossessedHand，并创立了身体共享公司 H2L。
creators.why: She has pursued 'body sharing', passing bodily experience between people through the muscles.
creators.why_zh: 她一直在推进“身体共享”：借由肌肉在人与人之间传递身体经验。

creators.name: Jun Rekimoto
creators.role: Professor, Interfaculty Initiative in Information Studies, University of Tokyo; Deputy Director, Sony Computer Science Laboratories
creators.role_zh: 东京大学情报学环教授；索尼计算机科学研究所副所长
creators.bio: HCI pioneer whose lab has produced augmented-human work such as PossessedHand and JackIn.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互先驱，其实验室产出了 PossessedHand、JackIn 等增强人类研究。
creators.why: His notion of 'human augmentation' as one person entering another's body and view shaped Japanese body-sharing research.
creators.why_zh: 他把“人类增强”理解为一个人进入另一个人的身体与视野，这塑造了日本的身体共享研究。

creators.name: Romain Nith
creators.role: HCI researcher, Human Computer Integration Lab, University of Chicago
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，芝加哥大学人机融合实验室
creators.bio: Researcher who works on EMS and haptic wearables that act on the body, such as SplitBody and JumpMod.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，研究作用于身体的肌肉电刺激与触觉可穿戴设备，如 SplitBody 与 JumpMod。
creators.why: His devices change how a movement or a jump feels by acting directly on muscles and momentum.
creators.why_zh: 他的设备通过直接作用于肌肉与动量，改变一个动作或一次跳跃的感受。

creators.name: Susumu Tachi
creators.role: Professor Emeritus, University of Tokyo; originator of telexistence
creators.role_zh: 东京大学名誉教授，远程存在（telexistence）的提出者
creators.bio: Engineer who proposed telexistence in 1980 and built the TELESAR robot series, which let an operator see, hear and feel through a remote robot body.
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，1980 年提出远程存在，并制作了 TELESAR 系列机器人，让操作者通过远方的机器人身体去看、去听、去触摸。
creators.why: Telexistence is the long-running experiment in feeling present in another body.
creators.why_zh: 远程存在是一项持续多年的实验：在另一个身体中感到自己在场。

creators.name: Cindy Hsin-Liu Kao
creators.role: Faculty member in Human Centered Design, Cornell University; director of the Hybrid Body Lab
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学以人为中心设计系教师，Hybrid Body Lab 负责人
creators.bio: Taiwanese-American designer-researcher who made DuoSkin (on-skin interfaces from gold leaf) at the MIT Media Lab and leads the Hybrid Body Lab.
creators.bio_zh: 台裔美国设计研究者，在 MIT 媒体实验室做出 DuoSkin（用金箔制作的皮肤界面），现领导 Hybrid Body Lab。
creators.why: Her 'Hybrid Body Craft' treats the skin as a cultural surface, so on-body technology is designed with body-decoration traditions and identity in mind.
creators.why_zh: 她的“混合身体工艺”把皮肤看作文化表面，让贴身技术的设计顾及身体装饰传统与身份。

creators.name: Nathan Semertzidis
creators.role: HCI researcher; PhD, Exertion Games Lab, Monash University
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；莫纳什大学 Exertion Games Lab 博士
creators.bio: Researcher who designs brain-computer integrations that turn neural activity into shared experiences, such as Neo-Noumena.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，设计把神经活动转化为共享体验的脑机融合系统，例如 Neo-Noumena。
creators.why: His work treats emotion read from the brain as something to be felt and shared, not only measured.
creators.why_zh: 他的研究把从大脑读出的情绪看作可以被感受与分享的东西，而不仅是测量结果。

creators.name: Kai Kunze
creators.role: Professor, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）教授
creators.bio: German-born wearable computing researcher at Keio KMD who co-authored the Superhuman Sports agenda.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于德国的可穿戴计算研究者，任教于庆应 KMD，是“超人体育”纲领的合著者。
creators.why: He studies how wearables can sense and extend attention, emotion and physical skill.
creators.why_zh: 他研究可穿戴设备如何感知并延展注意力、情绪与身体技能。

creators.name: Adrien Verhulst
creators.role: Researcher, Sony Computer Science Laboratories (Cybernetic Humanity Studio)
creators.role_zh: 索尼计算机科学研究所研究员（Cybernetic Humanity Studio）
creators.bio: VR researcher who studies embodiment of one or several virtual bodies with Shunichi Kasahara.
creators.bio_zh: 虚拟现实研究者，与笠原俊一一起研究对一个或多个虚拟身体的具身感。
creators.why: His dual-body experiments ask whether one person can learn to live in two bodies at once.
creators.why_zh: 他的双身体实验追问：一个人能否学会同时生活在两个身体里。

creators.name: Aaron Pengyu Zhu
creators.role: HCI researcher
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher studying reflection, contemplative traditions and non-Western epistemologies in interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 研究反思、沉思传统与非西方认识论的人机交互研究者。
creators.why: Brings Daoist stillness, resonance and emergence into HCI as design resources for embodied, relational reflection.
creators.why_zh: 他把道家的静、感应与生成带入人机交互，作为具身、关系性反思的设计资源。

creators.name: Janghee Cho
creators.role: Assistant Professor, National University of Singapore
creators.role_zh: 新加坡国立大学助理教授
creators.bio: Korean HCI researcher who studies reflection, wellbeing and everyday technology use.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国人机交互研究者，研究反思、安适与日常技术使用。
creators.why: Research on reflection in HCI opens space for Asian contemplative traditions as design knowledge.
creators.why_zh: 他对人机交互中反思的研究，为亚洲沉思传统成为设计知识打开了空间。

creators.name: Ping-Hsuan Han
creators.role: HCI researcher, National Taiwan University (Yi-Ping Hung's lab)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，台湾大学（洪一平实验室）
creators.bio: Taiwanese researcher who builds mixed reality tools for learning embodied skills such as tai chi.
creators.bio_zh: 台湾研究者，开发用于学习太极拳等身体技能的混合现实工具。
creators.why: My Tai-Chi Coaches asks how a learner can see, and so feel, a form from every side.
creators.why_zh: 他的太极教练系统追问：学习者如何从各个方向看见、进而感受一个拳架。

creators.name: Kouta Minamizawa
creators.role: Professor, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）教授
creators.bio: Haptics researcher who leads the Embodied Media Project at Keio KMD, working on telexistence, haptic transmission and shared bodies.
creators.bio_zh: 触觉研究者，主持庆应 KMD 的 Embodied Media 项目，研究远程临场、触觉传输与共享身体。
creators.why: The TECHTILE toolkit made touch into a material that anyone can record, play back and sketch with.
creators.why_zh: 他的 TECHTILE 工具包让触觉成为任何人都能录制、回放和用来构思的材料。

creators.name: Tomoya Sasaki
creators.role: Researcher, Embodied Media Project (Keio KMD) and University of Tokyo
creators.role_zh: 研究者，庆应 KMD Embodied Media 项目、东京大学
creators.bio: Japanese researcher who designs wearable robotic limbs and studies how extra limbs enter the body schema.
creators.bio_zh: 日本研究者，设计可穿戴机械肢体，研究额外的肢体如何进入身体图式。
creators.why: MetaLimbs asks how new arms come to be felt as one's own.
creators.why_zh: MetaLimbs 追问：新的手臂如何被感受为自己的一部分。

creators.name: Taro Maeda
creators.role: Professor, Osaka University; formerly NTT Communication Science Laboratories
creators.role_zh: 大阪大学教授；曾任职 NTT 通信科学基础研究所
creators.bio: Japanese researcher in human interfaces and telexistence who led the galvanic vestibular stimulation (GVS) work at NTT.
creators.bio_zh: 日本人机接口与远程临场研究者，在 NTT 主持电前庭刺激（GVS）研究。
creators.why: The NTT galvanic vestibular stimulation work showed that the sense of balance itself can be written to, not only read.
creators.why_zh: 他的 GVS 研究说明，平衡感本身也可以被写入，而不只是被读取。

creators.name: Hideyuki Ando
creators.role: Professor, Osaka University
creators.role_zh: 大阪大学教授
creators.bio: Japanese researcher and media artist working on perception, galvanic vestibular stimulation and sensory interfaces.
creators.bio_zh: 日本研究者与媒体艺术家，研究感知、电前庭刺激与感官接口。
creators.why: Turns perceptual research into art that lets visitors feel their own sensing.
creators.why_zh: 他把感知研究转化为艺术，让观众感受到自己的感知过程。

creators.name: Jun Nishida
creators.role: Assistant Professor, University of Maryland; director of the Embodied Dynamics Lab
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学助理教授，Embodied Dynamics Lab 主任
creators.bio: Japanese researcher who designs wearables that let people borrow each other's bodies: EMS devices that share muscle activity and rigs that give you a child's eye height; previously at the University of Tsukuba and the University of Chicago.
creators.bio_zh: 日本研究者，设计让人“借用”彼此身体的可穿戴设备：共享肌肉活动的电刺激装置、给你儿童视高的头戴装置；曾在筑波大学与芝加哥大学工作。
creators.why: The devices make another person's bodily experience felt in one's own body, a technology of kinesthetic empathy.
creators.why_zh: 他的设备让他人的身体经验在自己的身体里被感受到，是一种动觉共情的技术。

creators.name: Shunichi Kasahara
creators.role: Researcher, Sony Computer Science Laboratories; Cybernetic Humanity Studio
creators.role_zh: 索尼计算机科学研究所研究员，Cybernetic Humanity Studio
creators.bio: Japanese researcher who studies the sense of agency and self in human augmentation.
creators.bio_zh: 日本研究者，研究人类增强中的能动感与自我感。
creators.why: Asks when a movement assisted by a machine still feels like 'I did it'.
creators.why_zh: 他追问：一个由机器辅助完成的动作，何时仍然让人感到“是我做的”。

creators.name: Shigeo Yoshida
creators.role: Researcher, OMRON SINIC X; formerly University of Tokyo
creators.role_zh: OMRON SINIC X 研究员；曾任职东京大学
creators.bio: Japanese researcher on how altered bodily feedback, such as one's own facial expression, changes emotion and behaviour.
creators.bio_zh: 日本研究者，研究被改变的身体反馈（如自己的表情）如何改变情绪与行为。
creators.why: The Incendiary Reflection mirror shows that emotion can travel from the felt face inward, not only from mind to face.
creators.why_zh: 他的镜子作品说明，情绪可以从被感知的脸向内传递，而不只是从心到脸。

creators.name: Kyung Yun Choi
creators.role: Researcher; PhD, MIT Media Lab
creators.role_zh: 研究者，MIT 媒体实验室博士
creators.bio: Korean designer-researcher who builds tactile and pneumatic wearables that guide heart rate and breathing through gentle rhythms on the skin.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国设计研究者，开发触觉与气动可穿戴设备，通过皮肤上的柔和节律引导心率与呼吸。
creators.why: These devices regulate the body by offering it a rhythm to fall into, rather than by instructing the mind.
creators.why_zh: 她的设备通过给身体一个可以跟随的节律来调节身体，而不是向头脑发出指令。

creators.name: Zhuying Li
creators.role: HCI researcher; PhD, Exertion Games Lab (RMIT and Monash)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；Exertion Games Lab（RMIT、莫纳什大学）博士
creators.bio: Chinese HCI researcher whose doctoral work founded 'ingestible play', games played with sensors swallowed into the body.
creators.bio_zh: 中国人机交互研究者，其博士研究开创了“可吞咽游戏”：用吞入体内的传感器进行的游戏。
creators.why: Ingestible play turns the inside of the body, usually invisible and unfelt, into a playground.
creators.why_zh: 她把平时看不见、也感觉不到的身体内部变成了游戏场。

creators.name: Xinglin Sun
creators.role: HCI researcher
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher who designs embodied probes for adolescent mental health.
creators.bio_zh: 设计面向青少年心理健康的具身探针的人机交互研究者。
creators.why: The Embodied Probes workshops let teenage girls speak about stress through their bodies before words.
creators.why_zh: 她的工作坊让少女先用身体、再用语言谈论压力。

creators.name: Ziyue Piao
creators.role: Researcher, McGill University (Input Devices and Music Interaction Laboratory)
creators.role_zh: 麦吉尔大学研究者（输入设备与音乐交互实验室）
creators.bio: Researcher in music technology who studies performers' breathing and somatic experience.
creators.bio_zh: 音乐科技研究者，研究演奏者的呼吸与身体经验。
creators.why: Breathing Mirror connects breath data to performers' own first-person recall of what their body did.
creators.why_zh: 她把呼吸数据与演奏者对自己身体的第一人称回忆联系起来。

creators.name: Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.role: Researcher, University of Oxford; founder of Reality Design Lab; inventor of HoloKit
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学研究者；Reality Design Lab 创始人；HoloKit 发明者
creators.bio: Designer and researcher (Tsinghua BS, Stanford MS in AI) who leads Reality Design Lab's work on embodied, social mixed reality and XR soma design; his group's works have been shown at SIGGRAPH, CHI, TEI and Ars Electronica.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师与研究者（清华大学本科、斯坦福大学人工智能硕士），主持 Reality Design Lab 关于具身、社交混合现实与 XR 身体设计的研究；团队作品在 SIGGRAPH、CHI、TEI 与 Ars Electronica 展出。
creators.why: Reality Design Lab treats mixed reality as a medium for intercorporeal, felt experience and teaches XR soma design.
creators.why_zh: 他把混合现实当作身体间的、被感受的经验媒介，并教授 XR 身体设计课程。

creators.name: Rem RunGu Lin
creators.role: Media artist and researcher; Reality Design Lab collaborator
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家与研究者；Reality Design Lab 合作者
creators.bio: Media artist and researcher who combines contact improvisation, neurofeedback and mixed reality; co-teaches XR soma design with Botao Amber Hu.
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家与研究者，把接触即兴、神经反馈与混合现实结合；与胡博涛合作教授 XR 身体设计。
creators.why: Cell Space extends intercorporeality from touching bodies to shared biosignals.
creators.why_zh: 他的作品把身体间性从相互触碰的身体延伸到共享的生物信号。

creators.name: Ke Huang
creators.role: Artist and designer; Reality Design Lab collaborator
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师；Reality Design Lab 合作者
creators.bio: Designer who directs Reality Design Lab's kinetic and machine-vision installations Cybroc and Body Oracle.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师，主导 Reality Design Lab 的动态与机器视觉装置《Cybroc》和《Body Oracle》。
creators.why: Body Oracle turns postures into written characters, asking how a script could make bodies more aware of one another.
creators.why_zh: 《Body Oracle》把姿势变成文字，追问一种书写系统如何让身体更觉察彼此。

creators.name: Danlin Huang
creators.role: Artist, designer-researcher and AR developer; Reality Design Lab
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计研究者与 AR 开发者；Reality Design Lab
creators.bio: Trained in industrial design and media art at the China Academy of Art; uses XR, biosensors and AI to enrich bodily experience; lead designer of FeltSight.
creators.bio_zh: 毕业于中国美术学院工业设计与媒体艺术专业，用 XR、生物传感与 AI 丰富身体经验；FeltSight 的主设计师。
creators.why: FeltSight designs for touch and proximity as ways of knowing, shifting attention away from vision.
creators.why_zh: 她把触觉与接近感作为认识方式来设计，把注意力从视觉转开。

creators.name: WhiteFeather Hunter
creators.role: Bioartist and researcher
creators.role_zh: 生物艺术家、研究者
creators.bio: Artist and researcher working with tissue culture, bioart and feminist technoscience.
creators.bio_zh: 从事组织培养、生物艺术与女性主义技术科学的艺术家与研究者。
creators.why: Sentient Clit, made with Jiabao Li, grows tissue from menstrual cells to question who owns pleasure in biotech.
creators.why_zh: 她与李佳宝一起用经血细胞培养组织，追问生物技术中谁拥有愉悦。

creators.name: Dianya Mia Hua
creators.role: HCI and design researcher
creators.role_zh: 人机交互与设计研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on somaesthetic, feminist and disability-informed design for sexual wellbeing.
creators.bio_zh: 研究身体美学、女性主义与残障视角下性健康设计的人机交互研究者。
creators.why: Uses the researcher's own body and embroidery as design resources for women's pleasure.
creators.why_zh: 以研究者自己的身体与刺绣作为女性愉悦设计的资源。

creators.name: Wonjun Lee
creators.role: Design researcher; KAIST Department of Industrial Design (at the time of the study)
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者；研究时就读于韩国科学技术院工业设计系
creators.bio: Korean design researcher who, with Youn-kyung Lim and Richard Shusterman, tested somaesthetic practice as preparation for product ideation.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国设计研究者，与 Youn-kyung Lim 和 Richard Shusterman 合作，检验身体美学练习作为产品构思前准备的效果。
creators.why: One of the first empirical studies of training designers' somaesthetic awareness before they design.
creators.why_zh: 最早在设计之前训练设计者身体美学觉察力的实证研究之一。

creators.name: Michi Kanda
creators.role: Researcher, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）研究者
creators.bio: Japanese researcher designing somaesthetic toolkits with and for people with visual impairment.
creators.bio_zh: 日本研究者，与视障人士一起、为视障人士设计身体美学工具包。
creators.why: Treats the heightened somatic sensitivity of blind and low-vision people as expertise for soma design.
creators.why_zh: 把盲人与低视力人士更敏锐的身体感受力视为身体设计的专长。

creators.name: Sputniko! (Hiromi Ozaki)
creators.role: Artist and designer
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师
creators.bio: Japanese artist and designer (born 1985) known for speculative films and devices about technology and gender; trained in Design Interactions at the Royal College of Art.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家与设计师（1985 年生），以关于技术与性别的思辨影片和装置闻名，毕业于英国皇家艺术学院设计互动专业。
creators.why: Menstruation Machine lets people who do not menstruate feel its pain and bleeding in their own body.
creators.why_zh: 《月经机器》让不来月经的人在自己身体上感受月经的疼痛与出血。

creators.name: Haiyan Zhang
creators.role: Designer and engineer; Director of Innovation, Microsoft Research
creators.role_zh: 设计师与工程师；微软研究院创新总监
creators.bio: China-born Australian designer and engineer at Microsoft Research who builds assistive and playful technologies; featured on the BBC's Big Life Fix.
creators.bio_zh: 生于中国的澳大利亚设计师与工程师，在微软研究院开发辅助性与游戏性的技术，曾参与 BBC 节目《Big Life Fix》。
creators.why: The Emma Watch shows how a vibration felt on the wrist can quiet a tremor enough for a designer with Parkinson's to draw again.
creators.why_zh: Emma Watch 说明了腕部被感受到的振动如何能平息震颤，让一位帕金森病设计师重新画画。

creators.name: Takanori Shibata
creators.role: Chief senior research scientist, AIST (National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology)
creators.role_zh: 日本产业技术综合研究所首席研究员
creators.bio: Japanese roboticist who has developed PARO, a therapeutic seal robot, since 1993.
creators.bio_zh: 日本机器人学家，自 1993 年起开发治疗型海豹机器人 PARO。
creators.why: PARO is a robot meant to be touched and held, bringing animal-assisted calm to people in care.
creators.why_zh: PARO 是一台为被抚摸、被抱着而设计的机器人，把类似动物辅助疗法的安定带给被照护的人。

creators.name: Yuasa Yasuo
creators.role: Philosopher (1925–2005); professor at Osaka, Tsukuba and Obirin universities
creators.role_zh: 哲学家（1925–2005），曾任大阪大学、筑波大学、樱美林大学教授
creators.bio: Japanese philosopher, a student of Watsuji Tetsurō, who wrote on the body, ki, self-cultivation and Jungian psychology; his 1977 book on the body became the main English-language source on Eastern mind-body theory.
creators.bio_zh: 日本哲学家，师从和辻哲郎，研究身体、气、修行与荣格心理学；他 1977 年的《身体》一书成为英语世界了解东方身心论的主要来源。
creators.why: He argued that body-mind unity is not a given fact but an achievement of long practice, which is exactly what soma design asks designers to cultivate.
creators.why_zh: 他指出身心一如不是天生的事实，而是长期修行才能达到的状态，这正是身体设计要求设计者培养的能力。

creators.name: Ichikawa Hiroshi
creators.role: Philosopher (1931–2002); professor at Meiji University
creators.role_zh: 哲学家（1931–2002），明治大学教授
creators.bio: Japanese phenomenologist of the body who proposed the 'body as spirit' and the concept of mi, the lived body-self that extends into tools, others and the world.
creators.bio_zh: 日本身体现象学家，提出“作为精神的身体”以及“身”的概念：活的身体-自我会延伸到工具、他人与世界之中。
creators.why: His mi gives designers a Japanese word for the soma: a body that is at once flesh, self and relation, never a mere object.
creators.why_zh: 他的“身”为设计者提供了一个描述 soma 的日语概念：身体同时是肉身、自我与关系，而从来不只是对象。

creators.name: Nishida Kitarō
creators.role: Philosopher (1870–1945), founder of the Kyoto School
creators.role_zh: 哲学家（1870–1945），京都学派创始人
creators.bio: Founder of modern Japanese philosophy, known for 'pure experience', the logic of basho (place) and 'action-intuition' (kōiteki chokkan).
creators.bio_zh: 日本现代哲学的奠基人，以“纯粹经验”、场所逻辑和“行为的直观”闻名。
creators.why: Action-intuition describes knowing that happens through bodily making, the ground for Yuasa's and Ichikawa's body theories and for designing by doing.
creators.why_zh: “行为的直观”描述了在身体的制作中发生的认识，是汤浅泰雄、市川浩身体论的基础，也是“在做中设计”的哲学根据。

creators.name: Dōgen Zenji
creators.role: Zen master (1200–1253), founder of Japanese Sōtō Zen
creators.role_zh: 禅师（1200–1253），日本曹洞宗开祖
creators.bio: Japanese Buddhist monk who brought Caodong Chan from Song China to Japan, founded Eiheiji and wrote the Shōbōgenzō and the Fukanzazengi.
creators.bio_zh: 日本佛教僧人，从宋代中国带回曹洞禅，创建永平寺，著有《正法眼藏》与《普劝坐禅仪》。
creators.why: His phrase shinjin ichinyo, body and mind as one, and his just-sitting practice are the classical source of the body-mind unity that soma design builds on.
creators.why_zh: 他提出的“身心一如”以及只管打坐的修行，是身体设计所依据的身心一体思想的经典来源。

creators.name: Zhuangzi
creators.role: Daoist philosopher (c. 369–286 BCE)
creators.role_zh: 道家哲学家（约前 369–前 286）
creators.bio: Warring States thinker whose book, the Zhuangzi, uses stories of craftsmen, butchers and swimmers to show skill as effortless, attuned action.
creators.bio_zh: 战国时期思想家，《庄子》一书借庖丁、匠人、游水者的故事，展示技艺如何成为顺势而为、与物相应的行动。
creators.why: His craftsmen who work 'with spirit, not with the eyes' describe the tacit, felt skill that soma designers want to support rather than replace.
creators.why_zh: 庄子笔下“以神遇而不以目视”的匠人，描述了一种默会的、被感受的技艺，这正是身体设计想要支持而不是取代的东西。

creators.name: Mencius
creators.role: Confucian philosopher (c. 372–289 BCE)
creators.role_zh: 儒家哲学家（约前 372–前 289）
creators.bio: Second great Confucian thinker, who taught that human nature is good and that moral life is nourished like a body, through qi and daily cultivation.
creators.bio_zh: 儒家亚圣，主张性善，认为道德生命如身体一般需要以气与日常修养来滋养。
creators.why: His 'flood-like qi' ties moral feeling, breath and bodily vigour into one process, an early non-dualist account of the ethical soma.
creators.why_zh: 他所说的“浩然之气”把道德感、呼吸与身体的元气连成一个过程，是对伦理身体的早期非二元描述。

creators.name: Huangdi Neijing authors (anonymous)
creators.role: Anonymous physicians of the Warring States and Han periods
creators.role_zh: 战国至汉代的佚名医家
creators.bio: The Inner Classic of the Yellow Emperor was compiled by unnamed physicians between roughly the 3rd century BCE and the 1st century BCE and framed as dialogues between the Yellow Emperor and his ministers.
creators.bio_zh: 《黄帝内经》由佚名医家在约公元前 3 世纪至前 1 世纪间编成，以黄帝与岐伯等臣子问答的形式写成。
creators.why: The classic that grounds Chinese medicine in qi, meridians and the correspondence of emotions and organs, a body-mind map still used in qigong and tai chi.
creators.why_zh: 这部经典以气、经络以及情志与脏腑的对应奠定了中医，也是气功和太极拳至今沿用的身心图谱。

creators.name: Shigehisa Kuriyama
creators.role: Historian of medicine; Reischauer Institute Professor of Cultural History, Harvard University
creators.role_zh: 医学史学者，哈佛大学文化史讲席教授
creators.bio: Japanese-born historian of medicine who compares how Greek and Chinese physicians learned to touch, see and name the body.
creators.bio_zh: 日本出生的医学史学者，比较古希腊与中国医生如何学会触摸、观看和命名身体。
creators.why: Kuriyama shows that the body itself is perceived differently through different trained senses, a historical case for somatic connoisseurship.
creators.why_zh: 他说明：不同训练出来的感官，会感知到不同的身体，这为“身体鉴赏力”提供了历史证据。

creators.name: Shigenori Nagatomo
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy and Religion, Temple University
creators.role_zh: 天普大学哲学与宗教学教授
creators.bio: Japanese philosopher and translator of Yuasa Yasuo who writes on Japanese Buddhism, the lived body and ki.
creators.bio_zh: 日本哲学家，汤浅泰雄著作的英译者，研究日本佛教、活的身体与气。
creators.why: Nagatomo's 'attunement through the body' names the somatic skill of resonating with things and others that soma design trains.
creators.why_zh: 他所说的“经由身体的调谐”，命名了身体设计要训练的那种与物、与人共振的身体能力。

creators.name: Tu Weiming
creators.role: Confucian philosopher; professor emeritus, Harvard University and Peking University
creators.role_zh: 儒家哲学家；哈佛大学与北京大学荣休教授
creators.based_zh: 剑桥（马萨诸塞州），美国／北京，中国
creators.bio: Leading New Confucian thinker who reinterprets self-cultivation (xiushen) and 'embodied knowing' (tizhi) for the modern world.
creators.bio_zh: 当代新儒家代表人物，为现代世界重新诠释“修身”与“体知”。
creators.why: Tu's tizhi, knowing that is realised in the body and in conduct, is a Confucian counterpart to first-person soma knowledge.
creators.why_zh: 他提出的“体知”，即在身体与行为中实现的认识，是第一人称身体知识在儒家传统中的对应。

creators.name: Zeami Motokiyo
creators.role: Noh actor, playwright and theorist (c. 1363–1443)
creators.role_zh: 能乐演员、剧作家与理论家（约 1363–1443）
creators.bio: Master of Noh theatre whose secret treatises, such as the Fūshikaden and Kakyō, set out how an actor trains body, voice and awareness.
creators.bio_zh: 能乐大师，其秘传论著如《风姿花传》《花镜》阐述了演员如何修炼身体、声音与觉知。
creators.why: His riken no ken, 'the seeing of detached seeing', asks the performer to feel their movement from inside while seeing it from outside, a first-person method in all but name.
creators.why_zh: 他提出的“离见之见”要求演员一边从内部感受动作，一边从外部看见自己，这实际上就是一种第一人称方法。

creators.name: Yi Je-ma
creators.role: Korean physician and thinker (1837–1900)
creators.role_zh: 朝鲜王朝医学家与思想家（1837–1900）
creators.bio: Joseon-era physician who founded Sasang constitutional medicine in his book Dongui Suse Bowon (1894).
creators.bio_zh: 朝鲜王朝时期医学家，在《东医寿世保元》（1894）中创立四象医学。
creators.why: He tied four body types to four emotional dispositions, a Korean medical theory in which temperament and organs are one system.
creators.why_zh: 他把四种体质与四种情志倾向联系起来，这是一种把性情与脏腑视为同一系统的韩国医学理论。

creators.name: Yang Chengfu
creators.role: Tai chi master (1883–1936)
creators.bio: Grandson of Yang Luchan who standardised the large-frame Yang-style tai chi form and taught it widely in Beijing, Shanghai and Nanjing.
creators.bio_zh: 杨露禅之孙，定型了杨式大架太极拳，并在北京、上海、南京等地广泛传授。
