creators.why: The Yang form he fixed is the tai chi most people learn today, a daily practice of slow, rooted, breath-led movement.
creators.why_zh: 他定型的杨式拳架是今天大多数人学习的太极拳：一种缓慢、扎根、以呼吸带动的日常修习。

creators.name: Cheng Man-ch'ing
creators.role: Tai chi teacher, painter, poet and physician (1902–1975)
creators.role_zh: 太极拳家、画家、诗人与医师（1902–1975）
creators.bio: Student of Yang Chengfu who created the 37-posture short form and taught it in Taiwan and, from 1964, in New York.
creators.bio_zh: 杨澄甫弟子，创编三十七式简化太极拳，先在台湾、1964 年起在纽约传授。
creators.why: Cheng brought tai chi's softness and 'investing in loss' to the West, where it entered dance, somatics and later HCI.
creators.why_zh: 他把太极拳的柔与“吃亏”之道带到西方，进入舞蹈与身体修习领域，后来也影响了人机交互。

creators.name: Chinese Health Qigong Association
creators.role: National association for Health Qigong under the General Administration of Sport of China
creators.role_zh: 国家体育总局主管的健身气功全国性组织
creators.bio: Body that in the early 2000s standardised traditional qigong sequences such as Baduanjin, Yijinjing, Wuqinxi and Liuzijue as 'Health Qigong'.
creators.bio_zh: 在 2000 年代初把八段锦、易筋经、五禽戏、六字诀等传统功法整理为“健身气功”标准套路的机构。
creators.why: Its standard Baduanjin is the qigong practised daily by millions in Chinese parks, a public somatic infrastructure.
creators.why_zh: 它编定的八段锦每天在中国的公园里被数以百万计的人练习，是一种公共的身体修习基础设施。

creators.name: Wang Xiangzhai
creators.role: Martial artist (1885–1963), founder of Yiquan
creators.role_zh: 武术家（1885–1963），意拳创始人
creators.bio: Xingyiquan master who stripped martial training down to standing (zhan zhuang) and felt intention, founding Yiquan (also called Dachengquan).
creators.bio_zh: 形意拳名家，把武术训练简化为站桩与意念的体认，创立意拳（又称大成拳）。
creators.why: Wang made stillness the main training, showing that attention to the standing body is already practice.
creators.why_zh: 他把静止作为主要训练，说明对站立身体的觉察本身就是修习。

creators.name: Morihei Ueshiba
creators.role: Martial artist (1883–1969), founder of aikido
creators.role_zh: 武道家（1883–1969），合气道创始人
creators.bio: Japanese martial artist who turned Daitō-ryū jujutsu into aikido, a practice of blending with an attacker's movement.
creators.bio_zh: 日本武道家，把大东流柔术发展为合气道：一种与对手动作融合的修习。
creators.why: Aikido treats the other's force as something to feel and join, a model of intercorporeal attunement.
creators.why_zh: 合气道把对方的力视为可以感受和顺应的东西，是身体间调谐的范例。

creators.name: Noguchi Michizō
creators.role: Physical educator (1914–1998); professor, Tokyo University of the Arts
creators.role_zh: 体育教育家（1914–1998），东京艺术大学教授
creators.bio: Former military gymnastics teacher who, after the war, developed Noguchi Taisō, a practice of releasing effort and letting weight and momentum move the body.
creators.bio_zh: 曾是战时体操教师，战后创立野口体操：放下用力，让重量与惯性带动身体。
creators.why: Noguchi replaced drilling the body with listening to it, the stance that soma design asks of both designers and users.
creators.why_zh: 他以倾听身体代替训练身体，这正是身体设计对设计者和使用者的要求。

creators.name: Noguchi Haruchika
creators.role: Founder of Seitai (1911–1976)
creators.bio: Japanese healer who founded Seitai, a system of body types (taiheki), hand attention (yuki) and spontaneous movement (katsugen undō).
creators.bio_zh: 日本整体创始人，体系包括体癖论、愉气法与活元运动。
creators.why: Seitai trusts the body's own movement to restore balance, a practice of letting the soma lead.
creators.why_zh: 整体相信身体自发的运动能够恢复平衡，是一种让身体来引导的修习。

creators.name: Min Tanaka
creators.role: Dancer and actor (born 1945)
creators.role_zh: 舞者、演员（1945 年生）
creators.bio: Japanese dancer who left conventional dance in the 1970s, developed Body Weather training and founded Body Weather Farm in 1985.
creators.bio_zh: 日本舞者，1970 年代脱离传统舞蹈，发展出“身体气象”训练，并于 1985 年创立身体气象农场。
creators.why: Body Weather treats the body as weather, sensitive and always changing, and trains dancers through farm work and partnered manipulations.
creators.why_zh: “身体气象”把身体看作天气：敏感而不断变化，通过农活与双人操控练习来训练舞者。

creators.name: Tatsumi Hijikata
creators.role: Dancer and choreographer (1928–1986), founder of butoh
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞家（1928–1986），舞踏创始人
creators.bio: Japanese choreographer whose 1959 Kinjiki started Ankoku Butoh, the 'dance of darkness' built from images, memory and the collapsing body.
creators.bio_zh: 日本编舞家，1959 年的《禁色》开启了暗黑舞踏：以意象、记忆和崩塌的身体构成的舞蹈。
creators.why: His image scores (butoh-fu) make the dancer become an insect, a corpse or wind from inside, a radical method of somatic estrangement.
creators.why_zh: 他的舞踏谱让舞者从内部化为昆虫、尸体或风，是一种激进的身体陌生化方法。

creators.name: Kazuo Ohno
creators.role: Butoh dancer (1906–2010)
creators.bio: Co-founder of butoh with Hijikata, who kept dancing past 100 and taught that dance begins in the soul and the life of the body.
creators.bio_zh: 与土方巽共同开创舞踏，百岁后仍在舞蹈，主张舞蹈始于灵魂与身体的生命。
creators.why: Ohno's dancing shows an old body as fully expressive, a counter-image to technologies that measure bodies against norms.
creators.why_zh: 他的舞蹈展示了衰老的身体也能充分表达，是那些以常模衡量身体的技术的反面。

creators.name: Thich Nhat Hanh
creators.role: Vietnamese Zen monk and teacher (1926–2022), founder of Plum Village
creators.role_zh: 越南禅僧、教师（1926–2022），梅村创始人
creators.bio: Vietnamese Thiền monk, peace activist and author of The Miracle of Mindfulness, who taught mindful breathing, walking and eating to a worldwide lay public.
creators.bio_zh: 越南禅宗僧人、和平活动者，《正念的奇迹》作者，向全球大众传授正念呼吸、行禅与正念饮食。
creators.why: His practice of 'arriving' in the body with each breath and step is behind much of the mindfulness that HCI now designs for.
creators.why_zh: 他教人随每一次呼吸、每一步“回到”身体，这背后正是人机交互如今为之设计的正念。

creators.name: Shizuto Masunaga
creators.role: Shiatsu practitioner and psychologist (1925–1981)
creators.bio: Japanese psychologist and shiatsu teacher who created Zen Shiatsu, combining meridian theory with a two-handed, relaxed, listening touch.
creators.bio_zh: 日本心理学家与指压教师，创立禅式指压，把经络理论与放松、倾听式的双手触摸结合起来。
creators.why: Zen Shiatsu frames touch as mutual attunement between two bodies, not as a technique done to someone.
creators.why_zh: 禅式指压把触摸看作两个身体的相互调谐，而不是施加于人的技术。

creators.name: Lin Hwai-min
creators.role: Choreographer; founder of Cloud Gate Dance Theatre
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，云门舞集创办人
creators.bio: Taiwanese writer and choreographer who founded Cloud Gate in 1973 and built its training on tai chi daoyin, meditation, martial arts and calligraphy.
creators.bio_zh: 台湾作家、编舞家，1973 年创办云门舞集，以太极导引、静坐、武术与书法作为舞者训练的基础。
creators.why: Cloud Gate shows how an Eastern somatic practice can become a contemporary dance language and a daily training of attention.
creators.why_zh: 云门说明了东方身体修习如何成为当代舞蹈语言，以及一种日常的注意力训练。

creators.name: Huang Yi
creators.role: Choreographer, dancer and inventor; founder of Huang Yi Studio +
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞者、发明者，黄翊工作室＋创办人
creators.bio: Taiwanese choreographer who programs industrial robot arms himself and dances with them.
creators.bio_zh: 台湾编舞家，亲自为工业机械臂编程并与之共舞。
creators.why: The duet with a KUKA arm asks what a machine must do for a dancer to feel partnered rather than operated.
creators.why_zh: 他与 KUKA 机械臂的双人舞追问：机器要做到什么，舞者才会感到是在与伙伴共舞，而不是在操作机器。

creators.name: Tao Ye
creators.role: Choreographer; co-founder of TAO Dance Theater
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，陶身体剧场联合创始人
creators.bio: Chinese choreographer who founded TAO Dance Theater in 2008 with Duan Ni and makes numbered works built on continuous circular movement.
creators.bio_zh: 中国编舞家，2008 年与段妮创立陶身体剧场，以连续的圆形运动创作“数字系列”作品。
creators.why: The 'circular movement system' treats the whole body as one continuous flow, a contemporary Chinese somatic dance language.
creators.why_zh: 他的“圆运动体系”把整个身体视为连续不断的流动，是一种当代中国的身体舞蹈语言。

creators.name: Pichet Klunchun
creators.role: Dancer and choreographer
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞家
creators.bio: Thai dancer trained in classical masked khon who makes contemporary work from its body knowledge.
creators.bio_zh: 受过泰国古典孔剧训练的舞者，以其身体知识创作当代作品。
creators.why: The work shows a classical Asian dance body as a body of knowledge that can be explained, questioned and shared.
creators.why_zh: 他的作品把亚洲古典舞蹈的身体呈现为一种可以解释、质询和分享的知识体系。

creators.name: Jérôme Bel
creators.role: Choreographer
creators.role_zh: 编舞家
creators.bio: French conceptual choreographer whose pieces put dancers' own bodies and biographies on stage.
creators.bio_zh: 法国观念舞蹈编舞家，作品把舞者自己的身体与经历搬上舞台。
creators.why: The dialogue piece with Pichet Klunchun sets two trained bodies side by side to compare how they know.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Pichet Klunchun 的对话作品把两个受过训练的身体并置，比较它们各自如何认识。

creators.name: Yoko Ono
creators.role: Artist, musician and peace activist
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、音乐人、和平活动者
creators.bio: Japanese-American artist (born 1933) close to Fluxus, whose instruction pieces and performances ask the audience to complete the work with their own bodies.
creators.bio_zh: 日裔美国艺术家（1933 年生），与激浪派关系密切，她的指令作品与表演邀请观众用自己的身体完成作品。
creators.why: Cut Piece makes the artist's still body the site where the audience's touch, and its ethics, become visible.
creators.why_zh: 《切片》让艺术家静止的身体成为观众触碰及其伦理变得可见的场所。

creators.name: Atsuko Tanaka
creators.role: Gutai artist (1932–2005)
creators.bio: Japanese artist of the Gutai group, known for Electric Dress, Bell and paintings of circles and wires.
creators.bio_zh: 日本具体派艺术家，以《电气服》《铃》以及圆与电线的绘画闻名。
creators.why: Electric Dress is an early wearable in which the wearer lives inside heat, light and danger, a garment felt from within.
creators.why_zh: 《电气服》是早期的可穿戴作品：穿着者生活在热、光与危险之中，是一件从内部被感受的衣服。

creators.name: Kazuo Shiraga
creators.role: Gutai painter and performer (1924–2008)
creators.role_zh: 具体派画家、行为艺术家（1924–2008）
creators.bio: Gutai artist who painted with his feet while hanging from a rope and later became a Tendai monk.
creators.bio_zh: 具体派艺术家，吊在绳子上用脚作画，后来出家成为天台宗僧人。
creators.why: Made the whole body, not the hand, the instrument of painting, and the struggle itself the work.
creators.why_zh: 他让整个身体而不是手成为绘画的工具，让挣扎本身成为作品。

creators.name: Daito Manabe
creators.role: Artist and programmer, Rhizomatiks
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与程序员，Rhizomatiks
creators.bio: Japanese artist, programmer and DJ, co-founder of Rhizomatiks, working with data, bodies and electrical stimulation.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家、程序员、DJ，Rhizomatiks 联合创始人，以数据、身体与电刺激创作。
creators.why: The electric-stimulus experiments let music move the face from outside, making the familiar face strange to its owner.
creators.why_zh: 他的电刺激实验让音乐从外部驱动面部，使主人对自己熟悉的脸感到陌生。

creators.name: Jiabao Li
creators.role: Artist, designer and technologist; Associate Professor, Northeastern University
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师与技术专家；美国东北大学副教授
creators.bio: Chinese-born artist and inventor (Harvard GSD alum, former Apple designer) whose installations, wearables, XR, bio-art and performances deal with perception, feminist biotech and the more-than-human; co-directs work with Reality Design Lab.
creators.bio_zh: 生于中国的艺术家与发明者（哈佛设计研究生院毕业，曾任苹果设计师），以装置、可穿戴设备、XR、生物艺术与表演处理感知、女性主义生物技术与多于人类的世界；与 Reality Design Lab 合作创作。
creators.why: Works from the artist's own menstruating, pregnant and breastfeeding body, turning intimate first-person experience into shared sensory encounters.
creators.why_zh: 她从自己经期、孕期和哺乳期的身体出发，把私密的第一人称经验转化为可共享的感官相遇。

creators.name: Rosemary Candelario
creators.role: Dance scholar and butoh choreographer; Texas Woman's University
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈学者、舞踏编舞家；德州女子大学
creators.bio: Dance scholar and butoh practitioner, author of Flowers Cracking Concrete on Eiko & Koma, who choreographs site-based butoh.
creators.bio_zh: 舞蹈学者与舞踏实践者，著有关于 Eiko & Koma 的《Flowers Cracking Concrete》，创作场域舞踏。
creators.why: Carries Hijikata's image-based butoh scores into ecological performance.
creators.why_zh: 她把土方巽基于意象的舞踏谱带入生态表演之中。

creators.name: Richard Shusterman
creators.role: Dorothy F. Schmidt Eminent Scholar in the Humanities, Florida Atlantic University
creators.bio: American pragmatist philosopher who founded somaesthetics, the study of the body as the site of sensory appreciation and self-fashioning, and a trained Feldenkrais practitioner.
creators.why: Soma design takes its name and its core idea, cultivating felt bodily awareness as an aesthetic practice, from his somaesthetics.
creators.role_zh: 美国佛罗里达大西洋大学人文学科杰出学者
creators.bio_zh: 美国实用主义哲学家，身体美学（somaesthetics）的创立者，研究身体作为感官鉴赏与自我塑造的所在；也是受过训练的费登奎斯从业者。
creators.why_zh: 身体设计的名字与核心思想——把培养对身体的感受当作一种审美实践——都来自他的身体美学。

creators.name: John Dewey
creators.role: Philosopher, psychologist and educator (1859–1952)
creators.bio: American pragmatist philosopher whose theory of experience treated the live creature and its environment as one continuous process; he also studied with F. M. Alexander.
creators.why: His idea of 'an experience' as a felt, embodied whole is the pragmatist ground under Shusterman's somaesthetics and experience-centred HCI.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家、心理学家、教育家（1859–1952）
creators.bio_zh: 美国实用主义哲学家，他的经验理论把有生命的机体与环境看作一个连续的过程；他也曾跟随 F. M. Alexander 学习。
creators.why_zh: 他所说的“一个经验”是被感受的、具身的整体，这是 Shusterman 身体美学和以经验为中心的人机交互的实用主义根基。

creators.name: Thomas Hanna
creators.role: Philosopher and founder of Hanna Somatic Education (1928–1990)
creators.bio: American philosopher who coined 'somatics' and defined the soma as the body experienced from within by first-person perception; he trained with Moshe Feldenkrais.
creators.why: The word 'soma' in soma design comes from Hanna: the living body-mind as felt from the inside, not the body seen from outside.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，Hanna 身心教育创始人（1928–1990）
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，提出“身心学”（somatics）一词，把 soma 定义为以第一人称从内部感知的身体；曾随 Moshe Feldenkrais 学习。
creators.why_zh: 身体设计中的“soma”一词来自 Hanna：从内部被感受的活的身心，而不是从外部被观看的身体。

creators.name: Don Hanlon Johnson
creators.role: Professor, founder of the Somatics graduate program, California Institute of Integral Studies
creators.bio: Philosopher and Rolfer who founded the first accredited graduate program in somatics and edited anthologies that gathered the founders of the somatic movement.
creators.why: His writing links the somatic practices designers train in (Feldenkrais, BMC, Alexander) to a philosophy of the body-mind as one.
creators.role_zh: 加州整合研究学院教授，身心学研究生项目创始人
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家、罗尔夫治疗师，创立了第一个获认证的身心学研究生项目，并编选文集汇集身心学运动的创始者。
creators.why_zh: 他的写作把设计师修习的身体实践（Feldenkrais、BMC、亚历山大技巧）与身心一体的哲学联系起来。

creators.name: Edmund Husserl
creators.role: Philosopher, founder of phenomenology (1859–1938)
creators.bio: German philosopher who founded phenomenology and distinguished the lived body (Leib), felt from within, from the physical body (Körper) seen as a thing.
creators.why: The Leib/Körper distinction is the starting point for every later account of the lived body that soma designers cite.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，现象学创始人（1859–1938）
creators.bio_zh: 德国哲学家，现象学的创始人，区分了从内部被感受的“活的身体”（Leib）与被当作物体看待的“物理身体”（Körper）。
creators.why_zh: Leib 与 Körper 的区分，是身体设计师引用的所有“活的身体”理论的起点。

creators.name: Maurice Merleau-Ponty
creators.role: Philosopher, Collège de France (1908–1961)
creators.bio: French phenomenologist who argued that perception is the body's lived engagement with the world, and later described body and world as one 'flesh'.
creators.why: He is the most cited philosopher in embodied interaction: the body schema, motor intentionality and the flesh underpin Svanæs, Dourish, Loke and Höök.
creators.role_zh: 法兰西学院哲学家（1908–1961）
creators.bio_zh: 法国现象学家，主张知觉是身体对世界的亲身投入，晚期又把身体与世界描述为同一块“肉身”（la chair）。
creators.why_zh: 他是具身交互中被引用最多的哲学家：身体图式、运动意向性与肉身概念支撑了 Svanæs、Dourish、Loke 与 Höök 的工作。

creators.name: Maxine Sheets-Johnstone
creators.role: Philosopher and former dancer-choreographer, University of Oregon
creators.bio: Dancer turned phenomenologist who argues that movement, not the static body, is the ground of thinking, feeling and self.
creators.why: Her 'thinking in movement' and kinesthetic memory give dance-tech and movement-based soma design a philosophical base.
creators.role_zh: 俄勒冈大学哲学家，前舞者与编舞家
creators.bio_zh: 由舞者转为现象学家，她主张运动而非静止的身体，才是思考、感受与自我的根基。
creators.why_zh: 她的“在运动中思考”与动觉记忆，为舞蹈科技和基于动作的身体设计提供了哲学基础。

creators.name: Eugene Gendlin
creators.role: Philosopher and psychotherapist, University of Chicago (1926–2017)
creators.bio: American philosopher who described the 'felt sense', a bodily, pre-verbal sense of a whole situation, and developed Focusing and Thinking at the Edge from it.
creators.why: The felt sense is how soma designers name what they attend to in first-person design, and it shaped micro-phenomenology and articulation methods.
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学哲学家与心理治疗师（1926–2017）
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，提出“体会”（felt sense）：一种身体的、先于语言的对整个情境的感受，并由此发展出 Focusing（体会聚焦）与 Thinking at the Edge。
creators.why_zh: “体会”是身体设计师在第一人称设计中称呼自己所注意之物的方式，也影响了微观现象学与经验言说的方法。

creators.name: Drew Leder
creators.role: Professor of Western and Eastern Philosophy, Loyola University Maryland
creators.bio: Philosopher and physician who analysed why the body usually recedes from awareness and 'dys-appears' in pain and illness.
creators.why: His absent body explains why soma design must work to bring the body back into attention, and why pain makes it return uninvited.
creators.role_zh: 马里兰洛约拉大学东西方哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家、医生，分析了身体为何平时从意识中隐退，又为何在疼痛与疾病中“异常显现”（dys-appear）。
creators.why_zh: 他的“缺席的身体”解释了为何身体设计要努力把身体带回注意之中，以及疼痛为何让身体不请自来。

creators.name: Iris Marion Young
creators.role: Political philosopher, University of Chicago (1949–2006)
creators.bio: Feminist philosopher whose phenomenology of feminine bodily comportment showed how social norms shape how bodies move and feel their own capacities.
creators.why: She gives soma design its body-politics lens: lived bodies are gendered, and felt capacity is shaped by norms.
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学政治哲学家（1949–2006）
creators.bio_zh: 女性主义哲学家，她对女性身体举止的现象学分析揭示了社会规范如何塑造身体的动作方式和对自身能力的感受。
creators.why_zh: 她为身体设计提供了身体政治的视角：活的身体是有性别的，对能力的感受由规范塑造。

creators.name: Shaun Gallagher
creators.role: Lillian and Morris Moss Professor of Excellence in Philosophy, University of Memphis
creators.bio: Phenomenologist and cognitive scientist who distinguished body schema from body image and helped found 4E (embodied, embedded, enactive, extended) cognition.
creators.why: His body schema / body image distinction is a working tool for designers who alter how the body is felt versus how it is seen.
creators.role_zh: 孟菲斯大学哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 现象学家与认知科学家，区分了“身体图式”与“身体意象”，并参与奠定 4E 认知（具身、嵌入、生成、延展）。
creators.why_zh: 身体图式与身体意象的区分，是设计师改变身体“如何被感受”与“如何被看见”时的实用工具。

creators.name: Thomas Fuchs
creators.role: Karl Jaspers Professor of Philosophical Foundations of Psychiatry, Heidelberg University
creators.bio: Psychiatrist and phenomenologist who describes the brain as an organ of a living body in relation with others, and developed the idea of intercorporeality.
creators.why: His account of body memory and mutual incorporation grounds soma design work on shared touch, synchrony and care.
creators.role_zh: 海德堡大学精神医学哲学基础 Karl Jaspers 讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 精神科医生与现象学家，把大脑描述为一个与他人相处的活的身体中的器官，并发展了“身体间性”的概念。
creators.why_zh: 他关于身体记忆与“相互吸纳”的论述，是身体设计中共享触碰、同步与照护类工作的理论基础。

creators.name: Hanne De Jaegher
creators.role: Ikerbasque Research Fellow, University of the Basque Country
creators.bio: Enactive philosopher who, with Ezequiel Di Paolo, developed participatory sense-making: meaning created in the coordinated movement of interacting bodies.
creators.why: Participatory sense-making is the enactive account of intercorporeality that social soma design and shared-biosignal work draw on.
creators.role_zh: 巴斯克大学 Ikerbasque 研究员
creators.bio_zh: 生成论哲学家，与 Ezequiel Di Paolo 一起提出“参与式意义生成”：意义在互动身体的协调运动中被共同创造。
creators.why_zh: 参与式意义生成是对身体间性的生成论解释，社会性身体设计和共享生物信号的研究以此为据。

creators.name: Francisco Varela
creators.role: Biologist, neuroscientist and philosopher, CNRS Paris (1946–2001)
creators.bio: Chilean biologist who co-developed autopoiesis, founded enactivism and neurophenomenology, and brought Buddhist mindfulness practice into cognitive science.
creators.why: Enaction, the idea that mind is brought forth by a living body acting in its world, and his call to train first-person experience, are foundations of soma design.
creators.role_zh: 生物学家、神经科学家与哲学家，法国国家科学研究中心（1946–2001）
creators.bio_zh: 智利生物学家，共同提出自创生（autopoiesis），开创生成论与神经现象学，并把佛教正念修习带入认知科学。
creators.why_zh: “生成”——心智由在世界中行动的活的身体带出——以及他对训练第一人称经验的呼吁，是身体设计的根基。

creators.name: Evan Thompson
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy, University of British Columbia
creators.bio: Philosopher of mind who co-authored The Embodied Mind and developed the deep continuity of life and mind, working across phenomenology, biology and Buddhist thought.
creators.why: His enactive account of mind as living, embodied sense-making is one of the main non-dualist references in soma design.
creators.role_zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 心灵哲学家，《具身心智》合著者，提出生命与心智的深度连续性，跨越现象学、生物学与佛教思想。
creators.why_zh: 他把心智理解为活的、具身的意义生成，这是身体设计最主要的非二元参照之一。

creators.name: Eleanor Rosch
creators.role: Professor Emerita of Psychology, University of California, Berkeley
creators.bio: Cognitive psychologist known for prototype theory of categories and for bringing contemplative practice into the study of mind.
creators.why: Co-author of The Embodied Mind; her work ties categories and meaning to bodily experience and meditative awareness.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校心理学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 认知心理学家，以范畴的原型理论著称，并把沉思修习带入心智研究。
creators.why_zh: 《具身心智》合著者；她的工作把范畴与意义系于身体经验和冥想觉察。

creators.name: Humberto Maturana
creators.role: Biologist, University of Chile (1928–2021)
creators.bio: Chilean biologist who, with Francisco Varela, defined living systems as autopoietic, self-producing, and cognition as the living process itself.
creators.why: Autopoiesis ('to live is to know') is the biological root of the enactive, non-dualist view that soma design builds on.
creators.role_zh: 智利大学生物学家（1928–2021）
creators.bio_zh: 智利生物学家，与 Francisco Varela 一起把生命系统定义为自创生的、自我生产的系统，并把认知看作生命过程本身。
creators.why_zh: 自创生（“活着就是认知”）是身体设计所依据的生成论、非二元观点的生物学根源。

creators.name: George Lakoff
creators.role: Professor Emeritus of Cognitive Science and Linguistics, UC Berkeley
creators.bio: Cognitive linguist who, with Mark Johnson, showed that abstract thought is structured by metaphors grounded in bodily experience.
creators.why: Embodied metaphor (up is good, warmth is affection) is used in soma and tangible design to map felt qualities to meaning.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校认知科学与语言学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 认知语言学家，与 Mark Johnson 一起指出，抽象思维由扎根于身体经验的隐喻所结构。
creators.why_zh: 具身隐喻（上即好、温暖即亲密）被身体设计与有形交互设计用来把被感受的品质对应到意义。

creators.name: Mark Johnson
creators.role: Philip H. Knight Professor of Liberal Arts and Sciences, University of Oregon
creators.bio: Pragmatist philosopher who developed image schemas and argues that meaning is rooted in bodily, felt, aesthetic experience.
creators.why: His claim that meaning begins in felt bodily qualities is the philosophical core of designing for aesthetic, embodied experience.
creators.role_zh: 俄勒冈大学文理学院讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 实用主义哲学家，提出“意象图式”，主张意义扎根于身体的、被感受的、审美的经验。
creators.why_zh: 他认为意义始于被感受的身体品质，这是为审美的具身经验而设计的哲学核心。

creators.name: Alva Noë
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy, University of California, Berkeley
creators.bio: Philosopher who argues that perceiving is something we do with our moving bodies, through our practical grasp of how sensation changes as we move.
creators.why: His enactive, sensorimotor account of perception tells designers that feeling changes when movement changes.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家，主张知觉是我们用运动的身体去做的事，依赖我们对“运动时感觉如何变化”的实践把握。
creators.why_zh: 他的生成论、感觉运动的知觉理论告诉设计师：动作改变，感受就随之改变。

creators.name: Antonio Damasio
creators.role: University Professor of Neuroscience, University of Southern California
creators.bio: Neuroscientist whose somatic marker hypothesis showed that bodily feeling is part of reasoning, and who traces consciousness to the body's homeostatic feelings.
creators.why: He gave soma and affective design the neuroscience for treating emotion and reason as bodily processes rather than separate faculties.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学神经科学讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学家，他的“躯体标记假说”表明身体感受是推理的一部分，并把意识追溯到身体稳态的感受。
creators.why_zh: 他为身体设计与情感设计提供了神经科学依据：情绪与理性都是身体过程，而非分离的官能。

creators.name: Giovanna Colombetti
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy, University of Exeter
creators.bio: Philosopher who brought affective science and enactivism together, arguing that the whole living body, not only the brain, is the organ of feeling.
creators.why: Her affective, enactive account of emotion grounds affective loops and biodata work that treats emotion as a felt bodily process.
creators.role_zh: 埃克塞特大学哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家，把情感科学与生成论结合起来，主张整个活的身体而不只是大脑，才是感受的器官。
creators.why_zh: 她对情绪的情感性、生成论解释，是把情绪当作被感受的身体过程的情感回路与生物数据研究的依据。

creators.name: Paul Dourish
creators.role: Chancellor's Professor of Informatics, University of California, Irvine
creators.bio: Computer scientist and social scientist who brought phenomenology into HCI and defined embodied interaction.
creators.why: Where the Action Is made embodiment a central concept in HCI and opened the path that somaesthetic interaction design followed.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学欧文分校信息学讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家与社会科学家，把现象学引入人机交互，并定义了“具身交互”。
creators.why_zh: 《Where the Action Is》让具身成为人机交互的核心概念，开辟了身体美学交互设计后来走的路。

creators.name: Peter Wright
creators.role: Professor of Social Computing, Open Lab, Newcastle University
creators.bio: HCI researcher who, with John McCarthy, drew on Dewey and Bakhtin to frame technology use as felt, lived experience.
creators.why: Experience-centred design gave HCI the pragmatist vocabulary of felt, sensual experience that somaesthetic design extends.
creators.role_zh: 纽卡斯尔大学 Open Lab 社会计算教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，与 John McCarthy 一起借鉴 Dewey 与 Bakhtin，把技术使用理解为被感受的、亲历的经验。
creators.why_zh: 以经验为中心的设计为人机交互带来了关于被感受的、感官经验的实用主义词汇，身体美学设计在此基础上延伸。

creators.name: John McCarthy
creators.role: Professor of Applied Psychology, University College Cork
creators.bio: Psychologist and HCI researcher who co-developed experience-centred design with Peter Wright.
creators.why: Co-author of Technology as Experience, which named the sensual thread of experience as a design concern.
creators.role_zh: 科克大学应用心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家与人机交互研究者，与 Peter Wright 共同发展了以经验为中心的设计。
creators.why_zh: 《Technology as Experience》的合著者，这本书把经验中的“感官线索”列为设计议题。

creators.name: Scott Klemmer
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Science and Computer Science, UC San Diego
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on design tools, tangible interaction and how people learn design.
creators.why: His 'How Bodies Matter' gave interaction designers five practical themes for thinking with the body.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣迭戈分校认知科学与计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究设计工具、有形交互以及人们如何学习设计。
creators.why_zh: 他的《How Bodies Matter》为交互设计师提供了借助身体思考的五个实用主题。

creators.name: Eva Hornecker
creators.role: Professor of Human-Computer Interaction, Bauhaus-Universität Weimar
creators.bio: HCI researcher who built frameworks for tangible and embodied interaction, focusing on physical space, bodily movement and social use.
creators.why: Her tangible interaction framework named embodied facilitation and full-body interaction as design qualities.
creators.role_zh: 魏玛包豪斯大学人机交互教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，建立了有形与具身交互的框架，关注物理空间、身体动作与社会性使用。
creators.why_zh: 她的有形交互框架把“具身促成”与全身交互列为设计品质。

creators.name: Jacob Buur
creators.role: Professor of User-Centred Design, University of Southern Denmark
creators.bio: Design researcher who works on participatory innovation and on design as a bodily, material practice.
creators.why: Co-author of the tangible interaction framework that brought physical space and bodily interaction into HCI theory.
creators.role_zh: 南丹麦大学以用户为中心的设计教授
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究参与式创新，以及作为身体与材料实践的设计。
creators.why_zh: 有形交互框架的合著者，这一框架把物理空间与身体互动带入人机交互理论。

creators.name: Astrid Twenebowa Larssen
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, University of Technology Sydney (formerly)
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who studied how movement-based interaction feels from the mover's own perspective.
creators.why: Her 'feel dimension' framed technology interaction as kinaesthetic, felt experience rather than visual appearance.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者，曾任职于悉尼科技大学
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，研究基于动作的交互在动作者自身视角中的感受。
creators.why_zh: 她提出的“感觉维度”把技术交互理解为动觉的、被感受的经验，而非视觉外观。

creators.name: Toni Robertson
creators.role: Professor Emerita of Interaction Design, University of Technology Sydney
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who brought Merleau-Ponty's phenomenology into the study of cooperative work and movement-based interaction.
creators.why: With Lian Loke and Astrid Larssen she built the Sydney school of movement-based design that soma design draws on.
creators.role_zh: 悉尼科技大学交互设计荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，把 Merleau-Ponty 的现象学引入协同工作与基于动作的交互研究。
creators.why_zh: 她与 Lian Loke、Astrid Larssen 共同建立了身体设计所借鉴的悉尼动作设计学派。

creators.name: Maiken Hillerup Fogtmann
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, Aarhus School of Architecture / Aarhus University
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who studied bodily engaging games and interactive environments for movement.
creators.why: Her kinesthetic interaction concept names the body's kinaesthetic sense as a design material for interaction.
creators.role_zh: 奥胡斯建筑学院 / 奥胡斯大学交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，研究调动身体的游戏与鼓励运动的交互环境。
creators.why_zh: 她提出的“动觉交互”把身体的动觉当作交互的设计材料。

creators.name: Caroline Hummels
creators.role: Professor of Design and Theory for Transformative Qualities, Eindhoven University of Technology
creators.bio: Design researcher who works on embodied, movement-based and first-person design, and on design for societal transformation.
creators.why: Her work at TU/e made expressive, rich movement a design aim and connected phenomenology to design practice.
creators.role_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学变革品质设计与理论教授
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，从事具身的、基于动作的与第一人称的设计，以及面向社会变革的设计。
creators.why_zh: 她在埃因霍温理工大学的工作把富有表现力的动作确立为设计目标，并把现象学与设计实践联系起来。

creators.name: Dag Svanæs
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who has worked since the 1990s on what Merleau-Ponty's phenomenology means for interaction design.
creators.why: His TOCHI paper is the standard reference for designing 'for and with the lived body' in soma design.
creators.role_zh: 挪威科技大学交互设计教授
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，自 1990 年代起研究 Merleau-Ponty 的现象学对交互设计意味着什么。
creators.why_zh: 他发表在 TOCHI 的论文是身体设计中“为活的身体、与活的身体一起设计”的标准参考。

creators.name: David Kirsh
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Science, UC San Diego
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist who studies thinking with bodies and things, including how dancers think through marking movement.
creators.why: His studies of dancers show that the body can be a thinking medium, a key claim for embodied design.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣迭戈分校认知科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学家，研究人如何借助身体与物来思考，包括舞者如何通过“标记”动作来思考。
creators.why_zh: 他对舞者的研究表明身体可以是思考的媒介，这是具身设计的关键论点。

creators.name: Sarah Homewood
creators.role: Design researcher, feminist and somatic HCI
creators.bio: Design researcher working on feminist, somatic and more-than-human perspectives on the body and self-tracking.
creators.why: Her survey traces how HCI has conceived the body, from user to lived soma to more-than-human.
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者，女性主义与身体取向的人机交互
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，从女性主义、身体与超越人类的视角研究身体与自我追踪。
creators.why_zh: 她的综述梳理了人机交互如何理解身体：从“用户”到活的身体，再到超越人类。

creators.name: Susan Kozel
creators.role: Professor, School of Arts and Communication, Malmö University
creators.bio: Dancer, philosopher and researcher whose phenomenology of performance with technology shaped somatic approaches in HCI.
creators.why: Her book Closer (2007) and her practice bridge dance, phenomenology and interaction design.
creators.role_zh: 马尔默大学艺术与传播学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 舞者、哲学家与研究者，她关于技术表演的现象学塑造了人机交互中的身体取向。
creators.why_zh: 她的著作《Closer》（2007）与实践连接了舞蹈、现象学与交互设计。

creators.name: Kristina Höök
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Kristina Höök moved from affective computing at SICS (eMoto, Affective Diary, Affective Health) to founding soma design at KTH. The book Designing with the Body (MIT Press, 2018) sets out the programme.
creators.why: Höök built the soma design programme and the lab lineage this gallery is organised around.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计教授
creators.bio_zh: Kristina Höök 早年在瑞典计算机科学研究所（SICS）做情感计算（eMoto、Affective Diary、Affective Health），后来在 KTH 创立了身体设计（soma design）。《Designing with the Body》（MIT Press，2018）系统阐述了这一研究纲领。
creators.why_zh: Höök 建立了身体设计的研究纲领，本图录正是围绕这条实验室谱系组织的。

creators.name: Anna Ståhl
creators.role: Senior researcher, RISE Research Institutes of Sweden
creators.bio: Anna Ståhl is an interaction designer who has worked with Höök since eMoto and the Affective Diary, and co-designed the Soma Mat, Breathing Light and Pelvic Chair.
creators.why: Ståhl's annotated soma design processes show how somatic judgement guides material choices step by step.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典研究院（RISE）高级研究员
creators.bio_zh: Anna Ståhl 是交互设计师，从 eMoto 和 Affective Diary 起就与 Höök 合作，参与设计了 Soma Mat、Breathing Light 和 Pelvic Chair。
creators.why_zh: Ståhl 对身体设计过程的注释式记录，展示了身体感受如何一步步引导材料上的判断。

creators.name: Martin Jonsson
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, Södertörn University
creators.bio: Martin Jonsson (also published as Jönsson) co-developed the heated Soma Mat and the Sarka sound mat with Höök's group.
creators.why: Jonsson's work treats heat as an aesthetic design material for turning attention inward.
creators.role_zh: 瑟德脱恩大学交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Martin Jonsson（论文中也署名 Jönsson）与 Höök 团队共同开发了加热的 Soma Mat 和发声的 Sarka 垫子。
creators.why_zh: Jonsson 把热当作一种审美性的设计材料，用来把注意力引向身体内部。

creators.name: Jarmo Laaksolahti
creators.role: Researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Jarmo Laaksolahti is a long-time SICS and KTH collaborator of Höök, from the Sensual Evaluation Instrument and Affective Diary to the Soma Bits toolkit.
creators.why: Laaksolahti engineered many of the lab's prototyping platforms.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）研究员
creators.bio_zh: Jarmo Laaksolahti 长期在 SICS 与 KTH 同 Höök 合作，参与过 Sensual Evaluation Instrument、Affective Diary 和 Soma Bits 工具包。
creators.why_zh: 实验室的许多原型平台由 Laaksolahti 负责工程实现。

creators.name: Petra Sundström
creators.role: Interaction design researcher (SICS and Stockholm University), creator of eMoto
creators.bio: Petra Sundström (published earlier as Petra Fagerberg) designed eMoto, an affective messaging service, as doctoral research with Höök.
creators.why: eMoto was the first worked example of an affective loop between gesture, colour and emotion.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者（SICS 与斯德哥尔摩大学），eMoto 的设计者
creators.bio_zh: Petra Sundström（早期论文署名 Petra Fagerberg）在 Höök 指导下以博士研究设计了情感短信系统 eMoto。
creators.why_zh: eMoto 是手势、色彩与情绪之间“情感回路”的第一个完整案例。

creators.name: Ana Paiva
creators.role: Professor, Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon (GAIPS, INESC-ID)
creators.bio: Ana Paiva leads research on affective agents and social robots in Lisbon. In the EU SAFIRA project, Paiva's team built SenToy with Höök's SICS team.
creators.why: SenToy made emotion something you express with your whole arm, not a menu choice.
creators.role_zh: 里斯本大学高等理工学院教授（GAIPS，INESC-ID）
creators.bio_zh: Ana Paiva 在里斯本领导情感智能体与社交机器人研究。在欧盟 SAFIRA 项目中，Paiva 的团队与 Höök 的 SICS 团队一起做出了 SenToy。
creators.why_zh: SenToy 让情绪成为用整只手臂表达的东西，而不是菜单里的选项。

creators.name: Pedro Sanches
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, Umeå University (formerly KTH)
creators.bio: Pedro Sanches designed Affective Health at SICS and later worked on soma design, biodata and lived data at KTH.
creators.why: Sanches argues that biodata should be mirrored back for people's own interpretation rather than used to diagnose them.
creators.role_zh: 于默奥大学交互设计研究者（曾任职 KTH）
creators.bio_zh: Pedro Sanches 在 SICS 设计了 Affective Health，之后在 KTH 从事身体设计、生物数据与“活的数据”研究。
creators.why_zh: Sanches 主张把生物数据反映给人们自己去解读，而不是拿来诊断人。

creators.name: Vasiliki Tsaknaki
creators.role: Associate Professor, IT University of Copenhagen
creators.bio: Vasiliki Tsaknaki did a PhD at KTH on craft and materials in interaction design and then worked on shape-change, breathing and biodata in the soma design group.
creators.why: Tsaknaki's autobiographical wearables show how a material can make a neglected part of the body felt again.
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根信息技术大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: Vasiliki Tsaknaki 在 KTH 完成关于交互设计中手工艺与材料的博士研究，随后在身体设计团队研究形变、呼吸与生物数据。
creators.why_zh: Tsaknaki 的自传式可穿戴作品展示了材料如何让被忽略的身体部位重新被感受到。

creators.name: Charles Windlin
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Charles Windlin designed and built the Soma Bits, the lab's kit of heat, vibration and shape-change actuators for sketching with the body.
creators.why: The Soma Bits made it possible to feel actuation on the body from the first hour of a design process.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Charles Windlin 设计并制作了 Soma Bits——实验室用来“用身体画草图”的加热、振动与形变执行器套件。
creators.why_zh: 有了 Soma Bits，设计过程一开始就能在身体上感受执行效果。

creators.name: Pavel Karpashevich
creators.role: Researcher, Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg (PhD, KTH)
creators.bio: Pavel Karpashevich designed interactive costumes at Bauhaus-Universität Weimar and shape-changing garments such as the Soma Corset during doctoral work at KTH.
creators.why: Karpashevich's work names the uncanny, monstrous side of wearing technology that touches back.
creators.role_zh: 奥尔登堡大学研究员（KTH 博士）
creators.bio_zh: Pavel Karpashevich 在魏玛包豪斯大学设计互动服装，在 KTH 读博期间设计了 Soma Corset 等形变服装。
creators.why_zh: Karpashevich 的研究直面穿戴会回触身体的技术时那种诡异、“怪物般”的一面。

creators.name: Kelsey Cotton
creators.role: Singer, composer and HCI researcher (KTH; Chalmers University of Technology)
creators.bio: Kelsey Cotton is a classically trained singer who designs and performs with breathing-driven instruments and robotic garments, first at KTH and then in a PhD on AI and voice at Chalmers.
creators.why: Cotton brings a singer's trained interoception into soma design.
creators.role_zh: 歌手、作曲者与人机交互研究者（KTH；查尔姆斯理工大学）
creators.bio_zh: Kelsey Cotton 受过古典声乐训练，先在 KTH、后在查尔姆斯理工大学攻读关于 AI 与嗓音的博士，设计并演出由呼吸驱动的乐器和机器人服装。
creators.why_zh: Cotton 把歌手训练出的内感受带入了身体设计。

creators.name: Rachael Garrett
creators.role: Interaction design researcher (PhD, KTH), felt ethics and soma design
creators.bio: Rachael Garrett studied how ethical sensibility is felt in the body during design work, and co-designed shape-changing garments and drone interactions at KTH.
creators.why: Garrett's 'felt ethics' extends soma design from aesthetics to responsibility.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者（KTH 博士），研究“感受的伦理”与身体设计
creators.bio_zh: Rachael Garrett 研究设计工作中伦理敏感性如何在身体里被感受到，并在 KTH 参与了形变服装和无人机交互的设计。
creators.why_zh: Garrett 提出的“感受的伦理”把身体设计从审美延伸到责任。

creators.name: Muhammad Umair
creators.role: HCI researcher, Lancaster University (AffecTech network)
creators.bio: Muhammad Umair designed materials-based affective interfaces for emotion regulation in the EU AffecTech network, working with Höök's group on biodata and actuation.
creators.why: Umair's toolkits let non-experts shape how their own arousal becomes visible and warm.
creators.role_zh: 兰卡斯特大学人机交互研究者（AffecTech 网络）
creators.bio_zh: Muhammad Umair 在欧盟 AffecTech 网络中设计基于材料的情感界面以支持情绪调节，并与 Höök 团队合作研究生物数据与执行。
creators.why_zh: Umair 的工具包让非专业者自己决定唤醒如何变得可见、可感到温度。

creators.name: Miquel Alfaras
creators.role: Biomedical engineer and HCI researcher (PLUX Wireless Biosignals; Universitat Jaume I)
creators.bio: Miquel Alfaras worked on biosignal hardware at PLUX and on soma design with KTH in the AffecTech network.
creators.why: Alfaras and colleagues framed the move from biodata to 'somadata': signals made available to felt experience.
creators.role_zh: 生物医学工程师与人机交互研究者（PLUX 无线生物信号公司；海梅一世大学）
creators.bio_zh: Miquel Alfaras 在 PLUX 从事生物信号硬件工作，并在 AffecTech 网络中与 KTH 合作进行身体设计。
creators.why_zh: Alfaras 与合作者提出从“生物数据”到“身体数据（somadata）”的转向：让信号能被亲身感受到。

creators.name: Marie Louise Juul Søndergaard
creators.role: Associate Professor, Oslo School of Architecture and Design (AHO)
creators.bio: Marie Louise Juul Søndergaard designs feminist intimate technologies; as a postdoc at KTH, Søndergaard made Menarche Bits and worked on menstrual and menopause design.
creators.why: Søndergaard's work shows how soma design can make room for bodies that culture teaches us to hide.
creators.role_zh: 奥斯陆建筑与设计学院副教授
creators.bio_zh: Marie Louise Juul Søndergaard 设计女性主义的私密技术；在 KTH 做博士后期间做出了 Menarche Bits，并研究月经与更年期设计。
creators.why_zh: Søndergaard 的作品展示了身体设计如何为文化教人隐藏的身体腾出空间。

creators.name: Nadia Campo Woytuk
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Nadia Campo Woytuk works on feminist HCI for intimate health: menstrual blood, cervical mucus and the vaginal microbiome.
creators.why: Campo Woytuk's designs invite people to touch and look at their bodily fluids as sources of self-knowledge.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Nadia Campo Woytuk 从事面向私密健康的女性主义人机交互研究：经血、宫颈黏液与阴道微生物组。
creators.why_zh: Campo Woytuk 的设计邀请人们触摸、观看自己的体液，把它们当作认识自己的来源。

creators.name: Marianela Ciolfi Felice
creators.role: Researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Marianela Ciolfi Felice works on participatory, body-centred design for women's health, including menopause, menstruation and contraception.
creators.why: The menopause work reclaims a medicalised transition as a lived bodily experience.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）研究员
creators.bio_zh: Marianela Ciolfi Felice 研究以身体为中心、参与式的女性健康设计，涉及更年期、月经和避孕。
creators.why_zh: 这项更年期研究把被医学化的人生转变重新找回为亲身经历的身体体验。

creators.name: Joo Young Park
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Joo Young Park designs touch technologies for menstrual discomfort and critiques FemTech through feminist disability studies.
creators.why: Park treats menstrual pain as a cyclical lived experience to be cared for rather than hidden.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Joo Young Park 为经期不适设计触觉技术，并从女性主义残障研究的视角批判女性健康科技（FemTech）。
creators.why_zh: Park 把经痛看作需要照护、而非掩盖的周期性亲身经验。

creators.name: Caroline Yan Zheng
creators.role: Researcher in soft robotics and affective touch, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Caroline Yan Zheng designs soft robotic touch and studies how technologies can touch people well.
creators.why: Zheng asks what makes technology-initiated touch feel caring rather than mechanical.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）软体机器人与情感触觉研究者
creators.bio_zh: Caroline Yan Zheng 设计软体机器人触觉，研究技术怎样才能“触摸得好”。
creators.why_zh: Zheng 追问：由技术发起的触摸，怎样才会让人感到被照护，而不是机械的？

creators.name: Guðrún Margrét Ívansdóttir
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Guðrún Margrét Ívansdóttir designs haptic data physicalisations and shape-changing interfaces in the soma design group.
creators.why: The Kuddi pillow turns menstrual-cycle data into touch.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Guðrún Margrét Ívansdóttir 在身体设计团队中设计触觉数据实体化和形变界面。
creators.why_zh: Kuddi 枕头把月经周期数据变成触摸。

creators.name: Jakob Tholander
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, Stockholm University
creators.bio: Jakob Tholander studies whole-body interaction, sports and bodily experience, and co-organised the Move to be Moved workshop behind the first-person soma design paper.
creators.why: Tholander's running autoethnography treats the trained body as a sensor finer than the watch.
creators.role_zh: 斯德哥尔摩大学交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Jakob Tholander 研究全身交互、运动与身体经验，并参与组织了“Move to be Moved”工作坊，这个工作坊催生了第一人称身体设计的论文。
creators.why_zh: Tholander 关于跑步的自我民族志把受过训练的身体看作比手表更精细的传感器。

creators.name: Ozgun Kilic Afsar
creators.role: Researcher, MIT Media Lab and KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Ozgun Kilic Afsar develops fluidic fibre actuators and soft robotic garments, combining a KTH soma design PhD with work in MIT's Tangible Media Group.
creators.why: Kilic Afsar's garments move one body's felt experience onto another.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室与 KTH 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Ozgun Kilic Afsar 开发流体纤维执行器和软体机器人服装，其 KTH 身体设计博士研究与 MIT 可触媒体组的工作相结合。
creators.why_zh: Kilic Afsar 的服装把一个身体的感受转移到另一个身体上。

creators.name: Yoav Luft
creators.role: Researcher and martial arts practitioner, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Yoav Luft builds sensing and actuation systems for the soma design group and brings a long martial arts practice into design.
creators.why: The Boards Hit Back dummy shows a practitioner changing their own habits through soma design.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）研究者、武术修习者
creators.bio_zh: Yoav Luft 为身体设计团队搭建传感与执行系统，并把多年的武术修习带入设计。
creators.why_zh: Boards Hit Back 的木人桩展示了修习者如何通过身体设计改变自己的习惯。

creators.name: Sara Eriksson
creators.role: Interaction design researcher (PhD, KTH), drones and choreography
creators.bio: Sara Eriksson studied how a choreographer and engineers shaped the movement of drones for an opera, and the ethics of movement.
creators.why: Eriksson's drone opera study made intercorporeality a design resource for machines.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者（KTH 博士），研究无人机与编舞
creators.bio_zh: Sara Eriksson 研究编舞者与工程师如何为一部歌剧塑造无人机的动作，以及动作中的伦理。
creators.why_zh: Eriksson 对无人机歌剧的研究把身体间性变成了设计机器的资源。

creators.name: Annkatrin Jung
creators.role: Interaction designer, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Annkatrin Jung designed the Breathing Garment, which applies deep touch pressure in time with breathing.
creators.why: The Breathing Garment shows pressure as a way to make breathing felt.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计师
creators.bio_zh: Annkatrin Jung 设计了 Breathing Garment，它随呼吸对身体施加深压触觉。
creators.why_zh: Breathing Garment 说明压力可以让呼吸被感受到。

creators.name: Ilias Bergström
creators.role: Researcher in sound and interaction, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Ilias Bergström works on sonification and virtual embodiment; at KTH, Bergström built the Sarka mat with Martin Jonsson.
creators.why: Sarka tests how sound can guide inward listening without pulling attention outward.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）声音与交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: Ilias Bergström 研究声音化与虚拟具身；在 KTH 与 Martin Jonsson 一起做了 Sarka 垫子。
creators.why_zh: Sarka 探索声音如何引导向内聆听，而不把注意力拉向外部。

creators.name: Vygandas Šimbelis
creators.role: Artist and interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Vygandas Šimbelis is an artist who made the Metaphone biofeedback painting machine during doctoral work with Höök at KTH.
creators.why: Šimbelis brought machine aesthetics from art into affective interaction design.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Vygandas Šimbelis 是一位艺术家，在 KTH 随 Höök 读博期间制作了生物反馈绘画机器 Metaphone。
creators.why_zh: Šimbelis 把艺术中的“机器美学”带进了情感交互设计。

creators.name: Claudia Núñez-Pacheco
creators.role: Design researcher, Malmö University (formerly KTH)
creators.bio: Claudia Núñez-Pacheco develops Focusing-based methods for articulating felt sense in design, and worked as a postdoc in the KTH soma design group.
creators.why: Núñez-Pacheco connects Gendlin's felt sense with design and now with language models.
creators.role_zh: 马尔默大学设计研究者（曾任职 KTH）
creators.bio_zh: Claudia Núñez-Pacheco 发展基于“聚焦（Focusing）”的方法，用来在设计中表述体会（felt sense），曾在 KTH 身体设计团队做博士后。
creators.why_zh: Núñez-Pacheco 把 Gendlin 的“体会”与设计、如今又与语言模型联系起来。

creators.name: Thórhildur Ásgeirsdóttir
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Thórhildur Ásgeirsdóttir uses soma design to rethink everyday relations with energy.
creators.why: Ásgeirsdóttir's first-person work asks how energy can be felt rather than only counted.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Thórhildur Ásgeirsdóttir 用身体设计重新思考日常生活与能源的关系。
creators.why_zh: Ásgeirsdóttir 的第一人称研究追问：能源怎样才能被感受到，而不只是被计量？

creators.name: Joseph La Delfa
creators.role: Interaction design researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology (formerly RMIT Exertion Games Lab)
creators.bio: Joseph La Delfa designs somaesthetic human-drone interactions, from Drone Chi at RMIT to How to Train Your Drone at KTH.
creators.why: La Delfa treats a drone as a partner whose sensing world can be shaped with the body.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）交互设计研究者（曾在 RMIT 运动游戏实验室）
creators.bio_zh: Joseph La Delfa 设计身体美学取向的人机无人机交互，从 RMIT 的 Drone Chi 到 KTH 的 How to Train Your Drone。
creators.why_zh: La Delfa 把无人机看作一个伙伴，它的感知世界可以用身体去塑造。

creators.name: Mousa Sondoqah
creators.role: Researcher, Politecnico di Milano (Drone Arena project with RISE, KTH and Stockholm University)
creators.bio: Mousa Sondoqah studied how teams program drones by feeling out their behaviour, in the Drone Arena challenges held at KTH's Reactor Hall.
creators.why: The Drone Arena study shows programmers turning to intimate, bodily probing to understand a machine.
creators.role_zh: 米兰理工大学研究者（与 RISE、KTH、斯德哥尔摩大学合作的 Drone Arena 项目）
creators.bio_zh: Mousa Sondoqah 在 KTH 反应堆大厅举办的 Drone Arena 挑战赛中，研究团队如何通过亲身摸索无人机的行为来为它编程。
creators.why_zh: Drone Arena 研究显示，编程者会转向亲密的、身体性的试探来理解一台机器。

creators.name: Teresa Almeida
creators.role: Interaction design researcher; PhD from Open Lab, Newcastle University; later at Umeå University
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者；博士毕业于纽卡斯尔大学 Open Lab，后任职于于默奥大学
creators.based_zh: 纽卡斯尔，英国 / 于默奥，瑞典
creators.bio: Portuguese designer-researcher who works on women's intimate health, pelvic fitness and self-knowledge of the body through wearables and interactive systems.
creators.bio_zh: 葡萄牙设计研究者，通过可穿戴设备与交互系统研究女性的私密健康、盆底锻炼与对自身身体的认识。
creators.why: Almeida put the pelvic floor and the vulva on the HCI agenda and framed intimate care as designing for bodily self-knowledge rather than for shame.
creators.why_zh: Almeida把盆底与外阴带进人机交互的议程，把私密照护理解为帮助人认识自己的身体，而不是回避羞耻。

creators.name: Madeline Balaam
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, KTH Royal Institute of Technology (previously Open Lab, Newcastle University)
creators.role_zh: KTH 皇家理工学院交互设计教授（曾任职纽卡斯尔大学 Open Lab）
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on women's health, intimate care, rehabilitation and feminist approaches to designing for the body.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究女性健康、私密照护、康复，以及以女性主义方式为身体设计。
creators.why: Balaam's Newcastle work on stroke rehabilitation and intimate care, and later KTH work with Höök, tie feminist HCI to soma design.
creators.why_zh: Balaam在纽卡斯尔关于中风康复与私密照护的研究，以及之后在 KTH 与 Höök 的合作，把女性主义人机交互和身体设计连接起来。

creators.name: Rob Comber
creators.role: Associate Professor of Communication, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: KTH 皇家理工学院传播学副教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on civic, feminist and food technologies, formerly at Open Lab, Newcastle University.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，关注公民、女性主义与食物相关的技术，曾任职纽卡斯尔大学 Open Lab。
creators.why: Co-author of the intimate care and Labella work that made women's pelvic health a design topic.
creators.why_zh: 私密照护与 Labella 研究的合作者，这些研究让女性盆底健康成为设计议题。

creators.name: Jeffrey Bardzell
creators.role: Professor of Informatics, Pennsylvania State University
creators.role_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学信息学教授
creators.bio: HCI theorist working on design criticism, aesthetics and feminist and humanistic perspectives on interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互理论学者，研究设计批评、美学以及交互设计中的女性主义与人文视角。
creators.why: With Shaowen Bardzell, Jeffrey Bardzell brought sexuality, pleasure and the designer sex toy into HCI as serious objects of design and critique.
creators.why_zh: Jeffrey Bardzell 与 Shaowen Bardzell 一起，把性、愉悦与设计师情趣用品作为严肃的设计与批评对象带入人机交互。

creators.name: Shaowen Bardzell
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院交互计算学院教授
creators.bio: HCI scholar known for feminist HCI and humanistic approaches to interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互学者，以女性主义人机交互和人文取向的交互设计研究著称。
creators.why: Shaowen Bardzell's Feminist HCI agenda named pluralism, embodiment and ecology as qualities design should answer to, opening the way for intimate and feminist soma design.
creators.why_zh: Shaowen Bardzell的女性主义人机交互议程把多元、具身与生态列为设计应回应的品质，为亲密与女性主义的身体设计开了路。

creators.name: Gopinaath Kannabiran
creators.role: Researcher in interaction design, IT University of Copenhagen
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根信息技术大学交互设计研究者
creators.bio: Brings queer, ecofeminist and sexuality perspectives into HCI and computational art.
creators.bio_zh: 把酷儿、生态女性主义与性的视角带入人机交互与计算艺术。
creators.why: Kannabiran mapped how HCI talks, and avoids talking, about sexuality, and co-organised the CHI workshop on design for sexual wellbeing.
creators.why_zh: Kannabiran梳理了人机交互如何谈论、又如何回避谈论性，并共同组织了 CHI 性健康设计工作坊。

creators.name: Anna Eaglin
creators.role: HCI design researcher (Indiana University at the time of the work)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互设计研究者（研究时就读于印第安纳大学）
creators.bio: Design researcher who studied sex toys and their users with Shaowen Bardzell.
creators.bio_zh: 与 Shaowen Bardzell 一起研究情趣用品及其使用者的设计研究者。
creators.why: Eaglin's user study framed sex toys as tools for sexual wellness, not novelties.
creators.why_zh: Eaglin的用户研究把情趣用品视为性健康的工具，而非猎奇之物。

creators.name: Amanda Lazar
creators.role: Associate Professor, College of Information, University of Maryland
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学信息学院副教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on ageing, dementia, menopause and the lived experience of changing bodies.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，关注衰老、失智、更年期以及身体变化的亲历经验。
creators.why: Lazar's menopause study shows that bodily change becomes meaningful socially, over time, and that design should follow lived experience rather than symptoms.
creators.why_zh: Lazar对更年期的研究表明，身体变化是在社会中、随时间获得意义的，设计应追随亲历经验，而不只是症状。

creators.name: Anupriya Tuli
creators.role: HCI researcher, Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi)
creators.role_zh: 德里英德拉普拉斯塔信息技术学院（IIIT-Delhi）人机交互研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher on menstrual health, education and mobility in India, working with feminist and period-positive approaches.
creators.bio_zh: 研究印度月经健康、教育与出行的人机交互研究者，采用女性主义与“经期正向”的方法。
creators.why: Tuli's work moves menstrual technology away from tracking alone toward period-positive ecologies that address shame, space and silence around the menstruating body.
creators.why_zh: Tuli的研究让月经技术不再只是追踪，而是走向“经期正向”的生态，回应围绕经期身体的羞耻、空间与沉默。

creators.name: Shaan Chopra
creators.role: HCI researcher (IIIT-Delhi; later University of Washington)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（IIIT-Delhi，后赴华盛顿大学）
creators.based_zh: 新德里，印度 / 西雅图，美国
creators.bio: HCI researcher on menstrual health and chronic illness self-management.
creators.bio_zh: 研究月经健康与慢性病自我管理的人机交互研究者。
creators.why: Co-author of the Menstrupedia and menstrual (im)mobilities studies.
creators.why_zh: Menstrupedia 与月经（不）流动性研究的合作者。

creators.name: Neha Kumar
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Interactive Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院交互计算学院副教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on technology and global development, with a focus on women's health in the Global South.
creators.bio_zh: 研究技术与全球发展的人机交互学者，关注全球南方的女性健康。
creators.why: Co-author of the period-positive menstrual health work that centres Indian women's bodies and contexts.
creators.why_zh: “经期正向”月经健康研究的合作者，以印度女性的身体与处境为中心。

creators.name: Sarah Fox
creators.role: Assistant Professor, Human-Computer Interaction Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学人机交互研究所助理教授
creators.bio: HCI and design researcher on feminist hacking, menstrual technologies and labour.
creators.bio_zh: 研究女性主义黑客文化、月经技术与劳动的人机交互与设计研究者。
creators.why: Fox's speculative menstrual-tracking work shows how intimate body data can be turned against the people it describes.
creators.why_zh: Fox的思辨式月经追踪研究揭示，私密身体数据可能反过来被用来对付它所描述的人。

creators.name: Catherine D'Ignazio
creators.role: Associate Professor of Urban Science and Planning, MIT; director of the Data + Feminism Lab
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院城市科学与规划副教授，Data + Feminism Lab 主任
creators.bio: Scholar, artist and designer working on feminist data practices; co-author of Data Feminism (2020).
creators.bio_zh: 研究女性主义数据实践的学者、艺术家与设计师，《数据女性主义》（2020）合著者。
creators.why: D'Ignazio co-organised the Make the Breast Pump Not Suck hackathons, treating the lactating body as a design problem worth public attention.
creators.why_zh: D'Ignazio共同发起“让吸奶器不再糟糕”黑客松，把哺乳的身体当作值得公众关注的设计问题。

creators.name: Katta Spiel
creators.role: Assistant Professor, Human-Computer Interaction group, TU Wien
creators.role_zh: 维也纳工业大学人机交互组助理教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher working on neurodivergent, disabled, non-binary and trans perspectives on embodied interaction; SIGCHI Outstanding Dissertation Award 2020.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，从神经多样、残障、非二元与跨性别的视角研究具身交互；2020 年 SIGCHI 杰出博士论文奖得主。
creators.why: Spiel asks which bodies embodied interaction assumes, and shows how norms of ability and gender are built into devices.
creators.why_zh: Spiel 追问具身交互默认的是谁的身体，揭示能力与性别的规范如何被做进设备里。

creators.name: Os Keyes
creators.role: Researcher in HCI and science and technology studies (PhD, University of Washington)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互与科学技术研究学者（华盛顿大学博士）
creators.bio: Writer and researcher on gender, disability and technology, known for critical work on automated gender recognition.
creators.bio_zh: 研究性别、残障与技术的作者和学者，以批判自动性别识别的研究著称。
creators.why: Keyes's work with Spiel questions the idea of 'women's health' built on essentialised bodies.
creators.why_zh: Keyes 与 Spiel 的合作质疑建立在本质化身体之上的“女性健康”概念。

creators.name: Oliver L. Haimson
creators.role: Assistant Professor, School of Information, University of Michigan
creators.role_zh: 密歇根大学信息学院助理教授
creators.bio: Social computing researcher on trans people's experiences with technology; author of Trans Technologies (MIT Press, 2025).
creators.bio_zh: 研究跨性别者技术经验的社会计算学者，著有《Trans Technologies》（MIT 出版社，2025）。
creators.why: Haimson's participatory work names technologies for changing bodies as a core need of trans communities.
creators.why_zh: Haimson的参与式研究指出，“改变身体的技术”是跨性别社群的核心需要之一。

creators.name: Alex A. Ahmed
creators.role: HCI researcher; founder of Project Spectra (PhD, Northeastern University)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，Project Spectra 发起人（东北大学博士）
creators.bio: Researcher and developer who built free, open-source voice training tools with and for trans communities.
creators.bio_zh: 与跨性别社群一起、为他们开发免费开源嗓音训练工具的研究者与开发者。
creators.why: Ahmed's voice-training work treats the voice as a felt, gendered part of the body that people retrain through practice.
creators.why_zh: Ahmed的嗓音训练研究把嗓音视为身体中被感受、带有性别的一部分，人们通过练习重新训练它。

creators.name: Yolande Strengers
creators.role: Professor of Digital Technology and Society, Monash University
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学数字技术与社会教授
creators.bio: Sociologist of technology working on smart homes, gender and intimate technologies; co-author of The Smart Wife (2020).
creators.bio_zh: 技术社会学者，研究智能家居、性别与亲密技术，《The Smart Wife》（2020）合著者。
creators.why: Strengers carried the feminist model of embodied sexual consent into interaction design.
creators.why_zh: Strengers把女性主义的具身性同意模式带入交互设计。

creators.name: Odile Fillod
creators.role: Independent researcher in the sociology of science
creators.role_zh: 科学社会学独立研究者
creators.bio: French researcher who critiques biological claims about sex and gender and made an open-source, life-size 3D model of the clitoris in 2016.
creators.bio_zh: 法国研究者，批判关于性与性别的生物学论断，并于 2016 年制作了开源的等大 3D 阴蒂模型。
creators.why: Fillod's printable model gave schools and readers a tactile, accurate image of an organ that anatomy teaching had left out.
creators.why_zh: Fillod的可打印模型为学校和读者提供了一个可以触摸、准确的器官形象，而这个器官长期被解剖学教学遗漏。

creators.name: Aneesha Singh
creators.role: Professor of Human-Computer Interaction, UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC)
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院交互中心（UCLIC）人机交互教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on chronic pain, body awareness and technology for health and wellbeing.
creators.bio_zh: 研究慢性疼痛、身体觉察以及健康与安适技术的人机交互学者。
creators.why: Singh's Go-with-the-flow work showed that sonifying movement and breath can rebuild confidence to move in a body that fears pain.
creators.why_zh: Singh的 Go-with-the-flow 研究表明，把动作和呼吸变成声音，可以帮一个害怕疼痛的身体重新建立活动的信心。

creators.name: Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze
creators.role: Professor of Affective Computing and Interaction, UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC)
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院交互中心（UCLIC）情感计算与交互教授
creators.bio: Researcher on body movement, touch and affect, who led the EmoPain project on technology for chronic pain rehabilitation.
creators.bio_zh: 研究身体动作、触觉与情感的学者，主持了面向慢性疼痛康复的 EmoPain 项目。
creators.why: Bianchi-Berthouze treats bodily expression as the carrier of emotion, which grounds the lab's pain and movement-sonification work.
creators.why_zh: Bianchi-Berthouze把身体表达视为情绪的载体，这是其实验室疼痛与动作声音化研究的基础。

creators.name: Joseph W. Newbold
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, UCL Interaction Centre; later Northumbria University)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（伦敦大学学院交互中心博士，后任职诺森比亚大学）
creators.based_zh: 伦敦 / 纽卡斯尔，英国
creators.bio: Researcher on musical sonification of movement for physical rehabilitation.
creators.bio_zh: 研究以音乐化声音呈现动作、用于身体康复的学者。
creators.why: Newbold used musical expectation, a phrase that wants to resolve, to pace people with chronic pain through movement.
creators.why_zh: Newbold利用音乐期待（一个想要落定的乐句）来为慢性疼痛患者的动作定节奏。

creators.name: Amey Holden
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, Open Lab, Newcastle University)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（纽卡斯尔大学 Open Lab 博士）
creators.bio: Researcher on wearable technology for upper limb rehabilitation after stroke.
creators.bio_zh: 研究中风后上肢康复可穿戴技术的学者。
creators.why: Holden's CueS wristband prompts stroke survivors to use the affected arm in daily life.
creators.why_zh: Holden的 CueS 腕带提醒中风幸存者在日常生活中使用受影响的手臂。

creators.name: Jay Vidyarthi
creators.role: Designer of meditation technology (MSc, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University)
creators.role_zh: 冥想技术设计师（西蒙弗雷泽大学交互艺术与技术学院硕士）
creators.based_zh: 温哥华 / 蒙特利尔，加拿大
creators.bio: Designer and researcher who creates interactive tools for meditation and mindful technology use.
creators.bio_zh: 为冥想与正念使用技术创作交互工具的设计师与研究者。
creators.why: Sonic Cradle showed that a dark room and one's own breath turned into music can lead non-meditators into a meditative state.
creators.why_zh: Sonic Cradle 表明，一间暗室加上被转化为音乐的自己的呼吸，就能把不冥想的人带入冥想状态。

creators.name: Bernhard E. Riecke
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University; leads the iSpace Lab
creators.role_zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学交互艺术与技术学院教授，iSpace 实验室负责人
creators.bio: Researcher on self-motion perception, VR and technology for transformative, connected experiences.
creators.bio_zh: 研究自我运动知觉、虚拟现实以及促成转变与联结体验技术的学者。
creators.why: Riecke's lab builds breath- and body-centred immersive systems for meditation and connection.
creators.why_zh: Riecke的实验室打造以呼吸和身体为中心的沉浸式系统，用于冥想与人际联结。

creators.name: Diane Gromala
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University; former Canada Research Chair in Computational Technologies for Transforming Pain
creators.role_zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学交互艺术与技术学院教授，曾任加拿大“转化疼痛的计算技术”研究讲席
creators.bio: Artist and researcher who has worked on VR and the body since the early 1990s, and on immersive technology for people living with chronic pain.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家与研究者，自 1990 年代初起研究虚拟现实与身体，并为慢性疼痛者开发沉浸式技术。
creators.why: Gromala designs VR that teaches people to attend to pain differently rather than to escape it.
creators.why_zh: Gromala 设计的 VR 教人换一种方式注意疼痛，而不是逃离疼痛。

creators.name: Joan Sol Roo
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, Inria Bordeaux, Potioc team)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（法国国家信息与自动化研究所波尔多中心 Potioc 团队博士）
creators.bio: Researcher on spatial augmented reality and tangible mixed reality for introspection.
creators.bio_zh: 研究空间增强现实与用于内省的有形混合现实的学者。
creators.why: Inner Garden makes breath and heart rhythm shape a living sand landscape one tends by hand.
creators.why_zh: Inner Garden 让呼吸与心律塑造一片用手照料的“活”的沙景。

creators.name: Martin Hachet
creators.role: Research Director, Inria Bordeaux (Potioc team)
creators.role_zh: 法国国家信息与自动化研究所波尔多中心研究主任（Potioc 团队）
creators.bio: Researcher on tangible and augmented interaction for learning, art and wellbeing.
creators.bio_zh: 研究面向学习、艺术与安适的有形与增强交互的学者。
creators.why: Hachet's team built Inner Garden and related tangible systems for introspection and mindfulness.
creators.why_zh: Hachet的团队打造了 Inner Garden 等用于内省与正念的有形系统。

creators.name: Rakesh Patibanda
creators.role: HCI researcher, Exertion Games Lab, Monash University
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学 Exertion Games Lab 人机交互研究者
creators.bio: Researcher on breathing games, bodily play and actuated bodily extensions.
creators.bio_zh: 研究呼吸游戏、身体游戏与驱动式身体延伸的学者。
creators.why: Life Tree turns slow breathing into play that people choose to return to.
creators.why_zh: Life Tree 把缓慢呼吸变成人们愿意回来再玩的游戏。

creators.name: Florian 'Floyd' Mueller
creators.role: Professor, Monash University; directs the Exertion Games Lab
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学教授，Exertion Games Lab 主任
creators.bio: HCI researcher on exertion games, bodily play and human-computer integration.
creators.bio_zh: 研究运动型游戏、身体游戏与人机融合的人机交互学者。
creators.why: Mueller's lab frames the body as a site of play, and co-authored work on breathing games and embodied consent.
creators.why_zh: Mueller的实验室把身体视为玩的场所，并参与了呼吸游戏与具身性同意等研究。

creators.name: Kathryn E. Ringland
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Computational Media, University of California, Santa Cruz
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校计算媒体系助理教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on autism, sensory experience, disability and play.
creators.bio_zh: 研究自闭症、感官经验、残障与游戏的人机交互学者。
creators.why: SensoryPaint turned sensory therapy for autistic children into full-body play with textured balls and projected paint.
creators.why_zh: SensoryPaint 把自闭症儿童的感统治疗变成用触感球和投影颜料进行的全身游戏。

creators.name: Joan Mora-Guiard
creators.role: Researcher, Full-Body Interaction Lab, Universitat Pompeu Fabra
creators.role_zh: 庞培法布拉大学全身交互实验室研究者
creators.bio: Researcher on full-body mixed reality for social interaction in autistic children.
creators.bio_zh: 研究面向自闭症儿童社交的全身混合现实的学者。
creators.why: Lands of Fog uses shared full-body play in a projected world to invite social encounters without instruction.
creators.why_zh: Lands of Fog 在投影世界里以共同的全身游戏，不靠指令地引发社交相遇。

creators.name: Narcís Parés
creators.role: Associate Professor; leads the Full-Body Interaction Lab, Universitat Pompeu Fabra
creators.role_zh: 庞培法布拉大学副教授，全身交互实验室负责人
creators.bio: Researcher on full-body interaction and embodied cognition in interactive environments.
creators.bio_zh: 研究交互环境中的全身交互与具身认知的学者。
creators.why: Parés's lab designs for 'when the body acquires meaning', using full-body interaction for learning and inclusion.
creators.why_zh: Parés的实验室为“身体获得意义之时”而设计，用全身交互服务学习与融合。

creators.name: Franca Garzotto
creators.role: Professor, Politecnico di Milano; leads the I3Lab
creators.role_zh: 米兰理工大学教授，I3Lab 负责人
creators.bio: HCI researcher on smart multisensory spaces and technology for children with neurodevelopmental disorders.
creators.bio_zh: 研究智能多感官空间以及面向神经发育障碍儿童技术的人机交互学者。
creators.why: The Magic Room turns a whole room of light, sound and objects into a responsive partner for sensory play.
creators.why_zh: Magic Room 把一整间由光、声音与物件构成的房间变成回应感官游戏的伙伴。

creators.name: Cathy Treadaway
creators.role: Professor of Creative Practice, Cardiff Metropolitan University; leads the LAUGH project
creators.role_zh: 卡迪夫城市大学创意实践教授，LAUGH 项目负责人
creators.bio: Design researcher on compassionate design, playful objects and wellbeing in advanced dementia.
creators.bio_zh: 研究慈悲设计、游戏化物件以及晚期失智者安适的设计研究者。
creators.why: Treadaway's HUG doll offers touch, a heartbeat and music to people who can no longer be reached through words.
creators.why_zh: Treadaway的 HUG 玩偶为已无法用语言触及的人提供触摸、心跳与音乐。

creators.name: Nikki Theofanopoulou
creators.role: Researcher; co-founder of Purrble (King's College London / Sensing Self)
creators.role_zh: 研究者，Purrble 联合创始人（伦敦国王学院 / Sensing Self）
creators.bio: Researcher on in-situ, embodied interventions for children's emotion regulation.
creators.bio_zh: 研究儿童情绪调节的在地、具身干预的学者。
creators.why: Purrble shows that calming another body in your lap can be a way of calming your own.
creators.why_zh: Purrble 表明，安抚怀里的另一个“身体”，也可以是安抚自己的方式。

creators.name: Katherine Isbister
creators.role: Professor of Computational Media, University of California, Santa Cruz
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校计算媒体系教授
creators.bio: Game and HCI researcher on emotion, movement and social play; author of How Games Move Us (2016).
creators.bio_zh: 研究情感、运动与社交游戏的游戏与人机交互学者，著有《How Games Move Us》（2016）。
creators.why: From eMoto and SenToy with Höök to fidget widgets and Purrble, Isbister designs for emotion felt through the hands and body.
creators.why_zh: 从与 Höök 合作的 eMoto、SenToy，到指尖小物与 Purrble，Isbister 为通过手与身体感受的情绪而设计。

creators.name: Michael Karlesky
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, New York University)
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（纽约大学博士）
creators.bio: Researcher on fidgeting and embodied self-regulation at the margins of digital work.
creators.bio_zh: 研究数字工作边缘的摆弄小动作与具身自我调节的学者。
creators.why: Karlesky took fidgeting seriously as a bodily way of regulating attention and emotion.
creators.why_zh: Karlesky认真对待“摆弄小动作”，把它视为调节注意与情绪的身体方式。

creators.name: Hester Anderiesen-Le Riche
creators.role: Designer; founder of Tover (PhD, Delft University of Technology)
creators.role_zh: 设计师，Tover 创始人（代尔夫特理工大学博士）
creators.bio: Industrial designer whose PhD on playful design for people with advanced dementia led to the Tovertafel.
creators.bio_zh: 工业设计师，Anderiesen-Le Riche关于为晚期失智者做游戏化设计的博士研究催生了 Tovertafel。
creators.why: Anderiesen-Le Riche designed play that invites people with apathy to reach, touch and move again.
creators.why_zh: Anderiesen-Le Riche设计的游戏邀请陷入淡漠的人重新伸手、触碰与活动。

creators.name: Mark Morris Dance Group
creators.role: Dance company, Brooklyn; co-founder of Dance for PD with the Brooklyn Parkinson Group
creators.role_zh: 布鲁克林的舞蹈团，与布鲁克林帕金森组织共同创办 Dance for PD
creators.bio: Modern dance company founded by choreographer Mark Morris in 1980; its Dance for PD program is led by David Leventhal.
creators.bio_zh: 编舞家 Mark Morris 于 1980 年创立的现代舞团；其 Dance for PD 项目由 David Leventhal 主持。
creators.why: Dance for PD treats people with Parkinson's as dancers, using music and imagery to find movement that cueing alone does not reach.
creators.why_zh: Dance for PD 把帕金森患者当作舞者，借音乐与意象找到单靠提示无法唤起的动作。

creators.name: V. S. Ramachandran
creators.role: Distinguished Professor, Department of Psychology, University of California, San Diego
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校心理学系杰出教授
creators.bio: Neuroscientist known for work on phantom limbs, body image and synaesthesia; author of Phantoms in the Brain (1998).
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学家，以幻肢、身体意象与联觉研究著称，著有《脑中魅影》（1998）。
creators.why: Ramachandran's mirror box showed that the felt body is built by the brain from vision and movement, and can be rebuilt.
creators.why_zh: Ramachandran的镜箱表明，被感受的身体是大脑用视觉与动作建构的，而且可以被重建。

creators.name: Jan Hulsegge
creators.role: Therapist, De Hartenberg Institute, Ede (Netherlands)
creators.role_zh: 荷兰埃德市 De Hartenberg 机构治疗师
creators.bio: Dutch therapist who, with Ad Verheul, developed and named Snoezelen in 1978 and co-wrote Snoezelen: Another World.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰治疗师，1978 年与 Ad Verheul 一起发展并命名了 Snoezelen，并合著《Snoezelen：另一个世界》。
creators.why: Snoezelen made a room of soft light, sound and touch a place to rest and explore without a task.
creators.why_zh: Snoezelen 让一间充满柔光、声音与触感的房间，成为无需完成任务、可以休息与探索的地方。

creators.name: Ad Verheul
creators.role: Therapist, De Hartenberg Institute, Ede (Netherlands)
creators.role_zh: 荷兰埃德市 De Hartenberg 机构治疗师
creators.bio: Dutch therapist and co-founder of Snoezelen with Jan Hulsegge.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰治疗师，与 Jan Hulsegge 共同创立 Snoezelen。
creators.why: Co-author of the first book on Snoezelen multisensory environments.
creators.why_zh: 第一本关于 Snoezelen 多感官环境著作的合著者。

creators.name: Anna Vallgårda
creators.role: Associate Professor, IT University of Copenhagen
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根 IT 大学副教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher on computational composites, materiality and the body.
creators.bio_zh: 研究计算复合材料、物质性与身体的交互设计学者。
creators.why: Co-author of Homewood's phenomenological work on self-tracking and the changing body.
creators.why_zh: Homewood 关于自我追踪与变化中身体的现象学研究的合作者。

creators.name: Hunter G. Hoffman
creators.role: Research scientist, Human Photonics Lab, University of Washington
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学 Human Photonics Lab 研究科学家
creators.bio: Cognitive psychologist who, with David Patterson, pioneered immersive virtual reality for pain relief during burn wound care.
creators.bio_zh: 认知心理学家，与 David Patterson 一起开创了在烧伤换药中用沉浸式虚拟现实缓解疼痛的研究。
creators.why: Hoffman's SnowWorld showed that where attention goes changes how much pain is felt, the canonical case of VR analgesia.
creators.why_zh: Hoffman 的 SnowWorld 表明注意力去向会改变疼痛感受的强弱，是 VR 镇痛的经典案例。

creators.name: Jonas Löwgren
creators.role: Professor of Interaction and Information Design, Linköping University
creators.role_zh: 林雪平大学交互与信息设计教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher known for work on design knowledge and interaction aesthetics.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，以设计知识与交互美学研究著称。
creators.why: With Höök he framed 'strong concepts', the intermediate-level knowledge that soma design uses to share what it learns.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Höök 提出“强概念”，身体设计借这种中间层知识分享它的发现。

creators.name: Andrés Lucero
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Aalto University
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学交互设计教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher working on participatory, playful and first-person design methods.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，研究参与式、游戏化与第一人称的设计方法。
creators.why: He gathered HCI's first-person methods under one banner with 'A Sample of One'.
creators.why_zh: 他以“A Sample of One”把人机交互中的第一人称方法汇聚到一起。

creators.name: Audrey Desjardins
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Art + Art History + Design, University of Washington
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学艺术、艺术史与设计学院副教授
creators.bio: Design researcher who works through autobiographical design and living with prototypes at home.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，通过自传式设计和在家中与原型共同生活来做研究。
creators.why: Her work spells out what it takes for designers to use their own lived experience as research data.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究讲清楚了设计师把自己的生活经验当作研究数据需要什么。

creators.name: Carman Neustaedter
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on domestic and family technologies and telepresence.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究家庭与亲人之间的技术以及远程临场。
creators.why: With Phoebe Sengers he named autobiographical design as a legitimate HCI research method.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Phoebe Sengers 一起把自传式设计确立为正当的人机交互研究方法。

creators.name: Genevieve Bell
creators.role: Anthropologist; former Intel Fellow and Director of the School of Cybernetics, Australian National University
creators.role_zh: 人类学家；前英特尔院士，澳大利亚国立大学控制论学院前院长
creators.bio: Cultural anthropologist who studied technology in everyday life across cultures.
creators.bio_zh: 文化人类学家，研究不同文化日常生活中的技术。
creators.why: She co-wrote 'Making by making strange', which taught HCI to defamiliarize the ordinary.
creators.why_zh: 她是《Making by making strange》的第一作者，这篇论文教会人机交互把平常之物陌生化。

creators.name: Kristina Mah
creators.role: Design researcher, The University of Sydney
creators.role_zh: 悉尼大学设计研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher who studies contemplative and compassion practices as a way to train designers' self-observation.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究如何以冥想与慈悲修习训练设计师的自我观察。
creators.why: She shows how contemplative training can make first-person soma design research more careful.
creators.why_zh: 她展示了冥想训练如何让第一人称的身体设计研究更细致可靠。

creators.name: Lian Loke
creators.role: Associate Professor, Design Lab, The University of Sydney
creators.role_zh: 悉尼大学设计实验室副教授
creators.bio: Interaction designer and performance-maker who works with the moving, feeling body in design.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师与表演创作者，在设计中与运动、感受着的身体一起工作。
creators.why: Her 'Moving and Making Strange' gave movement-based and soma design a practical method for estrangement.
creators.why_zh: 她的“Moving and Making Strange”为基于动作的设计与身体设计提供了一套可操作的陌生化方法。

creators.name: Lone Koefoed Hansen
creators.role: Associate Professor of Digital Design, Aarhus University
creators.role_zh: 奥胡斯大学数字设计副教授
creators.bio: Digital design researcher working on aesthetics, critique and embodied experience with technology.
creators.bio_zh: 数字设计研究者，关注美学、批判与技术中的具身经验。
creators.why: With Susan Kozel she devised 'embodied imagination', a method that mixes improvisation and design for intimacy.
creators.why_zh: 她与 Susan Kozel 提出“具身想象”，把即兴与为亲密而做的设计结合起来。

creators.name: Danielle Wilde
creators.role: Professor of Embodied Design, Umeå Institute of Design / University of Southern Denmark
creators.role_zh: 具身设计教授，于默奥设计学院 / 南丹麦大学
creators.bio: Designer and researcher working with the body, performance, wearables and participatory futures.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师与研究者，与身体、表演、可穿戴物和参与式未来一起工作。
creators.why: Her work analyses how estrangement in embodied ideation opens new design possibilities.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究剖析了具身构思中的陌生化如何打开新的设计可能。

creators.name: Oscar Tomico
creators.role: Associate Professor, Eindhoven University of Technology; Elisava Barcelona
creators.role_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学副教授；巴塞罗那 Elisava 设计学院
creators.bio: Design researcher on soft wearables, first-person and embodied design research.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究柔性可穿戴、第一人称与具身设计研究。
creators.why: He co-shaped first-person and embodied ideation methods in wearables design.
creators.why_zh: 他参与塑造了可穿戴设计中的第一人称与具身构思方法。

creators.name: Thecla Schiphorst
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院教授
creators.bio: Media artist, dancer and Certified Laban Movement Analyst who brought somatics into HCI.
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家、舞者与认证 Laban 动作分析师，把身心学（somatics）带入人机交互。
creators.why: Her idea of somatic connoisseurship treats the trained felt sense as a valid basis for experience design.
creators.why_zh: 她提出的“身体鉴赏力”，把经过训练的身体感受当作体验设计的正当依据。

creators.name: Jules Françoise
creators.role: CNRS researcher, LISN, Université Paris-Saclay
creators.role_zh: 法国国家科学研究中心研究员，巴黎萨克雷大学 LISN 实验室
creators.bio: Researcher in movement-sound interaction and interactive machine learning.
creators.bio_zh: 研究动作—声音交互与交互式机器学习。
creators.why: He studies how interactive sound can deepen kinaesthetic awareness, and how to ask people about it.
creators.why_zh: 他研究互动声音如何加深动觉觉察，以及如何询问人们的这种体验。

creators.name: Yves Candau
creators.role: Researcher and somatic movement practitioner, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者、身体动作修习者
creators.bio: Movement practitioner and researcher who connects somatic practices, embodied cognition and interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 动作修习者与研究者，连接身体修习、具身认知与交互设计。
creators.why: He brings somatic practitioners' ways of attending into interactive system design.
creators.why_zh: 他把身体修习者的觉察方式带进交互系统设计。

creators.name: Sarah Fdili Alaoui
creators.role: Professor of Art, Science and Technology, Université Paris-Saclay; choreographer
creators.role_zh: 巴黎萨克雷大学艺术、科学与技术教授；编舞家
creators.bio: Dancer, Laban Movement Analyst and HCI researcher working on movement qualities and dance with technology.
creators.bio_zh: 舞者、Laban 动作分析师与人机交互研究者，研究动作质感与舞蹈中的技术。
creators.why: She bridges dance knowledge and design research on the felt quality of movement.
creators.why_zh: 她在舞蹈知识与关于动作感受质感的设计研究之间架桥。

creators.name: Antti Oulasvirta
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Aalto University
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher, early on in mobile and contextual design, later in computational models of interaction.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，早期研究移动与情境设计，后来研究交互的计算模型。
creators.why: His bodystorming case studies established designing by physically being in the situation.
creators.why_zh: 他的身体风暴案例研究确立了“亲身置身情境中”做设计的方法。

creators.name: Dennis Schleicher
creators.role: Design researcher and consultant; OCAD University Strategic Foresight and Innovation alumnus
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者与顾问；OCAD 大学战略预见与创新项目校友
creators.bio: Design researcher who wrote on bodystorming as a form of embodied designing.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，撰文把身体风暴阐述为一种具身的设计方式。
creators.why: He reframed bodystorming from role-play to embodied thinking.
creators.why_zh: 他把身体风暴从角色扮演重新理解为用身体思考。

creators.name: Marion Buchenau
creators.role: Designer, formerly IDEO
creators.role_zh: 设计师，曾任职 IDEO
creators.bio: Interaction designer who, with Jane Fulton Suri, described experience prototyping at IDEO.
