creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，与 Jane Fulton Suri 一起在 IDEO 阐述了体验原型方法。
creators.why: Experience prototyping made 'feel it yourself' a standard step in design practice.
creators.why_zh: 体验原型让“亲身去感受”成为设计实践中的常规步骤。

creators.name: Jane Fulton Suri
creators.role: Partner Emeritus and Chief Creative Officer, IDEO
creators.role_zh: IDEO 荣誉合伙人、前首席创意官
creators.bio: Psychologist and designer who shaped human-centred design research at IDEO.
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家与设计师，塑造了 IDEO 以人为本的设计研究。
creators.why: She championed learning through bodily, first-hand experience of prototypes.
creators.why_zh: 她倡导通过亲身、身体性地体验原型来学习。

creators.name: Elena Márquez Segura
creators.role: Associate Professor, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
creators.role_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学副教授
creators.bio: Interaction designer working on embodied and social play, movement and physical training.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，研究具身与社交游戏、动作与身体训练。
creators.why: She developed embodied sketching, which puts moving bodies and play at the start of design.
creators.why_zh: 她发展了具身草图法，把运动的身体与游戏放在设计的起点。

creators.name: Laia Turmo Vidal
creators.role: Researcher, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid / KTH
creators.role_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学 / 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: Interaction designer researching technology for physical training, movement learning and embodied design methods.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，研究身体训练技术、动作学习与具身设计方法。
creators.why: She develops methods and strong concepts for designing with trainers' and trainees' felt bodies.
creators.why_zh: 她为“以教练与学员的身体感受来设计”发展方法与强概念。

creators.name: Paul Tennent
creators.role: Associate Professor, Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室副教授
creators.bio: HCI researcher on amusement rides, bodily experience and biosensing in extreme experiences.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究游乐设施、身体经验以及极端体验中的生物传感。
creators.why: He led the soma trajectories method for articulating how a felt experience unfolds over time.
creators.why_zh: 他主导了“身体轨迹”方法，用来说出一段被感受的经验如何随时间展开。

creators.name: Steve Benford
creators.role: Professor of Collaborative Computing, Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室协作计算教授
creators.bio: Co-founder of the Mixed Reality Lab, known for performance-led research with artists and the trajectories framework.
creators.bio_zh: 混合现实实验室联合创始人，以与艺术家合作的表演导向研究和“轨迹”框架著称。
creators.why: His trajectories framework became the basis for soma trajectories.
creators.why_zh: 他的“轨迹”框架成为身体轨迹方法的基础。

creators.name: Claire Petitmengin
creators.role: Professor Emerita, Institut Mines-Télécom; member of the Archives Husserl, Paris
creators.role_zh: 巴黎电信矿业学院荣休教授；巴黎胡塞尔档案馆成员
creators.bio: Philosopher and researcher who developed the micro-phenomenological interview from Varela's neurophenomenology and Vermersch's explicitation interview.
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家与研究者，在 Varela 的神经现象学与 Vermersch 的“明述访谈”基础上发展出微观现象学访谈。
creators.why: Her interview method gives designers a rigorous way to help people describe felt experience moment by moment.
creators.why_zh: 她的访谈方法为设计师提供了严谨的途径，帮助人们一刻一刻地描述被感受的经验。

creators.name: Mirjana Prpa
creators.role: Researcher, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者
creators.bio: Interaction designer working on breath, attention and immersive experiences.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师，研究呼吸、注意力与沉浸式体验。
creators.why: She brought micro-phenomenology into HCI design research and reported how experts use it.
creators.why_zh: 她把微观现象学引入人机交互设计研究，并报告了专家如何使用它。

creators.name: Karen Anne Cochrane
creators.role: Design researcher, Carleton University
creators.role_zh: 卡尔顿大学设计研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher working on body maps, wearables and emotion.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究身体地图、可穿戴与情绪。
creators.why: She turned body mapping into a generative tool for soma-based design.
creators.why_zh: 她把身体地图变成身体设计的生成性工具。

creators.name: Kristina Popova
creators.role: Researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher on vulnerability, ethics and intimate data in soma design.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究身体设计中的脆弱性、伦理与亲密数据。
creators.why: She argued that vulnerability, not only protection, is an ethical stance in soma design processes.
creators.why_zh: 她主张：在身体设计过程中，脆弱性本身——而不只是保护——就是一种伦理立场。

creators.name: Jonas Fritsch
creators.role: Associate Professor of Digital Design, IT University of Copenhagen
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根信息技术大学数字设计副教授
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher working with affect theory, atmospheres and sound in design.
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，把情动理论、氛围与声音带入设计。
creators.why: He led the soma design study of silence as a way of estranging habitual sensing.
creators.why_zh: 他主导了以“静默”陌生化惯常感知的身体设计研究。

creators.name: David Rokeby
creators.role: Media artist
creators.bio: Canadian artist whose Very Nervous System (1982–91) was one of the first camera-based interactive sound environments.
creators.why: He described interaction as encounter, a loop where the sense of control dissolves into involvement.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，他的《Very Nervous System》（1982–1991）是最早的基于摄像头的交互声音环境之一。
creators.why_zh: 他把交互描述为相遇：在这个回路里，控制感消融为投入。

creators.name: Myron Krueger
creators.role: Computer artist; pioneer of 'artificial reality'
creators.bio: American artist-engineer who from the 1970s built responsive environments in which people's video silhouettes play with graphics.
creators.why: Videoplace let the unencumbered whole body, not a device, be the interface.
creators.role_zh: 计算机艺术家；“人工现实”先驱
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家兼工程师，自 1970 年代起建造响应式环境，让人的视频剪影与图形互动。
creators.why_zh: 《Videoplace》让不穿戴任何设备的整个身体成为界面。

creators.name: Chunky Move (Gideon Obarzanek with Frieder Weiss)
creators.role: Contemporary dance company
creators.bio: Australian dance company; its piece Glow (2006) was made by choreographer Gideon Obarzanek with software artist Frieder Weiss.
creators.why: Glow is a widely shown example of projection that follows and reshapes the dancing body in real time.
creators.role_zh: 当代舞团
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚舞团；作品《Glow》（2006）由编舞 Gideon Obarzanek 与软件艺术家 Frieder Weiss 创作。
creators.why_zh: 《Glow》是实时追随并重塑舞动身体的投影作品中流传最广的例子之一。

creators.name: Marco Donnarumma
creators.role: Performance artist, composer and researcher
creators.bio: Italian artist who makes biophysical music and performances in which muscle sounds and bioelectric signals drive sound, light and machines.
creators.why: He performs the inner, felt body (muscle tension, effort) as sound, rather than tracking outer gesture.
creators.role_zh: 行为艺术家、作曲家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，创作生物物理音乐与表演，用肌肉声音和生物电信号驱动声音、灯光与机器。
creators.why_zh: 他把内在的、被感受到的身体（肌肉张力、用力）演成声音，而不是追踪外部手势。

creators.name: Åsa Unander-Scharin
creators.role: Choreographer; Professor, Luleå University of Technology
creators.bio: Swedish choreographer and dancer who choreographs robots and mechatronic opera with Carl Unander-Scharin (Opera Mecatronica).
creators.why: She transfers a dancer's felt movement into machines and asks what a robot body can express.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；吕勒奥理工大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典编舞家与舞者，与 Carl Unander-Scharin 一起为机器人与机电歌剧编舞（Opera Mecatronica）。
creators.why_zh: 她把舞者感受到的动作转移到机器上，追问机器人的身体能表达什么。

creators.name: Carl Unander-Scharin
creators.role: Composer and opera singer; Professor, Karlstad University
creators.bio: Swedish tenor and composer who builds interactive instruments for singers, co-author with Kristina Höök.
creators.why: His instruments start from the singer's own bodily needs on stage (autobiographical design).
creators.role_zh: 作曲家与歌剧演唱家；卡尔斯塔德大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典男高音与作曲家，为歌手制作互动乐器，曾与 Kristina Höök 合作。
creators.why_zh: 他的乐器从歌手在舞台上的身体需要出发（自传式设计）。

creators.name: Stelarc
creators.role: Performance artist; Distinguished Research Fellow, Curtin University
creators.bio: Cyprus-born Australian artist who since the 1970s has extended, suspended and wired his own body with robots, prostheses and networks.
creators.why: His performances are extreme first-person experiments in what an extended body feels like from inside.
creators.role_zh: 行为艺术家；科廷大学杰出研究员
creators.bio_zh: 生于塞浦路斯的澳大利亚艺术家，自 1970 年代起用机器人、义体与网络延伸、悬吊和连接自己的身体。
creators.why_zh: 他的表演是极端的第一人称实验：从内部去感受一个被延伸的身体。

creators.name: Lygia Clark
creators.role: Artist and therapist (1920–1988)
creators.bio: Brazilian Neo-Concrete artist who moved from painting to 'propositions' completed by participants' bodies, and finally to a therapy with relational objects.
creators.why: Her sensorial propositions are a direct ancestor of soma design: objects that exist only in felt relation with a body.
creators.bio_zh: 巴西新具体主义艺术家，从绘画转向由参与者身体完成的“提议”，最终发展出使用关系物件的疗法。
creators.why_zh: 她的感官提议是身体设计的直接先声：物件只在与身体的感受关系中存在。

creators.name: Hélio Oiticica
creators.bio: Brazilian Neo-Concrete artist whose Parangolés, Penetrables and environments turned viewers into wearers, dancers and inhabitants.
creators.why: He called the goal 'suprasensorial': art completed by the whole moving, sensing body.
creators.bio_zh: 巴西新具体主义艺术家，他的《帕兰戈莱》、可穿透物与环境装置把观众变成穿戴者、舞者和居住者。
creators.why_zh: 他把目标称为“超感官”：由整个运动与感知的身体来完成的艺术。

creators.name: Rebecca Horn
creators.bio: German artist who began with wearable body extensions (horns, feathers, long gloves) and moved on to kinetic sculpture.
creators.why: Her body extensions are estrangement devices: they change balance and reach so the body is felt again.
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家，早期创作可穿戴的身体延伸（角、羽毛、长手套），后转向动态雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 她的身体延伸是陌生化装置：改变平衡与触及范围，让身体被重新感受到。

creators.name: Char Davies
creators.role: Painter and virtual reality artist; founder of Immersence
creators.bio: Canadian artist who made Osmose (1995) and Ephémère (1998), VR works navigated by breath and balance.
creators.why: She used breath and balance to reconnect VR with the felt, living body.
creators.role_zh: 画家与虚拟现实艺术家；Immersence 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，创作了以呼吸和平衡导航的 VR 作品《Osmose》（1995）与《Ephémère》（1998）。
creators.why_zh: 她用呼吸与平衡把 VR 重新连回被感受的、活的身体。

creators.name: Ernesto Neto
creators.role: Artist; soft walk-in sculptures
creators.bio: Brazilian artist who builds large crocheted and stretch-fabric environments, often scented, that visitors walk through, lie in and touch.
creators.why: He continues Clark and Oiticica's line: sculpture as something felt with the whole body.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；可进入的柔软雕塑
creators.bio_zh: 巴西艺术家，用钩织与弹力织物搭建常带香气的大型空间，观众可以穿行、躺卧和触摸。
creators.why_zh: 他延续了 Clark 与 Oiticica 的路线：雕塑是用整个身体去感受的东西。

creators.name: Tom Calvert
creators.role: Professor Emeritus, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University
creators.bio: Computer scientist who led the SFU team that built Life Forms (later DanceForms), a figure-animation tool for choreographers.
creators.why: Life Forms was an early case of designing software from a choreographer's bodily way of thinking.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学交互艺术与技术学院荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，领导西蒙弗雷泽大学团队开发了面向编舞家的人体动画工具 Life Forms（后称 DanceForms）。
creators.why_zh: Life Forms 是较早从编舞家的身体思维方式出发设计软件的案例。

creators.name: Merce Cunningham
creators.role: Choreographer (1919–2009)
creators.bio: American choreographer who used chance procedures, film and, from 1989, the Life Forms software to make dances.
creators.why: His work with Life Forms showed a choreographer thinking movement through a computer while keeping the dancer's body as the final judge.
creators.bio_zh: 美国编舞家，使用偶然程序、影像以及自 1989 年起的 Life Forms 软件来创作舞蹈。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Life Forms 的合作展示了编舞家借助计算机思考动作，同时让舞者的身体做最终判断。

creators.name: Frédéric Bevilacqua
creators.role: Head of Sound Music Movement Interaction team (ISMM), IRCAM
creators.bio: Researcher who has led IRCAM's work on gesture following, motion-sound interaction and embodied music tools since the 2000s.
creators.why: His team made continuous, movement-driven sound a design material for dance, music and rehabilitation.
creators.role_zh: IRCAM 声音音乐动作交互团队（ISMM）负责人
creators.bio_zh: 自 2000 年代起领导 IRCAM 在手势跟随、动作与声音交互及具身音乐工具方面的研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队把连续的、由动作驱动的声音变成舞蹈、音乐与康复的设计材料。

creators.name: Nicolas Rasamimanana
creators.role: Researcher and co-founder of Phonotonic; formerly IRCAM
creators.bio: Violinist and researcher in gesture and music who led the design of IRCAM's Modular Musical Objects.
creators.why: MO turned everyday gestures and objects into embodied instruments.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，Phonotonic 联合创始人；曾任职 IRCAM
creators.bio_zh: 小提琴手与手势音乐研究者，主导设计了 IRCAM 的模块化音乐物件（MO）。
creators.why_zh: MO 把日常手势与物件变成具身乐器。

creators.name: Antonio Camurri
creators.role: Professor, DIBRIS, University of Genoa; founder of Casa Paganini–InfoMus
creators.bio: Italian computer scientist who built EyesWeb and has studied expressive movement qualities in dance for three decades.
creators.why: His lab models qualities like fluidity, lightness and fragility, the felt texture of movement, rather than only positions.
creators.role_zh: 热那亚大学 DIBRIS 教授；Casa Paganini–InfoMus 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 意大利计算机科学家，开发了 EyesWeb，三十年来研究舞蹈中富有表现力的动作质感。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室为流畅、轻盈、脆弱等动作质感建模，也就是动作被感受到的纹理，而不只是位置。

creators.name: William Forsythe
creators.role: Choreographer
creators.bio: American choreographer who directed Ballett Frankfurt and The Forsythe Company and developed digital tools to teach and analyse improvisation.
creators.why: His improvisation technologies show how dancers think with imagined lines and planes inside their bodies.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家
creators.bio_zh: 美国编舞家，曾领导法兰克福芭蕾舞团与 The Forsythe Company，开发数字工具来教授和分析即兴。
creators.why_zh: 他的即兴技术展示了舞者如何用身体内部想象的线与面来思考。
creators.based_zh: 法兰克福，德国 / 佛蒙特，美国

creators.name: Wayne McGregor
creators.role: Choreographer; Artistic Director, Studio Wayne McGregor
creators.bio: British choreographer who has worked with cognitive scientists and technologists on how movement ideas are made.
creators.why: His research treats choreography as embodied cognition, thinking done by and through the body.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；Studio Wayne McGregor 艺术总监
creators.bio_zh: 英国编舞家，长期与认知科学家和技术人员合作，研究动作想法如何生成。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究把编舞看作具身认知，即由身体、通过身体完成的思考。

creators.name: Palindrome (Robert Wechsler)
creators.role: Interactive dance company led by choreographer Robert Wechsler; co-developers of EyeCon and MotionComposer
creators.bio: Founded in New York in 1982 and based in Germany since 1991, Palindrome made early dance pieces in which camera tracking, skin contact and body signals play music and light, mostly with engineer Frieder Weiss.
creators.why: Their work moved from stage pieces to MotionComposer, which lets people of all abilities hear their own movement.
creators.role_zh: 由编舞家 Robert Wechsler 领导的互动舞蹈团；EyeCon 与 MotionComposer 的共同开发者
creators.bio_zh: 1982 年成立于纽约，1991 年起常驻德国。Palindrome 主要与工程师 Frieder Weiss 合作，较早创作了由摄像追踪、皮肤接触与身体信号演奏音乐和灯光的舞蹈作品。
creators.why_zh: 他们从舞台作品走向 MotionComposer，让不同能力的人都能听见自己的动作。

creators.name: Mark Coniglio / Troika Ranch (with Dawn Stoppiello)
creators.role: Interactive dance-theatre company; Mark Coniglio created the Isadora media software and the MidiDancer sensor suit
creators.bio: Composer-programmer Mark Coniglio and choreographer Dawn Stoppiello founded Troika Ranch in 1994; their sensor suits and camera tracking let dancers shape video, sound and light.
creators.why: MidiDancer put joint-angle sensing on the dancer's own body, so media answered felt bending rather than an external camera.
creators.role_zh: 交互舞蹈剧场团体；Mark Coniglio 开发了媒体软件 Isadora 和传感舞衣 MidiDancer
creators.bio_zh: 作曲家兼程序员 Mark Coniglio 与编舞 Dawn Stoppiello 于 1994 年创立 Troika Ranch，传感舞衣与摄像追踪让舞者塑造影像、声音与灯光。
creators.why_zh: MidiDancer 把关节角度传感器放在舞者身上，让媒体回应身体感受到的弯曲，而不是外部摄像头。

creators.name: Richard Byrne
creators.role: Researcher, Exertion Games Lab (RMIT / Monash)
creators.bio: Game designer and researcher on digital vertigo play using galvanic vestibular stimulation.
creators.why: His vertigo games make the sense of balance, usually unnoticed, into the centre of play.
creators.role_zh: Exertion Games Lab 研究者（皇家墨尔本理工大学 / 莫纳什大学）
creators.bio_zh: 游戏设计者与研究者，研究利用前庭电刺激的数字眩晕游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他的眩晕游戏把平时注意不到的平衡感变成游戏的核心。

creators.name: Josh Andres
creators.role: Researcher in human-computer integration; Australian National University (formerly Exertion Games Lab)
creators.bio: Designer-researcher of integrated exertion systems such as eBikes that act with the rider.
creators.why: His eBikes explore what it feels like when a machine shares effort with your body.
creators.role_zh: 人机融合研究者；澳大利亚国立大学（曾在 Exertion Games Lab）
creators.bio_zh: 研究融合式运动系统的设计研究者，例如与骑行者一起行动的电动自行车。
creators.why_zh: 他的电动自行车探索当机器与身体分担用力时是什么感受。

creators.name: Amy Huggard
creators.role: Designer; Exertion Games Lab alumna (RMIT University)
creators.bio: Game designer who led Musical Embrace, a game played by strangers hugging a pillow-like controller.
creators.why: Musical Embrace uses bodily closeness and awkwardness as design material.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；Exertion Games Lab 校友（皇家墨尔本理工大学）
creators.bio_zh: 游戏设计师，主导了《Musical Embrace》，一款由陌生人拥抱枕头状控制器来玩的游戏。
creators.why_zh: 《Musical Embrace》把身体的亲近与尴尬当作设计材料。

creators.name: Die Gute Fabrik
creators.role: Independent game studio (Douglas Wilson, Nils Deneken, Hannes Hvidberg)
creators.bio: Copenhagen studio known for physical, screenless party games such as Johann Sebastian Joust.
creators.why: Joust made controlled, slow movement and bodily attention the core game skill.
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室（Douglas Wilson、Nils Deneken、Hannes Hvidberg）
creators.bio_zh: 哥本哈根的游戏工作室，以《Johann Sebastian Joust》等无屏幕的身体派对游戏闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《Joust》让受控的慢动作与身体觉察成为核心游戏技巧。

creators.name: Jin Moen
creators.role: Interaction designer; founder of Movinto Fun (Oriboo); PhD KTH
creators.bio: Swedish designer who developed kinaesthetic movement interaction from modern dance and built the BodyBug wearable.
creators.why: Her work argued early that movement interaction should start from people's own movement experience, not from sensors.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计师；Movinto Fun（Oriboo）创始人；KTH 博士
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典设计师，从现代舞出发发展了动觉动作交互，并制作了可穿戴设备 BodyBug。
creators.why_zh: 她较早主张动作交互应从人自身的动作经验出发，而不是从传感器出发。

creators.name: Perttu Hämäläinen
creators.role: Associate Professor, Aalto University
creators.bio: Finnish researcher on movement games, martial-arts and acrobatics interfaces and simulated movement.
creators.why: Kick Ass Kung-Fu used a full-body video mirror to make martial-arts play feel physical.
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: 芬兰研究者，研究动作游戏、武术与杂技界面以及动作模拟。
creators.why_zh: 《Kick Ass Kung-Fu》用全身视频镜像让武术游戏有真实的身体感。

creators.name: Moshé Feldenkrais
creators.role: Physicist, judo teacher and founder of the Feldenkrais Method
creators.bio: Moshé Feldenkrais (1904–1984) was a physicist and judo black belt who developed a method of learning through slow, attentive movement, taught as Awareness Through Movement group lessons and hands-on Functional Integration.
creators.why: The Feldenkrais Method is the somatic practice Kristina Höök's soma design group trains in and designs from.
creators.role_zh: 物理学家、柔道教师，费登奎斯方法创始人
creators.bio_zh: 摩谢·费登奎斯（1904–1984）是物理学家和柔道黑带，他发展出一种通过缓慢、专注的动作来学习的方法，以“动中觉察”团体课和手把手的“功能整合”来教授。
creators.why_zh: 费登奎斯方法是 Kristina Höök 的身体设计团队日常训练并用于设计的身体修习。

creators.name: F. Matthias Alexander
creators.role: Actor and founder of the Alexander Technique
creators.bio: Frederick Matthias Alexander (1869–1955), an Australian reciter, lost his voice on stage and spent years watching himself in mirrors until he found how his head-neck habits interfered with his whole coordination.
creators.why: The Alexander Technique is the earliest modern method for noticing and inhibiting a habitual body-mind pattern, and John Dewey built his philosophy of habit partly on it.
creators.role_zh: 演员，亚历山大技巧创始人
creators.bio_zh: 弗雷德里克·马提亚斯·亚历山大（1869–1955）是澳大利亚朗诵者，因舞台上失声，他花了多年对镜观察自己，发现头颈的习惯如何干扰整个身体的协调。
creators.why_zh: 亚历山大技巧是最早的现代身体方法之一，教人觉察并抑制习惯性的身心模式；杜威的习惯哲学部分建立在它之上。

creators.name: Bonnie Bainbridge Cohen
creators.role: Movement artist, occupational therapist, founder of Body-Mind Centering
creators.bio: Bonnie Bainbridge Cohen is an occupational therapist, dancer and educator who founded the School for Body-Mind Centering in 1973.
creators.why: Body-Mind Centering gives designers an experiential anatomy: learning organs, fluids, cells and developmental patterns by moving and feeling them.
creators.role_zh: 动作艺术家、职业治疗师，Body-Mind Centering 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 邦妮·班布里奇·科恩是职业治疗师、舞者和教育者，1973 年创立 Body-Mind Centering 学校。
creators.why_zh: Body-Mind Centering 为设计者提供一种“体验式解剖学”：通过动起来、感受它们，去认识器官、体液、细胞与发育动作模式。

creators.name: Rudolf Laban
creators.role: Dance theorist, choreographer, founder of Labanotation and Effort theory
creators.bio: Rudolf von Laban (1879–1958) was a Hungarian-born dance artist and theorist who created a notation for movement (1928) and theories of Effort and space harmony.
creators.why: Laban's categories of movement quality are the most used vocabulary for describing how a movement feels in movement-based interaction design.
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈理论家、编舞家，拉班舞谱与“力效”理论创始人
creators.bio_zh: 鲁道夫·冯·拉班（1879–1958）是匈牙利出生的舞蹈艺术家与理论家，1928 年创立动作记谱法，并提出“力效”（Effort）与空间和谐理论。
creators.why_zh: 拉班的动作质感范畴，是动作交互设计中描述“动作感觉如何”最常用的词汇。

creators.name: Irmgard Bartenieff
creators.role: Dance theorist, physical therapist, pioneer of dance therapy
creators.bio: Irmgard Bartenieff (1900–1981), a student of Laban, applied his spatial concepts to polio rehabilitation in the 1940s and developed the body-level exercises known as Bartenieff Fundamentals.
creators.why: Bartenieff joined Laban's movement analysis to physical therapy and insisted there is no purely physical or purely mental therapy.
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈理论家、物理治疗师、舞蹈治疗先驱
creators.bio_zh: 伊姆加德·巴特尼夫（1900–1981）是拉班的学生，1940 年代把拉班的空间概念用于小儿麻痹症康复，发展出后来称为“巴特尼夫基础动作”的练习。
creators.why_zh: 巴特尼夫把拉班的动作分析与物理治疗结合，坚持不存在纯粹“身体的”或纯粹“心理的”治疗。

creators.name: Ida Rolf
creators.role: Biochemist, founder of Structural Integration (Rolfing)
creators.bio: Ida Rolf (1896–1979) held a PhD in biochemistry and from the 1940s developed Structural Integration, a ten-session series of deep manual work on connective tissue.
creators.why: Rolfing brought fascia and whole-body organisation in gravity into the somatics movement at Esalen, where Hanna and others met it.
creators.role_zh: 生物化学家，结构整合（Rolfing）创始人
creators.bio_zh: 艾达·罗尔夫（1896–1979）拥有生物化学博士学位，自 1940 年代起发展出“结构整合”：针对结缔组织、为期十次的深层手法工作。
creators.why_zh: Rolfing 把筋膜和“身体在重力中的整体组织”带进了伊莎兰学院的身体学运动。

creators.name: Gerda Alexander
creators.role: Rhythmics teacher, founder of Eutony
creators.bio: Gerda Alexander (1908–1994), a German-born Dalcroze rhythmics teacher, emigrated to Denmark in 1933, founded her training school in Copenhagen in 1940 and named her method Eutony in 1956.
creators.why: Eutony treats muscle tone as something a person can sense and regulate, which is a direct model for designing with bodily tension.
creators.role_zh: 律动教师，优张力法（Eutony）创始人
creators.bio_zh: 格尔达·亚历山大（1908–1994）是德国出生的达尔克罗兹律动教师，1933 年移居丹麦，1940 年在哥本哈根创办培训学校，1956 年将其方法命名为 Eutony（优张力）。
creators.why_zh: 优张力法把肌张力当作人可以感知并调节的东西，这为“以身体紧张度为材料”的设计提供了直接的模型。

creators.name: Mabel Elsworth Todd
creators.role: Movement educator, author of The Thinking Body
creators.bio: Mabel Elsworth Todd (c.1880–1956) taught posture through imagery at Columbia Teachers College and published The Thinking Body in 1937.
creators.why: Todd showed that imagining a movement changes how the body organises itself, the root of ideokinesis and much dance somatics.
creators.role_zh: 动作教育者，《思考的身体》作者
creators.bio_zh: 梅布尔·埃尔斯沃思·托德（约 1880–1956）在哥伦比亚大学师范学院用意象教授姿态，1937 年出版《思考的身体》。
creators.why_zh: 托德表明，想象一个动作会改变身体组织自身的方式，这是意念动觉法和许多舞蹈身体学的源头。

creators.name: Lulu Sweigard
creators.role: Movement educator, developer of Ideokinesis
creators.bio: Lulu Sweigard (1895–1974), a student of Mabel Todd, researched imagery and skeletal alignment, taught at the Juilliard School and named the practice ideokinesis.
creators.why: Sweigard turned Todd's imagery into a teachable lying-down practice of 'lines of movement' that dancers still use.
creators.role_zh: 动作教育者，意念动觉法的发展者
creators.bio_zh: 露露·斯威加德（1895–1974）是托德的学生，研究意象与骨骼排列，在茱莉亚学院任教，并把这一修习命名为 ideokinesis（意念动觉法）。
creators.why_zh: 斯威加德把托德的意象发展成一套可教授的、躺着进行的“动作线”练习，至今仍为舞者所用。

creators.name: Charlotte Selver
creators.role: Teacher of Sensory Awareness
creators.bio: Charlotte Selver (1901–2003) studied with Elsa Gindler in Berlin, emigrated to the US in 1938 and taught the work as Sensory Awareness, including at Esalen from 1963.
creators.why: Selver's teaching of plain sensing, of sitting, standing and breathing, fed the human potential movement and body psychotherapy.
creators.role_zh: 感官觉察教师
creators.bio_zh: 夏洛特·塞尔弗（1901–2003）在柏林师从埃尔莎·金德勒，1938 年移居美国，以“感官觉察”之名教授这一工作，1963 年起也在伊莎兰学院任教。
creators.why_zh: 塞尔弗教人单纯地去感觉坐、站和呼吸，这深刻影响了人类潜能运动与身体心理治疗。

creators.name: Elsa Gindler
creators.role: Gymnastik teacher, pioneer of somatic education
creators.bio: Elsa Gindler (1885–1961) was a Berlin gymnastik teacher whose 'work on the human being' explored sitting, standing and walking through self-observation, in collaboration with Heinrich Jacoby.
creators.why: Gindler is the common root of Sensory Awareness, Rosen Method and much body psychotherapy.
creators.role_zh: 体操教师，身体教育先驱
creators.bio_zh: 埃尔莎·金德勒（1885–1961）是柏林的体操教师，她与海因里希·雅各比合作的“对人的工作”通过自我观察探索坐、站、走。
creators.why_zh: 金德勒是感官觉察、罗森疗法和许多身体心理治疗的共同源头。

creators.name: Emilie Conrad
creators.role: Dancer, founder of Continuum
creators.bio: Emilie Conrad (1934–2014) was a dancer who, after years in Haiti, founded Continuum in 1967, a practice of breath, sound and fluid micro-movement.
creators.why: Continuum treats the body as fluid rather than as a structure of parts, a strong image for designing slow, undulating interactions.
creators.role_zh: 舞者，Continuum 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 艾米莉·康拉德（1934–2014）是舞者，在海地生活多年后于 1967 年创立 Continuum，一种以呼吸、声音和流体微动作为主的修习。
creators.why_zh: Continuum 把身体看作流体而非由部件组成的结构，这为设计缓慢、波动的交互提供了有力的意象。

creators.name: Mary Starks Whitehouse
creators.role: Dancer and dance therapist, originator of Authentic Movement
creators.bio: Mary Starks Whitehouse (1911–1979) studied with Mary Wigman and Martha Graham and, drawing on Jungian active imagination, developed 'movement in depth' in the 1950s.
creators.why: Whitehouse distinguished 'I move' from 'I am moved', a distinction that matters to anyone designing for involuntary or emergent movement.
creators.role_zh: 舞者与舞蹈治疗师，真实动作的开创者
creators.bio_zh: 玛丽·斯塔克斯·怀特豪斯（1911–1979）师从玛丽·魏格曼与玛莎·葛兰姆，借鉴荣格的积极想象，于 1950 年代发展出“深度动作”。
creators.why_zh: 怀特豪斯区分了“我在动”与“我被动起来”，这对设计非自主、涌现的动作很重要。

creators.name: Janet Adler
creators.role: Dance therapist, developer of the Discipline of Authentic Movement
creators.bio: Janet Adler studied with Mary Starks Whitehouse and developed Authentic Movement into a discipline of mover and witness.
creators.why: Adler's witness role models a way of attending to another body without judgment, useful for first-person and second-person design studies.
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈治疗师，“真实动作修习”的发展者
creators.bio_zh: 珍妮特·阿德勒师从怀特豪斯，把真实动作发展为“动者与见证者”的修习。
creators.why_zh: 阿德勒的“见证者”角色示范了一种不带评判地关注他人身体的方式，适用于第一人称与第二人称的设计研究。

creators.name: Steve Paxton
creators.role: Dancer, choreographer, initiator of Contact Improvisation
creators.bio: Steve Paxton (1939–2024) danced with Merce Cunningham, co-founded Judson Dance Theater and Grand Union, and in 1972 initiated Contact Improvisation.
creators.why: Paxton's Contact Improvisation and his Small Dance made reflexes, weight and touch into material for improvisation.
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞家，接触即兴的发起人
creators.bio_zh: 史蒂夫·帕克斯顿（1939–2024）曾在默斯·坎宁汉舞团跳舞，参与创立贾德森舞蹈剧场和 Grand Union，1972 年发起接触即兴。
creators.why_zh: 帕克斯顿的接触即兴与“小舞”（Small Dance）把反射、重量和触碰变成即兴的材料。

creators.name: Nancy Stark Smith
creators.role: Dancer, co-founder of Contact Improvisation and Contact Quarterly
creators.bio: Nancy Stark Smith (1952–2020) was a founding participant of Contact Improvisation, co-editor of Contact Quarterly and creator of the Underscore.
creators.why: Stark Smith's Underscore is a shared score for long improvisations that moves from arriving in the body to dancing with others and back.
creators.role_zh: 舞者，接触即兴与《Contact Quarterly》的共同创始人
creators.bio_zh: 南希·斯塔克·史密斯（1952–2020）是接触即兴最早的参与者之一，《Contact Quarterly》的共同编辑，也是 Underscore 的创造者。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Underscore 是一份用于长时间即兴的共享谱：从进入身体，到与他人共舞，再回到自身。

creators.name: Anna Halprin
creators.role: Choreographer, pioneer of postmodern dance and dance for healing
creators.bio: Anna Halprin (1920–2021) founded the San Francisco Dancers' Workshop, developed the RSVP Cycles with Lawrence Halprin and co-founded the Tamalpa Institute with her daughter Daria in 1978.
creators.why: Halprin used scores, kinesthetic awareness and community ritual to make dance a way to live with illness and with others.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，后现代舞蹈与疗愈舞蹈的先驱
creators.bio_zh: 安娜·哈普林（1920–2021）创立旧金山舞者工作坊，与劳伦斯·哈普林共同发展 RSVP 循环，并于 1978 年与女儿达莉亚共同创立塔玛帕学院。
creators.why_zh: 哈普林用乐谱、动觉觉察和社区仪式，让舞蹈成为与疾病、与他人共处的方式。

creators.name: Daria Halprin
creators.role: Expressive arts therapist, co-founder of the Tamalpa Institute
creators.bio: Daria Halprin is a movement-based expressive arts therapist who co-founded the Tamalpa Institute with Anna Halprin in 1978 and directs it.
creators.why: She codified the Tamalpa Life/Art Process that links movement, drawing and spoken reflection.
creators.role_zh: 表达性艺术治疗师，塔玛帕学院共同创始人
creators.bio_zh: 达莉亚·哈普林是以动作为基础的表达性艺术治疗师，1978 年与安娜·哈普林共同创立塔玛帕学院并担任院长。
creators.why_zh: 她系统化了塔玛帕“生命/艺术历程”，把动作、绘画与口头反思连在一起。

creators.name: Ohad Naharin
creators.role: Choreographer, creator of Gaga
creators.bio: Ohad Naharin (born 1952) was artistic director of Batsheva Dance Company from 1990 to 2018 and developed the movement language Gaga.
creators.why: Gaga asks dancers and non-dancers to listen to sensation before shaping movement, and bans mirrors so movement is guided from inside.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，Gaga 的创造者
creators.bio_zh: 欧哈德·纳哈林（1952 年生）1990–2018 年任巴希瓦舞团艺术总监，发展了动作语言 Gaga。
creators.why_zh: Gaga 要求舞者和非舞者先倾听感觉，再塑造动作，并且不用镜子，让动作从内部被引导。

creators.name: Joan Skinner
creators.role: Dancer, creator of Skinner Releasing Technique
creators.bio: Joan Skinner (1924–2021) danced with Martha Graham and Merce Cunningham and first shared the beginnings of Skinner Releasing Technique with her students at the University of Illinois in 1966–67.
creators.why: Skinner Releasing uses poetic imagery to release held tension, so technique and creative exploration become the same act.
creators.role_zh: 舞者，斯金纳释放技巧创始人
creators.bio_zh: 琼·斯金纳（1924–2021）曾在葛兰姆和坎宁汉舞团跳舞，1966–67 年在伊利诺伊大学首次与学生分享“斯金纳释放技巧”的雏形。
creators.why_zh: 斯金纳释放技巧用诗意的意象释放紧张，让技术训练与创造性探索成为同一件事。

creators.name: Mary Overlie
creators.role: Choreographer, originator of the Six Viewpoints
creators.bio: Mary Overlie (1946–2020) was a choreographer and teacher who originated the Six Viewpoints (space, shape, time, emotion, movement, story), taught at NYU's Experimental Theater Wing from 1978.
creators.why: The Viewpoints give a shared vocabulary for attending to space, time and other bodies, widely used in theater and embodied design workshops.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，“六观点”的开创者
creators.bio_zh: 玛丽·奥弗利（1946–2020）是编舞家与教师，开创“六观点”（空间、形状、时间、情感、动作、故事），1978 年起在纽约大学实验剧场系教授。
creators.why_zh: “观点”为关注空间、时间与他人身体提供了共享词汇，广泛用于戏剧与具身设计工作坊。

creators.name: Pauline Oliveros
creators.role: Composer, founder of Deep Listening
creators.bio: Pauline Oliveros (1932–2016) was a composer and accordionist, a founder of the San Francisco Tape Music Center, whose Sonic Meditations (1971) grew into the practice of Deep Listening.
creators.why: Deep Listening trains attention to sound as a bodily, relational act, a model for designing with listening rather than with signals.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家，深度聆听的创立者
creators.bio_zh: 宝琳·奥利维罗斯（1932–2016）是作曲家与手风琴演奏家，旧金山磁带音乐中心的创始人之一，她的《声音冥想》（1971）后来发展成“深度聆听”修习。
creators.why_zh: 深度聆听把对声音的注意训练成一种身体性、关系性的行为，为“以聆听而非信号来设计”提供了范例。

creators.name: Jon Kabat-Zinn
creators.role: Molecular biologist, founder of Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction
creators.bio: Jon Kabat-Zinn (born 1944) holds a PhD in molecular biology and founded the Stress Reduction Clinic and MBSR at the University of Massachusetts Medical School in 1979.
creators.why: MBSR and its body scan put a secular, body-first meditation into hospitals, and the body scan is now a standard warm-up in soma design workshops.
creators.role_zh: 分子生物学家，正念减压（MBSR）创始人
creators.bio_zh: 乔恩·卡巴金（1944 年生）拥有分子生物学博士学位，1979 年在马萨诸塞大学医学院创立减压诊所和正念减压课程。
creators.why_zh: 正念减压及其身体扫描把一种世俗的、以身体为先的冥想带进医院；身体扫描如今是身体设计工作坊的常用热身。

creators.name: S. N. Goenka
creators.role: Teacher of Vipassana meditation
creators.bio: Satya Narayan Goenka (1924–2013) was born in Burma to an Indian family, learned Vipassana from Sayagyi U Ba Khin and from 1969 taught free ten-day residential courses worldwide.
creators.why: Goenka's technique of sweeping attention through bodily sensation is a direct ancestor of the body scan used in clinics and design studios.
creators.role_zh: 内观禅修导师
creators.bio_zh: 萨提亚·纳拉扬·葛印卡（1924–2013）生于缅甸的印度家庭，随乌巴庆学习内观，1969 年起在全球开设免费的十日住宿课程。
creators.why_zh: 葛印卡以注意力“扫过”身体感受的方法，是临床与设计工作室中身体扫描的直接前身。

creators.name: Peter A. Levine
creators.role: Psychologist, developer of Somatic Experiencing
creators.bio: Peter A. Levine (born 1942) holds doctorates in medical biophysics and psychology and developed Somatic Experiencing, a body-based approach to trauma.
creators.why: Levine frames trauma as incomplete bodily responses, which gives designers a vocabulary of titration and pendulation for pacing felt experience.
creators.role_zh: 心理学家，身体经验疗法（SE）创立者
creators.bio_zh: 彼得·莱文（1942 年生）拥有医学生物物理学与心理学博士学位，发展出以身体为基础处理创伤的“身体经验疗法”。
creators.why_zh: 莱文把创伤理解为未完成的身体反应，这为设计者提供了“滴定”与“摆荡”等调节亲身体验节奏的词汇。

creators.name: Ron Kurtz
creators.role: Psychotherapist, founder of the Hakomi Method
creators.bio: Ron Kurtz (1934–2011) developed the Hakomi Method in the 1970s, a body-centred psychotherapy that works in mindfulness, and co-founded the Hakomi Institute in 1981.
creators.why: Hakomi uses small, precise 'probes' offered to a mindful person to reveal how beliefs are held in the body.
creators.role_zh: 心理治疗师，哈科米疗法创立者
creators.bio_zh: 罗恩·库尔茨（1934–2011）于 1970 年代发展出哈科米疗法，一种在正念状态下进行的身体取向心理治疗，并于 1981 年共同创立哈科米学院。
creators.why_zh: 哈科米向处于正念中的人提供细小而精确的“探针”，揭示信念如何被保存在身体里。

creators.name: Marian Chace
creators.role: Dancer, founder of dance/movement therapy
creators.bio: Marian Chace (1896–1970) trained at Denishawn, began dancing with psychiatric patients at St. Elizabeths Hospital in 1942 and became the first president of the American Dance Therapy Association in 1966.
creators.why: Chace built therapy on mirroring and group rhythm, showing that moving together can open communication where talk cannot.
creators.role_zh: 舞者，舞动治疗的奠基人
creators.bio_zh: 玛丽安·蔡斯（1896–1970）出身丹尼肖恩舞蹈学校，1942 年起在圣伊丽莎白医院与精神科病人一起跳舞，1966 年成为美国舞蹈治疗协会首任主席。
creators.why_zh: 蔡斯以镜像与团体节奏为治疗基础，表明一起动能在言语失效处打开交流。

creators.name: Marion Rosen
creators.role: Physical therapist, founder of Rosen Method
creators.bio: Marion Rosen (1914–2012) trained in Berlin with Lucy Heyer, a student of Elsa Gindler, and developed Rosen Method Bodywork in Berkeley; the Rosen Institute was formed in 1980.
creators.why: Rosen Method uses a 'listening' touch that notices held tension without fixing it, a model for touch that attends rather than acts.
creators.role_zh: 物理治疗师，罗森疗法创立者
creators.bio_zh: 玛丽安·罗森（1914–2012）在柏林师从金德勒的学生露西·海尔，在伯克利发展出罗森身体疗法；罗森学院成立于 1980 年。
creators.why_zh: 罗森疗法用一种“聆听式”触碰去注意被保持的紧张而不去修正它，是“关注而非作用”的触碰范例。

creators.name: Ilse Middendorf
creators.role: Breath therapist, founder of the Perceptible Breath
creators.bio: Ilse Middendorf (1910–2009) developed 'Der Erfahrbare Atem' (the perceptible breath), founded her breath-therapy institute in Berlin in 1965 and became a professor at the Berlin University of the Arts in 1971.
creators.why: Middendorf taught letting breath come and go on its own and sensing where it moves, a counterpoint to breath-control apps.
creators.role_zh: 呼吸治疗师，“可感知的呼吸”创立者
creators.bio_zh: 伊尔瑟·米登多夫（1910–2009）发展出“可感知的呼吸”（Der Erfahrbare Atem），1965 年在柏林创立呼吸治疗学院，1971 年成为柏林艺术大学教授。
creators.why_zh: 米登多夫教人让呼吸自己来去，并感受它在身体何处流动，这与“控制呼吸”的应用形成对照。

creators.name: Joseph Pilates
creators.role: Physical trainer, creator of Contrology (Pilates)
creators.bio: Joseph Pilates (1883–1967) was a German-born trainer who opened a studio in New York and set out his method, Contrology, in books of 1934 and 1945.
creators.why: Pilates is a historical case of movement education framed as mind controlling body, useful to contrast with non-dualist somatics.
creators.role_zh: 体能训练师，控制术（普拉提）创始人
creators.bio_zh: 约瑟夫·普拉提（1883–1967）是德国出生的训练师，在纽约开设工作室，并在 1934 与 1945 年的著作中阐述其方法“控制术”（Contrology）。
creators.why_zh: 普拉提是“心控制身”框架下动作教育的历史案例，适合用来与非二元的身体学作对照。

creators.name: B. K. S. Iyengar
creators.role: Yoga teacher, founder of Iyengar Yoga
creators.bio: B. K. S. Iyengar (1918–2014) learned yoga from Tirumalai Krishnamacharya, taught in Pune and, after meeting Yehudi Menuhin in 1952, in Europe and the US; Light on Yoga (1966) made his method known worldwide.
creators.why: Iyengar's precise alignment and use of props made yoga a practice of detailed interoceptive and proprioceptive attention, as it is mostly taught in the West.
creators.role_zh: 瑜伽教师，艾扬格瑜伽创始人
creators.bio_zh: B. K. S. 艾扬格（1918–2014）师从克里希那玛查雅，在浦那教学；1952 年结识小提琴家梅纽因后赴欧美教学，《瑜伽之光》（1966）使他的方法闻名世界。
creators.why_zh: 艾扬格对体式排列的精确要求和辅具的使用，让瑜伽成为一种细致的内感受与本体感训练，这也是它在西方的主要教授方式。

creators.name: Deborah Hay
creators.role: Choreographer, member of Judson Dance Theater
creators.bio: Deborah Hay (born 1941) danced with Merce Cunningham, took part in Judson Dance Theater and developed a choreographic practice built on attention questions such as 'What if every cell in my body at once has the potential to perceive…'.
creators.why: Hay treats perception itself as the dance, which offers designers a way to choreograph attention rather than movement.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家，贾德森舞蹈剧场成员
creators.bio_zh: 黛博拉·海（1941 年生）曾在坎宁汉舞团跳舞，参与贾德森舞蹈剧场，发展出以注意力提问为核心的编舞实践，例如“假如我身体里的每一个细胞同时都有感知的潜能……”。
creators.why_zh: 海把知觉本身当作舞蹈，为设计者提供了一种“编排注意力而非编排动作”的思路。

creators.name: Bessel van der Kolk
creators.role: Psychiatrist and trauma researcher
creators.bio: Bessel van der Kolk (born 1943) is a Dutch-born psychiatrist and trauma researcher, author of The Body Keeps the Score (2014).
creators.why: His book popularised the view that trauma lives in the body and that yoga, theatre and movement can help, bringing somatic therapy into public debate.
creators.role_zh: 精神科医生与创伤研究者
creators.bio_zh: 贝塞尔·范德考克（1943 年生）是荷兰出生的精神科医生与创伤研究者，著有《身体从未忘记》（2014）。
creators.why_zh: 他的书让“创伤存在于身体中、瑜伽戏剧与动作有助康复”的观点广为人知，把身体疗法带入公共讨论。

creators.name: Mehmet Aydın Baytaş
creators.role: HCI researcher and designer; worked on human-drone interaction at Koç University and Chalmers University of Technology
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者与设计师；曾在科奇大学与查尔默斯理工大学研究人与无人机交互
creators.bio: Mehmet Aydın Baytaş studies the design of social drones and co-authored the Drone Chi work.
creators.bio_zh: Mehmet Aydın Baytaş 研究社交无人机的设计，是 Drone Chi 的合著者。
creators.why: He helped frame drones as companions whose movement is read through the body.
creators.why_zh: 他帮助把无人机理解为伙伴：它的运动要用身体去读懂。

creators.name: CuteCircuit
creators.role: Wearable-technology fashion label founded by Francesca Rosella and Ryan Genz
creators.role_zh: 由 Francesca Rosella 与 Ryan Genz 创立的可穿戴科技时装品牌
creators.bio: CuteCircuit, founded in 2004, designs garments with embedded electronics that light up, sense and touch the wearer.
creators.bio_zh: CuteCircuit 创立于 2004 年，设计内置电子元件、会发光、会感知、会触碰穿着者的服装。
creators.why: Its Hug Shirt is the best-known attempt to send the felt quality of a hug over a network.
creators.why_zh: 它的 Hug Shirt 是通过网络传递拥抱之“感觉”最知名的尝试。

creators.name: Scott Brave
creators.role: Former researcher, Tangible Media Group, MIT Media Lab
creators.role_zh: 曾任 MIT 媒体实验室 Tangible Media Group 研究者
creators.bio: Scott Brave built inTouch with Andrew Dahley and Hiroshi Ishii in the Tangible Media Group.
creators.bio_zh: Scott Brave 在 Tangible Media Group 与 Andrew Dahley、石井裕共同制作了 inTouch。
creators.why: inTouch is a founding example of touch shared between two distant bodies.
creators.why_zh: inTouch 是远距离两个身体共享触碰的奠基案例。

creators.name: Angela Chang
creators.role: Designer and researcher; formerly Tangible Media Group, MIT Media Lab
creators.role_zh: 设计师与研究者；曾在 MIT 媒体实验室 Tangible Media Group
creators.bio: Angela Chang designed ComTouch, a vibrotactile device that adds touch to phone calls.
creators.bio_zh: Angela Chang 设计了 ComTouch，一种在通话中加入触碰的振动触觉装置。
creators.why: ComTouch showed how squeeze and vibration can carry emphasis and turn-taking between two people.
creators.why_zh: ComTouch 展示了按压与振动如何在两人之间传递强调与话轮。

creators.name: Carl DiSalvo
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院交互计算学院教授
creators.bio: Carl DiSalvo works on design, robots and public life; at Carnegie Mellon he co-designed The Hug, a robotic pillow for intimate communication.
creators.bio_zh: Carl DiSalvo 研究设计、机器人与公共生活；在卡内基梅隆大学时共同设计了用于亲密沟通的机器人抱枕 The Hug。
creators.why: The Hug is an early social robot whose form is designed to be embraced.
creators.why_zh: The Hug 是较早一件为“被拥抱”而设计外形的社交机器人。

creators.name: Gijs Huisman
creators.role: Researcher in social touch technology; formerly University of Twente, later TU Delft
creators.role_zh: 社会触碰技术研究者；曾在特温特大学，后在代尔夫特理工大学
creators.bio: Gijs Huisman builds and studies devices for touch at a distance, such as the TaSST tactile sleeve.
creators.bio_zh: Gijs Huisman 制作并研究远程触碰装置，例如 TaSST 触觉袖套。
creators.why: His survey of social touch technology is the standard map of the field.
creators.why_zh: 他关于社会触碰技术的综述是这一领域的标准地图。

creators.name: Holland Haptics
creators.role: Dutch start-up that made the Frebble hand-holding device
creators.role_zh: 制作 Frebble 远程牵手装置的荷兰初创公司
creators.bio: Holland Haptics, founded by Frederic Petrignani, developed Frebble, a handheld device for holding hands at a distance.
creators.bio_zh: Holland Haptics 由 Frederic Petrignani 创立，开发了远程牵手的手持装置 Frebble。
creators.why: Frebble turned the squeeze of a held hand into a consumer object and a research tool on mediated touch.
creators.why_zh: Frebble 把握手时的一捏变成了消费品，也成了中介触碰研究的工具。

creators.name: Alexander Toet
creators.role: Senior scientist, TNO (Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research)
creators.role_zh: 荷兰应用科学研究组织（TNO）资深科学家
creators.bio: Alexander Toet studies perception, emotion and mediated social touch.
creators.bio_zh: Alexander Toet 研究知觉、情绪与中介的社会触碰。
creators.why: With Jan van Erp he tested whether a remote hand squeeze changes how people feel together.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Jan van Erp 一起检验了远程的一次握手是否会改变人们一起时的感受。

creators.name: Carey Jewitt
creators.role: Professor of Learning and Technology, UCL; director of the UCL Knowledge Lab
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院学习与技术教授；UCL Knowledge Lab 主任
creators.bio: Carey Jewitt led the ERC project IN-TOUCH on how digital technologies reshape touch and communication.
creators.bio_zh: Carey Jewitt 主持欧洲研究理事会项目 IN-TOUCH，研究数字技术如何重塑触碰与沟通。
creators.why: She brings a social-science reading of touch, its norms and its ethics, to haptic design.
creators.why_zh: 她把关于触碰及其规范与伦理的社会科学视角带进触觉设计。

creators.name: Julia Werner
creators.role: Interaction designer; studied at the University of Applied Sciences Potsdam
creators.role_zh: 交互设计师；曾就读于波茨坦应用科技大学
creators.bio: Julia Werner designed United-pulse with Reto Wettach and Eva Hornecker.
creators.bio_zh: Julia Werner 与 Reto Wettach、Eva Hornecker 共同设计了 United-pulse。
creators.why: United-pulse is a pair of rings that lets partners feel each other's pulse.
creators.why_zh: United-pulse 是一对戒指，让伴侣感受到彼此的脉搏。

creators.name: Game Oven
creators.role: Independent game studio (Adriaan de Jongh, Bojan Endrovski, Jonathan Barbosa)
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室（Adriaan de Jongh、Bojan Endrovski、Jonathan Barbosa）
creators.bio: Game Oven made playful games about physical closeness between players, including Fingle and Bounden.
creators.bio_zh: Game Oven 制作关于玩家之间身体亲近的游戏，包括 Fingle 与 Bounden。
creators.why: Bounden turns a phone into a shared object that two people dance around.
creators.why_zh: Bounden 把手机变成两个人围绕着起舞的共享物件。

creators.name: Brendan Walker
creators.role: Artist and 'thrill engineer'; founder of Thrill Laboratory; collaborator of the Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与“刺激工程师”；Thrill Laboratory 创始人；诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室合作者
creators.bio: Brendan Walker designs amusement rides and VR swings as artworks about thrill and the felt body.
creators.bio_zh: Brendan Walker 把游乐设施和 VR 秋千当作艺术作品，探讨刺激感与被感受的身体。
creators.why: His rides make vertigo, breath and heart rate into material for somatic play.
creators.why_zh: 他的游乐作品把眩晕、呼吸与心率变成身体游戏的材料。

creators.name: Joe Marshall
creators.role: Associate Professor, Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室副教授
creators.bio: Joe Marshall designs breath- and body-controlled experiences, from the Broncomatic ride to VR.
creators.bio_zh: Joe Marshall 设计由呼吸和身体控制的体验，从 Broncomatic 游乐设施到 VR。
creators.why: His breath-controlled bucking bronco is a sharp example of breath as a felt control channel.
creators.why_zh: 他的呼吸控制机械牛是把呼吸当作可感受的控制通道的鲜明例子。

creators.name: Mikko Salminen
creators.role: Researcher, Tampere University (Gamification Group); formerly Aalto University
creators.role_zh: 坦佩雷大学（Gamification Group）研究者；曾任职于阿尔托大学
creators.bio: Mikko Salminen studies emotion, empathy and physiological synchrony in VR.
creators.bio_zh: Mikko Salminen 研究 VR 中的情绪、共情与生理同步。
creators.why: His social VR studies test whether showing each other's biosignals brings two bodies into sync.
creators.why_zh: 他的社交 VR 研究检验了互相看到对方的生物信号能否让两个身体同步。

creators.name: Simo Järvelä
creators.role: Researcher in psychophysiology and VR, Aalto University and University of Helsinki
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学与赫尔辛基大学的心理生理学与 VR 研究者
creators.bio: Simo Järvelä studies shared biofeedback, meditation and social presence in virtual reality.
creators.bio_zh: Simo Järvelä 研究虚拟现实中的共享生物反馈、冥想与社会临场感。
creators.why: His dyadic VR meditation shows respiration synchrony as a route to feeling together.
creators.why_zh: 他的双人 VR 冥想研究把呼吸同步视为“一起感受”的途径。

creators.name: Alexis E. Block
creators.role: Roboticist; PhD at Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and ETH Zurich (HuggieBot)
creators.role_zh: 机器人研究者；在马普智能系统研究所与苏黎世联邦理工学院完成博士研究（HuggieBot）
creators.bio: Alexis Block built the HuggieBot series of soft, warm hugging robots with Katherine J. Kuchenbecker.
creators.bio_zh: Alexis Block 与 Katherine J. Kuchenbecker 一起制作了柔软、温暖的拥抱机器人系列 HuggieBot。
creators.why: Her 'hug commandments' spell out what a robot hug must feel like to feel good.
creators.why_zh: 她的“拥抱诫命”说清了机器人的拥抱要怎样才会让人觉得舒服。

creators.name: Steve Yohanan
creators.role: Researcher; formerly SPIN Lab, University of British Columbia
creators.role_zh: 研究者；曾在不列颠哥伦比亚大学 SPIN 实验室
creators.bio: Steve Yohanan built the Haptic Creature, a furry robot that breathes, purrs and stiffens under the hand.
creators.bio_zh: Steve Yohanan 制作了 Haptic Creature：一只在手下呼吸、发出咕噜声、会绷紧身体的毛茸茸机器人。
creators.why: It is a key study of affective touch between humans and robots.
creators.why_zh: 这是关于人与机器人之间情感触碰的关键研究。

creators.name: Paul Bucci
creators.role: Researcher; formerly SPIN Lab, University of British Columbia
creators.role_zh: 研究者；曾在不列颠哥伦比亚大学 SPIN 实验室
creators.bio: Paul Bucci led CuddleBits, small breathing robots prototyped together with their behaviour.
creators.bio_zh: Paul Bucci 主导了 CuddleBits：外形与行为一同原型化的小型呼吸机器人。
creators.why: CuddleBits show how a robot's body and its felt behaviour have to be sketched together.
creators.why_zh: CuddleBits 表明机器人的身体与它被感受到的行为必须一起草拟。

creators.name: Alice Haynes
creators.role: Researcher in soft robotics and haptics; PhD at the University of Bristol
creators.role_zh: 软体机器人与触觉研究者；在布里斯托大学完成博士学位
creators.bio: Alice Haynes designs soft, shape-changing objects for emotional support, such as a cushion that breathes.
creators.bio_zh: Alice Haynes 设计用于情绪支持的柔软形变物件，例如会呼吸的靠垫。
creators.why: Her breathing cushion lets the body entrain to a slower rhythm through touch alone.
creators.why_zh: 她的呼吸靠垫仅凭触碰就让身体跟上更慢的节律。

creators.name: Pedro Lopes
creators.role: Associate Professor of Computer Science, University of Chicago; director of the Human Computer Integration Lab
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学计算机科学副教授，人机融合实验室负责人
creators.bio: Pedro Lopes builds devices that integrate with the body, such as electrical muscle stimulation that moves the wearer's limbs.
creators.bio_zh: Pedro Lopes 研究与身体融为一体的设备，例如能驱动佩戴者肢体的肌肉电刺激。
creators.why: His EMS work asks what it feels like when a computer moves your muscles, and whose action that is.
creators.why_zh: 他的肌肉电刺激研究追问：当计算机驱动你的肌肉时是什么感觉，这个动作又属于谁。

creators.name: Rebecca Fiebrink
creators.role: Professor, UAL Creative Computing Institute
creators.role_zh: 伦敦艺术大学创意计算学院教授
creators.bio: Rebecca Fiebrink is a computer scientist and musician who builds interactive machine learning tools for artists.
creators.bio_zh: Rebecca Fiebrink 是计算机科学家与音乐人，为艺术家开发交互式机器学习工具。
creators.why: Wekinator lets people teach a model by moving, so the body, not code, shapes the mapping.
creators.why_zh: Wekinator 让人通过运动来训练模型，由身体而不是代码塑造映射。

creators.name: Baptiste Caramiaux
creators.role: CNRS researcher, ISIR, Sorbonne Université; formerly IRCAM and Goldsmiths
creators.role_zh: 索邦大学 ISIR 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）研究员；曾任职于 IRCAM 与金史密斯学院
creators.bio: Baptiste Caramiaux studies machine learning for expressive gesture, music and movement.
creators.bio_zh: Baptiste Caramiaux 研究面向表达性手势、音乐与动作的机器学习。
creators.why: His muscle-sensing work treats expressivity as something felt in effort and tension, not only seen.
creators.why_zh: 他的肌肉传感研究把表现力看作在发力和张力中被感受到的东西，而不只是被看到的。

creators.name: Marco Gillies
creators.role: Reader in Computing, Goldsmiths, University of London
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学金史密斯学院计算系 Reader
creators.bio: Marco Gillies researches movement interaction, virtual characters and interactive machine learning.
creators.bio_zh: Marco Gillies 研究动作交互、虚拟角色与交互式机器学习。
creators.why: He argues that designers should design movement interaction by moving, with ML learning from their examples.
creators.why_zh: 他主张设计者应当通过亲自运动来设计动作交互，让机器学习从示范中学习。

creators.name: Laura Devendorf
creators.role: Associate Professor, ATLAS Institute and Information Science, University of Colorado Boulder; director of the Unstable Design Lab
creators.role_zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校 ATLAS 研究所与信息科学系副教授，Unstable Design Lab 负责人
creators.bio: Laura Devendorf is a designer and artist working on weaving, smart textiles and hybrid human-machine making.
creators.bio_zh: Laura Devendorf 是设计师与艺术家，研究编织、智能织物与人机混合制造。
creators.why: Being the Machine turns the maker's own body into the 3D printer's moving head.
creators.why_zh: Being the Machine 把制作者自己的身体变成 3D 打印机的移动喷头。

creators.name: Matthew Botvinick
creators.role: Cognitive neuroscientist; formerly Princeton University and DeepMind
creators.role_zh: 认知神经科学家；曾任职于普林斯顿大学与 DeepMind
creators.bio: Matthew Botvinick and Jonathan Cohen described the rubber hand illusion in 1998.
creators.bio_zh: Matthew Botvinick 与 Jonathan Cohen 于 1998 年描述了橡胶手错觉。
creators.why: The rubber hand illusion is the foundation of research on felt body ownership.
creators.why_zh: 橡胶手错觉是“被感受的身体拥有感”研究的基础。

creators.name: Bigna Lenggenhager
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Psychology and Neuropsychology, University of Konstanz; formerly EPFL (Blanke lab)
creators.role_zh: 康斯坦茨大学认知心理学与神经心理学教授；曾在洛桑联邦理工学院 Blanke 实验室
creators.bio: Bigna Lenggenhager led the 2007 full-body illusion study with Olaf Blanke and Thomas Metzinger.
creators.bio_zh: Bigna Lenggenhager 与 Olaf Blanke、Thomas Metzinger 共同完成了 2007 年的全身错觉研究。
creators.why: Her work shows that the felt location of the self can be moved with video and touch.
creators.why_zh: 她的研究表明，自我被感受到的位置可以借由影像与触碰被移动。

creators.name: H. Henrik Ehrsson
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Neuroscience, Karolinska Institutet; Brain, Body and Self Laboratory
creators.role_zh: 卡罗林斯卡学院认知神经科学教授；Brain, Body and Self 实验室
creators.bio: Henrik Ehrsson studies how the brain builds the feeling of owning a body, using illusions of body swap and out-of-body experience.
creators.bio_zh: Henrik Ehrsson 借助身体互换与离体体验等错觉，研究大脑如何建立“拥有身体”的感觉。
creators.why: His illusions give designers a vocabulary for where and whose the felt body is.
creators.why_zh: 他的错觉研究为设计者提供了一套描述“被感受的身体在哪里、属于谁”的词汇。

creators.name: Valeria I. Petkova
creators.role: Cognitive neuroscientist; formerly Karolinska Institutet (Ehrsson lab)
creators.role_zh: 认知神经科学家；曾在卡罗林斯卡学院 Ehrsson 实验室
creators.bio: Valeria Petkova led the 2008 body-swap illusion study with Henrik Ehrsson.
creators.bio_zh: Valeria Petkova 与 Henrik Ehrsson 一起主导了 2008 年的身体互换错觉研究。
creators.why: The body-swap study showed that people can feel another person's body as their own.
creators.why_zh: 身体互换研究表明，人可以把另一个人的身体感受为自己的身体。

creators.name: Mel Slater
creators.role: Distinguished Investigator, University of Barcelona (Event Lab); formerly UCL
creators.role_zh: 巴塞罗那大学杰出研究员（Event Lab）；曾任职于伦敦大学学院
creators.bio: Mel Slater pioneered research on presence and virtual body ownership, from body transfer to extended avatars.
creators.bio_zh: Mel Slater 开创了关于临场感与虚拟身体拥有感的研究，从身体转移到延展化身。
creators.why: His lab shows that owning a different virtual body changes perception, attitudes and self-understanding.
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室表明，拥有一个不同的虚拟身体会改变知觉、态度与自我理解。

creators.name: Konstantina Kilteni
creators.role: Neuroscientist, Donders Institute; formerly Karolinska Institutet and Event Lab, Barcelona
creators.role_zh: 神经科学家，唐德斯研究所；曾在卡罗林斯卡学院与巴塞罗那 Event Lab
creators.bio: Konstantina Kilteni studies body ownership, self-touch and the sense of embodiment.
creators.bio_zh: Konstantina Kilteni 研究身体拥有感、自我触碰与具身感。
creators.why: Her definition of the 'sense of embodiment' (ownership, agency, self-location) is the standard framework in VR.
creators.why_zh: 她对“具身感”（拥有感、能动感、自我定位）的定义是 VR 研究的标准框架。

creators.name: Domna Banakou
creators.role: Researcher in virtual embodiment; formerly Event Lab, University of Barcelona
creators.role_zh: 虚拟具身研究者；曾在巴塞罗那大学 Event Lab
creators.bio: Domna Banakou studies how virtual bodies change perception and bias.
creators.bio_zh: Domna Banakou 研究虚拟身体如何改变知觉与偏见。
creators.why: Her child-body study shows that the felt body scales how the world looks.
creators.why_zh: 她的儿童身体研究表明，被感受的身体会改变世界看起来的尺度。

creators.name: William Steptoe
creators.role: VR researcher; formerly Virtual Environments and Computer Graphics group, UCL
creators.role_zh: VR 研究者；曾在伦敦大学学院虚拟环境与计算机图形组
creators.bio: William Steptoe led the Human Tails study on owning and controlling an extra body part in VR.
creators.bio_zh: William Steptoe 主导了 Human Tails 研究：在 VR 中拥有并控制一个额外的身体部位。
creators.why: Human Tails shows the body schema can grow a limb humans never had.
creators.why_zh: Human Tails 表明身体图式可以长出人类从未有过的肢体。

creators.name: Tabitha C. Peck
creators.role: Associate Professor of Mathematics and Computer Science, Davidson College
creators.role_zh: 戴维森学院数学与计算机科学副教授
creators.bio: Tabitha Peck studies avatar embodiment, bias and perception in VR.
creators.bio_zh: Tabitha Peck 研究 VR 中的化身具身、偏见与知觉。
creators.why: Her embodiment study made body ownership a question of body politics.
creators.why_zh: 她的具身研究把身体拥有感变成了身体政治的问题。

creators.name: BeAnotherLab
creators.role: Interdisciplinary collective for embodiment and empathy research
creators.role_zh: 关于具身与共情研究的跨学科团体
creators.bio: BeAnotherLab is a collective founded in Barcelona in 2012 that builds low-cost embodiment systems for swapping perspectives and bodies.
creators.bio_zh: BeAnotherLab 是 2012 年在巴塞罗那成立的团体，制作低成本具身系统，让人交换视角与身体。
creators.why: The Machine to Be Another turns body ownership research into a shared, choreographed encounter between two people.
creators.why_zh: 《成为他人的机器》把身体拥有感研究变成两个人之间共享的、被编排的相遇。

creators.name: Owen Harris
creators.role: VR designer and artist; co-creator of DEEP
creators.role_zh: VR 设计师与艺术家；DEEP 的共同创作者
creators.bio: Owen Harris makes meditative VR; he built DEEP with Niki Smit after using breathing to manage his own anxiety.
creators.bio_zh: Owen Harris 创作冥想型 VR；他在用呼吸应对自身焦虑之后，与 Niki Smit 一起做了 DEEP。
creators.why: DEEP is the best-known VR work steered only by diaphragmatic breathing.
creators.why_zh: DEEP 是最知名的一件只用腹式呼吸来驾驭的 VR 作品。

creators.name: John Desnoyers-Stewart
creators.role: Artist-researcher, iSpace Lab, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学 iSpace 实验室艺术家与研究者
creators.bio: John Desnoyers-Stewart makes social VR installations about connection, breath and touch.
creators.bio_zh: John Desnoyers-Stewart 创作关于联结、呼吸与触碰的社交 VR 装置。
creators.why: JeL uses shared breathing in VR to grow a connection between people and a virtual reef.
creators.why_zh: JeL 用 VR 中共享的呼吸，在人与人、人与虚拟珊瑚礁之间生长出联结。

creators.name: Ekaterina R. Stepanova
creators.role: Researcher, iSpace Lab, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学 iSpace 实验室研究者
creators.bio: Ekaterina Stepanova studies transformative and self-transcendent experiences in VR.
creators.bio_zh: Ekaterina Stepanova 研究 VR 中的转化性与自我超越体验。
creators.why: She studies how VR can support feelings of connection with others and with nature.
creators.why_zh: 她研究 VR 如何支持与他人、与自然相连的感受。

creators.name: Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.role: Experiential art collective
creators.role_zh: 体验艺术团体
creators.bio: Marshmallow Laser Feast is a London collective (Barney Steel, Robin McNicholas and others) making multisensory VR and installations about perception and the natural world.
creators.bio_zh: Marshmallow Laser Feast 是伦敦的艺术团体（Barney Steel、Robin McNicholas 等），创作关于感知与自然世界的多感官 VR 与装置。
creators.why: Their VR works let people borrow the senses and breath of animals and trees.
creators.why_zh: 他们的 VR 作品让人借用动物与树的感官和呼吸。

creators.name: Somniacs
creators.role: Swiss VR simulator company behind Birdly
creators.role_zh: 推出 Birdly 的瑞士 VR 模拟器公司
creators.bio: Somniacs was founded by Max Rheiner to develop Birdly, a full-body flight simulator.
creators.bio_zh: Somniacs 由 Max Rheiner 创立，开发全身飞行模拟器 Birdly。
creators.why: Birdly makes flying a matter of the whole prone body, arms as wings.
creators.why_zh: Birdly 让飞行成为整个俯卧身体的事情，手臂就是翅膀。

creators.name: Max Rheiner
creators.role: Media artist; creator of Birdly and founder of Somniacs; formerly Zurich University of the Arts
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Birdly 创作者与 Somniacs 创始人；曾任教于苏黎世艺术大学
creators.bio: Max Rheiner is a Swiss media artist who developed Birdly at the Zurich University of the Arts.
creators.bio_zh: Max Rheiner 是瑞士媒体艺术家，在苏黎世艺术大学开发了 Birdly。
creators.why: He turned the dream of flying into a posture, a wind and a flapping body.
creators.why_zh: 他把飞翔之梦变成一种姿态、一阵风和一副拍动的身体。

creators.name: Milica Zec
creators.role: Film director and VR storyteller
creators.role_zh: 电影导演与 VR 叙事者
creators.bio: Milica Zec is a Serbian-born director who makes VR films about nature and empathy.
creators.bio_zh: Milica Zec 是出生于塞尔维亚的导演，创作关于自然与共情的 VR 影片。
creators.why: Tree lets the viewer's body become a rainforest tree, from seed to fire.
creators.why_zh: Tree 让观者的身体变成一棵雨林中的树，从种子到被火焚烧。

creators.name: Winslow Porter
creators.role: Immersive producer and creative director
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式作品制作人与创意总监
creators.bio: Winslow Porter co-created the VR works Giant and Tree with Milica Zec.
creators.bio_zh: Winslow Porter 与 Milica Zec 共同创作了 VR 作品 Giant 与 Tree。
creators.why: He designs the haptic and environmental layers that make VR felt on the body.
creators.why_zh: 他设计让 VR 在身体上被感受到的触觉与环境层。

creators.name: Thomas Thwaites
creators.role: Designer
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio: Thomas Thwaites is a designer known for The Toaster Project and GoatMan.
creators.bio_zh: Thomas Thwaites 是以 The Toaster Project 与 GoatMan 闻名的设计师。
creators.why: GoatMan is a first-person experiment in taking on another species' body and gait.
creators.why_zh: GoatMan 是一次以第一人称承担另一物种身体与步态的实验。

creators.name: Chris Woebken
creators.role: Designer and researcher; co-founder of the Extrapolation Factory
creators.role_zh: 设计师与研究者；Extrapolation Factory 联合创始人
creators.bio: Chris Woebken is a German-born designer working on speculative and participatory futures.
creators.bio_zh: Chris Woebken 是出生于德国的设计师，从事思辨与参与式未来设计。
creators.why: Animal Superpowers gives children the senses of ants and birds through wearable devices.
creators.why_zh: Animal Superpowers 通过可穿戴装置，让孩子获得蚂蚁与鸟的感官。

creators.name: Kenichi Okada
creators.role: Designer; Royal College of Art Design Interactions graduate
creators.role_zh: 设计师；皇家艺术学院交互设计系毕业
creators.bio: Kenichi Okada is a Japanese designer who co-created Animal Superpowers with Chris Woebken.
creators.bio_zh: Kenichi Okada 是日本设计师，与 Chris Woebken 共同创作了 Animal Superpowers。
creators.why: He co-designed wearables that shift the scale and sense of the body.
creators.why_zh: 他参与设计了改变身体尺度与感官的可穿戴物。

creators.name: Art Orienté Objet
creators.role: Artist duo of Marion Laval-Jeantet and Benoît Mangin
creators.role_zh: Marion Laval-Jeantet 与 Benoît Mangin 组成的艺术家二人组
creators.bio: Art Orienté Objet is a French duo working at the edges of art, ethology and biology since 1991.
creators.bio_zh: Art Orienté Objet 是法国艺术二人组，自 1991 年起在艺术、动物行为学与生物学的边缘工作。
creators.why: Their horse-blood performance asks what it would mean to feel another species inside one's own body.
creators.why_zh: 他们的马血表演追问：在自己身体里感受另一个物种意味着什么。

creators.name: Clara Moge
creators.role: HCI researcher; formerly UCL Interaction Centre
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；曾在伦敦大学学院交互中心（UCLIC）
creators.bio: Clara Moge studies how physiological data can be shared between people to support social and emotional connection.
creators.bio_zh: Clara Moge 研究如何在人与人之间分享生理数据，以支持社会与情感联结。
creators.why: Her systematic review maps the field of social biofeedback that shared-heartbeat and shared-breath designs belong to.
creators.why_zh: 她的系统综述梳理了“社会生物反馈”领域，共享心跳与共享呼吸的设计都属于其中。

creators.name: Holger Schnädelbach
creators.role: Architect and HCI researcher; founder of the Adaptive Architecture research group, formerly Mixed Reality Lab, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 建筑师与人机交互研究者；自适应建筑研究组创始人，曾在诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室
creators.bio: Holger Schnädelbach designs adaptive architecture that changes shape and atmosphere in response to the people inside it.
creators.bio_zh: Holger Schnädelbach 设计会随内部人员而改变形状与氛围的自适应建筑。
creators.why: ExoBuilding makes a building breathe with its occupant, extending the felt body into architecture.
creators.why_zh: ExoBuilding 让建筑与其中的人一同呼吸，把被感受的身体延伸到建筑之中。

creators.name: Bronwyn Tarr
creators.role: Evolutionary anthropologist and dancer; formerly Institute of Cognitive and Evolutionary Anthropology, University of Oxford
creators.role_zh: 进化人类学者与舞者；曾在牛津大学认知与进化人类学研究所
creators.bio: Bronwyn Tarr studies how dancing and moving in synchrony bond people together.
creators.bio_zh: Bronwyn Tarr 研究一起跳舞、同步运动如何让人彼此联结。
creators.why: Her VR study isolates movement synchrony as a cause of felt social closeness.
creators.why_zh: 她的 VR 研究把动作同步单独拿出来，证明它本身就能带来被感受到的社会亲近。

works.title: Breathing Mirror
works.description: Pianists wear a breathing belt while playing and afterwards watch their breathing aligned with the music, using it to recall and describe what their body was doing at each moment.
works.description_zh: 钢琴家演奏时佩戴呼吸带，演奏后观看与音乐对齐的呼吸曲线，借此回忆并描述每个时刻自己的身体在做什么。
works.idea_en: Body data works best as a mirror for first-person recall, not as a verdict: seeing one's breath brings back the felt experience of playing.
works.idea_zh: 身体数据最好的用法是作为第一人称回忆的镜子，而不是评判：看见自己的呼吸，能唤回演奏时的身体感受。
works.method: Stretch-sensor breathing belt synchronised with audio and MIDI, plus an annotation interface used in stimulated-recall interviews with pianists.
works.method_zh: 与音频、MIDI 同步的拉伸传感呼吸带，加上一个在刺激回忆访谈中使用的标注界面。

paper.title: Exploring Breathing-Music Coupling: Using the Breathing Mirror for Somatic Reflection in Piano Performance

works.title: Change and Be Changed: Looking Back at 10 Years of the Soma Design Research Program
works.description: A TOCHI retrospective on ten years of the soma design research program: what its methods, prototypes and concepts achieved, and how doing it changed the designers themselves.
works.description_zh: TOCHI 回顾文章，总结身体设计研究纲领的十年：它的方法、原型与概念取得了什么，以及这项工作如何改变了设计师自己。
works.idea_en: Soma design changes the designer as much as the design; a research program built on the felt body must account for that change.
works.idea_zh: 身体设计改变设计师，不亚于改变设计；建立在被感受的身体之上的研究纲领，必须把这种改变算进去。
works.method: Retrospective analysis of design examples and concepts, assessing the program's generativity, transferability and scope.
works.method_zh: 对设计案例与概念的回顾性分析，从生成力、可迁移性与范围三方面评估该纲领。

paper.title: Change and Be Changed: Looking Back at 10 Years of the Soma Design Research Program

works.title_zh: 改变与被改变：回望身体设计研究纲领的十年

works.title: Experiencing the More-than-Human Through Human Augmentation
works.description: A design paper that turns human-augmentation devices sideways: instead of making people more capable, they give temporary, first-person approximations of how a bat, fungus or octopus might sense, drawing on five mixed-reality, haptic and EMS works.
works.description_zh: 一篇设计论文，把人类增强设备“侧转”使用：不是让人更强，而是提供短暂的、第一人称的近似体验，去体会蝙蝠、真菌或章鱼如何感知；论文基于五件混合现实、触觉与肌电刺激作品。
works.idea_en: Augmentation can loosen the human sensorium rather than optimise it; the felt body becomes a way to approach other species' worlds from within.
works.idea_zh: 增强技术可以松动人的感官，而不是优化它；被感受的身体成为从内部接近其他物种世界的途径。
works.method: Research through design grounded in eco-phenomenology and eco-somatics, synthesising seven design principles from EchoVision, FeltSight, FungiSync, TentacUs and City of Sparkles.
works.method_zh: 以生态现象学与生态身体学为基础的设计研究，从 EchoVision、FeltSight、FungiSync、TentacUs 与 City of Sparkles 中归纳出七条设计原则。

paper.title: Experiencing the More-than-Human Through Human Augmentation

works.title_zh: 借由人类增强体验超越人类

works.title: Inside the Mirror, Wearing My Own Body
works.description: Looking back on four wearable systems, the authors describe felt experiences that were at once pleasant and unpleasant, comforting and frightening, human-like and machinic, and read them through monster theory.
works.description_zh: 回顾四种可穿戴系统，作者描述了一些同时令人愉快又不快、安慰又恐惧、像人又像机器的亲身感受，并用“怪物理论”来解读。
works.idea_en: Attending to felt, ambiguous experiences reveals a monstrous category that user-experience frameworks miss; such experiences deserve design attention rather than removal.
works.idea_zh: 关注被感受到的、暧昧的体验，会揭示出用户体验框架遗漏的“怪物”类别；这类体验值得设计去关注，而不是被消除。
works.method: Retrospective first-person analysis of shape-changing and actuated wearables using concepts such as fusion, fission, massification and incompleteness (with Jeffrey Bardzell).
works.method_zh: 以融合、裂变、聚合与不完整等概念，对形变和执行类可穿戴设备做回顾性的第一人称分析（与 Jeffrey Bardzell 合作）。

paper.title: Inside the Mirror, Wearing My own Body: Why UX Should Engage Monstrous Experiences

works.title_zh: 镜中，穿着我自己的身体

works.title: Shared Bodily Control via Exoskeleton-based Play
works.description: In three games an exoskeleton controls one of the player's arms with its own logic while the player controls the other, framed as proxy, collaborator or opponent.
works.description_zh: 三款游戏中，一台外骨骼按自己的逻辑控制玩家的一只手臂，玩家控制另一只；外骨骼被设定为代理、合作者或对手。
works.idea_en: How a machine that moves part of your body is framed (helper, partner, rival) changes how that arm feels and whose arm it seems to be.
works.idea_zh: 一台驱动你部分身体的机器被如何定位（帮手、伙伴、对手），会改变那只手臂的感受，以及它看起来属于谁。
works.method: Arm exoskeleton with game scenarios; qualitative study with 16 participants on bodily experience and the human-machine relationship.
works.method_zh: 手臂外骨骼配合游戏情境；对 16 名参与者进行关于身体体验与人机关系的质性研究。

paper.title: Towards Understanding the Design of Shared Bodily Control via Exoskeleton-based Play

works.title_zh: 以外骨骼游戏共享身体控制

works.title: Toward Pluralizing Reflection in HCI through Daoism
works.description: Drawing on Daoist texts and interviews with 18 Daoist practitioners, scholars and priests, the paper describes everyday reflection as Stillness, Resonance and Emergence, and proposes 'reflecting-with' rather than reflecting on oneself.
works.description_zh: 论文以道家文献以及对 18 位道家修行者、学者与道士的访谈为基础，把日常反思描述为“静”“感应”“生成”三个维度，并提出“与之共同反思”而不是只反思自身。
works.idea_en: Reflection need not be a mind looking back at data: in Daoist practice it is embodied, relational and emerges from stillness with the world.
works.idea_zh: 反思不必是头脑回看数据：在道家实践中，它是具身的、关系性的，从与世界一同静下来的状态中生成。
works.method: Qualitative study combining textual analysis of Daoist literature with semi-structured interviews, analysed thematically for HCI design implications.
works.method_zh: 质性研究，结合道家文献的文本分析与半结构访谈，并通过主题分析提出人机交互设计启示。

paper.title: Toward Pluralizing Reflection in HCI through Daoism

works.title_zh: 借道家思想使人机交互中的反思多元化

works.title: What Makes Us Most Human Is Also So Animal
works.description: A blind tasting in which visitors drink a line of milks from mammals, including the artist's own breast milk, cow, goat, camel, yak, bat and coyote, and try to guess the source.
works.description_zh: 一场盲品：观众依次品尝多种哺乳动物的奶，包括艺术家本人的母乳，以及牛、山羊、骆驼、牦牛、蝙蝠和郊狼的奶，并猜测其来源。
works.idea_en: Breastfeeding, the most intimate bodily act, is also what we share with other mammals: tasting it crosses the line between human and animal.
works.idea_zh: 哺乳是最私密的身体行为，也是我们与其他哺乳动物共有的东西：品尝它，就跨越了人与动物的界限。
works.method: Performance and tasting made after the artist's pregnancy, part of the solo exhibition Womb Wetware (2026).
works.method_zh: 艺术家产后创作的表演与品尝活动，属于个展《Womb Wetware》（2026）。

works.title: Conversations With The Stressed Body
works.description: A co-design workshop in which nine girls aged 15–18 used Embodied Probes, artefacts and bodily activities, to locate, express and discuss the sensations of stress, then designed prototypes for their own stress relief.
works.description_zh: 一场共同设计工作坊：九名 15 至 18 岁的女孩使用“具身探针”（物件与身体活动）来定位、表达并讨论压力的身体感受，再为自己设计缓解压力的原型。
works.idea_en: Starting from bodily sensation makes stress easier to speak about: the body opens a path to self-disclosure that words alone block.
works.idea_zh: 从身体感受出发，压力更容易被说出来：身体打开了一条仅靠语言会被堵住的自我表露之路。
works.method: Workshop sessions with body mapping, tangible expression materials and embodied prototyping, analysed qualitatively.
works.method_zh: 工作坊包括身体地图、可触的表达材料与具身原型制作，并进行质性分析。

paper.title: Conversations With The Stressed Body: Facilitating Stress Self-Disclosure Among Adolescent Girls Through An Embodied Approach

works.title: Estrangement through Silence
works.description: Over four workshops across 18 months, mostly outdoors, the authors kept long periods of shared silence; the collective silence worked as an estrangement method that revealed how people and things shape one another.
works.description_zh: 在一年半里的四次工作坊中（多在户外），作者们长时间共同保持静默；这种集体静默成为一种陌生化方法，揭示了人与物如何彼此构成。
works.idea_en: Silence is not an absence but a presence full of sound and contact; shared silence tunes designers to themselves, each other and the environment.
works.idea_zh: 静默不是缺席，而是充满声音与接触的在场；共同的静默让设计师与自己、彼此和环境调谐。
works.method: Four first-person workshops with prolonged collective silence during activities such as cooking and designing (with Pedro Sanches and Vasiliki Tsaknaki).
works.method_zh: 四次第一人称工作坊，在烹饪、设计等活动中长时间保持集体静默（与 Pedro Sanches、Vasiliki Tsaknaki 合著）。

paper.title: Estrangement through Silence

works.title: FeltSight
works.description: Inspired by the star-nosed mole, soft haptic gloves worn with a mixed reality headset let wearers feel nearby surfaces through their fingertips before touching them, while vision fades to darkness and small clouds of light surround the hands.
works.description_zh: 受星鼻鼹启发，柔软的触觉手套与混合现实头显配合使用，让佩戴者在触碰之前就能通过指尖感受附近的表面；视觉则淡入黑暗，只有小团光晕环绕双手。
works.idea_en: Reducing sight and extending touch slows people down and makes them probe the world with the hand as an organ of knowing.
works.idea_zh: 削弱视觉、延伸触觉，会让人慢下来，把手当作认识世界的器官去探索。
works.method: Apple Vision Pro scene meshes and hand tracking drive vibrotactile actuators in splayed soft gloves according to distance to surfaces.
works.method_zh: Apple Vision Pro 的场景网格与手部追踪，根据与表面的距离驱动张开式软手套中的振动器。

paper.title: Designing "FeltSight": Feeling the World Like a Star-Nosed Mole

works.title: Intelligence Is Corporeal
works.description: In a 2025 lecture and a 2026 interactions article, Höök argues that current AI lives mostly in language, while intelligence, aesthetics and ethics are rooted in bodily existence, and asks how soma design can shape embodied AI.
works.description_zh: 在 2025 年的一场讲座和 2026 年发表于 interactions 的文章中，Höök 指出当下的 AI 主要存在于语言之中，而智能、审美与伦理都根植于身体性的存在，并追问身体设计如何塑造具身的 AI。
works.idea_en: Why we turn toward what is good and away from harm is felt in the body; AI that ignores the soma leaves out the ground of value itself.
works.idea_zh: 我们为何趋向美好、避开伤害，是在身体里被感受到的；忽视身体的 AI，也就遗漏了价值本身的根基。
works.method: Position lecture and essay drawing on a decade of soma design with shape-changing garments, drones and robots.
works.method_zh: 一场立场性讲座与一篇论文，以十年来关于形变服装、无人机与机器人的身体设计实践为依据。

paper.title: Shaping and Being Shaped by Embodied Intelligence

works.title: Kuddi
works.description: Kuddi is a soft pillow with 12 inflatable pockets that touches and is touched in relation to the changing menstruating body; its designer lived with it for two menstrual cycles.
works.description_zh: Kuddi 是一个带 12 个充气口袋的柔软枕头，随着月经周期中身体的变化去触碰、也被触碰；设计者与它共同生活了两个月经周期。
works.idea_en: Data felt through touch, 'visceralised' rather than visualised, can change one's relation to menstrual pain.
works.idea_zh: 通过触摸被感受到的数据——“内脏化”而非可视化——可以改变人与经痛的关系。
works.method: Haptic data physicalisation with 12 inflatable pockets, evaluated autoethnographically over two cycles and analysed through narrative thick descriptions.
works.method_zh: 带 12 个充气口袋的触觉数据实体化装置，以自我民族志方式评估两个周期，并用叙事性的深描进行分析。

paper.title: Becoming One with Kuddi: Touching Data through an Intimate Data Physicalisation

works.title: Somatic Safety
works.description: Dancers use contact improvisation to dance with collaborative robot arms, pushing, leaning on and being moved by them, and learn through the body how to do so safely.
works.description_zh: 舞者用接触即兴与协作机械臂共舞：推它、倚靠它、被它带动，并通过身体学会如何安全地这样做。
works.idea_en: Safety with robots can be felt and learned through contact, a mind-body skill, not only calculated as distance and force limits.
works.idea_zh: 与机器人相处的安全可以通过接触被感受、被习得，是一种身心技能，而不只是计算出的距离与力的上限。
works.method: Artistic exploration with dancers and cobots in iterative sessions of contact improvisation exercises and reflection, analysed by a multidisciplinary team.
works.method_zh: 舞者与协作机器人一起开展艺术探索，反复进行接触即兴练习与反思，由跨学科团队分析。

paper.title: Somatic Safety: An Embodied Approach Towards Safe Human-Robot Interaction

works.title: TentacUs
works.description: A mixed-reality ritual in which dancers join left hands in a ring and each becomes one arm of an octopus-like being; what one right hand senses nearby is passed on as vibration to the neighbours, so sensing spreads through the group.
works.description_zh: 一场混合现实仪式：舞者左手相牵围成一圈，每人成为一只类章鱼生命的一条触手；一只右手在附近感知到的东西，会以振动传给相邻的人，感知由此在群体中扩散。
works.idea_en: An octopus senses with its arms, not only its brain; sharing sensation across bodies lets participants feel a decentred, distributed body-mind.
works.idea_zh: 章鱼用触手而不只用大脑感知；在身体之间共享感觉，让参与者体会一种去中心的、分布式的身心。
works.method: Soft textile tentacle gloves hold smartphones whose LiDAR senses proximity and whose vibration motors pass haptic waves to neighbours; touch data are drawn as point clouds over a 3D Gaussian-splat scan on a public display.
works.method_zh: 柔软织物触手手套内置智能手机：LiDAR 感知距离，振动马达把触觉波传给相邻者；触碰数据以点云形式绘制在现场的 3D 高斯泼溅扫描上供观众观看。

paper.title: I Become Tentacle, We Become "Tentacus": A Mixed Reality Ritual for Distributed Bodies and Collective Minds

works.title: The Body as Its Own Best Sensor
works.description: Through an autobiographical study of everyday long-distance running with a basic sports watch, Tholander describes how runners sense pace, effort and terrain with their whole body.
works.description_zh: Tholander 通过对自己日常长跑、只戴一块普通运动手表的自传式研究，描述跑者如何用整个身体感知配速、用力与地形。
works.idea_en: A trained body senses more finely than the watch; sports technology should support these somatic sensitivities rather than replace them.
works.idea_zh: 受过训练的身体比手表感知得更细；运动技术应当支持这些身体敏感性，而不是取而代之。
works.method: Autoethnography of running practice and data use, distilled into six themes for sports technology design.
works.method_zh: 对跑步修习与数据使用的自我民族志，提炼出运动技术设计的六个主题。

paper.title: The Body as Its Own Best Sensor - An Autoethnographic Study of the Sensitivities of the Body in Long-Distance Running

works.title_zh: 身体是自己最好的传感器

works.title: Touchware
works.description: Touchware is a set of on-body touch probes that inflate or add weight, worn at work to engage with and care for menstrual discomfort.
works.description_zh: Touchware 是一组贴身的触觉探头，可以充气或施加重量，在工作场合佩戴，用来与经期不适相处并照护它。
works.idea_en: Technology can touch a body in a vulnerable state with care, when it is designed for the diffuse, lingering qualities of discomfort.
works.idea_zh: 当技术是为不适那种弥散、久久不去的特性而设计时，它就能带着照护去触碰处在脆弱状态的身体。
works.method: Pneumatic shape-change and weighted components developed through participatory soma design, deployed for two weeks with six participants in a workplace.
works.method_zh: 通过参与式身体设计开发的气动形变与加重部件，在工作场所由六位参与者使用两周。

paper.title: Designing Touch Technologies for and with Bodies in Menstrual Discomfort

works.title: Words that Feel Right: Haiku, Felt Sense and LLMs
works.description: Over three months, the authors wrote haiku with ChatGPT as a tool for somatic introspection, searching for words that 'feel right' to the body and its emotions.
works.description_zh: 三个月里，作者把 ChatGPT 当作身体内省的工具来写俳句，寻找对身体和情绪而言“感觉对了”的词语。
works.idea_en: A language model can support finding words for a felt sense only if designers respect the time it takes and each person's own idiom.
works.idea_zh: 语言模型要帮人为“体会”找到词语，前提是设计者尊重这所需的时间，以及每个人自己的言语方式。
works.method: First-person collaborative process combining Gendlin's Focusing, haiku writing and ChatGPT dialogues, yielding two design qualities: ongoing temporalities and idiolectic resonance.
works.method_zh: 结合 Gendlin 的聚焦法、俳句写作与 ChatGPT 对话的第一人称协作过程，得出两个设计品质：持续的时间性与个人语言的共鸣。

paper.title: Searching for the Words that "Feel Right": Resonating with our Bodies and Felt Senses Through Haiku and Large Language Models (LLMs)

works.title_zh: “感觉对了”的词：俳句、体会与大语言模型

works.title: Body Oracle
works.description: A camera reads the poses of one or several visitors and an AI model turns them into new pictograms styled on Chinese oracle-bone inscriptions, a written vocabulary for bodily and inter-bodily positions.
works.description_zh: 摄像头识别一位或多位观众的姿势，AI 模型把它们转化为模仿甲骨文风格的新象形字，形成一套描述身体及身体间位置的书写词汇。
works.idea_en: A language that has words for postures and for how bodies stand together could make people more aware of their own and each other's bodies.
works.idea_zh: 如果一种语言拥有描述姿势以及身体如何共处的字词，人们就可能对自己和彼此的身体更有觉察。
works.method: MoveNet keypoint detection feeding an image-to-image model trained on paired examples of volunteers re-enacting oracle-bone characters.
works.method_zh: MoveNet 关键点检测，输入到图像转换模型中；模型以志愿者重演甲骨文字形所得的配对样本训练。

paper.title: Body Oracle

works.title: Cell Space
works.description: Dancers and visitors practising contact improvisation each occupy a mixed reality 'cell' whose fluid boundary shows their heartbeat and pressure in real time, so the cells merge and split as bodies meet.
works.description_zh: 进行接触即兴的舞者与观众各自处在一个混合现实“细胞”中，细胞流动的边界实时显示心跳与压力，身体相遇时细胞随之融合或分离。
works.idea_en: Making biosignals visible between touching bodies extends intercorporeality: partners sense each other's inner state as part of the dance.
works.idea_zh: 让生物信号在相互触碰的身体之间可见，拓展了身体间性：舞伴把彼此的内在状态当作舞蹈的一部分来感知。
works.method: Co-located AR headsets rendering Voronoi cells around tracked participants, fed by heart rate and pressure sensors (neurofeedback).
works.method_zh: 同地增强现实头显围绕被追踪的参与者渲染 Voronoi 细胞，数据来自心率与压力传感器（神经反馈）。

paper.title: Cell Space

works.title: Critiquing Menstrual Pain Technologies
works.description: An interaction critique of FemTech products for menstrual pain, read through feminist disability studies, ends in three design provocations.
works.description_zh: 借助女性主义残障研究，对治疗经痛的女性健康科技产品进行交互批评，并提出三条设计挑衅。
works.idea_en: Most products try to hide menstrual pain; design should instead attend to it as a cyclical, chronic lived experience.
works.idea_zh: 多数产品试图把经痛藏起来；设计应当把它当作周期性的、慢性的亲身经验来关注。
works.method: Interaction critique of FemTech market exemplars using feminist disability studies as the analytical lens.
works.method_zh: 以女性主义残障研究为分析视角，对女性健康科技市场上的代表产品进行交互批评。
