works.description_zh: Gendlin 的哲学著作描述“体验”（experiencing）：一种总比语言更丰富的身体感受之流，以及当我们留意它、让它向前推进时新意义如何形成。
works.idea_en: Meaning is felt in the body before it is said; attending to that felt sense lets precise words and new ideas emerge.
works.idea_zh: 意义在被说出之前已在身体中被感受到；留意这种“体会”，才能让准确的语言与新想法浮现。
works.method: Philosophical analysis of the relation between felt experience and symbolisation; the basis for the Focusing practice (1978) and Thinking at the Edge.
works.method_zh: 对被感受的经验与符号化之间关系的哲学分析；是 Focusing 实践（1978）与 Thinking at the Edge 的基础。

paper.title: Experiencing and the Creation of Meaning

works.title: Cyborgs and Space
works.description: The paper that coined 'cyborg': two Rockland State Hospital scientists propose altering the astronaut's body with implanted pumps and drugs so it can regulate itself in space.
works.description_zh: 创造“赛博格”一词的论文：两位罗克兰州立医院的科学家提出，用植入的泵和药物改造宇航员的身体，使其能在太空中自我调节。
works.idea_en: The first cyborg was about homeostasis handled below awareness 'leaving man free to explore, to create, to think, and to feel'; the body is changed, not left behind.
works.idea_zh: 最初的赛博格关乎在意识之下完成的体内平衡，“让人得以自由地探索、创造、思考与感受”；身体被改变，而不是被抛下。
works.method: A speculative essay built on feedback control: an osmotic pump in a rat is the working example, extended to drugs for wakefulness, radiation and emotion in astronauts.
works.method_zh: 一篇基于反馈控制的思辨文章：以植入大鼠体内的渗透泵为实例，延伸到为宇航员调节清醒、辐射与情绪的药物。

paper.title: Cyborgs and Space

works.title: Ankoku Butoh (Dance of Darkness)
works.description: A dance form begun by Hijikata's Kinjiki (1959) in which dancers move very slowly, crouched and distorted, guided by image scores (butoh-fu) that ask them to become insects, ash or a body being eaten.
works.description_zh: 由土方巽的《禁色》（1959）开启的舞蹈形式：舞者以极慢的速度、蜷曲扭曲的姿态移动，由舞踏谱引导，化身为昆虫、灰烬或被吞噬的身体。
works.idea_en: Dancing from inner images rather than steps lets the body become other than itself, a method for making the habitual body strange.
works.idea_zh: 从内在意象而非舞步出发起舞，让身体成为自己以外的东西，这是一种使习惯的身体变得陌生的方法。
works.method: Training through butoh-fu image notations, walking exercises and extreme slowness, developed by Hijikata with Kazuo Ohno in 1960s Tokyo.
works.method_zh: 通过舞踏谱意象记谱、行走练习与极度缓慢来训练，由土方巽与大野一雄于 1960 年代在东京发展而成。

works.title: Authentic Movement
works.description: A mover closes their eyes and waits for movement to arise, following it without planning, while a witness sits at the edge and watches; afterwards both speak about their experience in the first person.
works.description_zh: 动者闭上眼睛，等待动作自己出现并不加计划地跟随它；见证者坐在一旁观看；之后两人都以第一人称讲述各自的体验。
works.idea_en: The practice separates 'I move' from 'I am moved' and trains a non-judging inner witness, a first-person method that designers can borrow for describing felt experience without evaluation.
works.idea_zh: 这一修习区分“我在动”与“我被动起来”，并训练一个不评判的内在见证者，是设计者可借用、以不加评价的方式描述亲身体验的第一人称方法。
works.method: Eyes-closed movement with an external witness and first-person spoken reflection; from Whitehouse's Jungian 'movement in depth' (1950s), developed by Janet Adler into the mover–witness discipline.
works.method_zh: 闭眼动作、外部见证者与第一人称的口头回顾；源自怀特豪斯基于荣格理论的“深度动作”（1950 年代），由珍妮特·阿德勒发展为“动者—见证者”修习。

works.title: Transhumanism
works.description: A short essay in which the biologist Julian Huxley proposes that humanity can deliberately transcend itself by realising new possibilities of its nature.
works.description_zh: 一篇短文，生物学家 Julian Huxley 提出人类可以通过实现自身本性的新可能，主动地超越自己。
works.idea_en: Huxley's transhumanism is about unfolding the potential of human nature, including richer experience, not about leaving the body; later transhumanism narrowed this to technology.
works.idea_zh: Huxley 的超人类主义关乎展开人性的潜能（包括更丰富的体验），而非离开身体；后来的超人类主义把它收窄为技术问题。
works.method: Essay in the collection New Bottles for New Wine (1957), reprinted in the Journal of Humanistic Psychology in 1968.
works.method_zh: 收录于文集《New Bottles for New Wine》（1957），1968 年重刊于《人本主义心理学杂志》。

paper.venue: New Bottles for New Wine (Chatto & Windus, 1957); Journal of Humanistic Psychology 8(1), 1968
paper.title: Transhumanism

works.title: Electric Dress
works.description: A garment of about 200 painted light bulbs and tubes, weighing over 50 kg, that flashed in sequence while Tanaka wore it at the 2nd Gutai Art Exhibition in Tokyo in 1956.
works.description_zh: 一件由约 200 个上色灯泡和灯管组成、重逾 50 公斤的服装，1956 年田中敦子在东京第二届具体美术展上穿着它，灯光依次闪烁。
works.idea_en: Wearing technology is a bodily risk and a felt state: heat, weight, light and danger enclose the wearer inside the machine.
works.idea_zh: 穿戴技术是一种身体的冒险，也是一种被感受的状态：热、重量、光与危险把穿着者包裹在机器之中。
works.method: Hand-painted incandescent and fluorescent lamps wired to a flashing controller, worn as a kimono-like costume.
works.method_zh: 手工上色的白炽灯与荧光灯管，接到闪烁控制器上，做成类似和服的服装穿着。

works.title: Challenging Mud
works.description: Stripped to his underwear, Shiraga threw himself into a pit of mud, clay and cement and wrestled with it, leaving the churned surface as the work; performed at the First Gutai Art Exhibition in Tokyo in 1955.
works.description_zh: 白发一雄只穿内裤，扑进混有黏土与水泥的泥坑，与泥浆搏斗，把被搅动的泥面留作作品；1955 年在东京第一届具体美术展上表演。
works.idea_en: The whole body can be the brush: making becomes a struggle of flesh with material, felt from inside and left as trace.
works.idea_zh: 整个身体可以成为画笔：创作变成肉身与材料的搏斗，从内部被感受，并留下痕迹。
works.method: Action performed three times in the exhibition yard, documented by photographs and film.
works.method_zh: 在展览庭院中表演三次的行动，以照片和影像记录。

works.title: Ideas II: Studies in the Phenomenology of Constitution
works.description: The second book of Husserl's Ideas analyses how the lived body (Leib) is constituted: as the zero point of orientation, the organ of will and the bearer of localised sensations felt when one hand touches the other.
works.description_zh: Husserl《观念》第二卷分析“活的身体”（Leib）如何被构成：它是定向的零点、意志的器官，也是一只手触摸另一只手时被感受到的定位感觉的载体。
works.idea_en: The body I live is felt from inside as mine; touching and being touched at once shows it is both subject and object.
works.idea_zh: 我所活的身体从内部被感受为“我的”；触摸与被触摸同时发生，表明它既是主体也是客体。
works.method: Phenomenological description written 1912–1928 and published posthumously in Husserliana IV (1952); English translation by Rojcewicz and Schuwer (1989).
works.method_zh: 写于 1912–1928 年的现象学描述，身后于 1952 年收入《胡塞尔全集》第四卷出版；英译本由 Rojcewicz 与 Schuwer 于 1989 年完成。

paper.title: Ideas Pertaining to a Pure Phenomenology and to a Phenomenological Philosophy, Second Book

works.title_zh: 纯粹现象学和现象学哲学的观念（第二卷）

works.title: Cheng Man-ch'ing's 37-Posture Tai Chi Form
works.description: A shortened Yang-style form of 37 postures that takes about ten minutes, emphasising total relaxation, a 'beautiful lady's hand' and rooting through the feet; Cheng taught it in Taipei and from 1964 at the Shr Jung school in New York.
works.description_zh: 由杨式太极拳简化而来的三十七式，约十分钟练完，强调全身放松、“美人手”与由脚下生根；郑曼青先在台北传授，1964 年起在纽约时中学社传授。
works.idea_en: Relaxation is not collapse: the practice trains a body that is soft yet structured, a state many Western somatic and dance teachers later adopted.
works.idea_zh: 放松不是瘫软：这门修习训练的是柔软而有结构的身体，许多西方身体修习与舞蹈教师后来都采纳了这种状态。
works.method: Short form codified in Cheng's Thirteen Chapters on Tai Chi Chuan (Zhengzi Taijiquan Shisan Pian), taught with push hands and Chinese medicine.
works.method_zh: 简化拳架记载于《郑子太极拳十三篇》，与推手及中医一同传授。

works.title: Seitai and Katsugen Undō (Spontaneous Regenerative Movement)
works.description: After a few preparatory breaths and twists, practitioners let the body move by itself, shaking, stretching or swaying without conscious direction; Noguchi Haruchika proposed katsugen undō in the decade after 1945 as part of Seitai.
works.description_zh: 经过几次预备呼吸与扭转后，习练者让身体自己动起来，在无意识引导下抖动、伸展或摇摆；野口晴哉在昭和二十年代（1945–1954）提出活元运动，作为整体的一部分。
works.idea_en: The body has its own intelligence of recovery: stepping back from control lets involuntary movement rebalance body and mood.
works.idea_zh: 身体有自己的恢复智慧：放下控制，让不随意运动来重新平衡身体与情绪。
works.method: Group or solo sessions of spontaneous movement, combined with yuki (attentive hand contact) and taiheki (body-type) observation.
works.method_zh: 单人或集体的自发运动练习，结合愉气法（专注的手部接触）与体癖观察。

works.title: Feldenkrais Method
works.description: A teacher talks a group through slow, small, often lying-down movement variations (Awareness Through Movement); in Functional Integration the teacher guides one person's movement by touch. People notice how a small change in one part reorganises the whole self.
works.description_zh: 教师用语言引导一群人做缓慢、细小、常常躺着进行的动作变化（动中觉察）；在“功能整合”中，教师用双手引导个人的动作。人们会注意到身体某处的细小改变如何重组整个自我。
works.idea_en: Feldenkrais held that we act according to our self-image, and that sensing, feeling, thinking and moving change together; Höök's soma design group trains in Feldenkrais before designing, and its Soma Mat and Breathing Light grew out of Feldenkrais lessons.
works.idea_zh: 费登奎斯认为人按照自我意象行动，感觉、感受、思考与动作会一同改变；Höök 的身体设计团队在设计前先练习费登奎斯，Soma Mat 与 Breathing Light 正是从费登奎斯课中生长出来的。
works.method: Verbally guided sequences of slow, reduced-effort movements with attention to differences, plus hands-on lessons; first set out in Body and Mature Behavior (1949).
works.method_zh: 以语言引导、缓慢且减少用力的动作序列，关注前后差异；另有手把手的个别课。最早阐述于《身体与成熟行为》（1949）。

works.title: Phenomenology of Perception
works.description: Merleau-Ponty's main work shows that perception is carried out by a lived body with its own motor know-how, the body schema, which reaches into tools and space before any thought about them.
works.description_zh: Merleau-Ponty 的代表作表明，知觉由拥有自身运动知识（身体图式）的活的身体完成，身体在任何思考之前就已伸展进工具与空间。
works.idea_en: I do not have a body, I am my body: understanding happens first as motor intentionality, the body's 'I can'.
works.idea_zh: 我不是拥有一个身体，我就是我的身体：理解首先以运动意向性、即身体的“我能”发生。
works.method: Phenomenological analysis drawing on Gestalt psychology and clinical cases such as Schneider, phantom limbs and the blind man's cane.
works.method_zh: 借助格式塔心理学与临床案例（如 Schneider 病例、幻肢、盲人的手杖）进行现象学分析。

paper.title: Phenomenology of Perception

works.title: Aikido
works.description: Partners practise throws and pins in which the defender blends with the attacker's movement, leads it in circles and redirects it, rather than blocking force with force; Ueshiba adopted the name aikido in 1942.
works.description_zh: 搭档练习投技与固技：防守者与进攻者的动作融合，把它引入圆周并加以转化，而不是以力抗力；植芝盛平于 1942 年正式采用“合气道”之名。
works.idea_en: Harmony can be trained physically: sensing and joining another's momentum turns conflict into shared movement.
works.idea_zh: 和谐可以在身体上训练：感知并顺应他人的动势，能把冲突转化为共同的运动。
works.method: Paired kata practice (nage and uke) of techniques such as shihōnage and iriminage, with breathing exercises and falls (ukemi).
works.method_zh: 双人形练习（取与受），技法如四方投、入身投，配合呼吸法与受身练习。

works.title: Dance/Movement Therapy
works.description: In a Chace circle, a therapist picks up and reflects each participant's movements and rhythms, builds a shared group rhythm and uses it to open expression and contact among people who may not speak.
works.description_zh: 在蔡斯式的圆圈中，治疗者捕捉并回映每位参与者的动作与节奏，建立共同的团体节奏，用它为可能无法言语的人打开表达与连接。
works.idea_en: Chace showed that mirroring another's movement is a form of empathy that can reach where words cannot; designers of synchrony and shared biosignals are working in the same territory.
works.idea_zh: 蔡斯表明，镜像他人的动作是一种能抵达语言无法抵达之处的同理；做同步与共享生物信号的设计者正身处同一领域。
works.method: Group circles with mirroring, rhythmic group action, symbolism and verbal reflection; begun by Chace with psychiatric patients at St. Elizabeths Hospital in 1942.
works.method_zh: 以镜像、团体节奏动作、象征与口头回应组成的团体圆圈；1942 年蔡斯在圣伊丽莎白医院与精神科病人一起开始。

works.title: Eutony
works.description: People lie, sit or move while sensing skin, bones and the space inside the body, often with bamboo sticks or balls under them, to find a flexible, well-adapted tone rather than simply relaxing.
works.description_zh: 人们躺、坐或移动，同时感受皮肤、骨骼与身体内部的空间，常在身下放竹棍或小球，以找到一种灵活、适应情境的张力，而不是单纯放松。
works.idea_en: Eutony treats tone as a relation between person and situation: good tension is the one that fits the moment, so a design can aim to tune tension rather than to relax the user.
works.idea_zh: 优张力法把张力看作人与情境之间的关系：好的张力是与当下相称的张力，因此设计可以去“调谐”张力，而不只是让使用者放松。
works.method: Contact with the floor and small objects, attention to skin and bone, and 'transport' of pressure through the skeleton; Alexander founded her Copenhagen school in 1940 and named the method in 1956.
works.method_zh: 借助与地面和小物件的接触，注意皮肤与骨骼，并让压力经由骨架“传导”；亚历山大 1940 年创办哥本哈根学校，1956 年为方法命名。

works.title: Sensory Awareness
works.description: In a class, people simply sit, stand, lie, walk, lift a stone or touch a partner's head, and are asked open questions about what they sense, with no correct form to reach.
works.description_zh: 课上，人们只是坐、站、躺、走、拿起一块石头或触碰同伴的头，并被问到开放的问题：你感觉到了什么？没有需要达到的正确形式。
works.idea_en: Gindler and Selver held that everyday acts, done attentively, are enough: noticing how you sit is already practice, which licenses designers to work with ordinary acts rather than special exercises.
works.idea_zh: 金德勒与塞尔弗认为，专注地去做日常动作就已足够：觉察自己怎么坐本身就是修习；这允许设计者从日常动作而非特殊练习出发。
works.method: Experiential 'experiments' in everyday activities guided by questions rather than instructions, from Gindler's Berlin work; Selver taught it in the US from 1938 and at Esalen from 1963.
works.method_zh: 以提问而非指令引导的日常活动“实验”，源自金德勒在柏林的工作；塞尔弗 1938 年起在美国教授，1963 年起在伊莎兰学院任教。

works.title: Action-Intuition (Kōiteki chokkan)
works.description: In essays of the late 1930s Nishida describes 'action-intuition': we see things by acting on them and are formed by what we make, so knowing and bodily making are one movement.
works.description_zh: 西田几多郎在 1930 年代后期的论文中提出“行为的直观”：我们通过作用于事物而看见事物，也被自己所制作的东西所塑造，认识与身体的制作是同一个运动。
works.idea_en: Perception is not a mind looking at the world but a body shaping and being shaped by it; designers know materials by working them.
works.idea_zh: 知觉不是心灵在看世界，而是身体在塑造世界、也被世界塑造；设计者通过加工材料来认识材料。
works.method: Philosophical essays (1937 onward) developing the logic of basho, historical bodies and poiesis.
works.method_zh: 哲学论文（1937 年起），发展场所逻辑、历史的身体与制作（poiesis）的思想。

paper.title: Nishida Kitarō

works.title: Ideokinesis
works.description: Lying still in 'constructive rest', a person imagines movements along the skeleton, for example the spine lengthening down or the thigh bones sinking, without doing them, and the body's alignment changes in response.
works.description_zh: 在“建设性休息”姿势中静躺，想象沿骨骼发生的动作，例如脊柱向下延长、股骨下沉，但并不真的去做，身体的排列会随之改变。
works.idea_en: Ideokinesis shows that an image is already a motor act: thinking a movement reorganises posture, so imagery is a design material for the body.
works.idea_zh: 意念动觉法表明，意象本身就是一种运动行为：想着一个动作就会重组姿态，因此意象是作用于身体的设计材料。
works.method: Guided imagery of 'lines of movement' in a supine rest position, from Mabel Todd's The Thinking Body (1937) and Lulu Sweigard's research on imagery and alignment.
works.method_zh: 在仰卧休息姿势中引导想象“动作线”，源自托德的《思考的身体》（1937）与斯威加德关于意象与排列的研究。

paper.title: The Thinking Body

works.title: Art as Experience
works.description: Dewey's lectures on aesthetics describe 'an experience' as a felt, rhythmic whole that arises when a live creature engages its environment, and root art in everyday bodily life.
works.description_zh: Dewey 的美学讲座把“一个经验”描述为有生命的机体与环境相互作用时产生的、被感受的、有节律的整体，并把艺术扎根于日常身体生活。
works.idea_en: Experience is neither mind nor body alone but the undergoing and doing of a whole organism; aesthetic quality is that experience made full.
works.idea_zh: 经验既不单属于心也不单属于身，而是整个机体的“承受”与“作为”；审美品质就是这一经验的充盈。
works.method: Philosophical lectures (William James Lectures, Harvard, 1931) developing a pragmatist theory of experience, art and perception.
works.method_zh: 哈佛 William James 讲座（1931）的哲学讲稿，发展了关于经验、艺术与知觉的实用主义理论。

paper.title: Art as Experience

works.title: Contrology (Pilates)
works.description: A sequence of precise floor exercises and exercises on spring-loaded apparatus such as the Reformer, done with coordinated breathing and attention to the body's centre.
works.description_zh: 一组在地面及弹簧器械（如 Reformer 核心床）上进行的精确练习，配合协调的呼吸与对身体中心的注意。
works.idea_en: Pilates wrote that Contrology 'begins with mind control over muscles', a mind-over-body model of movement education; comparing it with Feldenkrais or Gindler shows what shifts when control gives way to sensing.
works.idea_zh: 普拉提写道，控制术“始于心对肌肉的控制”，这是一种“心驾驭身”的二元论动作教育模式；把它与费登奎斯或金德勒对照，可以看到从“控制”转向“感知”时发生了什么变化。
works.method: Mat and apparatus exercises with breath and core engagement, taught in Pilates's New York studio and set out in Your Health (1934) and Return to Life Through Contrology (1945).
works.method_zh: 配合呼吸与核心参与的垫上及器械练习，在普拉提纽约工作室教授，阐述于《你的健康》（1934）与《通过控制术回归生活》（1945）。

works.title: Yang-Style Tai Chi Chuan
works.description: A slow, continuous solo form of about 85–108 movements, practised with a relaxed, rooted stance and paired with push hands (tuishou), in which two partners keep contact and learn to feel and yield to each other's force.
works.description_zh: 一套约 85 至 108 式、缓慢连贯的单人拳架，要求松沉扎根，并配合推手：两人保持接触，学习感知并化解对方的力。
works.idea_en: Softness is a form of sensing: by moving slowly and staying relaxed, practitioners learn to feel weight, breath and another person's intention through the body.
works.idea_zh: 柔是一种感知方式：通过缓慢与放松，习练者学会用身体感受重量、呼吸以及他人的意图。
works.method: Form practice of weight shifts and spiralling movement from the dantian, standardised by Yang Chengfu and set down in his 1934 manual Taijiquan Tiyong Quanshu.
works.method_zh: 以丹田带动重心转换与螺旋运动的拳架练习，由杨澄甫定型，并记录于 1934 年出版的《太极拳体用全书》。

works.title: Laban Movement Analysis
works.description: A language for observing and doing movement in four categories, Body, Effort, Shape and Space; movers explore Effort qualities such as light or strong, sudden or sustained, direct or indirect, bound or free, and feel how each changes intention and mood.
works.description_zh: 一套观察和执行动作的语言，分为身体、力效、形状、空间四个范畴；练习者探索轻或强、突然或持续、直接或间接、束缚或自由等力效质感，感受每一种如何改变意图与情绪。
works.idea_en: Laban treated effort as the inner attitude of the mover made visible, so movement quality is felt meaning; Schiphorst and Fdili Alaoui (a Certified Movement Analyst) use LMA to design and model how movement feels.
works.idea_zh: 拉班把“力效”看作动者内在态度的外显，因此动作质感就是被感受到的意义；Schiphorst 与认证动作分析师 Fdili Alaoui 用 LMA 来设计并建模“动作的感觉”。
works.method: Observation, notation (Kinetography Laban, 1928) and embodied exploration of Effort, Shape and Space, extended by Lisa Ullmann, Irmgard Bartenieff and Warren Lamb; taught by certification programs such as LIMS.
works.method_zh: 观察、记谱（拉班舞谱，1928）以及对力效、形状、空间的亲身探索，由丽莎·乌尔曼、巴特尼夫与沃伦·兰姆拓展；通过 LIMS 等认证课程教授。

works.title: Zhan Zhuang (Standing Like a Post)
works.description: The practitioner stands still for many minutes, knees soft and arms held as if embracing a tree, attending to breath, tension and the subtle sensations of the standing body; Wang Xiangzhai made it the core training of Yiquan from the late 1920s.
works.description_zh: 习练者长时间静立，膝微屈，双臂如抱树，觉察呼吸、紧张与站立身体的细微感受；王芗斋自 1920 年代后期起把站桩作为意拳的核心训练。
works.idea_en: Stillness is a rich movement practice: standing reveals tensions, shifts and inner motion that busy movement hides.
works.idea_zh: 静止也是丰富的运动修习：站立会显现出那些被忙碌动作掩盖的紧张、偏移与内在运动。
works.method: Held postures (the 'hunyuan' or tree-hugging stance and others) practised with relaxed breathing and imagery, gradually lengthened from minutes to an hour.
works.method_zh: 保持姿势（浑元桩、抱树桩等），配合放松的呼吸与意念，时间从几分钟逐渐延长到一小时。

works.title: Alexander Technique
works.description: In lessons, a teacher's light hands and verbal 'directions' help a person pause before an everyday act such as sitting, standing or speaking, and let the head-neck-back relation free up. The person discovers that what feels 'right' is often just habitual.
works.description_zh: 课上，教师以轻柔的双手和口头“指引”帮助学习者在坐下、站起或说话等日常动作前先停一下，让头、颈、背之间的关系放松。人会发现，“感觉正确”的往往只是习惯。
works.idea_en: Alexander called the self a 'psycho-physical' unity and showed that sensory appreciation can be unreliable; noticing and inhibiting a habit is itself an estrangement method, and Shusterman's somaesthetics discusses it at length.
works.idea_zh: 亚历山大称自我为“心理—生理”统一体，并表明身体感觉的判断并不可靠；觉察并抑制习惯本身就是一种陌生化方法，舒斯特曼的身体美学对此有长篇讨论。
works.method: One-to-one lessons with light touch, practising 'inhibition' (pausing the habitual response) and 'direction' in daily activities; first set out in Man's Supreme Inheritance (1910).
works.method_zh: 一对一课程，配合轻触，在日常活动中练习“抑制”（暂停习惯反应）与“指引”；最早阐述于《人的最高遗产》（1910）。

works.title: Dongui Suse Bowon: Sasang Constitutional Medicine
works.description: Yi Je-ma's treatise divides people into four constitutions (Taeyang, Soyang, Taeeum, Soeum), each with its own organ strengths, emotional tendencies and suitable foods and treatments.
works.description_zh: 李济马的《东医寿世保元》把人分为太阳、少阳、太阴、少阴四种体质，每种体质各有其脏腑强弱、情志倾向与相宜的饮食和治疗。
works.idea_en: Temperament and organ are one system: excess sorrow, anger, joy or pleasure shapes the body, so healing starts from knowing one's emotional constitution.
works.idea_zh: 性情与脏腑是同一个系统：过度的哀、怒、喜、乐会塑造身体，因此治疗要从了解自己的情志体质开始。
works.method: Medical treatise written in classical Chinese by a Joseon physician, grounding Korean medicine in Confucian self-cultivation.
works.method_zh: 朝鲜王朝医学家以汉文写成的医学著作，把韩医学建立在儒家修身思想之上。

paper.title: 東醫壽世保元 (Dongui Suse Bowon)

works.title_zh: 东医寿世保元：四象医学

works.title: Riken no ken: The Seeing of Detached Seeing (Kakyō)
works.description: In Kakyō (A Mirror Held to the Flower, 1424) Zeami tells the Noh actor to dance with 'eyes in front, mind behind' and to see himself as the audience sees him, uniting inner feeling and outer form.
works.description_zh: 世阿弥在《花镜》（1424）中要求能乐演员“目前心后”，像观众看自己那样看见自己，把内在感受与外在形体统一起来。
works.idea_en: A trained performer feels movement from inside and sees it from outside at the same time; this double awareness is the core skill of first-person design.
works.idea_zh: 受过训练的表演者能同时从内部感受动作、从外部看见动作；这种双重觉知正是第一人称设计的核心能力。
works.method: Secret treatise passed down within Zeami's lineage, alongside the Fūshikaden (c. 1400–1418), setting out training of body, voice and mind across an actor's life.
works.method_zh: 在世阿弥一门中秘传的论著，与《风姿花传》（约 1400–1418）并列，论述演员一生中身体、声音与心的修炼。

paper.venue: Zeami: Performance Notes, trans. Tom Hare, Columbia University Press, 2008
paper.title: Kakyō (A Mirror Held to the Flower)

works.title: Shinjin ichinyo: Body and Mind as One (Bendōwa, Shōbōgenzō)
works.description: In Bendōwa (1231), later placed at the head of the Shōbōgenzō, Dōgen rejects the idea of a mind that survives apart from the body and teaches that 'body and mind are one' (shinjin ichinyo), realised in seated practice.
works.description_zh: 道元在《办道话》（1231，后列于《正法眼藏》卷首）中驳斥心可以脱离身体而长存的观点，主张“身心一如”，并在坐禅中实现。
works.idea_en: Practice and realisation are not two: the posture itself is the awakening, so attending to how you sit is already the work.
works.idea_zh: 修证一如：姿势本身就是觉悟，因此留意自己如何坐，本身就是修行。
works.method: Classical Zen text written in Japanese vernacular as questions and answers, grounding its claims in the practice of zazen.
works.method_zh: 以日文问答体写成的禅宗经典，其论点以坐禅实践为根据。

paper.venue: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (Japanese Zen Buddhist Philosophy)
paper.title: Bendōwa (Shōbōgenzō)

works.title_zh: 身心一如：《办道话》与《正法眼藏》

works.title: Zazen (Seated Zen Meditation, Fukanzazengi)
works.description: Sitting upright on a cushion in full or half lotus, hands in the cosmic mudra, eyes half open and breath left natural, just sitting (shikantaza) without chasing thoughts; Dōgen's Fukanzazengi (1227) gives the instructions.
works.description_zh: 在蒲团上以全跏或半跏端坐，手结法界定印，眼半开，呼吸自然，不追逐念头，只管打坐；道元的《普劝坐禅仪》（1227）记载了这些要领。
works.idea_en: Posture is practice: aligning spine, breath and attention is already the realisation, not a means to some later insight.
works.idea_zh: 姿势即修行：调整脊柱、呼吸与注意力本身就是证悟，而不是通往日后某种领悟的手段。
works.method: Daily sitting periods in a zendō, alternating with walking meditation (kinhin), guided by Dōgen's instructions on posture, breath and non-thinking.
works.method_zh: 在禅堂中每日定时坐禅，与经行交替进行，依照道元关于姿势、呼吸与“非思量”的指导。

works.title: Huangdi Neijing (Inner Classic of the Yellow Emperor)
works.description: The founding classic of Chinese medicine, in two parts (Suwen and Lingshu), describes the body as flows of qi through meridians and organs that correspond to seasons, emotions and the cosmos.
works.description_zh: 中医的奠基经典，分为《素问》与《灵枢》两部分，把身体描述为气在经络与脏腑中的流动，并与四时、情志和天地相应。
works.idea_en: Emotions are organ events and organs are emotional: anger, joy, worry and fear move qi, so caring for feeling and caring for the body are the same practice.
works.idea_zh: 情志即脏腑之事，脏腑亦有情志：怒、喜、思、悲、恐都会使气发生变化，因此调养情绪与调养身体是同一种实践。
works.method: Dialogues compiled between roughly the 3rd and 1st centuries BCE, organised around yin-yang, the five phases, meridians and pulse diagnosis.
works.method_zh: 约公元前 3 至前 1 世纪间编成的问答体文本，围绕阴阳、五行、经络与脉诊组织。

paper.title: 黃帝內經 (Huangdi Neijing)

works.title: Cook Ding Carves the Ox (Zhuangzi, 'Nourishing the Lord of Life')
works.description: Cook Ding has used the same knife for nineteen years because he no longer looks at the ox with his eyes but meets it with his spirit, letting the blade follow the natural gaps; Lord Wenhui learns from him how to nourish life.
works.description_zh: 庖丁用同一把刀解牛十九年而刀刃如新，因为他“以神遇而不以目视”，依乎天理，批大郤、导大窾；文惠君由此领悟养生之道。
works.idea_en: Mastery is felt attunement to the grain of things: skill that has passed from deliberate control into the body moves with ease and without wear.
works.idea_zh: 技艺的最高境界是对事物纹理的感受与顺应：当技能从刻意控制沉入身体，动作便轻松而不损耗。
works.method: Parable in the third chapter (Yangshengzhu) of the Zhuangzi, one of many skill stories alongside the wheelwright, the swimmer and the cicada catcher.
works.method_zh: 《庄子·养生主》中的寓言，与轮扁、吕梁丈夫、痀偻承蜩等技艺故事同属一类。

paper.title: 養生主 (Nourishing the Lord of Life)

works.title: Fasting of the Heart-Mind and Sitting in Forgetfulness (Zhuangzi)
works.description: Confucius teaches Yan Hui to 'listen not with the ears but with the heart-mind, not with the heart-mind but with qi' (xinzhai), and Yan Hui later reports 'sitting in forgetfulness' (zuowang), letting go of limbs, senses and knowledge.
works.description_zh: 孔子教颜回“无听之以耳而听之以心，无听之以心而听之以气”（心斋）；颜回后来说自己“堕肢体，黜聪明，离形去知”，是谓“坐忘”。
works.idea_en: Listening with qi means attending with the whole body before concepts arrive; emptying habitual perception makes room to feel anew.
works.idea_zh: “听之以气”意味着在概念到来之前用整个身体去倾听；清空习惯性的知觉，才能重新感受。
works.method: Dialogues in the Renjianshi and Dazongshi chapters of the Zhuangzi that later shaped Daoist meditation and neidan practice.
works.method_zh: 出自《庄子·人间世》与《大宗师》的对话，后来深刻影响了道教的静坐与内丹修炼。

paper.title: 人間世 / 大宗師

works.title: Nourishing the Flood-Like Qi (Mencius 2A2)
works.description: Asked about an unmoved heart, Mencius says he is good at nourishing his 'flood-like qi' (haoran zhi qi), which fills the body and grows from righteous action, and warns against the farmer who pulls his sprouts to help them grow.
works.description_zh: 当被问及“不动心”时，孟子说自己“善养吾浩然之气”：此气充塞于身体，由集义所生；并以“揠苗助长”告诫不可强求。
works.idea_en: Moral strength is bodily and cultivated slowly: will leads qi, qi fills the body, and forcing growth harms it.
works.idea_zh: 道德的力量是身体性的，需要慢慢养成：志帅气，气充体，强求则伤之。
works.method: Dialogue in the Gongsun Chou chapter of the Mencius, a founding text for Confucian theories of qi and self-cultivation (xiushen).
works.method_zh: 出自《孟子·公孙丑上》的对话，是儒家气论与修身论的奠基文本。

paper.title: 公孫丑上 (Gong Sun Chou I)

works.title_zh: 养浩然之气（《孟子·公孙丑上》）

orgs.name: ACCAD (Ohio State University)
orgs.description: The Advanced Computing Center for the Arts and Design at Ohio State, a hub for motion capture, dance and technology, where Synchronous Objects with William Forsythe and later dance-tech work were produced.
orgs.description_zh: 俄亥俄州立大学的艺术与设计先进计算中心，是动作捕捉、舞蹈与技术的重要基地，与 William Forsythe 合作的 Synchronous Objects 等舞蹈科技项目出自这里。

orgs.name: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
orgs.description: The largest HCI conference, where most soma design papers, workshops and first-person research have appeared (e.g. Somaesthetic Appreciation Design, 2016; the soma-based design theory workshop, 2017).
orgs.description_zh: 规模最大的人机交互会议，大部分身体设计论文、工作坊和第一人称研究都发表于此（如 2016 年的 Somaesthetic Appreciation Design、2017 年的身体设计理论工作坊）。

orgs.name: ACM CHI PLAY
orgs.description: The ACM conference on play and games research, where exertion games, bodily play and somatic play design are presented.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 关于游戏与玩耍研究的会议，运动型游戏、身体游戏与身体玩耍设计在此发表。

orgs.name: ACM Designing Interactive Systems (DIS)
orgs.description: The ACM conference on design practice and research in interaction, a frequent venue for soma design methods such as Teaching Soma Design (2019) and Sketching Soma Bits (2022).
orgs.description_zh: ACM 关于交互设计实践与研究的会议，常发表身体设计方法论文，如《Teaching Soma Design》（2019）和《Sketching Soma Bits》（2022）。

orgs.name: ACM Interactions
orgs.description: The ACM's magazine for the HCI community, where accessible pieces on soma design and body-centric computing have appeared (e.g. the Dagstuhl 'Body-centric computing' report, 2018).
orgs.description_zh: ACM 面向人机交互社群的杂志，刊载过通俗易读的身体设计与身体中心计算文章（如 2018 年 Dagstuhl“身体中心计算”报告）。

orgs.name: ACM SIGCHI
orgs.description: The ACM Special Interest Group on Computer-Human Interaction, which sponsors CHI, DIS, TEI, CHI PLAY and other venues where soma design is published.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 人机交互特别兴趣小组，主办 CHI、DIS、TEI、CHI PLAY 等发表身体设计研究的会议。

orgs.name: ACM Tangible, Embedded and Embodied Interaction (TEI)
orgs.description: The ACM conference on tangible, embedded and embodied interaction, with studios and an arts track where soma designers demonstrate and share material and bodily explorations.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 关于可触、嵌入式与具身交互的会议，设有工作室（studios）和艺术单元，身体设计者在这里展示与分享材料和身体的探索。

orgs.name: ACM Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction (TOCHI)
orgs.description: The ACM's flagship HCI journal, which published key soma design papers such as 'Moving and Making Strange' (2013), 'Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case' (2021).
orgs.description_zh: ACM 的旗舰人机交互期刊，发表过《Moving and Making Strange》（2013）、《Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case》（2021）等身体设计关键论文。

orgs.name: Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII)
orgs.description: The main international conference of the affective computing community (AAAC), covering emotion sensing, physiological signals and affective interaction, the field that Höök's 'affective loops' responded to.
orgs.description_zh: 情感计算学会（AAAC）的主要国际会议，涵盖情绪感测、生理信号与情感交互。Höök 的“情感回路”正是对这一领域的回应。

orgs.name: Aikikai Foundation
orgs.description: The Tokyo headquarters (Hombu Dōjō) of aikido founded by Morihei Ueshiba, whose practice of blending with a partner's movement is used in somatic education and embodied design.
orgs.description_zh: 植芝盛平创立的合气道总部（东京本部道场）。合气道练习与对方动作相融，被身体教育与具身设计借用。

orgs.name: Alva Noë
orgs.description: Berkeley philosopher who argues that perception is something we do with our moving bodies (the enactive, sensorimotor view) and that art and dance are 'strange tools' that reorganise our embodied habits.
orgs.description_zh: 伯克利哲学家，主张知觉是我们用运动的身体“做”出来的（生成的、感觉运动的观点），并认为艺术与舞蹈是重组我们身体习惯的“奇异工具”。
known_for: Strange Tools: Art and Human Nature (2015)

orgs.name: American Society for the Alexander Technique (AmSAT)
orgs.name_zh: 美国亚历山大技巧协会
orgs.description: The largest US association of certified Alexander Technique teachers, setting teacher-training standards for the practice of noticing and inhibiting habitual patterns of use, which soma designers cite as a model of estrangement and re-education.
orgs.description_zh: 美国最大的亚历山大技巧认证教师协会，为教师培训设定标准。亚历山大技巧练习觉察并抑制惯常的身体使用方式，身体设计者把它当作陌生化与再教育的范例。

orgs.name: Ana Tajadura-Jiménez
orgs.description: Head of the i_mBODY Lab at UC3M who uses sound and multisensory feedback to change how people feel their own body, as in 'As Light as your Footsteps', where altered walking sounds change perceived body weight.
orgs.description_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学 i_mBODY 实验室负责人，用声音与多感官反馈改变人对自身身体的感受，例如《As Light as your Footsteps》：改变脚步声，使人觉得身体变轻或变重。
known_for: Embodied auditory perception: the emotional impact of approaching and receding sound sources (Emotion, 2010)
Action sounds recalibrate perceived tactile distance (2012)
As Light as your Footsteps: altering walking sounds to change perceived body weight (CHI 2015)
BODYinTRANSIT project on multisensory body transformation

orgs.name: Anders Lundström
orgs.description: Umeå University associate professor and Höök's PhD student (KTH 2016) on energy-sensitive interaction, now on human-powered interaction; co-author of Metaphone and co-supervisor of Windlin's Soma Bits PhD.
orgs.description_zh: 于默奥大学副教授，Höök 的博士生（KTH 2016），研究对能量敏感的交互，现研究人力驱动的交互；Metaphone 作者之一，也是 Windlin 的 Soma Bits 博士研究的合作导师。

orgs.name: Anna Halprin
orgs.description: Dancer who pioneered postmodern and community dance on her outdoor deck, using dance for healing and collective ritual (Planetary Dance); a reference for participatory, somatic movement.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者，在自家户外舞台开创后现代与社区舞蹈，以舞蹈疗愈并创造集体仪式（Planetary Dance）；是参与式、身体性动作的参照。

orgs.name: Anna Ståhl
orgs.description: Interaction designer at RISE and Höök's longest-standing collaborator, from the affective interaction of eMoto and Affective Diary to somaesthetic appreciation design, the Soma Mat and Breathing Light. Her PhD (KTH 2014) framed design for interactional empowerment.
orgs.description_zh: RISE 瑞典研究院的交互设计师，Höök 合作最久的伙伴：从 eMoto、Affective Diary 的情感交互，到身体美学鉴赏设计、Soma Mat 与 Breathing Light。她在 KTH 的博士论文（2014）提出“交互赋权”的设计。
known_for: The Soma Mat and Breathing Light (CHI EA 2016)

orgs.name: Antonio Damasio
orgs.description: Neuroscientist at USC whose somatic marker hypothesis argues that feelings rooted in body states guide reason, challenging Cartesian mind-body dualism; a key source for designing with emotion as a bodily process.
orgs.description_zh: 南加州大学神经科学家，他的“躯体标记假说”认为源于身体状态的感受引导理性，挑战笛卡尔式身心二元论；这是把情绪当作身体过程来设计的重要来源。

orgs.name: Ars Electronica
orgs.description: The festival, centre and Prix for art, technology and society in Linz, where many body-based works, from Stelarc's performances to JIZAI ARMS, have been shown.
orgs.description_zh: 林茨的艺术、技术与社会节、中心与大奖，许多身体相关作品在此展出，从 Stelarc 的表演到 JIZAI ARMS。

orgs.name: Association for Hanna Somatic Education
orgs.description: The association of practitioners of Thomas Hanna's Hanna Somatic Education, the method of the thinker who coined 'soma' as the body experienced from within and founded the Novato Institute and Somatics magazine-journal.
orgs.description_zh: Hanna 身心教育（Hanna Somatic Education）从业者的协会。Thomas Hanna 提出“soma”一词，指从内部体验的身体，并创办了 Novato 研究所和《Somatics》杂志。

orgs.name: Atau Tanaka
orgs.description: Goldsmiths professor and performer who plays the body as an instrument through muscle-tension (EMG) sensing and machine learning, from Sensorband to Myogram.
orgs.description_zh: 金史密斯学院教授与表演者，借肌电（EMG）传感与机器学习把身体当作乐器演奏，从 Sensorband 到 Myogram。
known_for: Sensorband (with Zbigniew Karkowski and Edwin van der Heide)
Gestural Musical Performance with Physiological Sensors, Focusing on the Electromyogram (Routledge Companion to Embodied Music Interaction, 2017)

orgs.name: Augmented Humans Conference
orgs.description: An international conference on technologies that extend human perception, action and body, from supernumerary limbs to sensory substitution; useful for seeing where augmentation meets felt embodiment.
orgs.description_zh: 关于扩展人类感知、行动与身体的技术的国际会议，从额外肢体到感官替代。可以从中看到身体增强与切身感受的交汇。

orgs.name: B. K. S. Iyengar
orgs.description: Indian yoga teacher whose precise, prop-supported Iyengar Yoga and 'Light on Yoga' made asana and pranayama widely teachable as practices of alignment and breath awareness.
orgs.description_zh: 印度瑜伽导师，以精确、借助辅具的艾扬格瑜伽与《瑜伽之光》，让体式与调息作为对位与呼吸觉察的修习得以广泛传授。

orgs.name: Baptiste Caramiaux
orgs.description: CNRS researcher at ISIR, Sorbonne, who works on machine learning for expressive gesture and muscle sensing in musical interaction, and on human-centred AI in the arts; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 索邦大学 ISIR 的法国国家科学研究中心研究员，研究面向表现性手势与肌肉传感的机器学习、音乐交互，以及艺术中的以人为本 AI；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Adaptive Gesture Recognition with Variation Estimation for Interactive Systems (ACM TiiS, 2014)
Understanding Gesture Expressivity through Muscle Sensing (TOCHI 2015)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: BeAnotherLab
orgs.description: An interdisciplinary collective based in Barcelona that created The Machine to Be Another, an embodiment system in which two people swap first-person perspectives and move in synchrony to 'be in another's body', used in art, research and dialogue work.
orgs.description_zh: 总部在巴塞罗那的跨学科团体，创作了 The Machine to Be Another：两人交换第一人称视角、同步动作，体验“在另一个人的身体里”，被用于艺术、研究与对话实践。

orgs.name: Bin Zhu
orgs.description: KTH PhD (2021, 'Designing for Mindfulness', co-supervised by Höök) on how digital technology can support mindfulness, distinguishing presence-in, presence-with and presence-through; now at Hangzhou City University.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 博士（2021，《Designing for Mindfulness》，Höök 为合作导师），研究数字技术如何支持正念，区分“在其中”“与之同在”“透过它”三种临在；现任职于杭州城市学院。
known_for: Designing Digital Mindfulness: Presence-In and Presence-With versus Presence-Through (CHI 2017)

orgs.name: Body & Society
orgs.description: A SAGE journal of the social and cultural analysis of the body, spanning phenomenology, feminist theory, affect and technology.
orgs.description_zh: SAGE 出版的身体社会与文化分析期刊，内容横跨现象学、女性主义理论、情动与技术。

orgs.name: Body, Space & Technology
orgs.description: An open-access journal on performance, the body and digital technology, publishing research on dance-tech, telematic performance and embodied media.
orgs.description_zh: 关于表演、身体与数字技术的开放获取期刊，发表舞蹈科技、远程表演与具身媒体研究。

orgs.name: Body-Mind Centering Association (BMCA)
orgs.description: The international membership association of Body-Mind Centering practitioners and teachers, with a professional locator, conferences and recordings.
orgs.description_zh: 身心平衡技法（BMC）从业者与教师的国际会员协会，提供从业者查询、年会和录音资源。

orgs.name: Bonnie Bainbridge Cohen
orgs.description: Movement artist and therapist who founded Body-Mind Centering, an embodied study of the body's systems, from organs and fluids to developmental movement patterns, experienced from the inside.
orgs.description_zh: 动作艺术家与治疗师，创立身心平衡技法（BMC）：从内部体验身体各系统，从器官、体液到发展性动作模式的具身研究。

orgs.name: Carl Unander-Scharin
orgs.description: Opera tenor and composer whose KTH PhD with Höök ('Extending Opera', 2015) built interactive instruments such as the Vocal Chorder and led to the drone opera experiments with her group.
orgs.description_zh: 歌剧男高音与作曲家，在 KTH 随 Höök 完成博士（《Extending Opera》，2015），打造了 Vocal Chorder 等互动乐器，并与她的团队开展无人机歌剧实验。
known_for: Extending Opera – Artist-led Explorations in Operatic Practice through Interactivity and Electronics (PhD thesis, KTH, 2015)

orgs.name: Caroline Hummels
orgs.description: TU Eindhoven professor whose 'Move to get moved' and seven principles for embodied sensemaking (with Jelle van Dijk) shaped the Dutch school of movement-based, embodied interaction design; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学教授，她的“Move to get moved”以及与 Jelle van Dijk 提出的具身意义建构七原则，塑造了荷兰以动作为基础的具身交互设计学派；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Move to get moved: methods, tools and knowledge to design for expressive and rich movement-based interaction (PUC, 2006)
Seven Principles to Design for Embodied Sensemaking (TEI 2015, with Jelle van Dijk)

orgs.name: Center for Body, Mind, and Culture (Florida Atlantic University)
orgs.description: Richard Shusterman's centre at Florida Atlantic University, the international hub of somaesthetics: it co-publishes the Journal of Somaesthetics, runs conferences such as 'Bodies of Culture: Somaesthetic Explorations' (2026) and hosts visiting scholars.
orgs.description_zh: Richard Shusterman 在佛罗里达大西洋大学主持的中心，是身体美学的国际枢纽：合办《身体美学期刊》，举办“文化之身：身体美学探索”（2026）等会议，并接待访问学者。

orgs.name: Centre for Dance Research (C-DaRE), Coventry University
orgs.description: Coventry University's dance research centre, directed by Sarah Whatley, working on somatic practices, dance documentation, digital performance and disability; it hosts the Journal of Dance & Somatic Practices and the International Dance and Somatic Practices Conference.
orgs.description_zh: 考文垂大学的舞蹈研究中心，由 Sarah Whatley 主持，研究身体修习、舞蹈记录、数字表演与残障议题；《Journal of Dance & Somatic Practices》和国际舞蹈与身体修习会议都由它主办。

orgs.name: Char Davies
orgs.description: Canadian artist whose VR works Osmose and Ephémère are navigated by breath and balance, letting the 'immersant' float through translucent landscapes; a founding example of breath-based, embodied VR.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家，其 VR 作品《Osmose》《Ephémère》以呼吸与平衡导航，让“沉浸者”漂浮在半透明的景观中；是以呼吸为基础的具身 VR 的开创性范例。

orgs.name: Charles Windlin
orgs.description: Höök's PhD student (KTH 2023) who built the Soma Bits, a kit of shapes with heat, vibration and shape-change actuators placed on the body so designers can sketch soma experiences hands-on.
orgs.description_zh: Höök 的博士生（KTH 2023），打造了 Soma Bits：一套可放在身体上的形体组件，内置加热、振动与形变执行器，让设计师能亲手为身体体验画“草图”。
known_for: Shape and Being Shaped: Sketching with Haptics in Soma Design (PhD thesis, KTH, 2023)

orgs.name: Charlotte Selver
orgs.description: Gindler's student who brought Sensory Awareness to the United States, teaching at Esalen and with Zen teachers; her simple experiments in noticing sensation are close cousins of soma design's attunement exercises.
orgs.description_zh: 金德勒的学生，把 Sensory Awareness 带到美国，在伊莎兰学院任教并与禅师合作；她那些觉察感觉的简单实验，与身体设计中的调谐练习一脉相承。
known_for: Sensory Awareness (taught in the US from 1938)

orgs.name: Cheng Man-ch'ing
orgs.description: Chinese tai chi master, painter and physician who created the Yang-style short form and brought tai chi to Taiwan and New York, where it spread as a practice of relaxed, rooted body-mind unity.
orgs.description_zh: 中国太极拳家、画家与医师，创编杨式简化三十七式，并把太极拳带到台湾与纽约，作为松沉、身心合一的修习广为流传。
known_for: Cheng Tzu's Thirteen Treatises on T'ai Chi Ch'uan

orgs.name: Chinese Health Qigong Association
orgs.description: China's national body for health qigong, which standardises and teaches forms such as Baduanjin, Wuqinxi, Yijinjing and Liuzijue that regulate body, breath and mind together.
orgs.description_zh: 负责健身气功的全国性社团，推广和规范八段锦、五禽戏、易筋经、六字诀等功法，讲究调身、调息、调心三者合一。

orgs.name: Choreographic Practices
orgs.description: An Intellect journal on choreography as an expanded practice, including choreographic thinking in research, technology and everyday life.
orgs.description_zh: Intellect 出版的期刊，把编舞视为一种扩展的实践，包括研究、技术与日常生活中的编舞思维。

orgs.name: Christine Li
orgs.description: Mixed Reality Lab PhD researcher designing VR for bodily training in performance arts and sport; she co-authored the collision design and 'Tangles' soma trajectories work and the non-dualistic design paper.
orgs.description_zh: 混合现实实验室博士研究者，为表演艺术与运动中的身体训练设计 VR；她参与了碰撞设计、以身体轨迹分析的《Tangles》以及非二元设计论文。
known_for: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)
Tangles: Unpacking Extended Collision Experiences with Soma Trajectories (TOCHI 2025)

orgs.name: Chungliang Al Huang
orgs.description: Chinese-American dancer and tai chi teacher who taught at Esalen with Alan Watts and blended tai chi, dance and calligraphy into a practice of Tao as moving, felt experience.
orgs.description_zh: 华裔美国舞者与太极老师，曾与 Alan Watts 在伊莎兰学院授课，把太极、舞蹈与书法融为一种以流动、可感的身体体会“道”的修习。
known_for: Tao: The Watercourse Way (1975, with Alan Watts)

orgs.name: Claire Petitmengin
orgs.description: French researcher who developed micro-phenomenology from Vermersch's explicitation interview and Varela's neurophenomenology: a guided interview that helps people describe fine-grained lived experience. Soma designers use it to articulate felt experience.
orgs.description_zh: 法国研究者，在 Vermersch 的“引导式访谈”与 Varela 的神经现象学基础上发展出微观现象学：一种帮助人细致描述亲历经验的引导式访谈。身体设计者用它来说出被感受的经验。
known_for: Describing one's subjective experience in the second person (2006)
The Validity of First-Person Descriptions as Authenticity and Coherence (2013)
Discovering the structures of lived experience (2019)

orgs.name: Claudia Daudén Roquet
orgs.description: King's College London researcher on mindfulness and emotion-regulation technologies; co-author of 'HCI and Affective Health' and of the soma design workshop study in 'Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design'.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦国王学院研究者，研究正念与情绪调节技术；《HCI and Affective Health》以及《Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design》中身体设计工作坊研究的作者之一。
known_for: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)
Designing for Emotion Regulation Interventions: An Agenda for HCI Theory and Research (TOCHI 2022)

orgs.name: Claudia Núñez-Pacheco
orgs.description: Malmö University design researcher trained in Focusing and micro-phenomenology who uses body maps and felt-sense articulation as design tools. She co-authored the soma design ethics papers on vulnerability and felt ethics with Höök's group.
orgs.description_zh: 马尔默大学设计研究者，受过 Focusing（体会聚焦）与微观现象学训练，把身体地图与“体会”的言说用作设计工具。她与 Höök 团队合写了关于脆弱性与“被感受的伦理”的身体设计伦理论文。
known_for: Body Maps: A Generative Tool for Soma-based Design (TEI 2022)
Vulnerability as an ethical stance in soma design processes (CHI 2022)
Felt Ethics: Cultivating Ethical Sensibility in Design Practice (CHI 2023)

orgs.name: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre
orgs.description: Taiwan's leading contemporary dance company, founded by Lin Hwai-min, whose dancers train in tai chi daoyin, qigong, martial arts and meditation; works such as Songs of the Wanderers and the Cursive trilogy grow from this body training.
orgs.description_zh: 林怀民创办的台湾当代舞团，舞者修习太极导引、气功、武术与静坐；《流浪者之歌》与《行草》三部曲等作品都来自这种身体训练。

orgs.name: Constructivist Foundations
orgs.description: An open-access journal on constructivist and enactive approaches that publishes micro-phenomenology and second-person methods research, with open peer commentary.
orgs.description_zh: 开放获取期刊，关注建构论与生成论取向，发表微观现象学与第二人称方法研究，并采用公开同行评论形式。

orgs.name: Contact Quarterly
orgs.description: The dance and improvisation journal that began in 1975 as the newsletter of the contact improvisation community, edited for decades by Nancy Stark Smith and Lisa Nelson; also a publisher of books and videos on somatic practice.
orgs.description_zh: 1975 年作为接触即兴社群通讯创刊的舞蹈与即兴期刊，长期由 Nancy Stark Smith 与 Lisa Nelson 编辑，也出版关于身体修习的书籍和影像。

orgs.name: Continuum Movement
orgs.description: The practice founded by Emilie Conrad that uses breath, sound and slow, wave-like movement to explore the body as fluid; teachers continue it through workshops and trainings.
orgs.description_zh: Emilie Conrad 创立的修习，用呼吸、声音和缓慢如波的动作把身体当作流体来探索，如今由教师们通过工作坊和培训延续。

orgs.name: Corina Sas
orgs.description: Lancaster University professor of HCI and digital health who led the AffecTech network on personal technologies for affective health, the setting for 'From Biodata to Somadata' and much of the biodata work with Höök.
orgs.description_zh: 兰卡斯特大学人机交互与数字健康教授，主持面向情感健康的个人技术研究网络 AffecTech；《From Biodata to Somadata》及与 Höök 的许多生物数据研究都出自这一网络。
known_for: HCI and Affective Health: Taking stock of a decade of studies (CHI 2019)
AffecTech: Personal Technologies for Affective Health (Marie Skłodowska-Curie ITN, 2017–2021)

orgs.name: Cumhur Erkut
orgs.description: Aalborg University Copenhagen associate professor in sonic and embodied interaction who teaches somaesthetics-informed embodied interaction courses (with Sofia Dahl); co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 奥尔堡大学哥本哈根校区副教授，研究声音与具身交互，与 Sofia Dahl 开设以身体美学为基础的具身交互课程；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)
Embodied Interaction through Movement in a Course Work (MOCO 2017, with S. Dahl)
Incorporating Virtual Reality in an Embodied Interaction Course (MOCO 2018, with S. Dahl)
Workshop 'Training, Sharing, and Enacting: Somaesthetics of Rhythmic Interaction' (2017, with S. Dahl)

orgs.name: Dag Svanæs
orgs.description: NTNU professor whose writing on kinaesthetic thinking and 'interaction design for and with the lived body' (TOCHI 2013) brought Merleau-Ponty's phenomenology into HCI, a core theoretical source for soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 挪威科技大学教授，他关于“动觉思考”与“为活的身体、与活的身体一起做交互设计”（TOCHI 2013）的论述，把梅洛-庞蒂的现象学带入人机交互，是身体设计的核心理论来源。
known_for: Kinaesthetic thinking: the tacit dimension of interaction design (Computers in Human Behavior, 1997)
Understanding Interactivity: Steps to a Phenomenology of Human-Computer Interaction (PhD, NTNU, 2000)
Interaction design for and with the lived body: some implications of Merleau-Ponty's phenomenology (TOCHI 2013)

orgs.name: Dagstuhl Seminar 17392: Body-Centric Computing
orgs.description: A week-long seminar at Schloss Dagstuhl in September 2017 where 23 researchers mapped the future of body-centric computing; organised by Steve Benford, Kristina Höök, Joe Marshall, Florian Mueller and Dag Svanæs and reported in ACM Interactions (2018).
orgs.description_zh: 2017 年 9 月在德国达格斯图尔城堡举行的一周研讨会，23 位研究者共同描绘身体中心计算的未来；由 Steve Benford、Kristina Höök、Joe Marshall、Florian Mueller 与 Dag Svanæs 组织，成果发表于 ACM Interactions（2018）。

orgs.name: Dan Zahavi
orgs.description: Danish philosopher at the University of Copenhagen who directs the Center for Subjectivity Research and argues for the minimal, embodied self given in first-person experience.
orgs.description_zh: 哥本哈根大学丹麦哲学家，主持主体性研究中心，主张在第一人称经验中被给予的、具身的“最小自我”。

orgs.name: Dance Notation Bureau
orgs.description: The New York organisation holding the world's largest collection of Labanotation dance scores and training notators, a key resource behind Laban-based descriptions of movement in HCI.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约的机构，收藏世界上最多的拉班舞谱，并培训记谱员，是人机交互中以拉班体系描述动作的重要资源。

orgs.name: Dance Umbrella
orgs.description: London's international festival of contemporary dance, presenting dance in theatres and public space each October.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦的国际当代舞蹈节，每年十月在剧场与公共空间呈现舞蹈。

orgs.name: Danielle Lottridge
orgs.description: University of Auckland associate professor and registered dance/movement therapist who works on affective interaction and remote intimacy (Sharing Empty Moments); co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 奥克兰大学副教授、注册舞蹈/动作治疗师，研究情感交互与远程亲密（Sharing Empty Moments）；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Sharing Empty Moments: design for remote couples (CHI 2009)
Affective Interaction: understanding, evaluating, and designing for human emotion (Reviews of Human Factors and Ergonomics, 2011)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: Danielle Wilde
orgs.description: Professor at Umeå Institute of Design and SDU who made performative body devices such as hipDisk and wrote on embodying embodied design research techniques; she now applies embodied research-through-design to food systems.
orgs.description_zh: 于默奥设计学院与南丹麦大学教授，创作了 hipDisk 等表演性身体装置，并论述如何“具身化”具身设计研究方法；现将具身的设计研究用于食物系统。

orgs.name: Deborah Hay
orgs.description: Choreographer whose practice asks performers questions such as 'what if every cell in my body at once has the potential to perceive?', making perception itself the dance.
orgs.description_zh: 编舞家，她的实践向表演者提问，如“如果我身体的每个细胞同时都能感知会怎样？”，让知觉本身成为舞蹈。

orgs.name: Deepika Yadav
orgs.description: Aalto University assistant professor who, as a Digital Futures postdoc in the KTH intimate-health group, studied the mixed feelings of digital contraception and fertility tracking.
orgs.description_zh: 阿尔托大学助理教授，曾在 KTH 亲密健康团队任 Digital Futures 博士后，研究数字避孕与生育追踪中的矛盾感受。
known_for: Ambivalences in Digital Contraception: Designing for Mixed Feelings and Oscillating Relations (DIS 2023)
Relational Aspects of Care in Intimate Digital Health Technologies (Digital Futures postdoc project)

orgs.name: Design Culture & Somaesthetics Conference
orgs.description: A 2019 conference at Moholy-Nagy University of Art and Design in Budapest, organised with the Hungarian Forum of Somaesthetics, with Richard Shusterman as keynote, on how somaesthetics can inform design culture.
orgs.description_zh: 2019 年在布达佩斯莫霍利-纳吉艺术设计大学举行的会议，由该校博士院与匈牙利身体美学论坛共同组织，Richard Shusterman 作主旨演讲，探讨身体美学如何影响设计文化。

orgs.name: Don Hanlon Johnson
orgs.description: Founder of the first graduate programme in somatics, at the California Institute of Integral Studies, whose anthologies documented the pioneers of body-based practice and argued for the body as a source of knowledge.
orgs.description_zh: 加州整合研究学院（CIIS）创办了第一个身心学研究生项目，其编撰的文集记录了身体修习的先驱，主张身体是知识的来源。

orgs.name: Donna Haraway
orgs.description: Feminist scholar of science whose cyborg and situated knowledges unsettle boundaries between human, animal and machine; her work underpins feminist and more-than-human strands of soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 女性主义科学研究学者，她的赛博格与“情境知识”理论动摇了人、动物与机器的边界，是身体设计中女性主义与超越人类脉络的基础。

orgs.name: Dr. Ida Rolf Institute
orgs.description: The school of Rolfing Structural Integration, the manual and movement education method developed by Ida Rolf, one of the founding somatic disciplines taught at Esalen in the 1960s.
orgs.description_zh: 罗尔夫结构整合（Rolfing）的学校。这套由 Ida Rolf 发展的徒手与动作教育方法，是 1960 年代在伊莎兰学院传授的奠基性身体修习之一。

orgs.name: Drew Leder
orgs.description: Philosopher and physician at Loyola University Maryland whose 'The Absent Body' explains why the body recedes from awareness in smooth action and 'dys-appears' in pain or illness, a frame soma design uses to bring the body back into attention.
orgs.description_zh: 洛约拉马里兰大学的哲学家与医生，其《The Absent Body》解释了身体为何在顺畅的行动中从觉察里隐退，又在疼痛或疾病中“异常地显现”；身体设计借此把身体重新带回注意之中。

orgs.name: Dōgen
orgs.description: Japanese Zen master who founded the Sōtō school and taught 'just sitting' (shikantaza) and the dropping off of body and mind (shinjin datsuraku), where practice with the whole body-mind is itself realisation.
orgs.description_zh: 日本禅师，创立曹洞宗，教导“只管打坐”与“身心脱落”：以整个身心修行，修行本身即是证悟。

orgs.name: Edmund Husserl
orgs.description: Founder of phenomenology whose distinction between the body as object (Körper) and as lived, sensing body (Leib) and whose method of describing experience from the first person underlie phenomenology of the body and first-person design research.
orgs.description_zh: 现象学创始人。他对作为物体的身体（Körper）与活的、感受着的身体（Leib）的区分，以及从第一人称描述经验的方法，是身体现象学与第一人称设计研究的根基。

orgs.name: Edward Melcer
orgs.description: Carleton University associate professor who, with Katherine Isbister, developed a design framework for embodied learning games; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 卡尔顿大学副教授，与 Katherine Isbister 共同提出具身学习游戏的设计框架；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Bridging the Physical Learning Divides: A Design Framework for Embodied Learning Games and Simulations (DiGRA 2016, with K. Isbister)
Bots & (Main)Frames: tangible blocks and collaborative play in an educational programming game (CHI 2018, with K. Isbister)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: Eiko Otake
orgs.description: Japanese-born movement artist who, with Koma, made slow, earth-bound dances shaped by butoh study with Ohno and Hijikata; her solo 'A Body in Places' brings the fragile body into sites of disaster and memory.
orgs.description_zh: 日本出生的动作艺术家，曾与 Koma 合作，师承大野一雄、土方巽，创作缓慢、贴近大地的舞蹈；她的独舞《A Body in Places》把脆弱的身体带入灾难与记忆之地。

orgs.name: Ekaterina R. Stepanova
orgs.description: Cognitive scientist and KTH postdoc who uses embodied cognition and somaesthetics to design immersive VR and bio-responsive installations for felt connection, such as JeL, where two people breathe together to grow a virtual ecosystem.
orgs.description_zh: 认知科学家、KTH 博士后，借具身认知与身体美学设计沉浸式 VR 与生物响应装置，追求“被感受到的连接”，如 JeL：两人同步呼吸，使虚拟生态生长。
known_for: JeL: Breathing Together to Connect with Others and Nature (DIS 2020)
Strategies for Fostering a Genuine Feeling of Connection in Technologically Mediated Systems (CHI 2022)

orgs.name: Eleanor Rosch
orgs.description: Berkeley psychologist known for prototype theory of categories and co-author of 'The Embodied Mind', which brought Buddhist mindfulness practice into cognitive science as a disciplined first-person method.
orgs.description_zh: 伯克利心理学家，以范畴的原型理论闻名，《The Embodied Mind》作者之一；该书把佛教正念修习作为严谨的第一人称方法引入认知科学。
known_for: The Embodied Mind (1991, with Varela and Thompson)

orgs.name: Elena Márquez Segura
orgs.description: UC3M researcher (PhD Uppsala 2016, co-supervised by Höök) who created embodied design methods such as embodied sketching and bodystorming for movement-based play; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学研究者（乌普萨拉大学博士 2016，Höök 为合作导师），为以动作为基础的游戏提出了具身草图、身体风暴等具身设计方法；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: The Design Space of Body Games (CHI 2013)
Bodystorming for movement-based interaction design (Human Technology, 2016)
Yamove! (Human Technology, 2016, with Isbister et al.)

orgs.name: Elizabeth Grosz
orgs.description: Australian feminist philosopher whose 'Volatile Bodies' argues for a corporeal feminism that refuses the split between mind and body and between biology and culture.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚女性主义哲学家，其《Volatile Bodies》主张一种“身体的女性主义”，拒绝身与心、生物与文化的二分。
known_for: Volatile Bodies: Toward a Corporeal Feminism (1994)

orgs.name: Elsa Gindler
orgs.description: Berlin teacher whose practice of attentive, experimental sensing of breathing, standing and moving, rather than exercises, seeded Sensory Awareness and influenced many later somatic methods.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的教师，她不是教体操，而是对呼吸、站立与移动进行专注、实验性的感受；这一修习孕育了 Sensory Awareness，影响了众多后来的身心方法。

orgs.name: Elsa Kosmack Vaara
orgs.description: Designer and former musician at RISE whose KTH PhD (2017) explored the aesthetics of felt time, for instance through sourdough baking. She co-authored early somaesthetic and affective-health work with Höök at SICS and Mobile Life.
orgs.description_zh: RISE 设计师、前音乐人，KTH 博士论文（2017）探讨“被感受的时间”的美学，例如借由酸面团烘焙。她在 SICS 与 Mobile Life 期间与 Höök 合写了早期的身体美学与情感健康研究。
known_for: Mirroring bodily experiences over time (CHI EA 2009)
Experiential artifacts as a design method for somaesthetic service development (2011)
Exploring the Aesthetics of Felt Time (PhD thesis, KTH, 2017)

orgs.name: Embodied Media (Keio University KMD)
orgs.name_zh: 庆应义塾大学 Embodied Media 实验室
orgs.description: Kouta Minamizawa's lab at the Keio University Graduate School of Media Design in Yokohama, creating media that record, share and enhance bodily experience, from haptic design and the TECHTILE toolkit to telexistence. It is a centre of Japan's 'haptic design' community.
orgs.description_zh: 南泽孝太（Kouta Minamizawa）在庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（横滨）的实验室，研究记录、分享和增强身体经验的媒体，从触觉设计、TECHTILE 工具包到远程临场（telexistence）。它是日本“触觉设计”社群的中心之一。

orgs.name: Emilie Conrad
orgs.description: Dancer who founded Continuum, a practice of breath, sound and wave-like micro-movement that explores the body as fluid process, informing somatic dance and fluid, undulating forms of interaction.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者，创立 Continuum：以呼吸、声音与波浪般的微动作，把身体作为流动的过程来探索，影响了身体舞蹈与流动、起伏式的交互形态。

orgs.name: Erin Manning
orgs.description: Artist and philosopher at Concordia University who founded the SenseLab and writes on movement, relation and neurodiversity, thinking movement as relational before it is a body's property.
orgs.description_zh: 康考迪亚大学的艺术家与哲学家，创立 SenseLab，书写运动、关系与神经多样性，把运动视为先于个体身体而存在的关系。

orgs.name: Ernesto Neto
orgs.description: Brazilian artist whose soft, spice-scented, walk-in crocheted installations invite visitors to touch, smell and lie down, extending the Neo-Concrete tradition of sensorial participation.
orgs.description_zh: 巴西艺术家，他柔软、散发香料气味、可走入的钩织装置邀请观众触摸、闻嗅与躺下，延续了新具体主义的感官参与传统。

orgs.name: Esalen Institute
orgs.description: The retreat centre at Big Sur, California, where Moshe Feldenkrais, Ida Rolf, Charlotte Selver and others taught in the 1960s–70s; the word and field of 'somatics' grew in its human potential movement milieu.
orgs.description_zh: 位于加州大瑟尔的静修中心，1960–70 年代 Moshe Feldenkrais、Ida Rolf、Charlotte Selver 等人在此授课；“身心学”（somatics）这一领域在其人类潜能运动的氛围中成长。

orgs.name: Eugene Gendlin
orgs.description: Philosopher and psychotherapist who described the 'felt sense', the bodily, not-yet-verbal sense of a situation, and developed Focusing to attend to it. Soma designers and micro-phenomenologists use his felt sense to articulate experience from within.
orgs.description_zh: 哲学家与心理治疗师，提出“体会”（felt sense）：对处境的一种身体性的、尚未成言的感受，并发展出 Focusing（体会聚焦）来关注它。身体设计者与微观现象学研究者借用“体会”从内部说出经验。
known_for: Experiencing and the Creation of Meaning (1962)

orgs.name: Eva Hornecker
orgs.description: Bauhaus-Universität Weimar professor whose frameworks for tangible interaction, physical space and the role of physicality are core references for embodied and whole-body interaction.
orgs.description_zh: 包豪斯魏玛大学教授，她关于实体交互、物理空间与“物质性的角色”的框架，是具身与全身交互的核心参考。
known_for: Getting a Grip on Tangible Interaction: a framework on physical space and social interaction (CHI 2006, with Jacob Buur)
Tangible User Interfaces: Past, Present, and Future Directions (2010, with Orit Shaer)
The Role of Physicality in Tangible and Embodied Interactions (Interactions, 2011)
Human-Computer Interactions in Museums (2019, with Luigina Ciolfi)

orgs.name: Evan Thompson
orgs.description: University of British Columbia philosopher and co-author of 'The Embodied Mind' who develops enactive cognition in dialogue with phenomenology and contemplative traditions, arguing for the deep continuity of life and mind.
orgs.description_zh: 英属哥伦比亚大学哲学家，《The Embodied Mind》作者之一，在与现象学及沉思传统的对话中发展生成认知，论证生命与心智的深层连续性。
known_for: The Embodied Mind (1991, with Varela and Rosch)
Why I Am Not a Buddhist (2020)

orgs.name: ex)situ (LISN, Université Paris-Saclay / Inria)
orgs.description: The Extreme Situated Interaction team at LISN, Université Paris-Saclay and Inria, led by Wendy Mackay; Sarah Fdili Alaoui developed her research on dance, somatics and first-person methods in HCI here.
orgs.description_zh: 巴黎萨克雷大学 LISN 与 Inria 的“极端情境交互”团队，由 Wendy Mackay 领导；Sarah Fdili Alaoui 在这里发展了她关于舞蹈、身体修习与人机交互第一人称方法的研究。

orgs.name: Exertion Games Lab
orgs.description: Florian 'Floyd' Mueller's lab at Monash University in Melbourne, designing 'bodily play': exertion games, integrated human-computer bodies and playful interactions with the body. It co-organised the CHI 2017 soma-based design theory workshop and the Dagstuhl seminar on body-centric computing.
orgs.description_zh: Florian “Floyd” Mueller 在墨尔本莫纳什大学的实验室，设计“身体游戏”：运动型游戏、人机融合的身体以及与身体玩耍的交互。它参与组织了 CHI 2017 身体设计理论工作坊和 Dagstuhl 身体中心计算研讨会。

orgs.name: F. M. Alexander
orgs.description: Australian actor who developed the Alexander Technique to unlearn habitual tension through 'inhibition' and conscious direction of head, neck and back; John Dewey was his student, and the technique is a root of somatics.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚演员，创立亚历山大技巧：通过“抑制”与对头、颈、背的有意识引导，去除惯性紧张；杜威曾是他的学生，该技巧是身心学的源头之一。

orgs.name: Feldenkrais Guild of North America
orgs.description: The professional association of Feldenkrais practitioners in the US and Canada, which lists accredited trainings, teachers and Awareness Through Movement classes.
orgs.description_zh: 美国与加拿大费登奎斯从业者的专业协会，提供经认证的培训、教师名录和“动中觉察”课程。

orgs.name: Feng Zhou
orgs.description: Research fellow at the University of Nottingham who leads Somabotics' Soma Skins, a plug-and-play kit of wearable sensor and actuator tiles for embodied interaction; co-author of 'Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design'.
orgs.description_zh: 诺丁汉大学研究员，负责 Somabotics 项目的 Soma Skins：一套即插即用、可穿戴的传感与执行模块，用于具身交互；《Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design》作者之一。
known_for: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)

orgs.name: Florian 'Floyd' Mueller
orgs.description: Monash University professor and director of the Exertion Games Lab, which designs bodily play, from exertion interfaces and Jogging over a Distance to human-computer integration where technology works inside and with the body.
orgs.description_zh: 莫纳什大学教授、Exertion Games Lab 主任，其实验室设计身体游戏，从运动界面、异地同跑（Jogging over a Distance）到让技术在身体之内、与身体协作的人机融合。
known_for: Exertion Interfaces: sports over a distance for social bonding and fun (CHI 2003)
Jogging over a Distance between Europe and Australia (UIST 2010)
Designing Sports: a framework for exertion games (CHI 2011)

orgs.name: Francisco Varela
orgs.description: Chilean biologist and neuroscientist who co-founded enactivism, arguing that cognition is embodied action, and joined Buddhist meditation with cognitive science. His neurophenomenology and first-person methods shaped micro-phenomenology and first-person design research.
orgs.description_zh: 智利生物学家与神经科学家，共同创立“生成主义”（enactivism），主张认知是具身的行动，并把佛教禅修与认知科学结合。他的神经现象学与第一人称方法影响了微观现象学与第一人称设计研究。
known_for: The Embodied Mind (1991, with Thompson and Rosch)

orgs.name: Frédéric Bevilacqua
orgs.description: Head of IRCAM's Sound Music Movement Interaction team, whose gesture following and movement sonification (e.g. Interlude) underpin much movement-sound interaction, including sound-guided rehabilitation.
orgs.description_zh: IRCAM“声音-音乐-动作交互”团队负责人，他的手势跟随与动作声音化研究（如 Interlude）是许多动作-声音交互的基础，包括以声音引导的康复。
known_for: Interlude project (2008–2010; 2011 Guthman Prize for new musical instruments)
Continuous Realtime Gesture Following and Recognition (LNCS, 2010)
Sensori-Motor Learning with Movement Sonification (Frontiers in Neuroscience, 2016)

orgs.name: Gendlin Online Library
orgs.description: The International Focusing Institute's free library of Eugene Gendlin's writings, including A Process Model and his papers on the felt sense and Thinking at the Edge.
orgs.description_zh: 国际聚焦研究所提供的 Eugene Gendlin 著作免费在线文库，包括《A Process Model》以及他关于“体会”和边缘思考的论文。

orgs.name: George Lakoff
orgs.description: Berkeley cognitive linguist whose theory of conceptual metaphor, developed with Mark Johnson, argues that thought is structured by bodily experience; widely used in embodied interaction to design with image schemas.
orgs.description_zh: 伯克利认知语言学家，与 Mark Johnson 发展出概念隐喻理论，认为思维由身体经验所构造；具身交互常借此以意象图式做设计。
known_for: Metaphors We Live By (1980, with Johnson)
Philosophy in the Flesh (1999, with Johnson)

orgs.name: George Poonkhin Khut
orgs.description: Chinese-Australian artist at UNSW who since 2004 has made participatory biofeedback artworks driven by heartbeat and breath (Cardiomorphologies) and brought them into hospitals with the BrightHearts app for children's procedural pain.
orgs.description_zh: 华裔澳大利亚艺术家，任教于新南威尔士大学。自 2004 年起创作由心跳与呼吸驱动的参与式生物反馈作品（Cardiomorphologies），并以 BrightHearts 应用把它带入医院，缓解儿童在医疗操作中的疼痛。
known_for: Development and Evaluation of Participant-Centred Biofeedback Artworks (Doctor of Creative Arts exegesis, Western Sydney University, 2006)
Designing Biofeedback Artworks for Relaxation (CHI EA 2016)
BrightHearts biofeedback app for children's procedural pain (Pain Practice, 2018)

orgs.name: Gerda Alexander
orgs.description: Danish teacher who created Eutony, a practice of sensing and adjusting muscle tone through contact with the floor, objects and one's own skin.
orgs.description_zh: 丹麦教师，创立 Eutony（优张力）：通过与地面、物件及自身皮肤的接触，感受并调节肌张力的修习。
known_for: Eutony: The Holistic Discovery of the Total Person (1985)

orgs.name: Hakomi Institute
orgs.description: The training organisation for Hakomi, Ron Kurtz's mindfulness-centred somatic psychotherapy that studies how beliefs are held in posture, gesture and felt sensation.
orgs.description_zh: Hakomi 疗法的培训机构。这是 Ron Kurtz 创立的以正念为中心的身体心理疗法，探究信念如何体现在姿态、手势和身体感受之中。

orgs.name: Hanne De Jaegher
orgs.description: Enactive philosopher who, with Ezequiel Di Paolo, proposed participatory sense-making: meaning is made together in the coordination of moving bodies, a key idea for designing shared and social soma experiences.
orgs.description_zh: 生成主义哲学家，与 Ezequiel Di Paolo 提出“参与式意义建构”：意义在运动身体之间的协调中共同生成；这是设计共享与社会性身体体验的关键思想。
known_for: Linguistic Bodies (2018, with Di Paolo and Cuffari)

orgs.name: Helena Tobiasson
orgs.description: Ergonomist and KTH PhD (2015, 'Traces of Movement') who studied physical activity in eldercare, schools and offices and proposed Physical Movement Sketching; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 人因工程师、KTH 博士（2015，《Traces of Movement》），研究养老照护、学校与办公室中的身体活动，并提出“身体动作草图”方法；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Traces of Movement: Exploring physical activity in societal settings (PhD thesis, KTH, 2015)
Physical Movement Sketching and Movement Probes (design methods, 2015 thesis)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: Hijikata Tatsumi
orgs.description: Japanese dancer who founded butoh, a dance of the 'body that has died', using imagery-driven transformation that rejects Western dance form; a radical source for somatic performance.
orgs.description_zh: 日本舞者，开创舞踏：一种“死去的身体”的舞蹈，以意象驱动身体变形，拒绝西方舞蹈形式；是身体表演的激进源头。

orgs.name: Hiroshi Ishii
orgs.description: MIT Media Lab professor who founded the Tangible Media Group; his Tangible Bits and Radical Atoms visions established tangible and shape-changing interfaces, a strand of the material and embodied turn in HCI.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室教授，创立 Tangible Media Group；他提出的 Tangible Bits 与 Radical Atoms 奠定了实体与形变界面，是人机交互物质与具身转向的一条脉络。

orgs.name: Hubert Dreyfus
orgs.description: Berkeley philosopher who used Heidegger and Merleau-Ponty to argue that skilled coping is embodied and cannot be captured by rule-based AI; his critique influenced embodied interaction and the skill-acquisition model.
orgs.description_zh: 伯克利哲学家，借海德格尔与梅洛-庞蒂论证熟练应对是具身的，无法被基于规则的 AI 捕捉；他的批判影响了具身交互与技能习得模型。
known_for: Mind over Machine (1986, with Stuart Dreyfus)

orgs.name: Human Computer Integration Lab (University of Chicago)
orgs.description: Pedro Lopes's lab at the University of Chicago, which builds interfaces that borrow parts of the user's body, such as electrical muscle stimulation that moves the hand, chemical haptics and temperature illusions. It raises questions of agency and ownership central to soma design with machines.
orgs.description_zh: Pedro Lopes 在芝加哥大学的实验室，制作“借用”使用者身体的界面，例如驱动手部的肌肉电刺激、化学触觉和温度错觉，提出了能动性与身体所有感等问题，这些正是机器与身体设计的核心。

orgs.name: Hélio Oiticica
orgs.description: Brazilian artist whose Parangolés, capes worn and danced in by participants, and immersive environments such as Tropicália made art something completed by the moving body.
orgs.description_zh: 巴西艺术家，他的 Parangolés 是由参与者穿上并起舞的披风，与《Tropicália》等沉浸环境一起，让艺术由运动的身体来完成。

orgs.name: i_mBODY Lab (Universidad Carlos III de Madrid)
orgs.description: The Interactive Multisensory Body-centred Experiences lab at UC3M Madrid, led by Ana Tajadura-Jiménez, which uses sound, touch and vision to change how people perceive their own bodies (e.g. Magic Feet, body-transformation experiences in BODYinTRANSIT). Elena Márquez Segura works here on embodied ideation and sketching.
orgs.description_zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学的“多感官身体中心体验”实验室，由 Ana Tajadura-Jiménez 领导，用声音、触觉和视觉改变人们对自己身体的感知（如 Magic Feet，以及 BODYinTRANSIT 项目中的身体变形体验）。Elena Márquez Segura 在此研究具身构思与具身草图。

orgs.name: ICHEC (formerly Chinese CHI)
orgs.description: The International Conference on Human-Engaged Computing of the International Association of Chinese HCI (ICACHI), formerly Chinese CHI; it gathers Chinese-speaking and Asian HCI researchers around technology, culture and lived experience. ICHEC 2025 was held at Singapore Management University.
orgs.description_zh: 国际华人人机交互协会（ICACHI）主办的“以人为本的计算”国际会议，前身为 Chinese CHI，聚集华人与亚洲的人机交互研究者，讨论技术、文化与生活经验。ICHEC 2025 在新加坡管理大学举行。

orgs.name: Ichikawa Hiroshi
orgs.description: Japanese philosopher of the body at Meiji University who developed a theory of 'mi', the living body-self that is at once body, mind and social being, in dialogue with Merleau-Ponty and Japanese language.
orgs.description_zh: 明治大学的日本身体论哲学家，在与梅洛-庞蒂及日语的对话中发展出“身”（mi）的理论：“身”是同时作为身体、心灵与社会存在的活的身体-自我。
known_for: 精神としての身体 (The Body as Spirit, 1975)

orgs.name: Ida Rolf
orgs.description: Biochemist who created Structural Integration (Rolfing), hands-on work on fascia to reorganise the body in gravity; one of the founding figures of somatic bodywork.
orgs.description_zh: 生物化学家，创立结构整合（罗尔夫疗法）：以手法作用于筋膜，使身体在重力中重新组织；身体工作（bodywork）的奠基人物之一。
known_for: Rolfing: The Integration of Human Structures (1977)

orgs.name: ImPulsTanz Vienna International Dance Festival
orgs.description: Europe's largest contemporary dance festival, held every summer in Vienna, with hundreds of workshops in somatic practices, contact improvisation and dance technique alongside performances.
orgs.description_zh: 欧洲规模最大的当代舞蹈节，每年夏天在维也纳举行，除演出外还有数百场身体修习、接触即兴和舞蹈技巧工作坊。

orgs.name: International Dance and Somatic Practices Conference
orgs.description: The conference series hosted by C-DaRE at Coventry University that brings together dance artists, somatic educators and researchers; its sixth edition took place in 2023.
orgs.description_zh: 由考文垂大学 C-DaRE 主办的系列会议，汇聚舞蹈艺术家、身体教育者和研究者；第六届于 2023 年举行。

orgs.name: International Feldenkrais Federation (IFF)
orgs.description: The international umbrella body of Feldenkrais Method guilds and training accreditation boards, which maintains the Method's standards, archives and research resources. Feldenkrais lessons (Awareness Through Movement) are the somatic training most used in Höök's soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 费登奎斯方法各国协会与培训认证机构的国际联合会，维护方法的标准、档案与研究资源。费登奎斯课程（动中觉察）是 Höök 身体设计中最常用的身体训练。

orgs.name: International Yang Style Tai Chi Chuan Association
orgs.description: The association led by Yang Jun, a fifth-generation lineage holder of Yang-style tai chi, which teaches the traditional Yang forms through affiliated centres worldwide.
orgs.description_zh: 由杨氏太极拳第五代传人杨军领导的国际协会，通过遍布世界的分会传授传统杨氏太极拳套路。

orgs.name: IRCAM Sound Music Movement Interaction (ISMM)
orgs.description: The team at IRCAM / STMS Lab in Paris that studies movement–sound interaction: gesture following, interactive sonification and movement learning, with tools such as MuBu and CoMo used by dancers, musicians and soma designers. Frédéric Bevilacqua leads it; Jules Françoise worked here on movement sonification and somatic learning.
orgs.description_zh: 巴黎 IRCAM / STMS 实验室里研究动作与声音交互的团队：手势跟随、交互式声音化与动作学习，开发的 MuBu、CoMo 等工具被舞者、音乐人和身体设计者使用。团队由 Frédéric Bevilacqua 领导，Jules Françoise 曾在此研究动作声音化与身体学习。

orgs.name: Iris Marion Young
orgs.description: Political philosopher whose essay 'Throwing Like a Girl' showed how women's bodily comportment and motility are shaped by social constraint; a founding text of feminist phenomenology of the body.
orgs.description_zh: 政治哲学家，其文章《像女孩那样丢球》揭示了女性的身体举止与运动能力如何受社会约束塑造；是女性主义身体现象学的奠基文本。

orgs.name: Irmgard Bartenieff
orgs.description: Laban's student, dancer and physical therapist who developed the Bartenieff Fundamentals of connected, whole-body movement and brought Laban analysis to dance therapy in the United States.
orgs.description_zh: 拉班的学生、舞者与物理治疗师，发展出强调全身连接动作的 Bartenieff 基础训练，并把拉班分析带入美国舞蹈治疗。
known_for: Body Movement: Coping with the Environment (1980)

orgs.name: ISMETA (International Somatic Movement Education and Therapy Association)
orgs.name_zh: 国际身体动作教育与治疗协会
orgs.description: The professional association, active since 1988, that sets standards for and registers somatic movement educators and therapists across many methods (BMC, Laban/Bartenieff, Hanna Somatics, Continuum and others).
orgs.description_zh: 自 1988 年起运作的专业协会，为多种方法（BMC、拉班/巴特尼夫、Hanna 身心学、Continuum 等）的身体动作教育者与治疗师制定标准并注册认证。

orgs.name: Jacob's Pillow
orgs.description: The dance centre and summer festival founded by Ted Shawn on a farm in Becket, Massachusetts, a National Historic Landmark with an extensive dance archive.
orgs.description_zh: Ted Shawn 在马萨诸塞州贝克特的农场上创办的舞蹈中心和夏季舞蹈节，是美国国家历史地标，拥有丰富的舞蹈档案。

orgs.name: Jacob's Pillow Dance Interactive
orgs.description: An online collection of dance videos filmed at Jacob's Pillow from the 1930s to today, with illustrated essays.
orgs.description_zh: 在线舞蹈影像库，收录 1930 年代至今在 Jacob's Pillow 拍摄的舞蹈影片，并附有图文文章。

orgs.name: Jakob Tholander
orgs.description: Stockholm University professor of HCI who studied whole-body interaction in golf, skateboarding and sports watches ('Snot, Sweat, Pain, Mud, and Snow') and co-authored the 2018 first-person soma design paper.
orgs.description_zh: 斯德哥尔摩大学人机交互教授，研究高尔夫、滑板与运动手表中的全身交互（《Snot, Sweat, Pain, Mud, and Snow》），是 2018 年第一人称身体设计论文的作者之一。
known_for: Mirroring bodily experiences over time (CHI EA 2009)
Design qualities for whole body interaction: learning from golf, skateboarding and BodyBugging (NordiCHI 2010)
Snot, Sweat, Pain, Mud, and Snow: Performance and Experience in the Use of Sports Watches (CHI 2015)

orgs.name: Jarmo Laaksolahti
orgs.description: Höök's PhD student (2008) and long-time collaborator at SICS and KTH. He co-developed the Sensual Evaluation Instrument for non-verbal, bodily evaluation and, with Windlin and Höök, the Soma Bits prototyping kit.
orgs.description_zh: Höök 的博士生（2008），也是她在 SICS 与 KTH 的长期合作者。他参与开发了以非语言、身体方式做评估的感官评估工具（Sensual Evaluation Instrument），并与 Windlin、Höök 一起开发了 Soma Bits 原型工具包。
known_for: Plot, Spectacle, and Experience (PhD thesis, Stockholm University, 2008)

orgs.name: JEDI Lab (National University of Singapore)
orgs.description: The Joyful Experiences in Design and Interaction lab in NUS's Department of Design, which studies technology for reflection, care and rest. Its CHI 2026 paper 'Toward Pluralizing Reflection in HCI through Daoism' draws on Daoist priests and practitioners to describe embodied, relational reflection (stillness, resonance, emergence).
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡国立大学设计系的 JEDI 实验室，研究支持反思、关怀与休息的技术。其 CHI 2026 论文《Toward Pluralizing Reflection in HCI through Daoism》通过访谈道士与修行者，提出一种具身、关系性的反思（静、感应、生发）。

orgs.name: Jiabao Li
orgs.description: Artist-researcher at Northeastern University working across wearables, robots, performance and biotechnology on interspecies and climate themes and on the female body, from Glacier's Lament to Menstrual Garden.
orgs.description_zh: 艺术家兼研究者，任教于东北大学，横跨可穿戴、机器人、表演与生物技术，关注跨物种、气候以及女性身体，作品从《Glacier's Lament》到《Menstrual Garden》。
known_for: Glacier's Lament (Fast Company World Changing Ideas finalist, 2021)
Body-focused works Menstrual Garden, Womb Wetware and Sentient Clit (years not verified)

orgs.name: Jodi Forlizzi
orgs.description: Carnegie Mellon professor who helped define experience-centred design and research through design in HCI, and studies social robots; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授，参与奠定人机交互中的以体验为中心的设计与“通过设计做研究”，并研究社交机器人；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Understanding Experience in Interactive Systems (DIS 2004, with Katja Battarbee)
Research through Design as a Method for Interaction Design Research in HCI (CHI 2007, with Zimmerman and Evenson)
How robotic products become social products (2007)

orgs.name: Joe Marshall
orgs.description: Mixed Reality Lab researcher who builds full-body experiences such as computerised fairground rides and physical games; co-author of 'Soma Design and Sensory Misalignment' and the non-dualistic design paper.
orgs.description_zh: 混合现实实验室（MRL）研究者，打造计算机化的游乐设施、身体游戏等全身体验；《Soma Design and Sensory Misalignment》与非二元设计论文的作者之一。
known_for: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)

orgs.name: John Dewey
orgs.description: American pragmatist whose 'Art as Experience' grounds aesthetics in the lived, embodied flow of everyday experience; a student of F.M. Alexander, he is a root of Shusterman's somaesthetics and of experience-centred HCI.
orgs.description_zh: 美国实用主义哲学家，《艺术即经验》把美学建立在日常经验活生生的身体之流中；他曾随 F.M. 亚历山大学习，是 Shusterman 身体美学与以体验为中心的人机交互的思想源头。

orgs.name: Jon Kabat-Zinn
orgs.description: Founder of Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction at the University of Massachusetts, whose body scan and mindful movement brought Buddhist-derived practice into medicine; the body scan is a standard soma design exercise.
orgs.description_zh: 马萨诸塞大学正念减压（MBSR）创始人，他的身体扫描与正念动作把源自佛教的修习带入医学；身体扫描也是身体设计的常用练习。
known_for: Wherever You Go, There You Are (1994)

orgs.name: Jonas Fritsch
orgs.description: IT University of Copenhagen associate professor who brought affect theory into interaction design through experiments with interactive sound and physical interfaces, and now applies affective interaction design to care.
orgs.description_zh: 哥本哈根 IT 大学副教授，通过互动声音与实体界面的实验，把情动理论引入交互设计，现将情感交互设计用于照护。
known_for: Understanding Affective Engagement as a Resource in Interaction Design (Nordes 2009)
Affective Interaction Design at the End of the World (DRS 2018)
Problematizing Affective Interaction Design (in Affects, Interfaces, Events, 2021)

orgs.name: Jonas Löwgren
