orgs.description: Linköping University professor of interaction design whose work on interaction aesthetics and, with Höök, 'strong concepts' as intermediate-level design knowledge frames how soma design generalises.
orgs.description_zh: 林雪平大学交互设计教授，他关于交互美学的研究，以及与 Höök 提出的作为中间层设计知识的“强概念”，为身体设计如何形成可推广的知识提供了框架。
known_for: Thoughtful Interaction Design (MIT Press, 2004, with E. Stolterman)
Strong concepts: Intermediate-level knowledge in interaction design research (ACM TOCHI, 2012, with K. Höök)

orgs.name: Jordi Solsona Belenguer
orgs.description: Höök's PhD student (KTH 2015) on designerly conversations with digital materials; co-author of the somaesthetic service design and Metaphone biodata work, and later co-supervisor of Karpashevich's soma design PhD.
orgs.description_zh: Höök 的博士生（KTH 2015），研究与数字材料的“设计对话”；参与身体美学服务设计与 Metaphone 生物数据研究，后来担任 Karpashevich 身体设计博士研究的合作导师。
known_for: Experiential artifacts as a design method for somaesthetic service development (2011)
Engineering through Designerly Conversations with the Digital Material (PhD thesis, KTH, 2015)

orgs.name: Joseph La Delfa
orgs.description: Designer and Höök's PhD student (KTH 2023, 'Cultivating Mechanical Sympathy') who made Drone Chi, where a drone follows the hand in tai chi-like movement, and developed 'mechanical sympathy' for somaesthetic relations with machines.
orgs.description_zh: 设计师，Höök 的博士生（KTH 2023，论文《Cultivating Mechanical Sympathy》）。他创作了 Drone Chi，让无人机随手做出类似太极的动作，并提出“机械同感”来描述人与机器的身体美学关系。
known_for: Articulating Mechanical Sympathy for Somaesthetic Human-Machine Relations (DIS 2024)

orgs.name: Josh Andres
orgs.description: UNSW Canberra senior lecturer whose award-winning PhD at the Exertion Games Lab built eBikes that respond to the rider's brain and body states, articulating human-computer integration during exertion.
orgs.description_zh: 新南威尔士大学堪培拉校区高级讲师，在 Exertion Games Lab 的获奖博士研究打造了能回应骑行者脑与身体状态的电动自行车，阐明了运动中的人机融合。
known_for: Integrated Exertion: Understanding the Design of Human–Computer Integration in an Exertion Context (PhD thesis, RMIT, 2020; ACM SIGCHI Outstanding Dissertation Award)
Ena, Ari and Ava eBikes (EEG- and sensor-driven integrated eBikes)
Introducing Peripheral Awareness as a Neurological State for Human-computer Integration (CHI 2020)

orgs.name: Journal of Consciousness Studies
orgs.description: The interdisciplinary journal whose 1999 special issue 'The View from Within' (eds. Francisco Varela and Jonathan Shear) set out first-person methods for the study of experience.
orgs.description_zh: 跨学科意识研究期刊；1999 年由 Francisco Varela 与 Jonathan Shear 主编的专刊《The View from Within》系统提出了研究经验的第一人称方法。

orgs.name: Journal of Dance & Somatic Practices
orgs.description: A peer-reviewed journal published by Intellect and edited from Coventry University's C-DaRE, covering somatic practices in dance, performance, education and research.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Intellect 出版、在考文垂大学 C-DaRE 编辑的同行评审期刊，涵盖舞蹈、表演、教育与研究中的身体修习。

orgs.name: Journal of Embodied Research
orgs.description: An open-access, peer-reviewed journal whose articles are videos, publishing embodied and practice-led research in which the body carries the argument.
orgs.description_zh: 开放获取的同行评审期刊，论文以视频形式发表，刊载由身体承载论证的具身研究与实践研究。

orgs.name: JST ERATO Inami JIZAI Body Project
orgs.description: Masahiko Inami's research project (University of Tokyo, with Keio, Waseda and other partners) on 'body editing': how perception, action and social behaviour change when bodies are augmented, e.g. JIZAI ARMS, a wearable set of detachable robot arms. It frames augmentation through the Japanese idea of jizai, moving freely and at ease.
orgs.description_zh: 稻见昌彦（Masahiko Inami）主持的研究项目（东京大学，联合庆应、早稻田等），研究“身体编辑”：身体被增强后，人的感知、行动和社会行为如何改变，代表作有可穿戴、可拆卸的机械臂 JIZAI ARMS。项目以日本的“自在”观念来理解身体增强。

orgs.name: Juan Pablo Martinez Avila
orgs.description: Nottingham HCI researcher in embodied and music interaction who brought soma design to musical instruments ('Soma Design for NIME', 2020) and took part in the workshop analysed in 'Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design'.
orgs.description_zh: 诺丁汉大学的具身与音乐交互研究者，把身体设计带入乐器设计（《Soma Design for NIME》，2020），并参与了《Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design》所分析的工作坊。
known_for: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)
Encumbered Interaction: a Study of Musicians Preparing to Perform (CHI 2019)

orgs.name: Judson Memorial Church (Judson Dance Theater)
orgs.description: The Greenwich Village church whose gymnasium hosted Judson Dance Theater (1962–1964), where Yvonne Rainer, Steve Paxton, Trisha Brown and others turned pedestrian and task-based movement into dance, the ground from which contact improvisation grew.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约格林威治村的教堂，其体育馆在 1962–1964 年间是 Judson 舞蹈剧场的所在地：Yvonne Rainer、Steve Paxton、Trisha Brown 等人把日常与任务性的动作变成舞蹈，接触即兴由此生长。

orgs.name: Jules Françoise
orgs.description: CNRS researcher at LISN working on movement sonification and interactive machine learning; his work with Schiphorst and Fdili Alaoui on kinesthetic awareness brought second-person, micro-phenomenological inquiry into somatic interaction design.
orgs.description_zh: 法国国家科学研究中心（LISN）研究员，研究动作声音化与交互式机器学习；他与 Schiphorst、Fdili Alaoui 关于动觉觉察的研究，把第二人称、微观现象学的访谈带入身体交互设计。
known_for: Motion-Sound Mapping by Demonstration (PhD thesis, UPMC/IRCAM, 2015)
Sensori-Motor Learning with Movement Sonification (Frontiers in Neuroscience, 2016)
Designing for Kinesthetic Awareness: revealing user experiences through second-person inquiry (CHI 2017)
Seeing, Sensing and Recognizing Laban Movement Qualities (CHI 2017)

orgs.name: Karey Helms
orgs.description: Designer and associate professor at Umeå Institute of Design whose KTH PhD ('Designing with care', 2023) worked self-centred and first-person with intimate, somatic data: urine, leaky objects and breastfeeding bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 于默奥设计学院设计师、副教授，KTH 博士论文（《Designing with care》，2023）以自我为中心、第一人称地处理亲密的身体数据：尿液、“会漏的物件”与哺乳的身体。
known_for: Do You Have to Pee?: A Design Space for Intimate and Somatic Data (DIS 2019)
Entangled Reflections on Designing with Leaky Breastfeeding Bodies (DIS 2021)

orgs.name: Katherine Isbister
orgs.description: UC Santa Cruz professor of computational media who co-developed the Sensual Evaluation Instrument with Höök and designs movement games and playful wearables for emotion and social connection, from Yamove! to the self-soothing toy Purrble.
orgs.description_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校计算媒体教授，与 Höök 共同开发感官评估工具（SEI），并为情感与社会连接设计动作游戏和好玩的可穿戴，从 Yamove! 到自我安抚玩具 Purrble。
known_for: The Sensual Evaluation Instrument (2006, with Höök et al.)
Yamove! A Movement Synchrony Game That Choreographs Social Interaction (Human Technology, 2016)

orgs.name: Katta Spiel
orgs.description: TU Wien researcher on critical access in embodied computing who centres disabled, neurodivergent and non-binary bodies; 'The Bodies of TEI' audits the normative body assumptions of embodied interaction research.
orgs.description_zh: 维也纳工业大学研究者，关注具身计算中的“批判性可及”，以残障、神经多样与非二元性别的身体为中心；《The Bodies of TEI》审视了具身交互研究中关于身体的规范性假设。
known_for: Agency of Autistic Children in Technology Research—A Critical Literature Review (TOCHI 2019)
Patching Gender: Non-binary Utopias in HCI (CHI EA 2019)
The Bodies of TEI – Investigating Norms and Assumptions in the Design of Embodied Interaction (TEI 2021)

orgs.name: Kazuo Ohno Dance Studio
orgs.description: The butoh studio of Kazuo Ohno and Yoshito Ohno in Yokohama, which still holds regular workshops and keeps the Kazuo Ohno Archives of films, photographs and notes.
orgs.description_zh: 大野一雄与大野庆人在横滨的舞踏研究所，至今定期开设工作坊，并保存大野一雄档案（影像、照片与笔记）。

orgs.name: Kelsey Cotton
orgs.description: Vocalist and researcher at Chalmers whose soma design work centres on the singing body and breath, including the Body Electric NIME and Corsetto, made with Höök's group.
orgs.description_zh: 查尔默斯理工大学的歌者与研究者，其身体设计研究以歌唱的身体与呼吸为中心，包括 Body Electric 乐器界面，以及与 Höök 团队合作的 Corsetto。
known_for: The Body Electric: A NIME designed through and with the somatic experience of singing (NIME 2021)
'Feeling the Sensor Feeling you': A Soma Design Exploration on Sensing Non-habitual Breathing (CHI 2021)

orgs.name: Kristina Andersen
orgs.description: TU Eindhoven associate professor and Höök's PhD student (KTH 2017, 'Making Magic Machines') whose Magic Machine workshops use embodied making with found materials to surface people's desires about technology.
orgs.description_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学副教授，Höök 的博士生（KTH 2017，《Making Magic Machines》）。她的“魔法机器”工作坊用现成材料进行具身制作，引出人们对技术的欲望与想象。
known_for: The Magic Machine Workshops: Making Personal Design Knowledge (CHI 2019)
Ten Permissions for Facilitating (Live) Design Activities (DIS 2024)

orgs.name: Kristina Höök
orgs.description: Professor of Interaction Design at KTH who formulated soma design: designing from the designer's own trained, felt body-mind, drawing on Shusterman's somaesthetics and Feldenkrais practice. Her lab's work, from the affective loops of eMoto to the Soma Mat and Drone Chi, is the core lineage of this gallery.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 皇家理工学院交互设计教授，提出身体设计（soma design）：以设计师自身经过训练、可被感受的身心为出发点做设计，汲取 Shusterman 的身体美学与费登奎斯修习。她的实验室从 eMoto 的情感回路到 Soma Mat、Drone Chi，构成本图库的核心谱系。
known_for: Designing with the Body: Somaesthetic Interaction Design (MIT Press, 2018)
The Soma Mat and Breathing Light (CHI EA 2016)
Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)

orgs.name: Kristina Popova
orgs.description: KTH researcher (PhD 2026, co-supervised by Höök) who studies the affective and felt dimensions of ethics in technology work, drawing on STS, feminist epistemology and soma design; co-author of the felt ethics papers.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 研究者（博士 2026，Höök 为合作导师），结合科技与社会研究、女性主义认识论和身体设计，研究科技工作中伦理的情感与身体维度；“被感受的伦理”系列论文的作者之一。
known_for: Vulnerability as an ethical stance in soma design processes (CHI 2022)
Felt Ethics: Cultivating Ethical Sensibility in Design Practice (CHI 2023)
Ethical Reasoning in Tech Work: From Individual Responsibility to Collective Action (PhD thesis, KTH, 2026)

orgs.name: KTH DiVA publication archive
orgs.description: KTH's open repository, where the doctoral theses and many papers of Höök's soma design students (e.g. Vasiliki Tsaknaki, Pedro Sanches, Pavel Karpashevich) can be read in full.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 的开放论文库，可以读到 Höök 身体设计团队学生的博士论文和许多论文全文（如 Vasiliki Tsaknaki、Pedro Sanches、Pavel Karpashevich）。

orgs.name: KTH Interaction Design group (Soma Design)
orgs.description: Kristina Höök's research group at KTH's Division of Media Technology and Interaction Design in Stockholm, where soma design was formulated and where Soma Mat, Breathing Light, the Soma Bits and much feminist intimate-health design were made. The group works in 'the IxD Jungle' at the top of KTH's main building and trains designers through Feldenkrais-based somaesthetic practice.
orgs.description_zh: Kristina Höök 在斯德哥尔摩皇家理工学院（KTH）媒体技术与交互设计系的研究组：身体设计（soma design）在这里成形，Soma Mat、Breathing Light、Soma Bits 以及许多女性主义私密健康设计都出自这里。研究组以 Feldenkrais 为基础的身体美学练习训练设计师。

orgs.name: Laban/Bartenieff Institute of Movement Studies (LIMS)
orgs.name_zh: 拉班/巴特尼夫动作研究所
orgs.description: The New York institute founded by Irmgard Bartenieff that certifies Laban Movement Analysts and teaches Bartenieff Fundamentals, the vocabulary of Effort, Shape and Space that movement-based interaction designers use to describe felt movement qualities.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Irmgard Bartenieff 在纽约创办的机构，认证拉班动作分析师、教授 Bartenieff 基础练习；它提供的力效、形状与空间词汇被动作交互设计者用来描述动作的感受品质。

orgs.name: Laia Turmo Vidal
orgs.description: Assistant professor at KTH whose PhD (Uppsala 2021, 'Designing for Intercorporeality') studied technology for learning movement together, e.g. BodyLights; she now designs soft-robotic and haptic wearables for lived health with feminist and disability perspectives.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 助理教授，博士研究（乌普萨拉 2021，《Designing for Intercorporeality》）关注用技术支持共同学习动作，如 BodyLights；现以女性主义与残障视角设计面向健康经验的软体机器人与触觉可穿戴。
known_for: Designing for Intercorporeality (PhD thesis, Uppsala University, 2021)

orgs.name: Lian Loke
orgs.description: University of Sydney associate professor, dancer and performance artist whose 'Moving and Making Strange' (with Toni Robertson) gave interaction design a method for estranging habitual movement; co-author of 'The Somatic Turn in HCI'.
orgs.description_zh: 悉尼大学副教授、舞者与表演艺术家，她与 Toni Robertson 提出的“Moving and Making Strange”为交互设计提供了陌生化惯常动作的方法；《The Somatic Turn in HCI》作者之一。
known_for: Understanding movement for interaction design: frameworks and approaches (Personal and Ubiquitous Computing, 2006)
Moving and Making Strange: a design methodology for movement-based interactive technologies (PhD thesis, UTS, 2009; TOCHI 2013 with Toni Robertson)
Intimate Aesthetics and Facilitated Interaction (2014, with George Khut)
The somatic turn in human-computer interaction (Interactions, 2018, with Thecla Schiphorst)

orgs.name: Lin Hwai-min
orgs.description: Taiwanese choreographer who founded Cloud Gate Dance Theatre and trained dancers in tai chi daoyin, meditation, martial arts and calligraphy, building a contemporary dance from East Asian body-mind practice.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾编舞家，创立云门舞集，以太极导引、静坐、武术与书法训练舞者，以东亚身心修习建立当代舞蹈。

orgs.name: Lisa Feldman Barrett
orgs.description: Northeastern University neuroscientist whose theory of constructed emotion holds that emotions are made from interoceptive body budgeting and concepts, not triggered by fixed circuits, undercutting recognition-based affective computing.
orgs.description_zh: 东北大学神经科学家，她的“建构情绪理论”认为情绪由内感受的身体预算与概念共同建构，而非固定回路触发，这动摇了识别式情感计算的前提。
known_for: Seven and a Half Lessons About the Brain (2020)

orgs.name: Lisa Park
orgs.description: Korean-American artist whose Eunoia uses an EEG headset to turn her brainwaves and emotional states into vibrations rippling pools of water, making inner states visible through the body.
orgs.description_zh: 韩裔美国艺术家，作品《Eunoia》用脑电头戴把她的脑波与情绪状态转化为振动，在水面激起波纹，借身体让内在状态可见。

orgs.name: Lygia Clark
orgs.description: Brazilian artist who moved from Neo-Concrete sculpture to relational objects handled on the body, and finally to therapeutic sessions; her sensorial works are touchstones for art felt through the skin.
orgs.description_zh: 巴西艺术家，从新具体主义雕塑走向贴身使用的“关系物件”，最终发展为疗愈性的工作；她的感官作品是“用皮肤感受的艺术”的标杆。

orgs.name: Mabel Elsworth Todd
orgs.description: Teacher whose 'The Thinking Body' used anatomical imagery to change posture and movement, the origin of ideokinesis in dance and somatic education.
orgs.description_zh: 教师，其《The Thinking Body》以解剖意象改变姿态与动作，是舞蹈与身心教育中“意念动觉法”（ideokinesis）的源头。

orgs.name: Madeline Balaam
orgs.description: KTH professor of interaction design who designs for intimate bodies and health: pelvic fitness (Labella), breastfeeding (FeedFinder) and menstruation (Menarche Bits). She co-authored soma design papers with Höök and supervises several soma-oriented PhD students.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 交互设计教授，为亲密身体与健康而设计：盆底训练（Labella）、哺乳（FeedFinder）与月经（Menarche Bits）。她与 Höök 合写身体设计论文，并指导多位身体设计方向的博士生。
known_for: On Looking at the Vagina through Labella (CHI 2016)
Touching and Being in Touch with the Menstruating Body (CHI 2020)
Exploring the Somatic Possibilities of Shape Changing Car Seats (DIS 2024)

orgs.name: Marcel Mauss
orgs.description: French anthropologist whose lecture 'Techniques of the Body' showed that walking, swimming, sleeping and breathing are learned, culturally specific techniques, opening the study of how cultures train bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 法国人类学家，其讲演《身体技术》指出行走、游泳、睡眠与呼吸都是后天习得、因文化而异的技术，开启了对文化如何训练身体的研究。

orgs.name: Marco Donnarumma
orgs.description: Italian performer and researcher who plays the sounds of his own muscles with the Xth Sense biosensor and performs with AI-driven prostheses, staging the body as unstable and hybrid.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利表演者与研究者，以 Xth Sense 生物传感器演奏自身肌肉的声音，并与 AI 驱动的义肢同台，把身体呈现为不稳定、混杂的存在。

orgs.name: Marco Gillies
orgs.description: Goldsmiths professor whose 'embodied design' lets designers create full-body interactions by moving and demonstrating with interactive machine learning rather than by coding.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦大学金史密斯学院教授，提出“具身设计”：借助交互式机器学习，设计师通过亲身运动与示范而非写代码来创造全身交互。
known_for: Embodied design of full bodied interaction with virtual humans (MOCO 2015)
Understanding the Role of Interactive Machine Learning in Movement Interaction Design (ACM TOCHI, 2019)
VR and ML for All MOOCs (Coursera)

orgs.name: Marianna Obrist
orgs.description: UCL professor of multisensory interfaces who works to make touch, taste and smell interaction modalities, from mid-air haptics that convey emotion to scent-delivery devices.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦大学学院多感官界面教授，致力于让触觉、味觉与嗅觉成为交互通道，从传达情绪的空中触觉到气味释放装置。
known_for: Opportunities for odor: experiences with smell and implications for technology (CHI 2014)
Scent-delivery technology shown at WEF Davos 2019 and 2020, commercialised via OWidgets Ltd (co-founded 2019)

orgs.name: Marianne Graves Petersen
orgs.description: Aarhus University professor whose 'Aesthetic Interaction' (DIS 2004) framed interaction through Dewey's pragmatist aesthetics, a precursor of somaesthetic interaction design; co-author of the CHI 2012 review of shape-changing interfaces.
orgs.description_zh: 奥胡斯大学教授，其《Aesthetic Interaction》（DIS 2004）以杜威的实用主义美学看待交互，是身体美学交互设计的先声；也是 CHI 2012 形变界面综述的作者之一。
known_for: Aesthetic Interaction: A Pragmatist's Aesthetics of Interactive Systems (DIS 2004)
Shape-changing interfaces: a review of the design space and open research questions (CHI 2012)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: Marie Louise Juul Søndergaard
orgs.description: Danish designer who uses speculative and feminist design for intimate technologies around menstruation and desire (PeriodShare, Intimate Futures); as a KTH postdoc she co-made the Menarche Bits and 'Soma Design and Politics of the Body'.
orgs.description_zh: 丹麦设计师，以思辨设计与女性主义设计探讨月经与欲望相关的亲密技术（PeriodShare、Intimate Futures）；在 KTH 做博士后期间参与制作 Menarche Bits 与《Soma Design and Politics of the Body》。
known_for: Designing with Intimate Materials and Movements: Making 'Menarche Bits' (DIS 2020)
Soma Design and Politics of the Body (HttF 2019)

orgs.name: Marina Abramović
orgs.description: Serbian performance artist whose durational works test the limits of body and presence, and whose Abramović Method trains audiences in slow walking, stillness and attention.
orgs.description_zh: 塞尔维亚行为艺术家，她的长时作品测试身体与在场的极限，“阿布拉莫维奇方法”训练观众慢走、静止与专注。

orgs.name: Mark Johnson
orgs.description: University of Oregon philosopher who showed that abstract meaning grows out of bodily image schemas and felt, aesthetic experience; his embodied aesthetics of meaning is a basis for designing with felt qualities.
orgs.description_zh: 俄勒冈大学哲学家，指出抽象意义源自身体的意象图式与被感受的审美经验；他关于意义的具身美学是以被感受的品质做设计的依据。
known_for: Metaphors We Live By (1980, with Lakoff)
Philosophy in the Flesh (1999, with Lakoff)

orgs.name: Martin Jonsson
orgs.description: Södertörn University researcher in tangible and ubiquitous interaction who co-designed the Soma Mat, Breathing Light and the heat-based somaesthetic prototypes with Höök and Ståhl.
orgs.description_zh: 瑟德托恩大学的实体与普适交互研究者，与 Höök、Ståhl 共同设计了 Soma Mat、Breathing Light 以及以热为媒介的身体美学原型。
known_for: The Soma Mat and Breathing Light (CHI EA 2016)

orgs.name: Mary Starks Whitehouse
orgs.description: Dancer and Jungian-trained therapist whose 'movement in depth' became Authentic Movement: a mover follows inner impulses with eyes closed while a witness attends, a model of first- and second-person bodily attention.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者与受荣格训练的治疗师，她的“深层动作”后来发展为真实动作（Authentic Movement）：动者闭眼跟随内在冲动，见证者在旁专注观看；这是第一人称与第二人称身体注意的范式。

orgs.name: Masahiko Inami
orgs.description: University of Tokyo professor of human augmentation who led the ERATO JIZAI Body project on bodies whose natural and artificial parts can be freely controlled or shared, drawing on the Japanese notion of jizai (freedom of the body).
orgs.description_zh: 东京大学人类增强研究教授，主持 ERATO“自在身体”项目，借日语“自在”的概念，研究天然与人工部分可以自由操控、分享的身体。
known_for: JIZAI Body project (JST ERATO, Oct 2017 – Mar 2023)
MetaLimbs: foot-controlled extra robotic arms (SIGGRAPH 2017 Emerging Technologies)
Theory of JIZAI Body: Towards Mastery Over the Extended Self (Springer, 2023)

orgs.name: Maurice Merleau-Ponty
orgs.description: French phenomenologist who argued that perception and meaning are rooted in the lived body (corps propre) and its motor intentionality, not in a detached mind. His notions of body schema, flesh and intercorporeality run through embodied interaction and soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 法国现象学家，主张知觉与意义扎根于活的身体（本己身体）及其运动意向性，而非一个抽离的心灵。他的身体图式、肉身与身体间性等概念贯穿具身交互与身体设计。

orgs.name: Maxine Sheets-Johnstone
orgs.description: Dancer, choreographer and philosopher at the University of Oregon who argues for the primacy of movement: we first come to know ourselves and the world as animate, moving bodies, and thinking in movement comes before thinking in words. A key reference for kinesthetic and movement-based design.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者、编舞家与俄勒冈大学哲学家，主张“运动的首要性”：我们首先作为有生命、会运动的身体认识自己与世界，以动作思考先于以语言思考。她是动觉与以动作为基础的设计的重要参考。

orgs.name: Mehmet Aydın Baytaş
orgs.description: Designer-engineer, formerly at Chalmers, who co-created Drone Chi with Joseph La Delfa, a somaesthetic human-drone interaction inspired by tai chi, and Azalea for somaesthetic remote co-experience.
orgs.description_zh: 设计工程师，曾任职查尔默斯理工大学，与 Joseph La Delfa 共同创作受太极启发的身体美学人机（无人机）交互 Drone Chi，以及用于远程共同体验的 Azalea。
known_for: Azalea: Co-experience in Remote Dialog through Diminished Reality and Somaesthetic Interaction Design (CHI 2021)

orgs.name: Merce Cunningham
orgs.description: Choreographer who used chance procedures and, from 1989, the LifeForms software co-developed with Thecla Schiphorst to compose dance, an early meeting of choreography and computing.
orgs.description_zh: 编舞家，以机遇手法编舞，1989 年起使用与 Thecla Schiphorst 共同开发的 LifeForms 软件，是编舞与计算的早期相遇。

orgs.name: Michael Haller
orgs.description: Professor at the Free University of Bozen-Bolzano and founder of the Media Interaction Lab, known for touch- and deformation-sensitive smart textiles (SmartSleeve, RESi); co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 博尔扎诺自由大学教授、Media Interaction Lab 创始人，以可感知触碰与形变的智能织物（SmartSleeve、RESi）闻名；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: SmartSleeve: sensing gestures on interactive textiles (UIST 2017)
RESi: pressure-sensitive textile interface based on resistive yarns (UIST 2018)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: Micro-phenomenology
orgs.description: The hub of the micro-phenomenology community (the 'psychological microscope' developed from Claire Petitmengin's and Pierre Vermersch's interview methods), listing research axes, trainings and events.
orgs.description_zh: 微观现象学社群的中心网站（源自 Claire Petitmengin 与 Pierre Vermersch 访谈方法的“心理显微镜”），列出研究方向、培训与活动。

orgs.name: Min Tanaka
orgs.description: Japanese dancer who developed Body Weather, a training that treats the body as weather, changing with its environment, practised on his farm; it shaped Lian Loke and many dance-tech practitioners.
orgs.description_zh: 日本舞者，发展出“身体气象”（Body Weather）：把身体视为随环境变化的天气，并在他的农场修习；这一训练影响了 Lian Loke 等众多舞蹈与技术实践者。

orgs.name: Mind & Life Institute
orgs.description: The institute co-founded by Francisco Varela, Adam Engle and the Dalai Lama to bring contemplative practice and science into dialogue; its dialogues and summer research institutes shaped contemplative and first-person science.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Francisco Varela、Adam Engle 与达赖喇嘛共同创办，推动冥想修习与科学对话；其对话会和夏季研究营塑造了沉思科学与第一人称科学。

orgs.name: Miquel Alfaras
orgs.description: Physicist and biosignals researcher who, as a Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellow at PLUX, worked with Höök's group on making biosensing accessible to designers; first author of 'From Biodata to Somadata' (CHI 2020).
orgs.description_zh: 物理学出身的生物信号研究者，作为居里夫人学者在 PLUX 公司与 Höök 团队合作，让设计师也能上手生物传感；CHI 2020 论文《From Biodata to Somadata》第一作者。
known_for: Biosensing and Actuation—Platforms Coupling Body Input-Output Modalities for Affective Technologies (Sensors, 2020)
Exploring Awareness of Breathing through Deep Touch Pressure (CHI 2021)

orgs.name: Mirjana Prpa
orgs.description: Designer-researcher (PhD SFU, now HKUST Guangzhou) who creates breath-based VR and biofeedback and applies micro-phenomenology to design research ('Articulating Experience', CHI 2020).
orgs.description_zh: 设计研究者（西蒙菲莎大学博士，现任香港科技大学（广州）），创作以呼吸为基础的 VR 与生物反馈，并把微观现象学用于设计研究（《Articulating Experience》，CHI 2020）。
known_for: Attending to Breath: breath-based VR experiences (DIS 2018)
Inhaling and Exhaling: How Technologies Can Perceptually Extend our Breath Awareness (CHI 2020)
Articulating Experience: reflections from experts applying micro-phenomenology to design research in HCI (CHI 2020)

orgs.name: MIT Media Lab Fluid Interfaces
orgs.description: Pattie Maes's group at the MIT Media Lab building wearable and physiological interfaces for attention, memory, sleep and wellbeing, such as Dormio for dream incubation and biofeedback wearables for calm.
orgs.description_zh: Pattie Maes 在 MIT 媒体实验室的研究组，设计与注意力、记忆、睡眠和安适相关的可穿戴与生理接口，例如用于梦境孵化的 Dormio，以及帮助平静的生物反馈可穿戴设备。

orgs.name: MIT Media Lab Tangible Media Group
orgs.description: Hiroshi Ishii's group at the MIT Media Lab, which founded tangible user interfaces and made early remote-touch works such as inTouch (1997), later shape displays (inFORM) and 'radical atoms'. Its work is a starting point for touch and shape-change in soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 石井裕（Hiroshi Ishii）在 MIT 媒体实验室的研究组，开创了可触用户界面，做出了远程触摸的早期作品 inTouch（1997），以及后来的形状显示器 inFORM 和“激进原子”。它是身体设计中触觉与形变研究的起点之一。

orgs.name: Mixed Reality Laboratory (Nottingham)
orgs.description: The University of Nottingham's interdisciplinary HCI lab led by Steve Benford, known for performance-led research with artists (Blast Theory) and for body-centred works such as the breath-controlled Exobuilding and the Broncomatic breathing ride. It is a key partner of Höök's group in soma design and somatic play.
orgs.description_zh: 诺丁汉大学由 Steve Benford 领导的跨学科人机交互实验室，以与艺术家（Blast Theory）合作的表演导向研究著称，也做了由呼吸控制的 Exobuilding、呼吸骑乘装置 Broncomatic 等以身体为中心的作品，是 Höök 团队在身体设计与身体游戏方面的重要伙伴。

orgs.name: Mobile Life Centre
orgs.description: A VINN Excellence Centre (2007–2017) in Kista, Stockholm, hosted by Stockholm University with SICS (now RISE) and the Interactive Institute, co-founded and directed by Kristina Höök. Its studios produced affective-loop and early somaesthetic prototypes (eMoto, Affective Diary, Brightr, Soma Mat) that seeded soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 设在斯德哥尔摩 Kista 的 VINN 卓越中心（2007–2017），由斯德哥尔摩大学主办，SICS（现 RISE）与 Interactive Institute 共同执行，Kristina Höök 是创办人和主任之一。这里做出的情感回路与早期身体美学原型（eMoto、Affective Diary、Brightr、Soma Mat）为身体设计打下了基础。

orgs.name: MOCO: International Conference on Movement and Computing
orgs.description: A conference that brings together dancers, somatic practitioners, artists and researchers working on movement and computation, with papers, performances and workshops. MOCO'26 was held in Montpellier.
orgs.description_zh: 汇集舞者、身体修习者、艺术家与研究者的动作与计算会议，形式包括论文、演出和工作坊。MOCO'26 在蒙彼利埃举行。

orgs.name: Moshé Feldenkrais
orgs.description: Physicist and judoka who created the Feldenkrais Method, gentle, attentive movement lessons that refine self-awareness. Höök and her lab trained in Feldenkrais, and its lessons became a core soma design practice for sensitising the designer.
orgs.description_zh: 物理学家与柔道家，创立费登奎斯方法：以轻柔、专注的动作课程提升自我觉察。Höök 与团队修习费登奎斯，其课程成为身体设计中训练设计师感受力的核心修习。
known_for: The Feldenkrais Method (Awareness Through Movement and Functional Integration)

orgs.name: Motion Bank
orgs.description: A research platform begun by The Forsythe Company (2010–2013) to create online digital scores of choreographers' thinking, continued at Hochschule Mainz as tools for annotating and sharing dance.
orgs.description_zh: Forsythe 舞团发起的研究平台（2010–2013），为编舞家的思考制作在线数字舞谱，之后在美因茨应用科技大学延续，开发标注与分享舞蹈的工具。

orgs.name: Movement Research
orgs.description: A New York laboratory for dance and movement-based practice founded in 1978, offering classes, residencies, the Movement Research at Judson Church series and the Performance Journal; many somatic and release techniques circulated through it.
orgs.description_zh: 1978 年在纽约创立的舞蹈与动作实践实验室，提供课程、驻留、Judson 教堂演出系列和《Performance Journal》，许多身体修习与释放技巧经由这里传播。

orgs.name: Muhammad Umair
orgs.description: Lancaster University researcher whose PhD built wearable biofeedback that turns arousal into visual, vibrotactile and thermal patterns for emotion regulation; co-author of 'From Biodata to Somadata' and the non-dualistic design paper.
orgs.description_zh: 兰卡斯特大学研究者，博士研究把唤醒度转化为视觉、振动与温度模式的可穿戴生物反馈，用于情绪调节；《From Biodata to Somadata》与非二元设计论文的作者之一。
known_for: Exploring Personalized Vibrotactile and Thermal Patterns for Affect Regulation (DIS 2021)
Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)

orgs.name: Myron Krueger
orgs.description: Computer artist whose VIDEOPLACE let people's silhouettes play with graphics and with each other through whole-body movement, decades before motion sensing; an origin of responsive environments.
orgs.description_zh: 计算机艺术家，他的 VIDEOPLACE 让人的身影以全身动作与图形及彼此嬉戏，比动作传感早了几十年；是响应式环境的源头之一。

orgs.name: Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze
orgs.description: UCL Interaction Centre professor of affective computing and the body who studies emotion in movement and touch and designs movement and breathing sonification to build confidence for people with chronic pain.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦大学学院交互中心教授，研究情感计算与身体，考察动作与触碰中的情绪，并为慢性疼痛者设计动作与呼吸的声音化，帮助他们重建动作信心。
known_for: Does Body Movement Engage You More in Digital Game Play? and Why? (ACII 2007)
Affective Body Expression Perception and Recognition: A Survey (IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing, 2013)
As Light as your Footsteps (CHI 2015, with Tajadura-Jiménez)

orgs.name: Nadia Campo Woytuk
orgs.description: Designer and artist at KTH (PhD 2026, 'Feminist Sensing') who designs with the menstruating body through textiles, biomaterials and touch, from Menarche Bits to tactful sensing of vaginal fluids.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 设计师与艺术家（博士 2026，《Feminist Sensing》），以织物、生物材料与触碰，与来月经的身体一起设计，从 Menarche Bits 到对阴道分泌物的“得体感知”。
known_for: Touching and Being in Touch with the Menstruating Body (CHI 2020)
Designing with Intimate Materials and Movements: Making 'Menarche Bits' (DIS 2020)
Tactful Feminist Sensing: Designing for Touching Vaginal Fluids (DIS 2023)

orgs.name: Nancy Stark Smith
orgs.description: Dancer who co-developed Contact Improvisation with Steve Paxton and co-edited Contact Quarterly for decades, spreading the practice and its underscore worldwide.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者，与 Steve Paxton 共同发展接触即兴，并长期合编《Contact Quarterly》，将这一实践及其“底谱”（Underscore）推向世界。

orgs.name: Nassrin Hajinejad
orgs.description: Professor of media informatics at HTW Berlin whose GangKlang project sonified walking to renew walkers' sense of the embodied qualities of their gait; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林应用技术大学（HTW）媒体信息学教授，其 GangKlang 项目把行走声音化，让人重新感受步态的身体品质；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: GangKlang: sonic interaction for walking experiences (Audio Mostly 2016)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: NIME: New Interfaces for Musical Expression
orgs.description: The international conference on new musical instruments and interfaces, where bodily, gestural and biosignal instruments (e.g. muscle-sensing and breath instruments) are presented and performed.
orgs.description_zh: 关于新型乐器与音乐界面的国际会议，许多身体、手势与生物信号乐器（如肌肉感测乐器、呼吸乐器）在此发表并演出。

orgs.name: Nishida Kitarō
orgs.description: Founder of the Kyoto School whose 'pure experience', prior to the split of subject and object, and 'acting intuition', where seeing and making are one bodily act, bring Zen-informed body-mind thought into philosophy.
orgs.description_zh: 京都学派创始人，他主张主客未分的“纯粹经验”，以及看与做在身体行动中合而为一的“行为的直观”，把受禅影响的身心思想带入哲学。

orgs.name: Noguchi Michizō
orgs.description: Japanese physical educator who created Noguchi Taisō, a practice of feeling the body as a water-filled sack moved by gravity and ease rather than muscular effort, influential in Japanese theatre and somatics.
orgs.description_zh: 日本体育教育者，创立野口体操：把身体感受为一个装满水的袋子，借重力与放松而非肌肉用力来运动，影响了日本戏剧与身体修习。
known_for: 原初生命体としての人間 (The Human as Primordial Life Form, 1972)

orgs.name: Noguchi Taisō Association
orgs.description: The group that continues Noguchi Michizō's (1914–1998) Noguchi Taisō, a Japanese movement practice of releasing unnecessary effort and letting weight and fluid move the body, taught for decades at Tokyo University of the Arts.
orgs.description_zh: 传承野口三千三（1914–1998）野口体操的团体。野口体操主张放下多余的力，让重量与体内“液体”带动身体，曾在东京艺术大学教授数十年。

orgs.name: NordiCHI
orgs.description: The Nordic conference on human-computer interaction, a home of the Scandinavian design tradition from which Höök's group and many soma design papers come.
orgs.description_zh: 北欧人机交互会议，是斯堪的纳维亚设计传统的阵地，Höök 团队和许多身体设计论文都出自这一传统。

orgs.name: Noura Howell
orgs.description: Designer-researcher (now at SDU, formerly Georgia Tech's Future Feelings Lab) who critically designs emotional biosensing, showing how ambiguous skin conductance and heart sounds can open reflection instead of fixing emotions as data.
orgs.description_zh: 设计研究者（现任南丹麦大学，曾主持佐治亚理工 Future Feelings Lab），以批判性设计探讨情绪生物传感，展示模糊的皮电与心音如何引发反思，而不是把情绪固定为数据。
known_for: Biosignals as Social Cues: ambiguity and emotional interpretation in social displays of skin conductance (DIS 2016)
Tensions of Data-Driven Reflection: a case study of real-time emotional biosensing (CHI 2018)

orgs.name: NTNU Department of Computer Science (IDI)
orgs.description: The Norwegian University of Science and Technology's computer science department in Trondheim, home of Dag Svanæs, whose work on Merleau-Ponty and interaction design and on 'kinaesthetic thinking' made phenomenology of the body usable for HCI. Svanæs co-organised the Dagstuhl seminar on body-centric computing.
orgs.description_zh: 挪威科技大学位于特隆赫姆的计算机系，Dag Svanæs 在这里工作。他关于 Merleau-Ponty 与交互设计、关于“动觉思维”的研究，让身体现象学能够用于人机交互。他也是 Dagstuhl 身体中心计算研讨会的组织者之一。

orgs.name: NTT InterCommunication Center (ICC)
orgs.description: A media art centre in Tokyo Opera City run by NTT East, showing interactive and sensory works on perception, communication and the body.
orgs.description_zh: 位于东京歌剧城的媒体艺术中心，由 NTT 东日本运营，展出关于感知、沟通与身体的互动和感官作品。

orgs.name: Numeridanse
orgs.description: A free international dance video library run from the Maison de la Danse in Lyon, with performances, documentaries, dance films and masterclasses.
orgs.description_zh: 由里昂舞蹈之家运营的免费国际舞蹈影像库，收录演出、纪录片、舞蹈影片和大师课。

orgs.name: Ohno Kazuo
orgs.description: Co-founder of butoh with Hijikata, whose improvised, deeply interior dancing into his hundreds made the felt inner life of the body visible.
orgs.description_zh: 与土方巽共同开创舞踏，他即兴、极度内在的舞蹈一直持续到百岁，让身体内部的感受生命变得可见。

orgs.name: Open Lab (Newcastle University)
orgs.description: Newcastle University's digital civics and HCI lab, where Madeline Balaam led feminist research on women's intimate health and pelvic-floor technologies before moving to KTH. It is a reference point for feminist and care-oriented soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 纽卡斯尔大学的数字公民与人机交互实验室，Madeline Balaam 在转往 KTH 之前在这里领导了关于女性私密健康和盆底技术的女性主义研究。它是女性主义与关怀取向身体设计的重要参照。

orgs.name: Ozgun Kilic Afsar
orgs.description: Designer-engineer of soft artificial muscles and fluidic fibre actuators (OmniFiber) who worked with Höök's group; Corsetto, a kinesthetic corset that lets a singer's voice be felt on the listener's body, came out of this collaboration.
orgs.description_zh: 软体人工肌肉与流体纤维执行器（OmniFiber）的设计工程师，曾与 Höök 团队合作；Corsetto 就出自这一合作：一件动觉胸衣，让听众在身体上感受到歌者的声音。
known_for: OmniFiber: Integrated Fluidic Fiber Actuators for Weaving Movement based Interactions into the 'Fabric of Everyday Life' (UIST 2021)
Wearable Choreographer: Designing Soft-Robotics for Dance Practice (DIS 2022)
Corsetto: A Kinesthetic Garment for Designing, Composing for, and Experiencing an Intersubjective Haptic Voice (CHI 2023)

orgs.name: Patrizia Marti
orgs.description: University of Siena associate professor in experience design, formerly at TU Eindhoven, who designs for health and inclusion, including socially assistive robots in dementia care; co-author of the 2018 first-person soma paper.
orgs.description_zh: 锡耶纳大学体验设计副教授，曾任教埃因霍温理工大学，为健康与包容而设计，包括用于失智症照护的社会辅助机器人；2018 年第一人称身体设计论文作者之一。
known_for: Socially Assistive Robotics in the Treatment of Behavioural and Psychological Symptoms of Dementia (BioRob 2006)
Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (Informatics, 2018)

orgs.name: Paul Dourish
orgs.description: UC Irvine professor whose 'Where the Action Is' (2001) introduced embodied interaction, grounding HCI in the phenomenology of Heidegger, Schutz and Merleau-Ponty; the theoretical ground soma design builds on.
orgs.description_zh: 加州大学尔湾分校教授，《Where the Action Is》（2001）提出“具身交互”，以海德格尔、舒茨与梅洛-庞蒂的现象学为人机交互奠基，是身体设计所依托的理论基础。
known_for: Embodied Interaction: Exploring the Foundations of a New Approach to HCI (1999 paper)
Where the Action Is: The Foundations of Embodied Interaction (MIT Press, 2001)
Divining a Digital Future (MIT Press, 2011, with Genevieve Bell)

orgs.name: Paul Tennent
orgs.description: Nottingham associate professor who builds breath-controlled games, VR swings and rides, and led the Nottingham–KTH work on soma trajectories and sensory misalignment.
orgs.description_zh: 诺丁汉大学副教授，制作以呼吸控制的游戏、VR 秋千与游乐设施，主导了诺丁汉与 KTH 在身体轨迹与感官错位方面的合作研究。
known_for: Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)

orgs.name: Pavel Karpashevich
orgs.description: Höök's PhD student (KTH 2023, 'Designing Monstrous Experiences Through Soma Design') who built shape-changing, on-body interfaces around breathing and deep touch pressure, reading their unsettling effects through monster theory.
orgs.description_zh: Höök 的博士生（KTH 2023，论文《Designing Monstrous Experiences Through Soma Design》），围绕呼吸与深压触觉设计贴身的形变界面，并借“怪物理论”解读其令人不安的体验。
known_for: Exploring Awareness of Breathing through Deep Touch Pressure (CHI 2021)
Touching Our Breathing through Shape-Change: Monster, Organic Other, or Twisted Mirror (TOCHI 2022)
Designing Monstrous Experiences Through Soma Design (PhD thesis, KTH, 2023)

orgs.name: Pedro Ferreira
orgs.description: Höök's PhD student (KTH 2015) who studied play and leisure in ICT for development and co-authored studies of the bodily and playful use of mobile phones; now at IT University of Copenhagen.
orgs.description_zh: Höök 的博士生（KTH 2015），研究面向发展的信息技术中的游戏与闲暇，并参与撰写手机使用中身体性与玩乐的研究；现任职于哥本哈根 IT 大学。
known_for: Play as Freedom: Implications for ICT4D (PhD thesis, KTH, 2015)

orgs.name: Pedro Lopes
orgs.description: University of Chicago associate professor who designs electrical muscle stimulation interfaces that move the user's own muscles, and studies with neuroscientists how such integration affects the sense of agency.
orgs.description_zh: 芝加哥大学副教授，设计以电刺激驱动使用者自身肌肉的界面，并与神经科学家研究这种“身体融合”如何影响能动感。
known_for: Affordance++: allowing objects to communicate dynamic use via electrical muscle stimulation (CHI 2015)
Providing Haptics to Walls & Heavy Objects in Virtual Reality by Means of Electrical Muscle Stimulation (CHI 2017)
Context-aware AI + EMS movement guidance (CHI 2026 Best Paper, students Yun Ho and Romain Nith)

orgs.name: Pedro Sanches
orgs.description: Umeå University researcher who worked for over a decade in Höök's group on biodata and affective health. He co-authored 'From Biodata to Somadata' and 'Teaching Soma Design', and brings feminist epistemologies to designing biodata and AI for bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 于默奥大学研究者，在 Höök 团队从事生物数据与情感健康研究十余年。他是《From Biodata to Somadata》《Teaching Soma Design》的作者之一，把女性主义认识论带入面向身体的生物数据与 AI 设计。
known_for: Touching Our Breathing through Shape-Change: Monster, Organic Other, or Twisted Mirror (TOCHI 2022)
Making New Worlds – Transformative Becomings with Soma Design (CHI 2022)

orgs.name: Peter A. Levine
orgs.description: Psychologist who developed Somatic Experiencing, a body-based approach to trauma that tracks sensation and lets arrested survival responses complete, widely used in somatic therapy.
orgs.description_zh: 心理学家，创立身体经验疗法（Somatic Experiencing）：一种以身体为本的创伤疗法，追踪身体感觉，让受阻的生存反应得以完成，广泛用于身体疗愈。

orgs.name: Phenomenology and the Cognitive Sciences
orgs.description: A Springer journal linking phenomenology with cognitive science, home of much work on embodiment, enaction and first-person methods (founded by Shaun Gallagher and Natalie Depraz).
orgs.description_zh: Springer 出版的期刊，连接现象学与认知科学，发表了大量关于具身、生成论与第一人称方法的研究（由 Shaun Gallagher 与 Natalie Depraz 创办）。

orgs.name: Philippe Pasquier
orgs.description: SFU professor and director of the Metacreation Lab for Creative AI who founded the MOCO conference on movement and computing and co-supervised breath and micro-phenomenology work with Schiphorst.
orgs.description_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学教授、Metacreation 创意 AI 实验室主任，创办了运动与计算会议 MOCO，并与 Schiphorst 合作指导呼吸与微观现象学方向的研究。
known_for: Founder of the ACM International Conference on Movement and Computing (MOCO)
Inhaling and Exhaling (CHI 2020, with Prpa, Schiphorst et al.)
Articulating Experience (CHI 2020, with Prpa, Fdili Alaoui, Schiphorst)

orgs.name: Phoebe Sengers
orgs.description: Cornell professor whose 'Reflective Design' and work on openness and ambiguity in evaluating experience (with Höök and colleagues) shaped the non-reductive approach to emotion that led to affective loops.
orgs.description_zh: 康奈尔大学教授，其《Reflective Design》以及与 Höök 等人关于体验评估中开放性与模糊性的研究，塑造了不化约的情绪观，促成了“情感回路”思路。
known_for: Sense and sensibility: evaluation and interactive art (CHI 2003, with K. Höök and G. Andersson)
Reflective Design (Critical Computing 2005, with Boehner, David, Kaye)

orgs.name: Pierre Vermersch
orgs.description: French psychologist who created the explicitation interview (entretien d'explicitation) for eliciting detailed descriptions of lived action, the basis of micro-phenomenology and of many first-person methods in design research.
orgs.description_zh: 法国心理学家，创立“引导式访谈”（entretien d'explicitation），用以引出对亲历行动的细致描述；这是微观现象学以及设计研究中许多第一人称方法的基础。

orgs.name: Plum Village
orgs.description: The monastery and practice centre founded by Zen master Thich Nhat Hanh in south-west France, teaching mindful breathing, walking meditation and 'interbeing' to a worldwide lay community.
orgs.description_zh: 一行禅师在法国西南部创办的禅修道场，向全世界的在家修行者传授正念呼吸、行禅与“相即”（interbeing）。

orgs.name: Rachael Garrett
orgs.description: Höök's PhD student (KTH 2026, 'Somatic Freedoms') who treats ethics as something felt in the body during design, through 'felt ethics' and vulnerability in soma design. At Nottingham's Somabotics she works on dancing with robots and the Drone Gymnasium.
orgs.description_zh: Höök 的博士生（KTH 2026，论文《Somatic Freedoms》），通过“被感受的伦理”与身体设计中的脆弱性，把伦理视为设计过程中身体里的感受。她在诺丁汉 Somabotics 项目中研究与机器人共舞和 Drone Gymnasium。
known_for: Vulnerability as an ethical stance in soma design processes (CHI 2022)
Felt Ethics: Cultivating Ethical Sensibility in Design Practice (CHI 2023)
Somatic Freedoms: Reconfiguring Human-Machine Ethical Relations (PhD thesis, KTH, 2026)

orgs.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
orgs.description: Mexican-Canadian artist whose biometric installations, such as Pulse Room, where each visitor's heartbeat makes a bulb flicker among hundreds, turn shared bodily rhythms into public space.
orgs.description_zh: 墨西哥裔加拿大艺术家，其生物识别装置如《Pulse Room》：每位观众的心跳使一盏灯泡在数百盏中闪烁，把共享的身体节律变成公共空间。

orgs.name: Reality Design Lab
orgs.description: Botao 'Amber' Hu's lab designing speculative and immersive realities (HoloKit, EchoVision) and teaching 'Somaesthetic Realities'; it makes this gallery, Somatic Reality Inspire.
orgs.description_zh: 胡博涛（Botao “Amber” Hu）的实验室，设计思辨性与沉浸式的现实（HoloKit、EchoVision），开设“身体美学现实”课程；本站 Somatic Reality Inspire 由它制作。

orgs.name: Rebecca Fiebrink
orgs.description: UAL professor of creative computing whose Wekinator lets musicians and artists train machine learning by demonstration to map body movement to sound and media.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦艺术大学创意计算教授，她开发的 Wekinator 让音乐人和艺术家通过示范训练机器学习，把身体动作映射为声音与媒体。
known_for: Real-time interaction with supervised learning (CHI EA 2010)
Machine Learning for Musicians and Artists (first online course on ML for music and art)

orgs.name: Rebecca Horn
orgs.description: German artist whose early body extensions, prosthetic gloves, fans and masks, altered how wearers touch and sense space, early examples of wearable estrangement.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，她早期的身体延伸装置（义肢手套、扇子与面具）改变了穿戴者触碰与感知空间的方式，是可穿戴“陌生化”的早期范例。

orgs.name: Richard Shusterman
orgs.description: Pragmatist philosopher at Florida Atlantic University who founded somaesthetics, the study of the body as the site of sensory appreciation and creative self-fashioning. Höök's soma design takes its name and its call for cultivated bodily awareness from his work, which also draws on Confucian and Zen self-cultivation.
orgs.description_zh: 佛罗里达大西洋大学的实用主义哲学家，创立身体美学：研究身体作为感官鉴赏与创造性自我塑造的所在。Höök 的身体设计沿用了他的术语与“修养身体觉察”的主张；他的思想也汲取儒家与禅宗的修身传统。

orgs.name: Rohit Ashok Khot
orgs.description: RMIT senior lecturer from the Exertion Games Lab who materialises bodily data as edible or printed artefacts, such as SweatAtoms and EdiPulse's heart-rate chocolate, and designs playful eating experiences.
orgs.description_zh: 皇家墨尔本理工大学高级讲师，出自 Exertion Games Lab，把身体数据物化为可食或打印的物件，如 SweatAtoms 与以心率制作巧克力的 EdiPulse，并设计好玩的饮食体验。
known_for: SweatAtoms: materializing physical activity as 3D-printed artefacts (OzCHI 2013)
Playful human-food interaction projects (e.g., GustaCine, SWAN)

orgs.name: Ron Kurtz
orgs.description: Psychotherapist who created the Hakomi Method, a body-centred, mindfulness-based therapy that uses gentle experiments in present-moment bodily experience.
orgs.description_zh: 心理治疗师，创立 Hakomi 方法：一种以身体为中心、以正念为基础的疗法，在当下的身体经验中进行温和的实验。

orgs.name: Rosalind Picard
orgs.description: MIT professor who founded affective computing (1997) and wearable electrodermal sensing; soma design and affective loops developed partly in response to her recognition-based model of emotion.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院教授，1997 年开创情感计算与可穿戴皮电传感；身体设计与情感回路在一定程度上是对她“识别式”情绪模型的回应。
known_for: Toward machine emotional intelligence: analysis of affective physiological state (IEEE TPAMI, 2001)
Co-founder of Affectiva and Empatica (wearable biosignal sensing)

orgs.name: Rudolf Laban
orgs.description: Dance theorist who created Labanotation and the effort and space theory that became Laban Movement Analysis, the vocabulary movement computing and MOCO researchers use to model movement qualities.
orgs.description_zh: 舞蹈理论家，创立拉班舞谱与力效、空间理论，后发展为拉班动作分析；运动计算与 MOCO 研究者用它来描述与建模动作质感。

orgs.name: San Francisco Zen Center
orgs.description: The Sōtō Zen community founded by Shunryu Suzuki, author of Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind, which runs City Center, Green Gulch Farm and Tassajara; a main route by which zazen reached Western designers and scholars.
orgs.description_zh: 铃木俊隆创办的曹洞宗禅修团体，他著有《禅者的初心》；中心运营城市中心、绿谷农场和塔萨哈拉禅山中心，是坐禅进入西方设计者与学者视野的主要途径之一。

orgs.name: Sarah Fdili Alaoui
orgs.description: Dancer and professor at UAL's Creative Computing Institute who integrates computation into choreography and somatic practice through Laban movement qualities, questioning how technology enters dance-making.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者、伦敦艺术大学创意计算研究院教授，借 Laban 动作质感把计算融入编舞与身体修习，并追问技术如何进入舞蹈创作。
known_for: From dance to touch: movement qualities for interaction design (CHI EA 2011)
Seeing, Sensing and Recognizing Laban Movement Qualities (CHI 2017)
Making an Interactive Dance Piece: tensions in integrating technology in art (DIS 2019)

orgs.name: Sarah Homewood
orgs.description: Former contemporary dancer and University of Copenhagen researcher who studies how self-tracking shapes views of bodies (fertility, menstrual cycles, long COVID), proposing removal as a design method and tracing conceptions of the body in HCI.
orgs.description_zh: 前当代舞者、哥本哈根大学研究者，研究自我追踪如何塑造人们对身体（生育、经期、长新冠）的看法，提出“移除”作为设计方法，并梳理人机交互中的身体观。
known_for: Ovum: Designing for Fertility Tracking as a Shared and Domestic Experience (DIS 2019)
Tracing Conceptions of the Body in HCI: From User to More-Than-Human (CHI 2021)

orgs.name: Scott Klemmer
orgs.description: UC San Diego professor and co-founder of its Design Lab whose 'How Bodies Matter: Five Themes for Interaction Design' (DIS 2006) is a widely cited statement of embodied cognition for interaction design.
orgs.description_zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校教授、设计实验室联合创始人，其《How Bodies Matter: Five Themes for Interaction Design》（DIS 2006）是交互设计中被广泛引用的具身认知宣言。
known_for: Papier-Mâché: toolkit support for tangible input (CHI 2004)
How Bodies Matter: Five Themes for Interaction Design (DIS 2006)

orgs.name: Seitai Kyokai
orgs.description: The Japanese association founded by Haruchika Noguchi to teach seitai, including katsugen undō, spontaneous 'regenerating movement' that lets the body move by itself, and yukiho, attentive laying-on of hands.
orgs.description_zh: 野口晴哉创办的日本整体协会，传授整体法，包括让身体自发运动的“活元运动”和专注的“愉气法”（手当）。

orgs.name: SFU School of Interactive Arts & Technology (SIAT)
orgs.description: Simon Fraser University's school in Surrey, BC, where Thecla Schiphorst brought somatics and dance into interaction design (whisper, soft(n), somatic connoisseurship), Philippe Pasquier's Metacreation Lab works on movement and generative art, and Diane Gromala built pain-focused VR.
orgs.description_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学位于萨里的学院：Thecla Schiphorst 在这里把身体修习和舞蹈带进交互设计（whisper、soft(n)、身体鉴赏力），Philippe Pasquier 的 Metacreation Lab 研究动作与生成艺术，Diane Gromala 做了面向疼痛的虚拟现实。

orgs.name: Sha Xin Wei
orgs.description: ASU professor and founder of the Topological Media Lab and Synthesis Center whose responsive environments and 'Poiesis and Enchantment in Topological Matter' treat gesture and movement as processual, felt experience.
orgs.description_zh: 亚利桑那州立大学教授，创办 Topological Media Lab 与 Synthesis Center。他的响应式环境与著作《Poiesis and Enchantment in Topological Matter》把手势与动作视为过程性的、被感受的经验。
known_for: Poiesis and Enchantment in Topological Matter (MIT Press, 2013)

orgs.name: Shaowen Bardzell
orgs.description: Taiwanese-American HCI scholar at Georgia Tech who set out the feminist HCI agenda (CHI 2010) and wrote on pleasure, sexuality and care, groundwork for intimate and feminist soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 台裔美国人机交互学者，任教于佐治亚理工学院。她提出女性主义人机交互议程（CHI 2010），并论述愉悦、性与照护，为亲密与女性主义身体设计奠定基础。
known_for: Feminist HCI: taking stock and outlining an agenda for design (CHI 2010)
Pleasure is your birthright: digitally enabled designer sex toys as a case of third-wave HCI (CHI 2011, with J. Bardzell)
Humanistic HCI (Morgan & Claypool, 2015, with J. Bardzell)

orgs.name: Shaun Gallagher
orgs.description: Philosopher at the University of Memphis who clarified the difference between body schema and body image and developed enactivist and phenomenological accounts of embodied cognition used in HCI and design.
orgs.description_zh: 孟菲斯大学哲学家，厘清了身体图式与身体意象的区别，并发展出生成主义与现象学取向的具身认知理论，为人机交互与设计所用。
known_for: How the Body Shapes the Mind (2005)

orgs.name: Shen Wei
orgs.description: Chinese choreographer and painter who created Natural Body Development, a movement system drawing on Chinese opera, tai chi and anatomy, and choreographed the 2008 Beijing Olympics opening scroll.
orgs.description_zh: 中国编舞家与画家，创立“自然身体发展”动作体系，汲取戏曲、太极与解剖学，并为 2008 年北京奥运会开幕式编排画卷段落。

orgs.name: Shigehisa Kuriyama
orgs.description: Harvard historian of medicine whose comparison of Greek and Chinese medicine shows how touching the pulse and seeing the muscles produced different felt bodies, a reminder that body experience is culturally trained.
orgs.description_zh: 哈佛医学史学者，他对希腊与中国医学的比较显示：切脉与看肌肉塑造出不同的被感受的身体，提醒我们身体经验是文化训练的结果。
known_for: The Expressiveness of the Body and the Divergence of Greek and Chinese Medicine (1999)

orgs.name: Shunryū Suzuki
orgs.description: Sōtō Zen priest who founded the San Francisco Zen Center; 'Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind' taught zazen posture and breath as the practice itself, shaping Western contemplative practice.
orgs.description_zh: 曹洞宗僧人，创立旧金山禅中心；《禅者的初心》把坐禅的姿势与呼吸本身作为修行，塑造了西方的沉思修习。

orgs.name: Social Emotional Technology Lab (UC Santa Cruz)
orgs.description: Katherine Isbister's lab at UC Santa Cruz designing games and wearables for social and emotional connection, including physical co-located play and the Sensual Evaluation Instrument lineage. Isbister is a long-time collaborator of Höök on affective and somaesthetic design.
orgs.description_zh: Katherine Isbister 在加州大学圣克鲁兹分校的实验室，设计促进社交与情感联结的游戏和可穿戴设备，包括同处一地的身体游戏，也延续了感官评估工具（Sensual Evaluation Instrument）的思路。Isbister 长期与 Höök 合作研究情感与身体美学设计。

orgs.name: Society of Teachers of the Alexander Technique (STAT)
orgs.name_zh: 亚历山大技巧教师协会
orgs.description: The oldest professional body for the Alexander Technique, founded in London in 1958 by teachers trained by F. M. Alexander; it accredits teacher-training courses and runs an extensive public guide to the Technique.
orgs.description_zh: 历史最悠久的亚历山大技巧专业团体，1958 年由 F. M. Alexander 亲自培训的教师在伦敦创立，负责认证教师培训课程，并维护内容丰富的公众指南。

orgs.name: Soma Bits (KTH)
orgs.description: KTH's page for the Soma Bits, a prototyping toolkit of soft shapes with heat, vibration and shape-changing actuators that designers place on and around the body to feel and share what a design might feel like.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 的 Soma Bits 页面。Soma Bits 是一套原型工具包：带有加热、振动与形变执行器的柔软形体，设计者把它们放在身上或身体周围，去感受并分享一个设计“会是什么感觉”。

orgs.name: Soma-Based Design Theory (CHI 2017 workshop)
orgs.description: A CHI 2017 workshop that followed the CHI 2016 meeting on aesthetics in soma-based design and moved from philosophy to design theory, asking how practical, pragmatic and analytical work can build soma design knowledge.
orgs.description_zh: CHI 2017 的工作坊，承接 2016 年关于身体设计美学的讨论，从哲学转向设计理论，探讨如何通过实践、实用与分析的工作积累身体设计知识。

orgs.name: Somatechnics
orgs.description: An Edinburgh University Press journal on how bodies and technologies co-constitute each other, with a strong feminist and queer focus.
orgs.description_zh: 爱丁堡大学出版社的期刊，研究身体与技术如何相互构成，具有鲜明的女性主义与酷儿视角。

orgs.name: Somatic Experiencing International
orgs.name_zh: 国际身体经验疗法协会
orgs.description: The organisation that trains practitioners in Peter Levine's Somatic Experiencing, a body-based approach to trauma that works with felt sensation, titration and the nervous system's capacity to settle.
orgs.description_zh: 培训 Peter Levine 身体经验疗法（Somatic Experiencing）从业者的机构。这种以身体为本的创伤疗法通过感受觉察、逐步滴定和神经系统自我平复的能力来工作。

orgs.name: Stelarc
orgs.description: Cypriot-Australian performance artist who extends and exposes the body with robotic arms, internet-actuated muscles and a cell-grown ear, provoking questions about the obsolete and augmented body.
orgs.description_zh: 塞浦路斯裔澳大利亚表演艺术家，以机械臂、由网络驱动的肌肉与细胞培养的耳朵延展和暴露身体，引发关于“过时”与增强身体的追问。

orgs.name: Steve Benford
orgs.description: Co-founder of Nottingham's Mixed Reality Lab whose trajectories framework for performance and cultural experiences was extended to soma design with Höök and Tennent; co-author of 'Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design' and lead of Somabotics.
orgs.description_zh: 诺丁汉混合现实实验室联合创始人，他为表演与文化体验提出的“轨迹”框架，后与 Höök、Tennent 一起扩展到身体设计；《Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design》作者之一，主持 Somabotics 项目。
known_for: Performing Mixed Reality (MIT Press, 2011, with Gabriella Giannachi)
Unpacking Non-Dualistic Design: The Soma Design Case (TOCHI 2021)

orgs.name: Steve Paxton
orgs.description: Dancer and Judson Dance Theater member who initiated Contact Improvisation, where partners move through shared weight, touch and momentum; a model for designing with touch and intercorporeality.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者、贾德森舞蹈剧场成员，开创接触即兴：舞伴通过分担重量、触碰与动量一起移动；这是以触碰与身体间性做设计的范本。

orgs.name: Susan Kozel
orgs.description: Dancer-philosopher at Malmö University whose 'Closer: Performance, Technologies, Phenomenology' (2007) reworks Merleau-Ponty from inside dance with interactive systems; she now develops somatic archiving with mixed reality.
orgs.description_zh: 马尔默大学的舞者兼哲学家，其《Closer: Performance, Technologies, Phenomenology》（2007）从舞蹈与互动系统内部重读梅洛-庞蒂；现研究以混合现实进行“身体存档”。
known_for: Ten Permissions for Facilitating (Live) Design Activities (DIS 2024, with Höök and Andersen)

orgs.name: Synchronous Objects
orgs.description: An online project by William Forsythe and Ohio State University (2009) that translates the choreographic structure of One Flat Thing, reproduced into data visualisations and animated objects.
orgs.description_zh: William Forsythe 与俄亥俄州立大学合作的在线项目（2009），把作品《One Flat Thing, reproduced》的编舞结构转译成数据可视化与动态对象。

orgs.name: Synthesis Center (Arizona State University)
orgs.description: Sha Xin Wei's research centre at ASU building responsive environments in which movement, sound and light co-evolve, grounded in phenomenology and process philosophy; it continues the Topological Media Lab's work from Concordia University.
orgs.description_zh: Sha Xin Wei 在亚利桑那州立大学的研究中心，建造动作、声音与光共同变化的响应式环境，理论基础是现象学与过程哲学，延续了他在康考迪亚大学 Topological Media Lab 的工作。

orgs.name: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB)
orgs.description: A cultural laboratory on a former air-force base in Taipei with a Future Vision Lab and technology-art residencies, showing immersive, sound and body-based work.
orgs.description_zh: 位于台北原空军总部旧址的文化实验场，设有未来视觉实验室和科技艺术驻留，呈现沉浸式、声音与身体相关的作品。

orgs.name: Tamalpa Institute
orgs.description: Founded in 1978 by Anna and Daria Halprin in Marin County, California, the institute trains people in the Life/Art Process, a movement-based expressive arts therapy that links body, feeling and imagery.
orgs.description_zh: 1978 年由 Anna Halprin 与 Daria Halprin 在加州马林县创办，教授“生命/艺术过程”（Life/Art Process）：一种以动作为基础、把身体、情感与意象连在一起的表达性艺术疗法。

orgs.name: Tanzfabrik Berlin
orgs.description: A Berlin production house and dance school with a long-standing programme of contact improvisation, release and somatic classes, residencies and performances.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的制作中心兼舞蹈学校，长期开设接触即兴、释放技巧和身体修习课程，并提供驻留与演出。

orgs.name: Tanzquartier Wien
orgs.description: Vienna's centre for contemporary dance and performance in the MuseumsQuartier, combining performances with theory, research and a public dance library.
orgs.description_zh: 位于维也纳博物馆区的当代舞蹈与表演中心，把演出与理论、研究和公共舞蹈图书馆结合在一起。

orgs.name: Tehching Hsieh
orgs.description: Taiwanese-American artist whose year-long performances, punching a time clock every hour or being tied to another person, make lived time and bodily endurance the material of art.
orgs.description_zh: 台裔美国艺术家，他长达一年的行为作品（每小时打卡一次，或与他人以绳相系）把亲历的时间与身体的耐受作为艺术材料。

orgs.name: Teresa Almeida
orgs.description: Instituto Superior Técnico assistant professor whose feminist design research on intimate care created Labella for pelvic fitness and treats the body as an ecosystem.
orgs.description_zh: 里斯本高等理工学院助理教授，其女性主义设计研究关注亲密照护，创作了盆底训练系统 Labella，并把身体视为生态系统。
known_for: Labella: looking at the vagina through an interactive pelvic-fitness system (CHI 2016 Interactivity)
Woman-Centered Design through Humanity, Activism, and Inclusion (ACM TOCHI, 2020)

orgs.name: The Discipline of Authentic Movement
orgs.description: Janet Adler's development of Mary Starks Whitehouse's Authentic Movement: a mover moves with eyes closed while a witness attends, training embodied presence and first-person articulation.
orgs.description_zh: Janet Adler 在 Mary Starks Whitehouse 的真实动作（Authentic Movement）基础上发展出的修习：动者闭眼移动，见证者在旁专注观照，训练具身的在场与第一人称表达。

orgs.name: The International Focusing Institute
orgs.description: The institute founded by Eugene Gendlin to teach Focusing, attending to the bodily 'felt sense' of a situation before words, and his Thinking at the Edge. Soma designers use Focusing to articulate felt experience.
orgs.description_zh: Eugene Gendlin 创办的机构，教授体会聚焦（Focusing）：在言语之前关注对一个情境的身体“体会”（felt sense），以及“边缘思考”（Thinking at the Edge）。身体设计者用 Focusing 来说出被感受到的经验。

orgs.name: The Journal of Somaesthetics
orgs.description: The open-access journal of somaesthetics published by Aalborg University Press with Florida Atlantic University's Center for Body, Mind, and Culture; its 2019 issue 'Somaesthetics and Technology' gathered soma design work.
orgs.description_zh: 由奥尔堡大学出版社与佛罗里达大西洋大学身体、心智与文化中心合作出版的开放获取身体美学期刊；2019 年的“身体美学与技术”专刊收录了身体设计研究。

orgs.name: The School for Body-Mind Centering
orgs.description: The school founded by Bonnie Bainbridge Cohen to teach Body-Mind Centering, an experiential study of body systems, developmental movement and embodied anatomy that shapes somatic dance and several soma design methods.
orgs.description_zh: Bonnie Bainbridge Cohen 创办的学校，教授身心平衡技法（Body-Mind Centering）：以亲身体验来研究身体各系统、发展性动作和具身解剖，影响了身体舞蹈和多种身体设计方法。

orgs.name: Thecla Schiphorst
orgs.description: Dancer, computer scientist and SFU professor who brought somatic practice and Laban analysis into HCI; a member of the original LifeForms team with Merce Cunningham, she made soft(n), whisper[s] and exhale and wrote on somatic connoisseurship.
orgs.description_zh: 舞者、计算机科学家、西蒙菲莎大学教授，把身体修习与 Laban 分析带入人机交互；她是与 Merce Cunningham 合作的 LifeForms 最初团队成员，创作了 soft(n)、whisper[s]、exhale，并论述“身体鉴赏力”。
known_for: Life Forms choreography software (collaboration with Merce Cunningham, 1990–2005)
soft(n): toward a somaesthetics of touch (CHI EA 2009)
Self-evidence: applying somatic connoisseurship to experience design (CHI EA 2011)
The somatic turn in human-computer interaction (Interactions, 2018, with Lian Loke)

orgs.name: Thomas Fuchs
orgs.description: Psychiatrist and philosopher at Heidelberg University who develops phenomenological psychiatry and an ecological view of the brain as an organ of a living, embodied being, including work on body memory and intercorporeality.
orgs.description_zh: 海德堡大学精神科医生与哲学家，发展现象学精神病学，并把大脑视为一个活的、具身存在的器官；也研究身体记忆与身体间性。
known_for: In Defence of the Human Being (2021)

orgs.name: Thomas Hanna
orgs.description: Philosopher and Feldenkrais practitioner who coined 'somatics' and defined the soma as the body perceived from within by first-person perception, the sense of 'soma' that soma design adopts; founder of Hanna Somatic Education.
orgs.description_zh: 哲学家与费登奎斯修习者，创造了“somatics”（身心学）一词，把 soma 定义为从内部以第一人称感知到的身体，身体设计中的“soma”即取此义；他也是 Hanna 身心教育的创始人。

orgs.name: Thích Nhất Hạnh
orgs.description: Vietnamese Zen monk who founded Plum Village and taught mindful breathing and walking meditation worldwide; his practices of coming home to the body through breath inform breath-based design.
orgs.description_zh: 越南禅宗僧人，创立梅村，在世界各地教授正念呼吸与行禅；他“借呼吸回到身体”的修习启发了以呼吸为核心的设计。

orgs.name: Toni Robertson
orgs.description: Retired UTS professor whose taxonomy of embodied actions (1997) was an early phenomenological account of the body in cooperative work; she led the UTS movement-based interaction line with Loke and Larssen.
orgs.description_zh: 悉尼科技大学退休教授，1997 年提出的“具身行动分类”是对协同工作中身体最早的现象学阐述之一；她与 Loke、Larssen 一起开创了悉尼科技大学以动作为基础的交互研究。
known_for: Cooperative Work and Lived Cognition: A Taxonomy of Embodied Actions (ECSCW 1997)
Understanding movement for interaction design: frameworks and approaches (PUC, 2006)
The feel dimension of technology interaction (TEI 2007)
Moving and Making Strange (TOCHI 2013, with Lian Loke)

orgs.name: Trinity Laban Conservatoire of Music and Dance
orgs.name_zh: 圣三一拉班音乐舞蹈学院
orgs.description: The London conservatoire whose dance faculty descends from Rudolf Laban's Art of Movement Studio and the Laban Centre; it houses the Laban Archive and teaches somatic approaches alongside contemporary dance.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦的音乐与舞蹈学院，其舞蹈部门源自 Rudolf Laban 的动作艺术工作室和拉班中心，收藏拉班档案，并在当代舞之外教授身体修习方法。

orgs.name: Trisha Brown
orgs.description: Postmodern choreographer whose release-based, fluid movement and gravity-defying equipment pieces changed how dancers use weight, momentum and ease.
orgs.description_zh: 后现代编舞家，她以释放为基础的流动动作与借器械对抗重力的作品，改变了舞者运用重量、动量与轻松的方式。
known_for: Man Walking Down the Side of a Building (1970)

orgs.name: Tsinghua University Future Laboratory
orgs.description: An interdisciplinary laboratory at Tsinghua University in Beijing whose Center for Perception and Consciousness Research designs multisensory, touch-based experiences such as tactile music appreciation and dream visualisation, and which publishes widely at CHI on haptics and human-computer interaction.
orgs.description_zh: 清华大学的跨学科实验室。其感知与意识研究中心设计以触觉为主的多感官体验，例如“音乐可触化”和梦境可视化，实验室也在 CHI 上发表了大量触觉与人机交互研究。

orgs.name: Tu Weiming
orgs.description: New Confucian philosopher at Harvard and Peking University who describes Confucian learning as embodied knowing (tizhi) and self-cultivation (xiushen), a Chinese frame for the knowing body in soma design.
orgs.description_zh: 任教哈佛与北京大学的新儒家哲学家，把儒家之学阐释为“体知”与“修身”，为身体设计中“会知的身体”提供了中文思想框架。
known_for: Confucian Thought: Selfhood as Creative Transformation (1985)

orgs.name: TU/e Department of Industrial Design
orgs.description: Eindhoven University of Technology's design department, where Caroline Hummels and colleagues developed embodied, phenomenology-informed design education and research (skills-based design, embodied sensemaking, transformative practices). Hummels co-organised the CHI 2017 soma-based design theory workshop.
orgs.description_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学工业设计系：Caroline Hummels 等人在这里发展出受现象学启发的具身设计教育与研究（基于技能的设计、具身意义建构、转化性实践）。Hummels 也是 CHI 2017 身体设计理论工作坊的组织者之一。

orgs.name: UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC)
orgs.description: University College London's HCI centre, home of Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze's research on affective body movement and touch, including movement sonification for people with chronic pain (Go-with-the-Flow) and body-perception work with Ana Tajadura-Jiménez.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦大学学院的人机交互中心，Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze 在这里研究带情感的身体动作与触摸，包括为慢性疼痛患者设计的动作声音化（Go-with-the-Flow），以及与 Ana Tajadura-Jiménez 合作的身体感知研究。

orgs.name: Ueshiba Morihei
orgs.description: Founder of aikido, a martial art of blending with an attacker's movement and ki, framed as a spiritual practice of harmony; a reference for designing with partnered movement and yielding.
orgs.description_zh: 合气道创始人。合气道顺应对手的动作与“气”，被视为追求和谐的精神修习；是设计双人协同动作与“顺势”的参照。

orgs.name: UMass Memorial Center for Mindfulness
orgs.description: The centre that grew from Jon Kabat-Zinn's Stress Reduction Clinic (1979) at the University of Massachusetts Medical School, where Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction and its body scan were developed and taught.
orgs.description_zh: 源自 Jon Kabat-Zinn 1979 年在麻省大学医学院创办的减压诊所，正念减压（MBSR）及其身体扫描练习在这里形成并传授。

orgs.name: University of Sydney Design Lab
orgs.description: The research arm of design at the University of Sydney's School of Architecture, Design and Planning (formerly the Key Centre of Design Computing and Cognition). Lian Loke, a former head, translates dance and somatic knowledge into interaction design, e.g. Labanotation for movement-based interaction and the 'moving and making strange' approach with Toni Robertson.
orgs.description_zh: 悉尼大学建筑、设计与规划学院的设计研究部门（前身为设计计算与认知重点中心）。曾任负责人的 Lian Loke 把舞蹈和身体修习的知识转译为交互设计，例如用拉班舞谱描述动作交互，以及与 Toni Robertson 提出的“移动与陌生化”方法。

orgs.name: V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
orgs.description: The Rotterdam centre for art and technology that has long supported body-centred media art, from sensor-based performance to wearable and interactive installations.
orgs.description_zh: 鹿特丹的艺术与技术中心，长期支持以身体为中心的媒体艺术，从传感器表演到可穿戴与互动装置。

orgs.name: Vasiliki Tsaknaki
orgs.description: Associate professor at IT University of Copenhagen who came through KTH with craft-based interaction design. She co-developed soma design pedagogy and the politics of the body with Höök's group and proposed 'breathing-with' as a more-than-human design tactic.
orgs.description_zh: 哥本哈根 IT 大学副教授，在 KTH 以手工艺取向的交互设计完成博士。她与 Höök 团队共同发展了身体设计教学与“身体政治”视角，并提出“一起呼吸”（breathing-with）这一超越人类的设计策略。
known_for: Making Preciousness: Interaction Design Through Studio Crafts (PhD thesis, KTH, 2017)
Soma Design and Politics of the Body (HttF 2019)
'Breathing-with': a design tactic for the more-than-human (HCI journal, 2023)

orgs.name: Vipassana Meditation (dhamma.org)
orgs.description: The worldwide network of centres offering S. N. Goenka's free ten-day Vipassana courses, in which practitioners systematically scan bodily sensations with equanimity, one of the most widespread body-scan practices.
orgs.description_zh: 葛印卡（S. N. Goenka）内观禅修的全球中心网络，提供免费的十日课程：学员以平等心有系统地扫描身体感受，这是流传最广的身体扫描修习之一。

orgs.name: Vittorio Gallese
orgs.description: Neuroscientist at the University of Parma, co-discoverer of mirror neurons, whose embodied simulation theory explains how we understand others' actions and feelings by re-enacting them in our own bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 帕尔马大学神经科学家，镜像神经元的共同发现者，其“具身模拟”理论解释我们如何通过在自己身体中重演他人的动作与感受来理解他人。
known_for: Discovery of mirror neurons (1990s, Parma group)

orgs.name: Vygandas Šimbelis
orgs.description: Lithuanian-Swedish artist ('Das Vegas') and Höök's PhD student (KTH 2018) whose post-digital art repurposes devices; Metaphone turned biodata into sound and image.
orgs.description_zh: 立陶宛裔瑞典艺术家（艺名 Das Vegas），Höök 的博士生（KTH 2018），其后数字艺术改造既有设备；作品 Metaphone 把生物数据转化为声音与图像。
known_for: Repurposing Bits and Pieces of the Digital (CHI 2016)
Humanizing Technology Through Post-Digital Art (PhD thesis, KTH, 2018)

orgs.name: Wang Xiangzhai
orgs.description: Chinese martial artist who founded Yiquan and championed zhan zhuang (standing post), a practice of cultivating whole-body awareness and intent through stillness.
orgs.description_zh: 中国武术家，创立意拳并倡导站桩：以静立培养全身的觉察与意念的修习。

orgs.name: Watsuji Tetsurō
orgs.description: Japanese philosopher who described human being as 'betweenness' (aidagara), always embodied in relations and in climate (fūdo), a counterpoint to individualist views of the body.
orgs.description_zh: 日本哲学家，把人的存在描述为“间柄”（aidagara）：总是具身于人际关系与“风土”之中，与个人主义的身体观形成对照。

orgs.name: Wayne McGregor
orgs.description: British choreographer who works with cognitive scientists and AI, from studies of choreographic thinking to Living Archive, a tool trained on his archive that proposes movement to dancers.
orgs.description_zh: 英国编舞家，与认知科学家及 AI 合作，从“编舞思维”研究到 Living Archive：一个以其作品档案训练、为舞者提议动作的工具。
known_for: Living Archive: An AI Performance Experiment (2019, with Google Arts & Culture)

orgs.name: Wen Hui
orgs.description: Beijing choreographer who co-founded Living Dance Studio, China's first independent dance company, and makes documentary dance from women's and everyday bodies and their memories.
orgs.description_zh: 北京编舞家，与吴文光共同创立中国第一个独立舞团“生活舞蹈工作室”，以女性与日常身体及其记忆创作纪录剧场式舞蹈。
known_for: Living Dance Studio (co-founded 1994 with Wu Wenguang)

orgs.name: Wilhelm Reich
orgs.description: Austrian psychoanalyst who argued that emotional history is held in the body as 'muscular armour', founding body psychotherapy; later lineages include bioenergetics and Hakomi.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利精神分析师，主张情绪史以“肌肉盔甲”的形式储存在身体中，开创身体心理治疗；生物能疗法与 Hakomi 等都承其脉络。

orgs.name: William Forsythe
orgs.description: Choreographer whose Improvisation Technologies and Synchronous Objects made the principles of movement visible and analysable, bridging choreography and computing.
orgs.description_zh: 编舞家，他的《Improvisation Technologies》与《Synchronous Objects》让动作的原理可视、可分析，架起了编舞与计算之间的桥梁。

orgs.name: William James
orgs.description: American pragmatist and psychologist who argued that emotion is the feeling of bodily changes ('we feel sorry because we cry'), an early body-first theory of emotion that affective loops return to.
orgs.description_zh: 美国实用主义者与心理学家，主张情绪就是对身体变化的感受（“我们因为哭泣而感到难过”），这一早期“身体先行”的情绪理论为情感回路所重拾。

orgs.name: Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (YCAM)
orgs.description: An art centre in Yamaguchi, Japan, whose in-house YCAM InterLab develops media technology with artists, including Reactor for Awareness in Motion (RAM), a dance-creation toolkit made with Forsythe dancer Yoko Ando.
orgs.description_zh: 日本山口市的艺术中心，其内部的 YCAM InterLab 与艺术家共同开发媒体技术，例如与 Forsythe 舞团舞者安藤洋子合作的舞蹈创作工具 Reactor for Awareness in Motion（RAM）。

orgs.name: Yang Rur-bin
orgs.description: Philosopher at National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan whose studies of the Confucian view of the body trace how qi, form and mind were understood as one cultivated whole in classical Chinese thought.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾清华大学哲学学者，其儒家身体观研究梳理了中国古典思想中气、形与心如何被视为一个可以修养的整体。
known_for: 儒家身体观 (The Confucian View of the Body, 1996)
中国古代思想中的气论及身体观 (ed., 1993)

orgs.name: Ylva Fernaeus
orgs.description: Professor at Umeå Institute of Design and KTH (PhD co-supervised by Höök) working on tangible and embodied interaction and design philosophy, from robotic pets to wabi-sabi and joyful movement; she supervised Tsaknaki and Helms.
orgs.description_zh: 于默奥设计学院与 KTH 教授（博士由 Höök 合作指导），研究实体与具身交互及设计哲学，从机器宠物到侘寂与“愉悦的运动”；她指导过 Tsaknaki 与 Helms。
known_for: How do you play with a robotic toy animal? A long-term study of Pleo (IDC 2010)
The material move: how materials matter in interaction design research (DIS 2012)
Expanding on Wabi-Sabi as a Design Resource in HCI (CHI 2016)

orgs.name: Yoav Luft
orgs.description: KTH PhD candidate studying how designers can programme touch on the body with shape-changing garments; co-author of 'Boards Hit Back', which reflects on martial arts practice through soma design.
orgs.description_zh: KTH 博士生，研究设计师如何借形变服装为身体“编程”触觉；论文《Boards Hit Back》的作者之一，通过身体设计反思武术修习。
known_for: Boards Hit Back: Reflecting on Martial Arts Practices Through Soma Design (CHI 2023)

orgs.name: Yuasa Yasuo
orgs.description: Japanese philosopher who argued that in Eastern thought body-mind unity is not a given but an achievement of self-cultivation (shugyō) through practices such as meditation and the martial arts, a source for soma design's attention to training the body.
orgs.description_zh: 日本哲学家，主张在东方思想中，身心合一不是现成的状态，而是通过冥想、武道等修行（修行）而达成的成就；这是身体设计重视身体训练的思想来源之一。
known_for: The Body: Toward an Eastern Mind-Body Theory (1977; English 1987)

orgs.name: Yvonne Rainer
orgs.description: Judson Dance Theater choreographer whose Trio A stripped dance to task-like, everyday movement, turning attention to the ordinary moving body.
orgs.description_zh: 贾德森舞蹈剧场编舞家，《Trio A》把舞蹈剥离为如同完成任务的日常动作，把注意转向普通的运动身体。

orgs.name: Zhang Huan
orgs.description: Chinese artist from Beijing's East Village whose endurance performances, such as sitting covered in honey in a public latrine, use the body to register physical and social conditions.
orgs.description_zh: 出自北京东村的中国艺术家，他的耐力行为作品（如在公厕中浑身涂满蜂蜜静坐）以身体记录物质与社会的处境。
known_for: To Add One Meter to an Anonymous Mountain (1995)

orgs.name: Zhuying Li
orgs.description: Southeast University associate professor whose Exertion Games Lab PhD invented 'ingestible play', games such as The Guts Game and HeatCraft built around swallowable sensors that engage people with their inner body.
orgs.description_zh: 东南大学副教授，在 Exertion Games Lab 的博士研究开创了“可吞食游戏”：如 The Guts Game 与 HeatCraft，以可吞服传感器让人与自己的体内相遇。
known_for: The Guts Game: Towards Designing Ingestible Games (CHI PLAY 2018)
HeatCraft: experiencing body temperature from an ingestible sensor as localised heat
A Design Framework for Ingestible Play (ACM TOCHI, 2023)

orgs.name: Åsa Unander-Scharin
orgs.description: Choreographer and professor at Luleå University of Technology who choreographs robots and drones, from the industrial robot of The Lamentations of Orpheus to Robocygne. She co-authored the drone opera studies 'Dancing With Drones' and 'Ethics in Movement' with Höök.
orgs.description_zh: 编舞家、吕勒奥理工大学教授，为机器人与无人机编舞，从《The Lamentations of Orpheus》中的工业机器人到《Robocygne》。她与 Höök 合写了无人机歌剧研究《Dancing With Drones》与《Ethics in Movement》。
known_for: The Lamentations of Orpheus (1998, choreography for an industrial robot)
